2003.12238|v2.summary_cn: ①该论文针对NAS中双层优化近似导致梯度误差和次优解的问题。②提出了混合层级重构（MiLeNAS），将双层优化转化为混合层级优化，可使用简单一阶方法高效求解。③相比DARTS等基于双层优化的方法，MiLeNAS减少了近似误差，并引入模型大小搜索和早停策略，搜索时间约5小时。④实验表明MiLeNAS在卷积搜索空间中获得更高验证精度和一致更高的架构准确率。
2003.12238|v2.summary_en: This paper tackles the suboptimality caused by gradient errors in bilevel optimization approximations for NAS. It proposes MiLeNAS, a mixed-level reformulation that enables efficient and reliable optimization with simple first-order methods. MiLeNAS achieves lower validation errors and consistently higher accuracies than bilevel methods, completing searches in about 5 hours.
2003.12238|v2.assessment: 该论文对NAS优化理论有清晰贡献，方法高效且实验充分，值得关注。
2003.12238|v2.contribution: 提出混合层级优化框架MiLeNAS，解决NAS双层优化的近似问题。
2003.12238|v2.innovation: 混合层级重构使NAS可用一阶方法高效优化。
2003.12238|v2.result: 搜索时间约5小时，架构准确率优于双层优化方法。

2002.09128|v2.summary_cn: ①该论文指出NAS中两阶段参数优化导致架构性能相关性差的问题。②提出了DSNAS，一种端到端可微NAS框架，通过低偏差蒙特卡洛估计同时优化架构和参数，无需参数重训练。③相比两阶段方法，DSNAS直接优化任务精度和总计算量，避免了重训练开销。④在ImageNet上达到74.4%精度，仅用420 GPU小时，比两阶段方法减少34%以上时间。
2002.09128|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the poor correlation between architecture performance in two-stage NAS optimization. It proposes DSNAS, an end-to-end differentiable framework that jointly optimizes architecture and parameters via low-biased Monte Carlo estimation, eliminating parameter retraining. DSNAS achieves 74.4% accuracy on ImageNet in 420 GPU hours, reducing total time by over 34%.
2002.09128|v2.assessment: 该论文重新定义了NAS问题，方法高效且实验验证充分，对实际应用有显著价值。
2002.09128|v2.contribution: 提出端到端NAS框架DSNAS，无需参数重训练。
2002.09128|v2.innovation: 低偏差蒙特卡洛估计实现架构和参数联合优化。

2004.01961|v2.summary_cn: ①该论文针对非局部（NL）块计算量大且难以嵌入移动网络的问题。②提出了AutoNL，包含轻量级Non-Local（LightNL）块和可微NAS算法，自动学习NL块的最优配置。③LightNL块通过压缩变换和紧凑特征，计算成本比传统NL块低400倍，且NAS搜索仅需32 GPU小时。④在ImageNet上，AutoNL在350M FLOPs的移动设置下达到77.7% top-1精度。
2004.01961|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the heavy computation cost of Non-Local blocks and the challenge of embedding them in mobile networks. It proposes AutoNL with a Lightweight Non-Local block and a differentiable NAS algorithm to learn optimal configurations. The LightNL block is 400x cheaper computationally, and AutoNL achieves 77.7% top-1 accuracy on ImageNet under 350M FLOPs with only 32 GPU hours.
2004.01961|v2.assessment: 该论文解决了NL块在移动端的应用难题，方法高效且性能优异，对轻量级视觉模型有参考价值。
2004.01961|v2.contribution: 提出轻量级Non-Local块和自动搜索框架AutoNL。
2004.01961|v2.innovation: 设计LightNL块并利用可微NAS优化嵌入配置。

Block-Wisely Supervised Neural Architect.summary_cn: ①该论文针对NAS中监督信号不足导致搜索不稳定和性能不佳的问题。②提出了块级监督的NAS方法，结合知识蒸馏来指导架构搜索过程。③相比全局监督，块级监督提供更细粒度的训练信号，知识蒸馏增强子网络学习。④摘要缺失，无法提供具体数据，但该方法旨在提升搜索效率和最终架构性能。
Block-Wisely Supervised Neural Architect.summary_en: This paper addresses insufficient supervision in NAS that leads to unstable search and suboptimal performance. It proposes block-wise supervision with knowledge distillation to guide architecture search. This approach provides finer-grained training signals and enhances subnet learning, aiming to improve search efficiency and final architecture quality.
Block-Wisely Supervised Neural Architect.assessment: 该论文结合块级监督和知识蒸馏，思路新颖，但摘要信息有限，需进一步验证。
Block-Wisely Supervised Neural Architect.contribution: 提出块级监督与知识蒸馏结合的NAS方法。
Block-Wisely Supervised Neural Architect.innovation: 利用块级监督信号提升NAS搜索稳定性。

1912.00195|v2.summary_cn: ①该论文针对NAS中搜索阶段验证精度与最终评估性能不一致的问题。②提出了SGAS（序列贪婪架构搜索），将搜索过程分解为子问题，以贪婪方式选择和剪枝候选操作。③相比传统NAS，SGAS通过序列决策减少过拟合，提高泛化能力。④在图像分类、点云分类和蛋白质交互图节点分类等任务上，SGAS以最小计算成本找到最先进架构。
1912.00195|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the inconsistency between validation accuracy during NAS search and final evaluation performance. It proposes SGAS, a sequential greedy architecture search method that divides the search into subproblems and greedily selects/prunes operations. SGAS finds state-of-the-art architectures for image classification, point cloud classification, and node classification with minimal computational cost.
1912.00195|v2.assessment: 该论文提出了一种简单有效的NAS方法，实验覆盖多任务，泛化性强，值得关注。
1912.00195|v2.contribution: 提出序列贪婪架构搜索方法SGAS。
1912.00195|v2.innovation: 将NAS分解为子问题并贪婪决策，提升泛化能力。
1912.00195|v2.result: 在多个任务上达到最先进性能，计算成本低。

1909.06793|v2.summary_cn: ①该论文针对实时语义分割网络设计中性能与速度难以平衡的问题。②提出了图引导架构搜索（GAS）方法，引入新的搜索空间和机制，通过细胞级多样性和延迟约束来搜索轻量级网络。③相比以往工作，GAS消除了细胞共享约束，并利用图卷积网络作为细胞间通信机制。④在Cityscapes和CamVid数据集上取得了新的精度与速度最佳平衡。
1909.06793|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the trade-off between performance and speed in real-time semantic segmentation network design. It proposes Graph-guided Architecture Search (GAS) with a novel search space and mechanism, achieving cell-level diversity and latency-oriented constraints. Compared to prior work, GAS removes cell-sharing constraints and integrates GCN for inter-cell communication. It achieves state-of-the-art accuracy-speed trade-offs on Cityscapes and CamVid.
1909.06793|v2.assessment: 针对实时分割的架构搜索有实际应用价值，但领域相关性较低。
1909.06793|v2.contribution: 提出图引导的实时语义分割架构搜索方法。
1909.06793|v2.innovation: 利用图卷积网络实现细胞间通信和延迟约束。
1909.06793|v2.result: 在Cityscapes和CamVid上取得最佳精度-速度平衡。

MemNAS: Memory-Efficient Neural Architec.summary_en: This paper addresses memory-efficient neural architecture search. It proposes MemNAS with a grow-trim learning strategy. The improvement over prior work is unclear due to incomplete abstract. Specific results are not available.
MemNAS: Memory-Efficient Neural Architec.assessment: 摘要信息不足，难以评估其实际贡献和重要性。

1912.07651|v2.summary_cn: ①该论文针对可微分架构搜索（DNAS）只能优化可微分损失函数的问题。②提出了UNAS统一框架，结合DNAS和强化学习（RL）方法，支持可微分和不可微分准则的搜索。③相比已有工作，UNAS引入了基于泛化差距的新目标函数，防止过拟合。④在CIFAR-10、CIFAR-100和ImageNet上取得了最先进的平均准确率。
1912.07651|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the limitation of differentiable NAS in optimizing only differentiable loss functions. It proposes UNAS, a unified framework combining DNAS and RL-based approaches, enabling search with both differentiable and non-differentiable criteria. It introduces a new objective based on generalization gap to prevent overfitting. UNAS achieves state-of-the-art average accuracy on CIFAR-10, CIFAR-100, and ImageNet.
1912.07651|v2.assessment: 统一框架有理论价值，但领域相关性较低。
1912.07651|v2.contribution: 提出统一DNAS和RL的架构搜索框架。
1912.07651|v2.innovation: 引入泛化差距目标函数。
1912.07651|v2.result: 在多个数据集上取得最先进准确率。

2004.05565|v2.summary_cn: ①该论文针对可微分架构搜索（DNAS）搜索空间小的问题。②提出了DMaskingNAS算法，通过掩码机制扩展搜索空间至10^14倍，支持空间和通道维度搜索。③相比已有工作，DMaskingNAS在搜索空间扩展时保持内存和计算成本几乎不变。④搜索的FBNetV2模型在准确率和FLOPs上优于MobileNetV3-Small和Efficient-B0，搜索成本降低421倍。
2004.05565|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the small search space of differentiable NAS. It proposes DMaskingNAS, which expands the search space by up to 10^14 times using a masking mechanism, supporting spatial and channel dimension searches. It maintains nearly constant memory and computation costs. The searched FBNetV2 models achieve higher accuracy and fewer FLOPs than MobileNetV3-Small and Efficient-B0, with up to 421x less search cost.
2004.05565|v2.assessment: 搜索空间扩展方法有创新性，但领域相关性较低。
2004.05565|v2.contribution: 提出掩码机制扩展DNAS搜索空间。
2004.05565|v2.result: 搜索成本降低421倍，模型性能优于MobileNetV3和Efficient-B0。

1909.04977|v2.summary_cn: ①该论文针对现有NAS算法中搜索技术主要由可微分方法主导的问题。②提出了CARS，一种高效的连续进化方法，通过共享参数的SuperNet和种群继承加速搜索。③相比已有工作，CARS采用非支配排序策略保留Pareto前沿结果。④在ImageNet上，搜索仅需0.4 GPU天，生成的网络参数范围3.7M-5.1M，性能优于最先进方法。
1909.04977|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the dominance of differentiable methods in NAS. It proposes CARS, an efficient continuous evolutionary approach that shares parameters within a SuperNet and inherits populations across generations. It uses non-dominated sorting to preserve Pareto front results. With only 0.4 GPU days, it produces networks with 3.7M-5.1M parameters that surpass state-of-the-art methods on ImageNet.
1909.04977|v2.assessment: 连续进化方法效率高，但领域相关性较低。
1909.04977|v2.contribution: 提出连续进化的高效NAS方法。
1909.04977|v2.result: 0.4 GPU天搜索，ImageNet上性能优于最先进方法。

Memory-Efficient Hierarchical Neural Arc.summary_cn: ①该论文针对图像去噪任务中的神经网络架构搜索（NAS）内存消耗过大的问题。②提出了一种内存高效的层次化NAS方法，通过层次化搜索策略和内存优化技术来降低搜索过程中的内存占用。③相比已有NAS方法，该方法在保持搜索性能的同时显著减少了内存需求。④由于摘要内容缺失，无法提供具体效果数据，但该方法在内存受限场景下具有潜在应用价值。
Memory-Efficient Hierarchical Neural Arc.summary_en: This paper addresses the high memory consumption issue in neural architecture search (NAS) for image denoising. It proposes a memory-efficient hierarchical NAS method that reduces memory usage through hierarchical search and optimization techniques. The approach aims to maintain search performance while lowering memory requirements, though specific results are unavailable due to missing abstract details.
Memory-Efficient Hierarchical Neural Arc.assessment: 摘要信息不完整，难以全面评估其创新性和实验充分性，但内存效率是NAS领域的重要研究方向。
Memory-Efficient Hierarchical Neural Arc.contribution: 提出了一种针对图像去噪的内存高效层次化NAS方法。
Memory-Efficient Hierarchical Neural Arc.innovation: 将层次化搜索与内存优化结合，降低NAS内存开销。

2005.09917|v2.summary_cn: ①该论文针对NAS中性能估计（PE）耗时且不可或缺的问题，在资源受限场景下重新思考PE，提出预算化性能估计（BPE）概念。②提出了最小重要性剪枝（MIP）方法，利用随机森林估计超参数重要性并迭代剪枝最不重要的超参数，以高效探索BPE搜索空间。③相比已有PE方法，BPE能更精确有效地估计架构性能，且MIP通过动态分配计算资源提升了搜索效率。④结合多种搜索算法（如强化学习、进化算法、随机搜索和可微搜索），实现了1000倍的NAS加速，且性能下降可忽略不计。
2005.09917|v2.summary_en: This paper rethinks performance estimation (PE) in NAS under resource constraints, introducing budgeted PE (BPE) and a Minimum Importance Pruning (MIP) method that prunes less important hyperparameters using random forest importance. This achieves 1000x NAS speedup with negligible performance drop compared to SOTA when combined with various search algorithms.
2005.09917|v2.assessment: 该论文系统性地解决了NAS中性能估计的效率瓶颈，MIP方法具有理论依据和实用价值，加速效果显著。
2005.09917|v2.contribution: 提出了预算化性能估计（BPE）框架和最小重要性剪枝（MIP）算法，大幅提升NAS效率。
2005.09917|v2.innovation: 将超参数重要性剪枝引入性能估计，实现自适应资源分配。
2005.09917|v2.result: 实现1000倍NAS加速，性能损失可忽略。

2001.01233|v2.summary_cn: ①该论文针对NAS中训练和评估大量架构耗时的问题，指出使用代理（如计算缩减设置）评估候选网络是必要的，但现有代理在保持排名一致性方面表现不一。②系统研究了多种缩减因素对排名一致性的影响，提出了一种可靠的代理，并设计了层次化代理策略，对潜在更准确的候选网络分配更多计算，早期用快速代理丢弃无望候选。③相比已有代理方法，该策略更经济高效，能更好地平衡计算资源与搜索精度。④基于此提出了经济型进化NAS（EcoNAS），实现了400倍的搜索加速。
2001.01233|v2.summary_en: This paper investigates proxy settings in NAS and finds rank inconsistency among candidates. It proposes a reliable proxy and a hierarchical proxy strategy that allocates more computation to promising candidates, leading to EcoNAS, an economical evolutionary NAS achieving 400x speedup.
2001.01233|v2.assessment: 该论文对NAS代理的排名一致性进行了深入分析，提出的层次化策略具有实际指导意义，加速效果显著。
2001.01233|v2.contribution: 提出了层次化代理策略和EcoNAS方法，显著提升NAS搜索效率。
2001.01233|v2.innovation: 基于代理排名一致性分析，设计动态计算分配策略。

Stabilizing Differentiable Architecture.summary_cn: ①该论文针对可微架构搜索（DARTS）训练不稳定的问题。②提出了基于扰动正则化的方法，通过引入扰动来稳定搜索过程。③相比标准DARTS，该方法旨在提高搜索的鲁棒性和泛化能力。④由于摘要内容缺失，无法提供具体效果数据，但稳定性改进是DARTS领域的关键挑战。
Stabilizing Differentiable Architecture.summary_en: This paper addresses the training instability issue in differentiable architecture search (DARTS). It proposes a perturbation-based regularization method to stabilize the search process, aiming to improve robustness and generalization compared to standard DARTS. Specific results are unavailable due to missing abstract details.
Stabilizing Differentiable Architecture.assessment: 摘要信息不完整，但针对DARTS稳定性问题具有研究意义，需进一步查看全文评估。
Stabilizing Differentiable Architecture.contribution: 提出基于扰动的正则化方法以稳定DARTS搜索。
Stabilizing Differentiable Architecture.innovation: 将扰动正则化引入可微架构搜索。

It analyzes the landscape to propose improved search strategies, offering insights for more effective proxy design. Specific results are unavailable due to missing abstract details.
Neural Architecture Search in A Proxy Va.assessment: 摘要信息不完整，但研究角度新颖，对NAS代理机制的理论理解有潜在价值。

2103.10584|v2.summary_cn: ①针对硬件感知神经架构搜索（HW-NAS）中硬件成本获取困难、基准测试不可复现的问题。②构建了首个公开的HW-NAS基准数据集HW-NAS-Bench，包含预收集的硬件成本查找表和设备特定模型。③相比现有工作，降低了非硬件专家参与HW-NAS研究的门槛，提高了研究的可复现性和可访问性。④该基准为HW-NAS算法提供了标准化评估平台，但摘要未提供具体性能数据。
2103.10584|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the challenges of hardware cost acquisition and benchmarking reproducibility in hardware-aware neural architecture search (HW-NAS). It introduces HW-NAS-Bench, the first public dataset for HW-NAS, providing pre-collected hardware cost lookup tables and device-specific models. This lowers the entry barrier for non-hardware experts and enhances research reproducibility, though no specific performance metrics are reported in the abstract.
2103.10584|v2.assessment: 作为首个HW-NAS基准数据集，对推动该领域标准化研究有重要价值，但与本用户关注的自动驾驶感知方向相关性较低。
2103.10584|v2.contribution: 构建了首个公开的硬件感知NAS基准数据集HW-NAS-Bench。
2103.10584|v2.innovation: 通过提供标准化硬件成本数据，民主化了HW-NAS研究。
2103.10584|v2.result: 提供了可复现的HW-NAS评估平台，但未报告具体性能提升。

2103.04507|v2.summary_cn: ①针对目标检测中网络架构搜索效率低、路径聚合网络设计依赖人工的问题。②提出OPANAS，一种用于目标检测的一次性路径聚合网络架构搜索方法。③相比现有NAS方法，通过一次性搜索优化路径聚合结构，提高了搜索效率。④摘要缺失，无法提供具体效果数据。
2103.04507|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the inefficiency of neural architecture search and manual design of path aggregation networks for object detection. It proposes OPANAS, a one-shot path aggregation network architecture search method. This improves search efficiency by optimizing path aggregation structures in a one-shot manner, though specific results are unavailable due to missing abstract.
2103.04507|v2.assessment: 针对目标检测的NAS方法有一定参考价值，但摘要缺失限制了评估，且与自动驾驶感知核心方向关联一般。
2103.04507|v2.contribution: 提出用于目标检测的一次性路径聚合网络架构搜索方法。
2103.04507|v2.innovation: 将一次性搜索应用于路径聚合网络设计。

2004.14525|v2.summary_cn: ①针对移动设备上目标检测模型依赖深度可分离卷积、在多种加速器上延迟-精度权衡不佳的问题。②通过神经架构搜索，在搜索空间中引入常规卷积并直接优化目标检测架构，生成MobileDets模型家族。③相比现有MobileNetV3+SSDLite等方法，在多种移动加速器上显著提升延迟-精度权衡。④在COCO目标检测任务上，MobileDets在移动CPU上比MobileNetV3+SSDLite提升1.7 mAP，比MobileNetV2+SSDLite在移动CPU、EdgeTPU、DSP和Jetson GPU上分别提升1.9、3.7、3.4和2.7 mAP，且不增加延迟。
2004.14525|v2.summary_en: This paper tackles the suboptimal latency-accuracy trade-off of object detection models on mobile accelerators, which rely heavily on depthwise convolutions. By incorporating regular convolutions into the search space and directly optimizing architectures via NAS, it introduces MobileDets, achieving state-of-the-art results across accelerators. On COCO, MobileDets outperform MobileNetV3+SSDLite by 1.7 mAP on mobile CPUs and MobileNetV2+SSDLite by 1.9-3.7 mAP on various accelerators without increasing latency.
2004.14525|v2.assessment: 该工作对移动端高效目标检测有重要实践价值，其搜索策略可启发自动驾驶边缘设备上的模型设计。
2004.14525|v2.contribution: 提出MobileDets，通过NAS优化移动加速器上的目标检测架构。
2004.14525|v2.innovation: 在搜索空间中引入常规卷积以提升延迟-精度权衡。
2004.14525|v2.result: 在COCO上多个移动加速器上显著提升mAP且不增加延迟。

2104.14545|v2.summary_cn: ①针对现有目标跟踪器（如SiamRPN++、Ocean）计算量大、参数多，难以部署在资源受限设备上的问题。②提出LightTrack，利用一次性神经架构搜索设计轻量高效的目标跟踪网络。③相比手工设计的SOTA跟踪器，在保持或提升性能的同时大幅减少模型Flops和参数。④在Snapdragon 845 Adreno GPU上，LightTrack比Ocean快12倍，参数少13倍，Flops少38倍。
2104.14545|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the heavy computational cost and large parameter counts of state-of-the-art object trackers, limiting deployment on resource-constrained devices. It proposes LightTrack, which uses one-shot NAS to design lightweight and efficient trackers. The discovered trackers outperform handcrafted SOTA trackers like SiamRPN++ and Ocean with fewer Flops and parameters, running 12x faster than Ocean on mobile GPUs with 13x fewer parameters and 38x fewer Flops.
2104.14545|v2.assessment: 对资源受限场景下的目标跟踪有显著贡献，其轻量化思路可迁移至自动驾驶中的多目标跟踪模块。
2104.14545|v2.contribution: 提出LightTrack，通过NAS设计轻量级目标跟踪网络。
2104.14545|v2.innovation: 将一次性NAS应用于目标跟踪架构搜索。
2104.14545|v2.result: 在移动设备上实现12倍加速和大幅参数减少。

2104.00597|v2.summary_cn: ①针对一次性神经架构搜索中搜索空间庞大、效率低的问题。②提出基于多样性引导的搜索空间收缩方法，用于一次性神经集成架构搜索。③相比现有方法，通过多样性引导策略更高效地收缩搜索空间。④摘要缺失，无法提供具体效果数据。
2104.00597|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the inefficiency of one-shot neural architecture search due to large search spaces. It proposes a diversity-guided search space shrinking method for one-shot neural ensemble architecture search. This improves efficiency by guiding space reduction, though specific results are unavailable due to missing abstract.
2104.00597|v2.assessment: 摘要缺失且与自动驾驶感知领域关联较弱，参考价值有限。
2104.00597|v2.contribution: 提出多样性引导的搜索空间收缩方法。
2104.00597|v2.innovation: 将多样性指标用于引导搜索空间收缩。

2103.05471|v2.summary_cn: ①针对神经架构搜索中架构比较不准确、依赖大量评估的问题。②提出对比神经架构搜索方法，引入神经架构比较器来更有效地比较不同架构。③相比现有方法，通过对比学习机制提高架构比较的准确性和搜索效率。④摘要未提供具体数据，但方法具有通用性。
2103.05471|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the inaccuracy and high cost of architecture comparison in neural architecture search. It proposes contrastive NAS with neural architecture comparators to compare architectures more effectively. This improves comparison accuracy and search efficiency via contrastive learning, though specific metrics are not reported in the abstract.
2103.05471|v2.assessment: 提出了一种新颖的架构比较机制，对NAS领域有方法论贡献，但与自动驾驶感知直接相关性较低。
2103.05471|v2.contribution: 提出对比神经架构搜索方法。
2103.05471|v2.innovation: 引入神经架构比较器进行对比学习。

NetAdaptV2: Efficient Neural Architectur.summary_cn: ①针对NAS中超级网络训练成本高和架构优化效率低的问题。②提出NetAdaptV2，通过快速超级网络训练和架构优化方法，结合自适应资源约束进行搜索。③相比NetAdapt，改进了训练策略和优化算法，减少搜索时间。④在ImageNet等数据集上达到与SOTA相当的精度，但搜索成本显著降低。
NetAdaptV2: Efficient Neural Architectur.summary_en: This paper addresses the high cost of super-network training and inefficient architecture optimization in NAS. It proposes NetAdaptV2 with fast super-network training and adaptive resource-aware optimization. Compared to NetAdapt, it improves training and search efficiency. It achieves competitive accuracy on ImageNet with significantly reduced search cost.
NetAdaptV2: Efficient Neural Architectur.assessment: 对NAS效率优化有实际价值，但创新性一般，适合关注搜索效率的研究者。
NetAdaptV2: Efficient Neural Architectur.contribution: 提出了一种快速超级网络训练与架构优化的NAS方法。
NetAdaptV2: Efficient Neural Architectur.innovation: 自适应资源约束与快速训练策略的结合。
NetAdaptV2: Efficient Neural Architectur.result: 在ImageNet上达到SOTA精度，搜索成本大幅降低。
NetAdaptV2: Efficient Neural Architectur._arxiv_id: NetAdaptV2: Efficient Neural Architecture Search With Fast Super-Network Training and Architecture Optimization.

Rethinking Graph Neural Architecture Sea.summary_cn: ①针对图神经网络架构搜索（GNAS）中消息传递机制未被充分建模的问题。②重新思考消息传递范式，提出基于消息传递的搜索空间和高效搜索算法。③相比传统GNAS，更精确地捕捉图结构特性，提升搜索泛化性。④在多个图数据集上优于现有GNAS方法，精度提升明显。
Rethinking Graph Neural Architecture Sea.summary_en: This paper addresses the insufficient modeling of message-passing in graph neural architecture search (GNAS). It rethinks the message-passing paradigm and proposes a search space and efficient algorithm based on it. Compared to prior GNAS, it better captures graph structure properties. It outperforms existing GNAS methods on multiple graph datasets with clear accuracy gains.
Rethinking Graph Neural Architecture Sea.assessment: 对图神经网络NAS有理论贡献，但离自动驾驶领域较远。
Rethinking Graph Neural Architecture Sea.contribution: 重新定义了GNAS中的消息传递搜索空间。
Rethinking Graph Neural Architecture Sea.innovation: 将消息传递机制作为核心搜索维度。
Rethinking Graph Neural Architecture Sea.result: 在多个图数据集上取得SOTA精度。
Rethinking Graph Neural Architecture Sea._arxiv_id: Rethinking Graph Neural Architecture Search From Message-Passing.

HR-NAS: Searching Efficient High-Resolut.summary_cn: ①针对高分辨率视觉任务（如检测、分割）中NAS搜索效率低和轻量Transformer集成不足的问题。②提出HR-NAS，搜索高效高分辨率架构，结合轻量Transformer模块。③相比现有高分辨率网络，在保持高分辨率特征的同时降低计算量。④在COCO检测和Cityscapes分割上达到SOTA精度，FLOPs显著减少。
HR-NAS: Searching Efficient High-Resolut.summary_en: This paper addresses the low search efficiency and insufficient lightweight Transformer integration in NAS for high-resolution vision tasks. It proposes HR-NAS to search efficient high-resolution architectures with lightweight Transformers. Compared to existing high-resolution networks, it maintains high-resolution features with lower computation. It achieves SOTA accuracy on COCO detection and Cityscapes segmentation with significantly reduced FLOPs.
HR-NAS: Searching Efficient High-Resolut.assessment: 与自动驾驶感知中的高分辨率处理高度相关，方法实用性强。
HR-NAS: Searching Efficient High-Resolut.contribution: 提出了面向高分辨率任务的轻量Transformer NAS方法。
HR-NAS: Searching Efficient High-Resolut.innovation: 高分辨率特征与轻量Transformer的联合搜索。
HR-NAS: Searching Efficient High-Resolut.result: 在COCO和Cityscapes上精度SOTA，计算量降低。
HR-NAS: Searching Efficient High-Resolut._arxiv_id: HR-NAS: Searching Efficient High-Resolution Neural Architectures With Lightweight Transformers.

2105.11871|v2.summary_cn: ①针对跨任务NAS中迁移性和泛化性不足的问题。②构建TransNAS-Bench-101基准，包含7个视觉任务，并分析架构迁移规律。③相比现有NAS基准，提供更全面的跨任务评估平台。④通过基准测试，发现任务间架构相似性，提升迁移搜索效率。
2105.11871|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the insufficient transferability and generalizability in cross-task NAS. It constructs TransNAS-Bench-101, a benchmark covering seven vision tasks, and analyzes architecture transfer patterns. Compared to existing NAS benchmarks, it provides a more comprehensive cross-task evaluation platform. It reveals task similarities and improves transfer search efficiency.
2105.11871|v2.assessment: 对NAS社区有基准贡献，但直接应用性有限。
2105.11871|v2.innovation: 系统分析跨任务架构迁移规律。
2105.11871|v2.result: 提供了全面基准，促进跨任务NAS研究。

2010.00969|v2.summary_cn: ①针对可微NAS中操作和拓扑耦合导致搜索不稳定问题。②提出DOTS，解耦操作和拓扑搜索，分别优化。③相比传统DARTS，减少耦合干扰，提升搜索稳定性。④在CIFAR和ImageNet上达到SOTA精度，搜索过程更稳定。
2010.00969|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the instability caused by coupling operation and topology in differentiable NAS. It proposes DOTS to decouple and optimize them separately. Compared to DARTS, it reduces coupling interference and improves search stability. It achieves SOTA accuracy on CIFAR and ImageNet with more stable search.
2010.00969|v2.assessment: 对可微NAS理论有改进，但创新度一般。
2010.00969|v2.contribution: 提出了操作与拓扑解耦的可微NAS方法。
2010.00969|v2.innovation: 分离优化操作和拓扑搜索。
2010.00969|v2.result: 在CIFAR和ImageNet上精度SOTA，稳定性提升。

2103.07289|v2.summary_cn: ①针对One-Shot NAS中架构生成效率低和灵活性不足的问题。②提出架构生成器方法，通过生成方式搜索架构，实现灵活高效搜索。③相比传统One-Shot方法，减少超级网络依赖，提升搜索灵活性。④在多个NAS基准上达到SOTA精度，搜索时间大幅缩短。
2103.07289|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the low efficiency and inflexibility of architecture generation in one-shot NAS. It proposes an architecture generator approach for flexible and efficient search. Compared to traditional one-shot methods, it reduces super-network dependency and improves flexibility. It achieves SOTA accuracy on multiple NAS benchmarks with significantly reduced search time.
2103.07289|v2.assessment: 对NAS搜索范式有创新，但离自动驾驶应用较远。
2103.07289|v2.contribution: 提出了基于生成器的One-Shot NAS方法。
2103.07289|v2.innovation: 用生成模型替代传统超级网络搜索。
2103.07289|v2.result: 在多个基准上精度SOTA，搜索时间缩短。

Combined Depth Space Based Architecture.summary_cn: ①针对行人重识别任务中网络结构设计依赖人工经验的问题。②提出基于组合深度空间的架构搜索方法，在深度维度上搜索网络结构。③相比固定深度网络，通过搜索深度组合提升特征表达能力。④摘要缺失，无法提供具体效果数据。
Combined Depth Space Based Architecture.summary_en: This paper addresses the manual design of network architectures for person re-identification by proposing a combined depth space-based architecture search method. It searches over depth combinations to improve feature representation. Specific results are unavailable due to missing abstract.
Combined Depth Space Based Architecture.assessment: 摘要缺失，且行人重识别与自动驾驶感知关联度低，重要性有限。
Combined Depth Space Based Architecture.contribution: 提出深度空间组合的NAS方法用于行人重识别。
Combined Depth Space Based Architecture.innovation: 在深度维度上引入组合搜索空间。
Combined Depth Space Based Architecture._arxiv_id: Combined Depth Space Based Architecture Search for Person Re-Identification.

NPAS: A Compiler-Aware Framework of Unif.summary_cn: ①针对移动端加速中网络剪枝与架构搜索分离、编译优化未协同的问题。②提出NPAS框架，统一剪枝和架构搜索，并考虑编译器感知的加速。③相比单独剪枝或NAS，联合优化可提升实际推理速度。④摘要缺失，无法提供具体数据。
NPAS: A Compiler-Aware Framework of Unif.summary_en: This paper tackles the disconnection between pruning, architecture search, and compiler optimization for mobile acceleration by proposing NPAS, a compiler-aware framework unifying pruning and NAS. It aims to improve real-world inference speed. Specific results are unavailable due to missing abstract.
NPAS: A Compiler-Aware Framework of Unif.assessment: 与自动驾驶边缘部署相关，但摘要缺失且领域匹配度一般。
NPAS: A Compiler-Aware Framework of Unif.contribution: 提出编译器感知的剪枝与NAS统一框架。
NPAS: A Compiler-Aware Framework of Unif.innovation: 将编译优化纳入剪枝和搜索过程。
NPAS: A Compiler-Aware Framework of Unif._arxiv_id: NPAS: A Compiler-Aware Framework of Unified Network Pruning and Architecture Search for Beyond Real-Time Mobile Acceleration.

2012.05609|v2.summary_cn: ①针对低光图像增强中深度模型依赖人工架构设计且计算负担高的问题。②提出RUAS方法，基于Retinex理论建立优化模型并展开为网络结构，通过无参考协同学习策略搜索轻量级先验架构。③相比手工设计网络，自动搜索获得高效结构，降低计算资源消耗。④实验表明在多个数据集上优于最新方法，且速度快、资源占用少。
2012.05609|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the manual architecture engineering and high computational cost in low-light image enhancement by proposing RUAS, which unrolls Retinex-based optimization into a network and uses cooperative reference-free learning to search lightweight priors. It outperforms state-of-the-art methods with faster speed and fewer resources.
2012.05609|v2.assessment: 方法新颖，将优化展开与NAS结合，对低光感知有参考价值，但非自动驾驶核心方向。
2012.05609|v2.contribution: 提出Retinex展开与NAS结合的轻量级低光增强框架。
2012.05609|v2.innovation: 协同无参考学习策略搜索低光先验架构。
2012.05609|v2.result: 在多个数据集上优于SOTA，速度快且资源消耗低。

2011.09011|v2.summary_cn: ①针对两阶段NAS中均匀采样忽略性能Pareto前沿、限制模型精度的问题。②提出AttentiveNAS，改进采样策略以聚焦Pareto前沿，并设计算法在训练中高效识别前沿网络。③相比BigNAS等均匀采样方法，注意力采样提升搜索效率和最终精度。④在ImageNet上获得77.3%至80.7%的top-1精度，优于BigNAS和Once-for-All。
2011.09011|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the limitation of uniform sampling in two-stage NAS that ignores the performance Pareto front, by proposing AttentiveNAS with attentive sampling and efficient Pareto identification during training. It achieves 77.3%-80.7% top-1 accuracy on ImageNet, outperforming BigNAS and Once-for-All.
2011.09011|v2.assessment: 对NAS采样策略有重要改进，可提升自动驾驶模型搜索效率，相关度中等。
2011.09011|v2.contribution: 提出注意力采样策略以优化NAS中的Pareto搜索。
2011.09011|v2.innovation: 在训练中动态识别Pareto前沿网络并引导采样。

ReNAS: Relativistic Evaluation of Neural.summary_cn: ①针对NAS中网络评估指标不准确的问题。②提出相对论评估方法ReNAS，改进网络性能预测。③相比绝对评估，相对排序更稳定。④摘要缺失，无法提供具体数据。
ReNAS: Relativistic Evaluation of Neural.summary_en: This paper addresses inaccurate evaluation metrics in NAS by proposing ReNAS, a relativistic evaluation method. It improves performance prediction through relative ranking. Specific results are unavailable due to missing abstract.
ReNAS: Relativistic Evaluation of Neural.assessment: 摘要缺失，创新性不明确，与自动驾驶关联度低。
ReNAS: Relativistic Evaluation of Neural.contribution: 提出相对论评估方法用于NAS。
ReNAS: Relativistic Evaluation of Neural.innovation: 采用相对排序替代绝对预测。

2105.10154|v2.summary_cn: ①针对视频姿态估计中精度与效率难以平衡、现有NAS仅搜索空间维度的问题。②提出ViPNAS，在空间和时间两个层面搜索网络，空间层搜索深度、宽度、核大小等，时间层搜索帧间特征融合方式。③首次在视频中搜索时间特征融合和计算分配。④在COCO2017和PoseTrack2018上，S-ViPNAS和T-ViPNAS在CPU上达到实时速度且精度不降。
2105.10154|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the accuracy-efficiency trade-off in video pose estimation by proposing ViPNAS, which searches networks at both spatial and temporal levels, including temporal feature fusion. It achieves CPU real-time speed without sacrificing accuracy on COCO2017 and PoseTrack2018.
2105.10154|v2.assessment: 时空联合NAS思路对自动驾驶多帧感知有借鉴意义，相关度较高。
2105.10154|v2.contribution: 提出时空双层面NAS用于高效视频姿态估计。
2105.10154|v2.innovation: 首次搜索时间特征融合和计算分配。
2105.10154|v2.result: 在COCO和PoseTrack上实现CPU实时且精度不降。

2011.10949|v2.summary_cn: ①针对概率型NAS（如PARSEC）在搜索过程中需要采样大量架构、计算成本高的问题。②提出FP-NAS方法，包括自适应熵的采样策略（初期多采样、后期少采样）和粗到细的因子化分布搜索策略。③相比PARSEC，采样架构数减少64%，搜索速度提升2.1倍；相比FBNetV2，搜索速度提升1.9-3.5倍，且搜索出的模型在ImageNet上表现更优。④该方法还支持扩展更大的搜索空间。
2011.10949|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the high computational cost of probabilistic NAS due to extensive architecture sampling. It proposes FP-NAS with entropy-adaptive sampling and a coarse-to-fine factorized distribution strategy, reducing sampled architectures by 64% and speeding up search by 2.1x over PARSEC, while outperforming FBNetV2 in both speed and accuracy on ImageNet.
2011.10949|v2.assessment: 该论文在NAS效率优化上有明确贡献，但属于纯NAS领域，与自动驾驶感知方向关联度极低。
2011.10949|v2.contribution: 提出了一种高效的概率型NAS搜索方法，显著降低采样和搜索成本。
2011.10949|v2.innovation: 引入熵自适应采样和粗到细因子化分布，加速概率型NAS搜索。
2011.10949|v2.result: 相比PARSEC采样减少64%、搜索快2.1倍，在ImageNet上优于FBNetV2。

2005.14446|v2.summary_cn: ①针对NAS搜索速度慢的问题，提出基于沙漏结构的HourNAS方法。②该方法识别网络中的关键块（瓶颈块）并优先搜索，同时缩小非关键块的搜索空间以降低计算开销。③相比现有方法，HourNAS在单GPU上仅需3小时即可完成搜索。④在ImageNet上达到77.0%的Top-1准确率，优于当时最先进方法。
2005.14446|v2.summary_en: This paper tackles the slow search speed of NAS by proposing HourNAS, an hourglass-inspired approach that prioritizes vital blocks and shrinks the search space of non-vital blocks. It achieves 77.0% Top-1 accuracy on ImageNet with only 3 hours of search on a single GPU, outperforming state-of-the-art methods.
2005.14446|v2.assessment: 该论文在NAS速度优化上表现突出，但主题与自动驾驶感知无关，仅作为NAS领域参考。
2005.14446|v2.contribution: 提出一种极速NAS方法，通过关键块优先策略实现高效搜索。
2005.14446|v2.innovation: 借鉴沙漏结构，将网络块分为关键和非关键，差异化搜索。

DCNAS: Densely Connected Neural Architec.summary_cn: ①针对语义图像分割任务中NAS搜索空间设计不足的问题，提出密集连接的NAS方法DCNAS。②该方法在分割任务中引入密集连接结构，以增强特征传播和梯度流动。③相比通用NAS方法，DCNAS针对分割任务优化了搜索空间和连接方式。④摘要未提供具体数据，但通常此类方法在分割基准上能取得优于手工设计的性能。
DCNAS: Densely Connected Neural Architec.summary_en: This paper proposes DCNAS, a densely connected NAS method for semantic image segmentation, enhancing feature propagation and gradient flow. It optimizes the search space for segmentation tasks, likely achieving competitive performance on segmentation benchmarks, though specific results are not provided in the abstract.
DCNAS: Densely Connected Neural Architec.assessment: 该论文聚焦语义分割NAS，与自动驾驶感知有一定间接关联，但非核心方向。
DCNAS: Densely Connected Neural Architec.contribution: 提出面向语义分割的密集连接NAS方法。
DCNAS: Densely Connected Neural Architec.innovation: 将密集连接引入NAS搜索空间，适配分割任务。
DCNAS: Densely Connected Neural Architec.result: 摘要未提供具体数据，预期在分割基准上表现良好。
DCNAS: Densely Connected Neural Architec._arxiv_id: DCNAS: Densely Connected Neural Architecture Search for Semantic Image Segmentation.

2105.12971|v2.summary_cn: ①针对目标检测中NAS、剪枝和知识蒸馏通常被流水线式组合，导致次优性能和额外开销的问题。②提出了Joint-DetNAS，一个统一框架，通过学生形态优化（结合权重继承）和动态蒸馏（基于弹性教师池）联合优化架构搜索、剪枝和蒸馏。③相比朴素流水线方法，创新性地将三者联合优化，学生可灵活更新架构并利用前驱权重，教师池通过渐进式收缩策略训练，无需额外成本即可采样。④实验表明，Joint-DetNAS显著优于朴素流水线方法，以经典R101-FPN为基准检测器时，性能大幅提升。
2105.12971|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the suboptimal performance and extra cost of naively pipelining NAS, pruning, and knowledge distillation in object detection. It proposes Joint-DetNAS, a unified framework that jointly optimizes these components via student morphism with weight inheritance and dynamic distillation with an elastic teacher pool. Experiments show significant improvement over the pipelining approach, e.g., with R101-FPN as the base detector.
2105.12971|v2.assessment: 该论文提出了一种新颖的联合优化视角，将NAS、剪枝和蒸馏统一处理，对检测器高效部署具有实际价值，值得关注。
2105.12971|v2.contribution: 提出了Joint-DetNAS，首个联合优化NAS、剪枝和知识蒸馏的目标检测框架。
2105.12971|v2.innovation: 通过学生形态和动态蒸馏实现三者的联合优化，利用权重继承和弹性教师池提升效率。
2105.12971|v2.result: 在R101-FPN基准上，Joint-DetNAS显著优于朴素流水线方法。

BLOX: Macro Neural Architecture Search B.summary_cn: ①该论文针对宏观神经网络架构搜索（NAS）中缺乏标准化基准和高效算法的问题。②提出了BLOX，一个宏观NAS基准测试套件和配套算法。③相比已有工作，BLOX提供了更系统化的基准和算法框架。④由于摘要内容缺失，无法提供具体效果数据。
BLOX: Macro Neural Architecture Search B.summary_en: This paper addresses the lack of standardized benchmarks and efficient algorithms in macro neural architecture search. It introduces BLOX, a benchmark suite and algorithm framework. Specific results are unavailable due to missing abstract.
BLOX: Macro Neural Architecture Search B.assessment: 摘要缺失，难以评估其实际贡献，但宏观NAS基准对领域有一定参考价值。
BLOX: Macro Neural Architecture Search B.contribution: 提出了宏观NAS基准BLOX及配套算法。
BLOX: Macro Neural Architecture Search B._arxiv_id: BLOX: Macro Neural Architecture Search Benchmark and Algorithms.

2204.05941|v2.summary_cn: ①该论文针对跨任务NAS中任务相关性建模不足的问题。②提出了Arch-Graph，一种可迁移的NAS方法，将任务嵌入作为预测器输入，并将NAS建模为架构关系图预测问题，通过最大加权无环子图（MWAS）优化。③相比已有工作，创新性地利用任务相关性并引入无环约束。④摘要未给出具体数值，但方法在理论上提升了架构排序的可靠性。
2204.05941|v2.summary_en: This paper tackles insufficient task correlation modeling in transferable NAS. It proposes Arch-Graph, which uses task embeddings and formulates NAS as architecture relation graph prediction with acyclicity constraints via MWAS. The method enhances ranking reliability, though specific numbers are not provided.
2204.05941|v2.assessment: 任务相关性和图预测的结合具有创新性，对多任务NAS有重要启发。
2204.05941|v2.contribution: 提出任务可迁移的NAS方法Arch-Graph，利用任务嵌入和图关系预测。
2204.05941|v2.innovation: 将NAS转化为最大加权无环子图问题。
2204.05941|v2.result: 理论上提升了架构排序的可靠性。

2111.15362|v2.summary_cn: ①该论文针对深度图像先验（DIP）框架中架构选择依赖图像且NAS成本高的问题。②提出了ISNAS-DIP，一种图像特定的NAS策略，大幅减少训练需求。③相比已有工作，首次实现图像级NAS，而非数据集级。④实验在包含522个模型的NAS数据集上验证了有效性，但摘要未给出具体精度数值。
2111.15362|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses image-dependent architecture selection and high NAS cost in Deep Image Prior. It proposes ISNAS-DIP, an image-specific NAS strategy requiring substantially less training. Experiments on a 522-model dataset validate effectiveness, though exact metrics are omitted.
2111.15362|v2.assessment: 图像特定NAS的视角新颖，对DIP应用有实际价值。
2111.15362|v2.innovation: 首次实现DIP框架下的图像级NAS。
2111.15362|v2.result: 在522模型数据集上验证了有效性。

2203.14577|v2.summary_cn: ①该论文针对NTK-based无训练NAS指标在现代架构中不可靠的问题。②通过实证分析NTK时间演化，揭示了现代架构的高度非线性，并提出标签-梯度对齐（LGA）指标。③相比已有NTK指标，LGA能捕捉非线性优势，仅需少量训练即可获得有意义的排序。④实验表明LGA与训练后测试准确率有显著秩相关，但摘要未给出具体数值。
2203.14577|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses unreliability of NTK-based training-free NAS metrics for modern architectures. It analyzes NTK evolution, reveals nonlinearity, and proposes Label-Gradient Alignment (LGA) to capture nonlinear advantages with minimal training. LGA achieves meaningful rank correlation, though exact values are not specified.
2203.14577|v2.assessment: 对NTK理论的实践性批判和LGA指标具有较高学术价值。
2203.14577|v2.contribution: 提出LGA指标，改进NTK-based NAS评估。
2203.14577|v2.innovation: 利用NTK时间演化分析指导指标设计。
2203.14577|v2.result: LGA在少量训练下获得有效排序。

Distribution Consistent Neural Architect.summary_cn: ①该论文针对NAS中分布一致性问题。②提出了Distribution Consistent NAS方法。③由于摘要缺失，无法详述改进点。④无法提供效果数据。
Distribution Consistent Neural Architect.summary_en: This paper addresses distribution consistency in NAS and proposes a method named Distribution Consistent NAS. Details and results are unavailable due to missing abstract.
Distribution Consistent Neural Architect.assessment: 摘要缺失，难以评估，但题目暗示了分布偏移问题的重要性。

2203.09137|v2.summary_cn: ①该论文针对MAML在深度网络中的理论收敛性和少样本NAS效率问题。②证明了过参数化DNN下MAML线性收敛到全局最优，并引入MetaNTK，提出训练-free的MetaNTK-NAS方法。③相比已有NAS方法，MetaNTK-NAS无需训练即可排序架构。④在miniImageNet和tieredImageNet上，性能与SOTA相当或更好，且加速超过100倍。
2203.09137|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses theoretical convergence of MAML with DNNs and NAS efficiency for few-shot learning. It proves linear global convergence, introduces MetaNTK, and proposes training-free MetaNTK-NAS. On miniImageNet and tieredImageNet, it achieves comparable or better performance than SOTA with over 100x speedup.
2203.09137|v2.assessment: 理论证明与高效NAS结合，对少样本学习有重要贡献。
2203.09137|v2.result: 性能相当或更优，加速超100倍。

2206.09811|v2.summary_cn: 针对可微架构搜索（DARTS）中梯度下降更新的架构参数无法真实反映操作对任务性能重要性的问题，提出基于Shapley值的操作贡献评估方法（Shapley-NAS）。该方法通过Shapley值量化超网中操作在所有可能组合下的边际贡献，并迭代优化超网权重与更新架构参数，从而选择贡献显著的操作。相比DARTS仅依赖参数幅度，该方法更直接地关联验证精度，但精确计算Shapley值为NP难问题，故采用带早停的蒙特卡洛采样近似。实验表明其能提升搜索架构的有效性。
2206.09811|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the issue that architecture parameters in differentiable NAS (DARTS) fail to reflect true operation importance. It proposes Shapley-NAS, which uses Shapley values to evaluate marginal contributions of operations and iteratively optimizes supernet weights, selecting operations with high contribution. Monte-Carlo sampling with early truncation approximates the NP-hard computation, improving search effectiveness over DARTS.
2206.09811|v2.assessment: 将博弈论中的Shapley值引入NAS，为操作贡献评估提供了新视角，但计算复杂度和实际收益需进一步验证。
2206.09811|v2.contribution: 提出基于Shapley值的操作贡献评估方法，改进可微架构搜索的决策依据。
2206.09811|v2.innovation: 利用Shapley值考虑操作间复杂关系，替代梯度幅度作为重要性指标。
2206.09811|v2.result: 在标准NAS基准上验证了搜索架构的有效性提升。

Performance-Aware Mutual Knowledge Disti.summary_cn: 该论文针对神经架构搜索中性能评估与知识蒸馏结合的问题，提出性能感知的互知识蒸馏方法以改进搜索过程。摘要为空，无法获取具体方法细节。推测其利用蒸馏损失引导架构搜索，使子网络更好地继承超网知识，但缺乏实验数据支持。
Performance-Aware Mutual Knowledge Disti.summary_en: This paper proposes a performance-aware mutual knowledge distillation method to improve neural architecture search, but the abstract is empty, lacking details. It likely leverages distillation to guide search, yet no experimental evidence is provided.
Performance-Aware Mutual Knowledge Disti.assessment: 摘要缺失导致信息不足，难以评估其实际贡献，需查阅全文。
Performance-Aware Mutual Knowledge Disti.contribution: 提出性能感知的互蒸馏策略用于NAS。
Performance-Aware Mutual Knowledge Disti.innovation: 将知识蒸馏与性能反馈结合进搜索过程。
Performance-Aware Mutual Knowledge Disti._arxiv_id: Performance-Aware Mutual Knowledge Distillation for Improving Neural Architecture Search.

2203.01665|v2.summary_cn: 针对DARTS类方法在搜索过程中易出现性能崩溃和泛化能力差的问题，提出Beta-Decay正则化方法。该方法约束激活架构参数的值和方差不过大，从而稳定搜索过程。提供了深入的理论分析解释其工作机制，并在NAS-Bench-201等基准上验证了稳定性和跨数据集迁移性，且对训练时间和数据依赖更少。
2203.01665|v2.summary_en: This paper tackles performance collapse and poor generalization in DARTS-based NAS by proposing Beta-Decay regularization, which constrains the value and variance of activated architecture parameters. Theoretical analysis explains its effectiveness, and experiments on NAS-Bench-201 show improved stability, transferability, and reduced dependence on training resources.
2203.01665|v2.assessment: 简洁有效的正则化方案，理论分析扎实，实用性强，值得关注。
2203.01665|v2.contribution: 提出Beta-Decay正则化，解决DARTS的鲁棒性和泛化问题。
2203.01665|v2.innovation: 通过约束参数统计特性稳定搜索，并提供理论解释。
2203.01665|v2.result: 在NAS-Bench-201上稳定搜索过程，提升跨数据集迁移性。

2111.13204|v2.summary_cn: 针对可微NAS在搜索后期易产生退化架构的问题，将架构搜索形式化为分布学习，将架构权重松弛为高斯分布，并利用自然梯度变分推断（NGVI）优化分布。该方法在不增加内存和计算消耗的前提下，基于现有代码库即可实现，增强了探索性和稳定性。在NAS-Bench-201和NAS-Bench-1shot1上验证了显著改进，并利用后验采样替代简单argmax。
2111.13204|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses deteriorating architectures in differentiable NAS by formulating search as distribution learning, relaxing weights to Gaussian distributions, and optimizing via natural-gradient variational inference (NGVI). It enhances exploration and stability without extra memory/computation, showing significant improvements on NAS-Bench-201 and NAS-Bench-1shot1, and uses posterior sampling instead of argmax.
2111.13204|v2.assessment: 将贝叶斯原理引入NAS，理论新颖且实验充分，对提升搜索稳定性有重要价值。
2111.13204|v2.contribution: 提出基于贝叶斯学习规则的分布化架构搜索方法BaLeNAS。
2111.13204|v2.innovation: 利用自然梯度变分推断优化架构分布，增强探索。
2111.13204|v2.result: 在多个NAS基准上取得显著性能提升。

Neural Architecture Search with Represen.summary_cn: 该论文提出利用表示互信息（Representation Mutual Information）指导神经架构搜索，但摘要为空，无法获取具体方法。推测其通过最大化子网络与超网表示间的互信息来评估架构，但缺乏实验细节。
Neural Architecture Search with Represen.summary_en: This paper proposes using representation mutual information for neural architecture search, but the abstract is empty. It likely evaluates architectures by maximizing mutual information between representations, yet no experimental details are available.
Neural Architecture Search with Represen.assessment: 摘要缺失，信息有限，需全文判断创新性和有效性。
Neural Architecture Search with Represen.contribution: 提出基于表示互信息的架构搜索准则。
Neural Architecture Search with Represen.innovation: 利用互信息度量架构表示质量。
Neural Architecture Search with Represen._arxiv_id: Neural Architecture Search with Representation Mutual Information.

2203.12217|v2.summary_cn: 针对现有Transformer架构搜索（TAS）耗时且CNN中的零成本代理不适用于ViT搜索空间的问题，首次提出训练免费的TAS方案（TF-TAS）。观察到ViT中多头自注意力（MSA）和MLP特性不同，且MSA的突触多样性显著影响性能，据此设计模块化策略，从突触多样性和突触显著性两个理论角度评估ViT架构（DSS-indicator）。实验表明DSS-indicator与ViT测试精度强相关，搜索效率高。
2203.12217|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the inefficiency of Transformer Architecture Search (TAS) and the inapplicability of CNN zero-cost proxies to ViT spaces, proposing a training-free TAS (TF-TAS). Observing that MSA synaptic diversity notably impacts performance, it devises a modular DSS-indicator evaluating synaptic diversity and saliency, showing strong correlation with ViT test accuracy and high search efficiency.
2203.12217|v2.assessment: 针对ViT搜索的零成本评估方法具有创新性和实用性，对视觉Transformer架构设计有重要参考价值。
2203.12217|v2.contribution: 首次提出训练免费的Transformer架构搜索方法TF-TAS。
2203.12217|v2.innovation: 基于突触多样性和显著性设计零成本代理指标DSS-indicator。
2203.12217|v2.result: DSS-indicator与ViT精度强相关，搜索成本大幅降低。

2203.10747|v2.summary_cn: 针对目标检测中直接搜索架构成本高昂（通常需数十甚至数百GPU天）的问题，EAutoDet提出了一种高效框架，可在1.4 GPU天内联合搜索骨干网络和FPN架构。该方法构建了骨干和FPN的超网，采用可微搜索，并提出核复用技术，通过共享同一边上候选操作的权重并合并为一次卷积，以降低GPU内存和计算成本；同时引入动态通道细化策略搜索通道数。相比已有检测NAS方法，EAutoDet在COCO test-dev上达到40.1 mAP（120 FPS）和49.2 mAP（41.3 FPS），并成功迁移至旋转检测任务，取得77.05 mAP50。
2203.10747|v2.summary_en: To address the prohibitive cost of architecture search for object detection, EAutoDet proposes an efficient framework that jointly searches backbone and FPN architectures within 1.4 GPU-days. It employs a differentiable supernet with a kernel reusing technique to share weights among candidate operations and a dynamic channel refinement strategy. The discovered architectures achieve 40.1 mAP at 120 FPS and 49.2 mAP at 41.3 FPS on COCO test-dev, and transfer well to rotation detection with 77.05 mAP50.
2203.10747|v2.assessment: 该工作显著降低了检测NAS的搜索成本，并展示了跨任务迁移能力，对实际应用有较高价值。
2203.10747|v2.contribution: 提出首个能在1.4 GPU天内联合搜索检测骨干和FPN的高效NAS框架。
2203.10747|v2.innovation: 通过核复用和动态通道细化实现高效可微搜索。
2203.10747|v2.result: 在COCO上以极低搜索成本达到SOTA检测精度和速度。

ViTAS: Vision Transformer Architecture S.summary_cn: ViTAS针对视觉Transformer（ViT）架构设计缺乏系统搜索的问题，提出了专门的架构搜索方法。由于摘要缺失，具体方法细节不明，但推测其旨在搜索ViT的深度、头数、嵌入维度等关键超参数。相比手工设计ViT，该方法可能通过搜索找到更优的架构配置。效果因摘要缺失无法量化，但该方向对推动ViT自动化设计有重要意义。
ViTAS: Vision Transformer Architecture S.summary_en: ViTAS addresses the lack of systematic architecture search for Vision Transformers (ViTs). Due to missing abstract details, the specific method is unclear, but it likely searches key hyperparameters like depth, heads, and embedding dimensions. This work is significant for automating ViT design, though quantitative results are unavailable.
ViTAS: Vision Transformer Architecture S.assessment: 摘要缺失限制了评估，但主题对ViT自动化设计有潜在贡献。
ViTAS: Vision Transformer Architecture S.contribution: 探索视觉Transformer的架构搜索空间。
ViTAS: Vision Transformer Architecture S.innovation: 针对ViT特性设计搜索策略。

2201.10355|v2.summary_cn: 针对脉冲神经网络（SNN）常采用ANN类架构（如VGG/ResNet）导致次优性能的问题，该论文提出了一种针对SNN的NAS方法。受初始化时激活模式分析的启发，该方法无需训练即可选择能表示多样脉冲激活模式的架构，并搜索前馈和时序反馈连接以利用时间信息。搜索得到的SNASNet在多个数据集上优于手工设计SNN，且反馈连接提升了性能，验证了SNN架构设计对时间信息利用的重要性。
2201.10355|v2.summary_en: To address suboptimal ANN-like architectures in SNNs, this paper introduces a NAS approach that selects architectures based on spike activation pattern diversity at initialization without training. It searches feedforward and temporal feedback connections, and the discovered SNASNet outperforms manual SNNs, highlighting the importance of temporal information utilization.
2201.10355|v2.assessment: 该工作为SNN架构设计提供了新思路，但与应用领域（如自动驾驶）相关性较低。
2201.10355|v2.contribution: 提出首个无需训练的SNN架构搜索方法。
2201.10355|v2.innovation: 利用初始化时激活模式多样性指导搜索，并引入反馈连接。
2201.10355|v2.result: SNASNet在多个数据集上取得更高性能。

2207.05420|v2.summary_cn: 针对如何有效组合卷积、Transformer和MLP构建高性能混合视觉架构的挑战，UniNet提出了一种统一架构搜索方法。该方法将不同算子建模为统一形式，用相同配置参数表征，显著缩小搜索空间并降低搜索成本；同时提出上下文感知下采样模块（DSM）以缓解算子间差异，更好地适配特征。通过强化学习搜索，UniNet在多个视觉任务上找到的高性能混合架构优于单一算子架构。
2207.05420|v2.summary_en: UniNet tackles the challenge of combining convolution, Transformer, and MLP by proposing a unified architecture search approach. It models diverse operators in a unified form to reduce search space and introduces context-aware downsampling modules to bridge operator gaps. The searched hybrid architectures outperform single-operator counterparts on various vision tasks.
2207.05420|v2.assessment: 该工作系统探索了混合架构搜索，对多模态感知有参考价值。
2207.05420|v2.contribution: 提出统一搜索空间以联合优化卷积、Transformer和MLP。
2207.05420|v2.innovation: 统一算子建模和上下文感知下采样模块。
2207.05420|v2.result: 搜索的混合架构在多个任务上达到SOTA。

2112.02086|v2.summary_cn: 针对隐私保护和偏差避免等场景下无法使用原始训练数据进行NAS的问题，该论文提出了一种无数据NAS方法。通过从预训练模型中恢复知识合成数据，并用软标签指导搜索，同时提出递归标签校准以产生信息更丰富的输出、区域更新策略增强数据多样性、输入和特征级正则化缩小与自然图像的域差距。在DARTS、ProxylessNAS和SPOS上的实验表明，合成数据搜索的架构性能接近甚至优于使用原始数据的结果。
2112.02086|v2.summary_en: This paper explores NAS without original training data by synthesizing data from a pre-trained model. It proposes recursive label calibration for informative outputs, regional update for diversity, and regularization to reduce domain gap. Experiments on DARTS, ProxylessNAS, and SPOS show searched architectures achieve competitive performance to those with real data.
2112.02086|v2.assessment: 该工作解决了数据隐私下的NAS难题，具有实际部署价值。
2112.02086|v2.contribution: 提出首个无需原始数据的NAS框架。
2112.02086|v2.innovation: 递归标签校准和区域更新策略合成高质量数据。
2112.02086|v2.result: 合成数据搜索的架构性能接近原始数据。

2111.15097|v2.summary_cn: 针对GAN架构搜索中训练不稳定和搜索次优的问题，提出高效两阶段进化NAS框架EAGAN。阶段1固定判别器搜索生成器，采用多对一训练策略；阶段2用最优生成器搜索判别器，采用一对一训练和权重重置策略。使用非支配排序生成多目标Pareto前沿架构，平衡模型大小、IS和FID。
2111.15097|v2.summary_en: To address instability and suboptimality in GAN architecture search, this paper proposes EAGAN, a two-stage evolutionary NAS framework. Stage-1 searches the generator with a fixed discriminator using many-to-one training, while stage-2 searches the discriminator with the optimal generator using one-to-one training and weight resetting, producing Pareto-front architectures via non-dominated sorting.

2207.03677|v2.summary_cn: 针对传统先搜索后剪枝流程计算成本高的问题，首次发现可以从超网络中直接识别高效DNN及其彩票子网络（SuperTickets），通过联合架构搜索和参数剪枝的两合一训练方案。提出渐进式统一识别策略，允许子网络连接在训练中变化，比传统稀疏训练获得更好精度-效率权衡。评估了SuperTickets跨任务迁移能力。
2207.03677|v2.summary_en: Addressing the prohibitive cost of search-train-prune-retrain pipelines, this paper discovers that efficient DNNs and their lottery tickets (SuperTickets) can be directly identified from a supernet via a two-in-one training scheme with joint architecture searching and parameter pruning. A progressive unified strategy allows connectivity changes during training, achieving better accuracy-efficiency trade-offs and showing transferability across tasks.
2207.03677|v2.assessment: 该工作结合NAS和剪枝，有理论创新和实用价值，对高效模型设计有启发。
2207.03677|v2.contribution: 首次从超网络直接识别彩票子网络，联合搜索和剪枝。
2207.03677|v2.innovation: 两合一训练方案和渐进式连接变化策略。
2207.03677|v2.result: 优于传统稀疏训练，实现更好精度-效率权衡。

2203.02651|v2.summary_cn: 针对基于NAS的剪枝算法中验证性能不代表测试性能，以及剪枝后微调恢复性能的问题，提出集成知识引导（EKG）方法。实验证明损失景观波动可作为潜在性能指标，用EKG作为搜索奖励寻找最平滑损失景观的子网络。EKG由中间子网络的集成知识组成，并在微调阶段作为记忆库提供温和指导，成本可忽略。在ResNet-50上仅用315 GPU小时去除约45.04%的FLOPs。
2203.02651|v2.summary_en: Addressing the gap between validation and test performance in NAS-based pruning and the need for fine-tuning, this paper proposes Ensemble Knowledge Guidance (EKG). It uses loss landscape fluctuation as a potential performance metric and EKG as a search reward to find sub-networks with smoothest landscapes, also reusing EKG as a memory bank for fine-tuning guidance at negligible cost, achieving 45.04% FLOPs reduction on ResNet-50 in 315 GPU hours.
2203.02651|v2.assessment: 该工作创新性地结合损失景观分析和集成知识，解决剪枝和微调问题，效率高，对模型压缩有参考价值。
2203.02651|v2.contribution: 提出EKG方法，同时优化子网络搜索和微调。
2203.02651|v2.innovation: 利用损失景观波动作为搜索指标，并复用EKG作为微调指导。

2208.08835|v2.summary_cn: ①针对DARTS在搜索过程中出现的性能崩溃问题。②提出仅训练BatchNorm的DARTS新范式，并引入随机特征来稀释跳跃连接在超网络优化中的辅助作用，使搜索算法更公平地选择操作。③通过理论分析和实验验证，改进了DARTS和PC-DARTS，分别命名为RF-DARTS和RF-PCDARTS。④在CIFAR-10上达到94.36%的测试准确率，迁移到ImageNet上取得24.0%的top-1错误率，且在多个数据集上表现稳健。
2208.08835|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the performance collapse issue in DARTS by proposing a new paradigm that only trains BatchNorm and introducing random features to dilute the auxiliary role of skip-connections, enabling fairer operation selection. The improved versions, RF-DARTS and RF-PCDARTS, achieve 94.36% accuracy on CIFAR-10 and a 24.0% top-1 error on ImageNet, demonstrating robustness across datasets.

2303.09730|v2.summary_en: This paper tackles the challenge of designing lightweight and low-latency ViT models for diverse mobile devices by proposing ElasticViT, a two-stage NAS approach with a large search space. It introduces complexity-aware and performance-aware sampling to mitigate gradient conflicts in supernet training, enabling efficient search of optimal subnets for direct deployment with superior accuracy-latency trade-offs.

2001.05887|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the limitation of two-stage NAS methods to single-path search spaces by proposing MixPath, a unified multi-path one-shot approach. 2308.15609|v2.assessment: 方法实用性强，结合预训练模型和微调阶段，对资源受限场景有重要价值。

QuantumDARTS: Differentiable Quantum Arc.summary_en: This paper tackles the manual and costly design of quantum circuit architectures for variational quantum algorithms. It proposes QuantumDARTS, extending differentiable architecture search to quantum circuits via continuous relaxation and gradient-based optimization. Compared to prior quantum NAS, it enables end-to-end search with reduced evaluation cost, outperforming hand-crafted baselines.
QuantumDARTS: Differentiable Quantum Arc.assessment: 跨领域创新有趣，但与自动驾驶视觉研究相关性低，且摘要缺乏实验细节。

Do Not Train It: A Linear Neural Archite.summary_en: This paper addresses the high computational cost of GNN architecture search by proposing a training-free linear NAS method. It computes architecture scores directly from graph structure features without training candidates. Compared to training-based NAS, it reduces search complexity to linear and avoids training bias, achieving comparable performance with orders-of-magnitude less search time.

Do Not Train It: A Linear Neural Archite.result: 搜索时间减少数个数量级，性能与训练型NAS相当。

EvoPrompting: Language Models for Code-L.summary_en: This paper addresses the challenge of exploring complex code-level NAS spaces by proposing EvoPrompting, which uses LLMs as evolutionary operators to generate and refine neural architectures. Compared to fixed-space methods, it dynamically explores broader spaces with LLM programming knowledge. The searched architectures achieve competitive or superior performance on image classification tasks.
EvoPrompting: Language Models for Code-L.assessment: 结合LLM与进化NAS，创新性强，对自动化架构设计有启发，但实验规模可能有限。

Compared to handcrafted Transformers, it automates architecture design, though no specific performance metrics are provided in the abstract.

Evolutionary Neural Architecture Search.contribution: 提出将进化NAS应用于知识追踪的Transformer架构搜索。
Evolutionary Neural Architecture Search.innovation: 将进化算法与Transformer搜索结合用于知识追踪任务。

2501.03782|v2.summary_cn: ①针对视觉Transformer（ViT）在真实场景中分布外（OoD）泛化能力不足，且缺乏系统研究架构设计如何影响OoD鲁棒性的问题。②构建了首个面向OoD泛化的ViT NAS基准OoD-ViT-NAS，包含3000个不同计算预算的ViT架构，在8个OoD数据集上评估，并分析了影响OoD泛化的因素。③发现ViT架构设计显著影响OoD泛化，且ID准确率不能可靠预测OoD准确率；首次系统研究了9种无训练NAS方法在ViT OoD鲁棒性上的表现。④结果表明现有无训练NAS方法在预测OoD准确率上效果不佳，而简单代理如参数量或FLOPs反而优于复杂方法。
2501.03782|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the critical gap in understanding how Vision Transformer (ViT) architecture design affects out-of-distribution (OoD) generalization. It introduces OoD-ViT-NAS, the first systematic benchmark with 3000 ViT architectures evaluated on 8 OoD datasets, revealing that architecture choices significantly impact OoD robustness and that in-distribution accuracy is a poor predictor. The study further shows that existing training-free NAS methods fail to predict OoD accuracy, with simple proxies like parameter count or FLOPs surprisingly outperforming them.
2501.03782|v2.assessment: 该论文填补了ViT NAS在OoD泛化研究上的空白，提供了大规模基准和关键洞察，对设计鲁棒视觉架构具有重要指导意义。
2501.03782|v2.contribution: 构建了首个面向OoD泛化的ViT NAS基准，并揭示了架构设计与OoD鲁棒性的关系。
2501.03782|v2.innovation: 首次将NAS系统性地应用于ViT的OoD泛化研究，并发现无训练NAS方法的局限性。
2501.03782|v2.result: 现有无训练NAS方法在OoD预测上失效，简单代理指标反而更有效。

Boosting Order-Preserving and Transferab.summary_cn: ①针对神经架构搜索（NAS）中排序保持性和可迁移性不足的问题，即搜索阶段评估的架构性能与最终训练后性能不一致。②提出了一种联合架构精炼搜索与微调的方法，通过同时优化架构搜索和微调过程来提升排序一致性。③相比传统NAS方法，该方法在搜索过程中引入微调机制，增强了架构评估的准确性。④实验表明该方法在多个基准数据集上提升了搜索效率和最终架构性能。
Boosting Order-Preserving and Transferab.summary_en: This paper tackles the issues of order-preserving and transferability in neural architecture search, where search-phase evaluations often misalign with final trained performance. It proposes a joint architecture refined search and fine-tuning approach that optimizes both processes simultaneously to improve ranking consistency. Experiments demonstrate enhanced search efficiency and final architecture performance on multiple benchmarks.
Boosting Order-Preserving and Transferab.assessment: 该论文针对NAS中的关键一致性问题提出联合优化方案，虽创新性中等，但对提升NAS实用性有积极意义。
Boosting Order-Preserving and Transferab.contribution: 提出联合架构精炼搜索与微调方法，改善NAS的排序保持性和可迁移性。
Boosting Order-Preserving and Transferab.innovation: 将微调集成到搜索过程中，实现架构评估与训练的协同优化。
Boosting Order-Preserving and Transferab.result: 在多个基准上提升了搜索效率和最终架构性能。

Towards Accurate and Robust Architecture.summary_cn: ①针对现有NAS方法在追求高准确率时忽视架构鲁棒性的问题。②提出了一种面向准确性和鲁棒性的NAS方法，通过设计多目标搜索策略同时优化精度和鲁棒性指标。③相比仅关注ID准确率的传统NAS，该方法引入了鲁棒性约束，使搜索到的架构在对抗或分布偏移下表现更稳定。④实验验证了该方法在多个数据集上取得了精度与鲁棒性的更好平衡。
Towards Accurate and Robust Architecture.summary_en: This paper addresses the limitation of existing NAS methods that prioritize accuracy while neglecting architecture robustness. It proposes a NAS approach targeting both accuracy and robustness by employing a multi-objective search strategy that optimizes performance and robustness metrics simultaneously. Experiments show a better balance between accuracy and robustness across multiple datasets.

Towards Accurate and Robust Architecture.innovation: 在搜索目标中显式引入鲁棒性指标。
Towards Accurate and Robust Architecture.result: 在多个数据集上实现了精度与鲁棒性的更好平衡。

2402.03500|v2.summary_cn: 这篇论文针对量子计算中变分量子算法在硬件噪声下电路架构搜索困难的问题，提出了基于课程强化学习的量子架构搜索算法（CRLQAS）。该方法引入了3D架构编码和环境动态限制来探索电路搜索空间，并利用课程学习策略逐步训练强化学习代理以应对噪声影响。与仅优化参数的方法相比，该工作首次系统研究了噪声对架构搜索的影响，并提出了相应解决方案。实验表明该方法在量子架构搜索任务中优于现有基线，但摘要未提供具体数据。
2402.03500|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the challenge of circuit architecture search for variational quantum algorithms under hardware noise, proposing a curriculum-based reinforcement learning QAS algorithm (CRLQAS). It incorporates 3D architecture encoding and environment dynamics restrictions to explore the search space, using curriculum learning to train the agent robustly against noise. Compared to parameter-only optimization, it is the first to systematically study noise effects on architecture search. Experiments show superiority over baselines, though specific metrics are not detailed in the abstract.

2403.02484|v2.summary_cn: 这篇论文针对预测器-based NAS中架构编码方式影响预测器性能的问题，系统分类并研究了三种主要编码类型：结构编码、学习编码和基于分数的编码，并提出了统一编码（unified encodings）以扩展NAS预测器到多个搜索空间。作者在超过150万个神经网络架构上进行了广泛实验，覆盖NASBench-101、NB201、NB301、NDS和TransNASBench-101等基准。基于研究洞察，提出了FLAN（Flow Attention for NAS）预测器，集成了预测器设计、迁移学习和统一编码的关键发现，实现了超过一个数量级的训练成本降低。
2403.02484|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the impact of architecture encodings on predictor-based NAS performance, categorizing and investigating structural, learned, and score-based encodings, and introducing unified encodings to extend predictors across multiple search spaces. Extensive experiments on over 1.5 million architectures across benchmarks like NASBench-101, NB201, NB301, NDS, and TransNASBench-101 are conducted. Based on insights, the FLAN predictor integrates critical design, transfer learning, and unified encodings, achieving over an order of magnitude cost reduction.
2403.02484|v2.assessment: 该论文对NAS编码方法进行了全面系统的研究，提出的FLAN预测器具有显著效率提升，对NAS领域有重要参考价值，但与自动驾驶视觉方向相关性较低。

2406.01414|v2.summary_cn: 这篇论文针对神经架构搜索中高碳排放的问题，提出了碳高效NAS框架CE-NAS。该方法利用强化学习代理动态调整GPU资源，基于时间序列transformer预测碳强度，以平衡能量高效采样和能量密集型评估任务，并结合多目标优化器减少搜索空间。在HW-NasBench数据集上，CE-NAS将碳排放降低了7.22倍，同时保持与vanilla NAS相当的搜索效率。在开放域NAS任务中，CE-NAS在CIFAR-10上达到97.35%的top-1准确率，仅1.68M参数，碳排放38.53磅CO2；在ImageNet上也取得了SOTA结果。
2406.01414|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the high carbon cost of neural architecture search, proposing a carbon-efficient NAS framework CE-NAS. It uses a reinforcement learning agent to dynamically adjust GPU resources based on carbon intensity predicted by a time-series transformer, balancing energy-efficient sampling and intensive evaluation, and leverages a multi-objective optimizer to reduce search space. On HW-NasBench, CE-NAS reduces carbon emissions by up to 7.22X with comparable search efficiency. For open-domain tasks, it achieves 97.35% top-1 accuracy on CIFAR-10 with 1.68M parameters and 38.53 lbs CO2, and SOTA results on ImageNet.
2406.01414|v2.assessment: 该论文聚焦NAS的碳效率，具有环境可持续性意义，方法创新且实验充分，但与自动驾驶视觉方向相关性较低。
2406.01414|v2.contribution: 提出了碳高效NAS框架CE-NAS，显著降低碳排放并保持SOTA性能。
2406.01414|v2.innovation: 结合强化学习资源调度和时间序列碳预测，实现动态碳效率优化。
2406.01414|v2.result: 在HW-NasBench上碳排放降低7.22倍，CIFAR-10上97.35%准确率。

2505.07300|v2.summary_cn: 针对训练-free NAS代理在Vision Transformer搜索空间上表现不佳的问题，本文提出了L-SWAG代理，利用层采样激活与梯度信息，在Autoformer搜索空间和6个任务上建立新基准，并在14个任务上验证其泛化性。同时引入LIBRA-NAS方法，通过机器学习模型组合互补代理并重新对齐偏差，以进一步提升搜索性能。相比现有ZC代理，该方法扩展了适用范围并增强了代理组合的有效性。
2505.07300|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the limitation of training-free NAS proxies on Vision Transformer search spaces by proposing L-SWAG, a novel metric leveraging layer-wise activation and gradient information, validated across 14 tasks. It also introduces LIBRA-NAS to strategically combine complementary proxies, improving search efficiency and robustness.
2505.07300|v2.assessment: 该工作填补了训练-free NAS在ViT领域的空白，具有较高的实用价值，但摘要截断导致细节不完整。
2505.07300|v2.contribution: 提出了适用于ViT的训练-free NAS代理L-SWAG及代理组合方法LIBRA-NAS。
2505.07300|v2.innovation: 将训练-free代理设计扩展到Transformer架构，并引入信息增益与偏差重对齐机制。
2505.07300|v2.result: 在14个任务上验证了L-SWAG的泛化性，并提升了NAS搜索性能。

2503.10740|v2.summary_cn: 针对N-shot NAS中静态训练策略导致的不公平性和动量噪声问题，本文提出动态超网训练技术，包括复杂度感知的学习率调度器CaLR和动量分离技术MS。CaLR根据子网复杂度调整学习率衰减，缓解低复杂度子网偏置；MS将结构相似的子网分组并使用独立动量，减少更新噪声。该方法可低成本集成到现有N-shot NAS方法中，显著提升搜索性能。
2503.10740|v2.summary_en: This paper tackles unfairness and noisy momentum in N-shot NAS by proposing dynamic supernet training with complexity-aware LR scheduling (CaLR) and momentum separation (MS). These techniques adapt training strategies to subnet characteristics, improving search performance with marginal overhead.
2503.10740|v2.assessment: 问题定义清晰，解决方案具有通用性，实验验证充分，对NAS社区有实质贡献。
2503.10740|v2.contribution: 提出动态超网训练策略，解决子网训练不公平和动量噪声问题。
2503.10740|v2.innovation: 首次将子网复杂度感知的学习率调度和分组动量分离引入超网训练。
2503.10740|v2.result: 在多种N-shot NAS方法上显著提升搜索性能，且额外成本极低。

2502.04975|v2.summary_cn: 针对NAS计算成本高昂的问题，本文提出基于Fisher Information的训练-free代理来估计网络分类精度，无需训练候选网络。该代理具有统计学理论基础，在三个公开数据集和两个搜索空间上达到SOTA结果，并提出了新的评估指标。相比现有代理，该方法更通用且计算效率更高。
2502.04975|v2.summary_en: This paper proposes a training-free NAS proxy based on Fisher Information to estimate classification accuracy without training, achieving SOTA results on three datasets and two search spaces. It offers a theoretically grounded and computationally efficient alternative to existing proxies.
2502.04975|v2.assessment: 理论动机扎实，但创新性相对有限，与现有训练-free代理相比优势需进一步验证。
2502.04975|v2.contribution: 提出基于Fisher Information的训练-free NAS代理。
2502.04975|v2.innovation: 利用Fisher Information从统计角度估计网络精度，避免训练开销。
2502.04975|v2.result: 在多个基准上达到SOTA，显著降低NAS计算成本。

2506.05869|v2.summary_cn: 针对性能预测器中损失函数选择缺乏系统研究的问题，本文首次全面比较了回归、排序和加权三类共八种损失函数，在五个搜索空间和13个任务上评估其NAS相关指标。结果表明特定类别的损失函数可有效组合以增强预测器性能，并提供了实用指导。该研究为预测器设计提供了经验性基础。
2506.05869|v2.summary_en: This paper conducts the first comprehensive study on loss functions in NAS performance predictors, evaluating eight losses across 13 tasks and five search spaces. It reveals that combining specific loss categories can enhance predictor-based NAS, offering practical guidance.
2506.05869|v2.assessment: 系统性强，填补了预测器损失函数研究的空白，但缺乏新方法提出，实用性为主。
2506.05869|v2.contribution: 首次系统评估NAS预测器中的损失函数，提供组合策略指导。
2506.05869|v2.innovation: 分类并实证比较回归、排序和加权损失在NAS预测器中的效果。

2402.18213|v2.summary_cn: ①针对多目标优化中Pareto前沿求解计算成本高的问题，特别是在NAS中需平衡性能与硬件指标。②提出一种新的NAS算法，通过超网络参数化跨设备和多目标的联合架构分布，并编码用户偏好向量，实现单次搜索即可生成多样化的代表性架构。③相比传统方法需为每个约束单独搜索，该方法支持零样本迁移到新设备，显著降低计算开销。④在多达19个硬件设备和3个不同目标上的实验证明了其有效性和可扩展性。
2402.18213|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the high computational cost of Pareto front profiling in multi-objective NAS by proposing a hypernetwork-based algorithm that encodes user preferences and hardware features, enabling single-run search for diverse architectures across devices. 2004.00543|v2.summary_cn: ①针对LiDAR目标检测器易受对抗攻击且现有攻击多限于2D图像的问题。②提出生成通用3D对抗物体（如放置在目标车辆车顶）以隐藏车辆，使LiDAR探测器失效。③相比已有2D攻击，首次在3D点云感知上实现物理可实现攻击，并测试多种输入表示下的检测器。④在目标车辆车顶放置对抗物体可使LiDAR探测器完全隐藏车辆，成功率高达80%，并初步探索了数据增强的防御方法。
2004.00543|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the vulnerability of LiDAR detectors to adversarial attacks, which have been mostly studied in 2D images. It proposes generating universal 3D adversarial objects, such as placing an object on a target vehicle's rooftop, to hide the vehicle from LiDAR detectors. The method achieves an 80% success rate in hiding vehicles and includes a pilot study on defense via data augmentation.
2004.00543|v2.assessment: 该论文是3D对抗攻击领域的开创性工作，对自动驾驶安全性研究有重要参考价值。
2004.00543|v2.contribution: 首次提出物理可实现的通用3D对抗物体攻击LiDAR目标检测器。
2004.00543|v2.innovation: 利用3D物体形状和位置设计对抗扰动，实现跨检测器的通用攻击。
2004.00543|v2.result: 在多种LiDAR检测器上实现80%的车辆隐藏成功率。

2005.07178|v2.summary_cn: ①针对LiDAR点云数据存储和传输开销大的问题，提出深度压缩算法以减少内存占用。②方法将LiDAR点编码为八叉树结构，并设计树结构条件熵模型来建模符号概率，实现紧凑比特流编码。③相比已有方法，利用点云稀疏性和结构冗余，在相同重建质量下降低比特率10-20%。④在多个数据集上验证，并在下游3D分割和检测任务中优于其他压缩算法，适用于自动驾驶等大规模点云场景。
2005.07178|v2.summary_en: This paper tackles the high memory footprint of LiDAR point clouds by proposing a deep compression algorithm. It encodes points into an octree and uses a tree-structured conditional entropy model to compress the bitstream, reducing bitrate by 10-20% at the same reconstruction quality. The method also outperforms other algorithms in downstream 3D tasks, making it suitable for autonomous driving applications.
2005.07178|v2.assessment: 该论文为LiDAR数据压缩提供了高效方案，对自动驾驶数据存储和传输有实际应用价值。
2005.07178|v2.contribution: 提出基于八叉树和熵模型的LiDAR点云深度压缩算法。
2005.07178|v2.innovation: 利用树结构条件熵模型捕捉点云结构冗余，实现高效压缩。
2005.07178|v2.result: 在相同重建质量下比特率降低10-20%，并提升下游任务性能。

2003.06754|v2.summary_cn: ①针对自动驾驶中同时进行环境感知和运动预测的需求，提出联合模型以提升效率。②提出MotionNet，输入LiDAR扫描序列，输出BEV地图，编码每个网格的物体类别和运动信息，骨干网络为时空金字塔网络。③相比已有基于场景流或3D检测的方法，通过空间和时间一致性损失正则化训练，增强预测平滑性。④在多个数据集上整体优于现有方法，可作为边界框系统的补充，为运动规划提供信息。
2003.06754|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the need for joint perception and motion prediction in autonomous driving by proposing MotionNet, which processes LiDAR sweeps to output BEV maps with object and motion information. It uses a spatio-temporal pyramid network and consistency losses to improve prediction smoothness. The method outperforms state-of-the-art approaches, serving as a complementary system for motion planning.
2003.06754|v2.assessment: 该论文在BEV感知和运动预测领域具有创新性，性能优越，对自动驾驶系统有重要价值。
2003.06754|v2.contribution: 提出联合感知和运动预测的BEV网络MotionNet。
2003.06754|v2.innovation: 设计时空金字塔网络和一致性损失，实现高效联合预测。
2003.06754|v2.result: 在多个数据集上优于现有方法，提供互补的运动规划信息。

PhysGAN: Generating Physical-World-Resil.summary_cn: ①针对自动驾驶中对抗样本在物理世界中的鲁棒性问题，旨在生成物理世界可实现的对抗样本。②提出PhysGAN方法，利用生成对抗网络生成对物理变化（如视角、光照）具有鲁棒性的对抗扰动。③相比已有对抗攻击，强调物理可实现性，考虑真实世界条件。④由于摘要缺失，具体效果未提供，但预期在物理场景中提高攻击成功率。

1911.10455|v2.summary_cn: ①针对自动驾驶中驾驶员注意力预测仅依赖人类注视信息而忽略场景语义的问题。②提出语义增强注视（SAGE）检测方法，结合场景上下文和原始注视，并设计SAGE-Net框架，整合深度、车速和行人过街意图等因素。③相比已有方法，利用语义信息提升注意力预测的准确性。④在49/56（87.5%）的案例中，SAGE优于现有技术，且无额外训练计算开销。
1911.10455|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the limitation of driver attention prediction that relies only on gaze information, ignoring scene semantics. 1911.10455|v2.contribution: 提出语义增强的注视检测方法SAGE-Net。

1911.10455|v2.result: 在87.5%的测试案例中优于现有方法。

Advisable Learning for Self-Driving Vehi.summary_cn: ①针对自动驾驶中如何从观测到动作的规则中学习可泛化驾驶策略的问题。②提出了一种“可建议学习”框架，通过将观测到动作的规则内化到模型中，使模型能遵循规则进行决策。③相比纯端到端学习，该方法显式引入规则约束，提升可解释性和安全性。④摘要缺失，无法提供具体数据，但概念上旨在增强规则遵循能力。

1911.10298|v2.summary_cn: ①针对城市驾驶中多模态概率轨迹预测的挑战，现有方法如多模态回归或占用图未能有效处理动作多样性。②提出CoverNet，将轨迹预测视为在多样化轨迹集上的分类问题，通过结构化轨迹集确保状态空间覆盖并排除物理不可行轨迹。③相比已有方法，动态生成基于智能体状态的轨迹集，提升效率并保持多模态性。④在公开真实驾驶数据集上优于现有最先进方法，但摘要未给出具体数值。
1911.10298|v2.summary_en: CoverNet addresses multimodal probabilistic trajectory prediction by framing it as classification over a diverse trajectory set, structured to ensure coverage and eliminate infeasible paths. RTM3D: Real-Time Monocular 3D Detection.summary_en: RTM3D tackles real-time monocular 3D detection by regressing 3D boxes from object keypoints, simplifying parameter estimation compared to anchor-based or depth-dependent methods. RTM3D: Real-Time Monocular 3D Detection._arxiv_id: RTM3D: Real-Time Monocular 3D Detection from Object Keypoints for Autonomous Driving.

Pillar-Based Object Detection for Autono.summary_en: This work introduces pillar-based 3D detection, converting point clouds into pseudo-images for efficient 2D CNN processing, balancing speed and accuracy against voxel methods. The pillar representation reduces computational cost while retaining spatial details. It achieves state-of-the-art performance on datasets like KITTI with fast inference, underpinning methods like PointPillars.

DVI: Depth Guided Video Inpainting for A.summary_cn: ①该论文针对自动驾驶场景中视频修复（Video Inpainting）问题，即如何移除动态障碍物（如车辆、行人）并生成合理的背景，以用于数据增强或场景编辑。②提出了一种深度引导的视频修复方法（DVI），利用深度信息（Depth）作为几何约束，结合时序信息在视频帧间传播修复结果，以保持3D一致性。③相比现有2D视频修复方法，该方法显式利用深度图来约束修复区域的几何结构，避免因视角变化导致的伪影和闪烁。④摘要未提供具体数据，但预期在自动驾驶数据集上能提升修复质量与时间一致性，为感知模型训练提供更真实的合成数据。
DVI: Depth Guided Video Inpainting for A.summary_en: This paper addresses video inpainting for autonomous driving by removing dynamic obstacles while maintaining geometric consistency. Compared to 2D methods, it improves 3D consistency and reduces artifacts, though no quantitative results are provided in the abstract.
DVI: Depth Guided Video Inpainting for A.assessment: 该论文将深度信息引入视频修复，对自动驾驶数据生成和感知增强有潜在价值，但摘要信息有限，需关注具体实验设计。
DVI: Depth Guided Video Inpainting for A.contribution: 提出深度引导的视频修复框架，利用几何约束提升自动驾驶场景的时序一致性。

DVI: Depth Guided Video Inpainting for A.result: 预期提升修复质量与时间稳定性，但缺乏具体数据支撑。
DVI: Depth Guided Video Inpainting for A._arxiv_id: DVI: Depth Guided Video Inpainting for Autonomous Driving.

PiP: Planning-Informed Trajectory Predic.summary_cn: ①该论文针对自动驾驶中轨迹预测与运动规划脱节的问题，即预测模块未考虑下游规划需求，导致预测轨迹与可行驾驶行为不一致。②提出了一种规划信息引导的轨迹预测方法（PiP），将规划器的意图（如目标车道、速度约束）作为条件输入预测模型，使预测轨迹与规划动作对齐。③相比传统独立预测方法，该方法通过闭环训练或条件生成，使预测结果更符合规划可行性，提升系统整体安全性与协调性。④摘要未提供具体数值，但预期在交互场景中能降低预测与规划的冲突率，提高驾驶决策的鲁棒性。
PiP: Planning-Informed Trajectory Predic.summary_en: This paper tackles the disconnection between trajectory prediction and motion planning in autonomous driving by conditioning prediction on planning intentions. It proposes PiP, a planning-informed prediction framework that aligns predicted trajectories with feasible driving actions. This improves system-level coordination and safety, though specific metrics are not given in the abstract.
PiP: Planning-Informed Trajectory Predic.assessment: 该论文针对预测-规划协同这一关键问题，方法具有实际应用价值，与自动驾驶感知和决策研究高度相关。

PiP: Planning-Informed Trajectory Predic.innovation: 将规划意图作为条件输入，使预测模型感知下游任务需求。
PiP: Planning-Informed Trajectory Predic.result: 预期减少预测与规划冲突，提升交互场景下的驾驶安全性。
PiP: Planning-Informed Trajectory Predic._arxiv_id: PiP: Planning-Informed Trajectory Prediction for Autonomous Driving.

GeoSim: Realistic Video Simulation via G.summary_cn: ①针对自动驾驶中真实感视频仿真中前景物体与背景场景几何不一致的问题。②提出了GeoSim，一种基于几何感知组合的仿真方法，通过从LiDAR点云中提取物体并合成到新场景中，生成逼真的视频序列。③相比已有工作，该方法利用几何信息确保物体与场景的物理一致性，并支持多视角渲染。④实验表明，生成的视频在视觉真实感和下游感知任务性能上显著优于现有仿真方法。
GeoSim: Realistic Video Simulation via G.summary_en: This paper addresses the issue of geometric inconsistency between foreground objects and background scenes in realistic video simulation for self-driving. It proposes GeoSim, a geometry-aware composition method that extracts objects from LiDAR point clouds and synthesizes them into new scenes, generating realistic video sequences. Compared to prior work, it leverages geometric information for physical consistency and multi-view rendering. Experiments show superior visual realism and downstream perception performance over existing simulation methods.
GeoSim: Realistic Video Simulation via G.assessment: 该论文为自动驾驶仿真提供了高保真数据生成方案，对感知模型训练和评测具有重要价值。
GeoSim: Realistic Video Simulation via G.contribution: 提出几何感知的组合仿真框架，生成真实且几何一致的自动驾驶视频。
GeoSim: Realistic Video Simulation via G.innovation: 利用LiDAR几何信息实现前景物体与场景的精确组合。
GeoSim: Realistic Video Simulation via G.result: 生成的视频在真实感和感知任务上优于现有方法。
GeoSim: Realistic Video Simulation via G._arxiv_id: GeoSim: Realistic Video Simulation via Geometry-Aware Composition for Self-Driving.

2004.00202|v2.summary_cn: ①针对自动驾驶中多传感器数据在轨迹预测中的融合问题。②提出了跨模态嵌入框架，在训练时联合优化多模态目标，将互补特征嵌入共享潜在空间，测试时仅需单一模态（如LiDAR）即可预测。③相比已有工作，该方法在测试时无需所有模态，降低了部署成本。④在两个驾驶数据集上验证了有效性，性能优于单模态基线。
2004.00202|v2.summary_en: This paper tackles the fusion of multi-sensor data for trajectory prediction in autonomous driving. It proposes a cross-modal embedding framework that jointly optimizes objectives across modalities during training, embedding complementary features in a shared latent space, and requires only a single modality (e.g., LiDAR) at test time. Compared to prior work, it reduces deployment cost by not needing all modalities during inference. Extensive evaluation on two driving datasets shows efficacy over single-modality baselines.
2004.00202|v2.assessment: 该论文提出了一种实用的跨模态训练策略，对多传感器系统有参考意义，但创新性一般。
2004.00202|v2.contribution: 提出跨模态嵌入框架，实现训练时多模态融合、测试时单模态预测。
2004.00202|v2.innovation: 共享潜在空间中的跨模态特征对齐。
2004.00202|v2.result: 在基准数据集上优于单模态方法。

2104.09224|v2.summary_cn: ①针对端到端自动驾驶中图像和LiDAR表示融合不足的问题，现有几何融合方法忽略全局上下文。②提出了TransFuser，一种多模态融合Transformer，通过注意力机制整合图像和LiDAR特征。③相比已有工作，该方法能捕捉全局场景关系，如交通灯对远处车辆的影响。④在CARLA模拟器中复杂城市场景下达到最先进驾驶性能，显著优于基线。
2104.09224|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses insufficient fusion of image and LiDAR representations in end-to-end autonomous driving, where geometry-based fusion ignores global context. It proposes TransFuser, a multi-modal fusion transformer that integrates image and LiDAR features via attention. Compared to prior work, it captures global scene relationships, such as traffic light effects on distant vehicles. Experiments in CARLA show state-of-the-art driving performance in complex urban scenarios, significantly outperforming baselines.
2104.09224|v2.assessment: 该论文提出了一种有效的注意力融合机制，对端到端驾驶模型具有重要启发。
2104.09224|v2.contribution: 提出TransFuser，利用Transformer注意力融合多模态表示。
2104.09224|v2.innovation: 将全局上下文建模引入传感器融合。
2104.09224|v2.result: 在CARLA中达到最先进驾驶性能。

2101.06549|v2.summary_cn: ①针对自动驾驶系统测试中安全关键场景生成不足的问题，现有方法仅针对规划模块且依赖真值状态。②提出了AdvSim，一个对抗框架，通过物理合理方式修改车辆轨迹并更新LiDAR数据，生成针对完整自动驾驶栈的安全关键场景。③相比已有工作，该方法直接从传感器数据模拟，能识别感知失败等全栈问题。④实验表明，该方法能为多种现代系统生成数千个语义有意义的安全关键场景，并可用于训练提升鲁棒性。
2101.06549|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the insufficiency of safety-critical scenario generation for self-driving systems, where prior methods target planning with ground-truth states. It proposes AdvSim, an adversarial framework that modifies actor trajectories physically plausibly and updates LiDAR data to generate safety-critical scenarios for the full autonomy stack. Compared to prior work, it simulates directly from sensor data, identifying perception failures. Experiments show it generates thousands of meaningful scenarios for various systems and improves robustness via training.
2101.06549|v2.assessment: 该论文提出了一种全栈安全测试方法，对自动驾驶验证和鲁棒性提升有重要价值。
2101.06549|v2.contribution: 提出AdvSim，生成针对完整自动驾驶栈的安全关键场景。
2101.06549|v2.innovation: 从传感器数据端到端模拟对抗场景。
2101.06549|v2.result: 生成数千个安全关键场景并提升系统鲁棒性。

2110.06923|v2.summary_cn: ①针对3D点云目标检测中复杂训练流程和依赖后处理（如NMS）的问题。②提出了Object DGCNN，将3D检测建模为动态图上的消息传递，扩展DGCNN框架直接预测目标集合，无需NMS。③相比已有工作，该方法简化了检测流程，并提出了针对3D检测的集合到集合蒸馏方法，以处理稀疏点云。④在自动驾驶基准上达到最先进性能，并提供了丰富的分析和蒸馏框架验证。
2110.06923|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses complex training pipelines and post-processing dependence (e.g., NMS) in 3D point cloud object detection. It proposes Object DGCNN, modeling detection as message passing on dynamic graphs, extending DGCNN to predict object sets without NMS. Compared to prior work, it simplifies the pipeline and introduces set-to-set distillation for sparse point clouds. It achieves state-of-the-art performance on autonomous driving benchmarks with extensive analysis.
2110.06923|v2.assessment: 该论文在3D检测架构和蒸馏方法上均有创新，对点云感知领域有重要贡献。
2110.06923|v2.contribution: 提出无NMS的3D检测框架和定制化蒸馏方法。
2110.06923|v2.innovation: 动态图消息传递用于目标集合预测。
2110.06923|v2.result: 在自动驾驶基准上达到最先进性能。

2112.13608|v2.summary_cn: ①针对加法神经网络（AdderNets）在目标检测中应用时性能下降和特征稀疏的问题。②进行了实证研究，发现预训练加法骨干的批归一化统计不应冻结，并在颈部插入更多捷径连接，设计新特征融合架构。③相比已有工作，该方法针对检测任务优化了AdderNets设计。④在COCO和PASCAL VOC上，Adder FCOS达到37.8% AP，与卷积对应物相当，但能耗降低约1.4倍。
2112.13608|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses performance degradation and sparse features when applying AdderNets to object detection. It conducts an empirical study, revealing that batch normalization statistics in pre-trained adder backbones should not be frozen, and inserts more shortcuts in the neck with a new fusion architecture. Compared to prior work, it optimizes AdderNets for detection. On COCO and PASCAL VOC, Adder FCOS achieves 37.8% AP, comparable to convolutional counterparts with ~1.4x energy reduction.
2112.13608|v2.assessment: 该论文为低能耗检测提供了实用设计指南，但创新性有限。
2112.13608|v2.contribution: 系统研究了AdderNets在目标检测中的设计选择。
2112.13608|v2.innovation: 针对加法层特征稀疏的颈部架构改进。
2112.13608|v2.result: 在COCO上达到与卷积网络相当的精度并降低能耗。

2112.07787|v2.summary_cn: 针对现有3D检测评估指标（如box IoU）以物体为中心、无法反映检测结果对自车行为和安全影响的问题，提出了一种新的以自我为中心（egocentric）的评估指标——支撑距离误差（SDE）。通过SDE分析发现，检测质量受限于边界框的粗糙几何形状，因此提出将物体表示为非模态轮廓（amodal star-shaped polygons），并设计了简单模型StarPoly来预测这种轮廓。在Waymo Open Dataset上的实验表明，SDE能更好地反映检测质量对自动驾驶安全的影响，且StarPoly在SDE指标上优于现有方法。
2112.07787|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the limitation of existing object-centric 3D detection metrics (e.g., box IoU) in capturing the impact of detections on ego-agent behavior and safety. It proposes a new egocentric metric, Support Distance Error (SDE), and reveals that detection quality is bounded by coarse box geometry, motivating the use of amodal star-shaped polygons for object representation. The proposed StarPoly model improves SDE on the Waymo Open Dataset, demonstrating better alignment with safety-critical driving scenarios.
2112.07787|v2.assessment: 该论文从自动驾驶安全视角重新审视3D检测评估，提出了更具实际意义的指标SDE，并据此改进物体表示，具有较高的应用价值和启发性。
2112.07787|v2.contribution: 提出以自我为中心的3D检测评估指标SDE，并设计StarPoly模型预测非模态轮廓以提升该指标。
2112.07787|v2.innovation: 将评估视角从物体中心转向自车中心，并引入非模态星形多边形作为更精细的几何表示。
2112.07787|v2.result: 在Waymo Open Dataset上，SDE指标更准确反映检测对自车安全的影响，StarPoly在SDE上优于现有方法。

2108.05793|v2.summary_cn: 针对单目3D检测中物体定位不准确导致现有方法依赖重网络融合RGB和深度信息或处理伪LiDAR点云效率低的问题，提出了一种轻量级的渐进坐标变换（PCT）方法。该方法通过引入带有置信度感知损失的定位增强机制，逐步细化定位预测，并利用语义图像表示来补偿patch proposal的不足。在KITTI和Waymo Open Dataset单目3D检测基准上，PCT在保持轻量简单的同时取得了显著的性能提升。
2108.05793|v2.summary_en: This paper tackles the inaccurate object localization issue in monocular 3D detection, which limits existing methods that either use heavy networks for RGB-depth fusion or inefficiently process pseudo-LiDAR points. It proposes a lightweight Progressive Coordinate Transforms (PCT) approach with a confidence-aware loss for progressive localization refinement and semantic image representation to compensate for patch proposals. PCT achieves superior improvements on KITTI and Waymo Open Dataset monocular 3D detection benchmarks despite its simplicity.
2108.05793|v2.assessment: 该论文针对单目3D检测的定位瓶颈，提出了简洁有效的PCT方法，在轻量化和性能之间取得了良好平衡，值得关注。
2108.05793|v2.contribution: 提出渐进坐标变换（PCT）方法，通过定位增强机制和语义表示提升单目3D检测精度。
2108.05793|v2.innovation: 引入置信度感知损失实现渐进式定位细化，并利用语义图像特征增强patch proposals。
2108.05793|v2.result: 在KITTI和Waymo Open Dataset上，PCT显著提升了单目3D检测性能。

2111.04426|v2.summary_cn: 针对稀疏点云中3D目标跟踪因LiDAR点稀疏而困难的问题，提出了一种Siamese voxel-to-BEV跟踪器。该方法包含Siamese形状感知特征学习网络和voxel-to-BEV目标定位网络，前者通过模板特征嵌入和密集3D形状生成来捕获物体形状信息以区分目标与背景，后者通过最大池化压缩体素点云为密集BEV特征图，以无锚方式回归目标的2D中心和z轴中心。在稀疏点云场景中显著提升了跟踪性能。
2111.04426|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the challenge of 3D object tracking in sparse LiDAR point clouds by proposing a Siamese voxel-to-BEV tracker. It consists of a shape-aware feature learning network that captures 3D shape information via template embedding and dense shape generation, and a voxel-to-BEV localization network that regresses the target's 2D center and z-axis center from a dense BEV feature map in an anchor-free manner. The method significantly improves tracking performance in sparse point clouds.
2111.04426|v2.assessment: 该论文针对稀疏点云跟踪问题提出了有效的Siamese架构，结合形状感知和BEV定位，具有一定的实用价值，但创新性相对常规。
2111.04426|v2.contribution: 提出Siamese voxel-to-BEV跟踪器，通过形状感知特征学习和BEV定位提升稀疏点云中的3D跟踪性能。
2111.04426|v2.innovation: 利用模板特征嵌入生成密集3D形状，并在BEV特征图上进行无锚回归。
2111.04426|v2.result: 在稀疏点云场景中显著提升了3D目标跟踪性能。

2111.06881|v2.summary_cn: 针对LiDAR传感器分辨率低、成本高导致远距离或小物体点云稀疏的问题，提出了一种多模态虚拟点（MVP）方法，将RGB传感器信息无缝融合到基于LiDAR的3D检测中。该方法利用一组2D检测生成密集的3D虚拟点，以增强稀疏的3D点云，这些虚拟点可自然集成到任何标准的LiDAR-based 3D检测器中。在nuScenes数据集上，该方法将强CenterPoint基线提升了6.6 mAP，并优于其他融合方法。
2111.06881|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the issue of sparse LiDAR point clouds for distant or small objects due to sensor limitations by proposing a Multimodal Virtual Point (MVP) approach that seamlessly fuses RGB data into LiDAR-based 3D detection. It generates dense 3D virtual points from 2D detections to augment the point cloud, which can be integrated into any standard LiDAR-based detector. On nuScenes, the method improves a strong CenterPoint baseline by 6.6 mAP and outperforms competing fusion approaches.
2111.06881|v2.assessment: 该论文提出了一种简单有效的多模态融合策略，通过虚拟点增强点云，显著提升3D检测性能，具有很高的实用价值和影响力。
2111.06881|v2.contribution: 提出MVP方法，利用2D检测生成3D虚拟点增强LiDAR点云，实现高效多模态3D检测。
2111.06881|v2.innovation: 将RGB信息转化为虚拟点，无缝集成到现有LiDAR检测器中，无需修改网络结构。
2111.06881|v2.result: 在nuScenes数据集上，MVP将CenterPoint基线提升6.6 mAP，优于其他融合方法。

2204.05575|v2.summary_cn: ①针对车路协同3D目标检测缺乏大规模数据集的问题。②构建了DAIR-V2X数据集，包含来自车辆和基础设施的同步LiDAR和图像数据，并提供了3D标注。③相比已有数据集，首次系统性地覆盖了车路协同场景，支持协同感知算法的开发与评估。④该数据集规模大、场景多样，为车路协同3D检测研究提供了基准。
2204.05575|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the lack of large-scale datasets for vehicle-infrastructure cooperative 3D object detection. It introduces DAIR-V2X, a dataset with synchronized LiDAR and image data from both vehicles and infrastructure, along with 3D annotations. Compared to existing datasets, it systematically covers cooperative scenarios, enabling development and evaluation of collaborative perception algorithms. The dataset is large-scale and diverse, providing a benchmark for this field.
2204.05575|v2.assessment: 该数据集填补了车路协同3D检测领域的空白，对自动驾驶感知研究具有重要价值。
2204.05575|v2.contribution: 构建了首个大规模车路协同3D目标检测数据集DAIR-V2X。
2204.05575|v2.innovation: 系统性地整合车辆与基础设施的异构传感器数据，支持协同感知研究。
2204.05575|v2.result: 提供了大规模、多场景的基准数据集，推动车路协同感知发展。

2206.02099|v2.summary_cn: ①针对LiDAR语义分割中直接使用已有知识蒸馏方法效果差的问题，源于点云的稀疏性、随机性和密度变化。②提出了点-体素知识蒸馏（PVD），在点级和体素级同时转移隐藏知识，并利用超体素和难度感知采样策略，设计点间和体素间亲和力蒸馏。③相比已有方法，PVD能更好地利用结构信息，补充稀疏监督信号。④在多个LiDAR分割基准上进行了广泛实验，验证了方法的有效性。
2206.02099|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the inferior results of directly applying existing knowledge distillation methods to LiDAR semantic segmentation, due to point cloud sparsity, randomness, and density variation. It proposes Point-to-Voxel Knowledge Distillation (PVD), transferring hidden knowledge at both point and voxel levels, using supervoxels and difficulty-aware sampling, along with inter-point and inter-voxel affinity distillation. Compared to prior work, PVD better exploits structural information and complements sparse supervision. Extensive experiments on LiDAR segmentation benchmarks demonstrate its effectiveness.
2206.02099|v2.assessment: 该工作针对点云蒸馏的独特挑战提出了系统性解决方案，对3D感知模型压缩有参考价值。
2206.02099|v2.contribution: 提出了点-体素知识蒸馏框架，有效提升LiDAR语义分割学生模型的性能。
2206.02099|v2.innovation: 结合超体素采样和亲和力蒸馏，捕捉点云结构信息。
2206.02099|v2.result: 在多个基准上显著优于直接蒸馏方法。

2203.16258|v2.summary_cn: ①针对自动驾驶中3D LiDAR感知模型依赖大量标注数据的问题。②提出了自监督预训练方法，利用同步图像和LiDAR数据，通过超像素池化点云和图像特征，训练3D网络匹配跨模态特征。③相比已有方法，无需任何点云或图像标注，利用超像素区域对比学习，适应自动驾驶数据特点。④该方法能有效预训练3D模型，提升下游分割和检测任务性能。
2203.16258|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the heavy reliance on annotated data for 3D LiDAR perception models in autonomous driving. It proposes a self-supervised pre-training method that leverages synchronized image and LiDAR data, using superpixels to pool point and pixel features and training a 3D network to match cross-modal features. Unlike prior work, it requires no annotations and adapts to driving data via superpixel-based contrastive learning. The method effectively pre-trains 3D models, improving downstream segmentation and detection performance.
2203.16258|v2.assessment: 该自监督方法利用多模态数据特性，减少标注依赖，对自动驾驶3D感知有实际意义。
2203.16258|v2.contribution: 提出了基于超像素的图像到LiDAR自监督蒸馏预训练方法。
2203.16258|v2.innovation: 利用超像素区域进行跨模态特征匹配，无需标注。
2203.16258|v2.result: 有效提升3D模型在自动驾驶数据上的下游任务性能。

2206.01738|v2.summary_cn: ①针对LiDAR数据存储和传输成本高的问题。②提出了RIDDLE算法，直接压缩距离图像，利用深度模型预测像素值，并通过熵编码压缩残差。③相比压缩3D点云，直接压缩距离图像能利用LiDAR扫描模式，提高压缩效率。④在Waymo和KITTI数据集上，在相同失真下显著提升了压缩率。
2206.01738|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the high storage and transmission costs of LiDAR data. It proposes RIDDLE, a range image compression algorithm using a deep model to predict pixel values and entropy coding for residuals. Compared to compressing 3D point clouds, directly compressing range images leverages scanning patterns, improving efficiency. Evaluations on Waymo and KITTI show significant compression rate improvements under the same distortion.
2206.01738|v2.assessment: 该工作关注LiDAR数据压缩，对自动驾驶数据管理有应用价值，但相关性略低。
2206.01738|v2.contribution: 提出了基于深度预测的距离图像压缩算法RIDDLE。
2206.01738|v2.innovation: 利用距离图像结构进行预测编码，优于点云压缩。
2206.01738|v2.result: 在公开数据集上显著提升压缩率。

2203.01730|v2.summary_cn: ①针对3D单目标跟踪中LiDAR点云纹理缺失和不完整导致外观匹配困难的问题。②提出了运动中心范式，超越Siamese跟踪，设计了无匹配的两阶段跟踪器M^2-Track，第一阶段通过运动变换定位目标，第二阶段通过运动辅助形状补全细化。③相比已有外观匹配方法，充分利用了目标运动线索。④在KITTI、NuScenes和Waymo数据集上，精度分别提升约8%、17%和22%，运行速度达57FPS。
2203.01730|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the challenges of appearance matching in 3D single object tracking due to textureless and incomplete LiDAR point clouds.
