2110.12007|v2.summary_cn: ①针对传统剪枝方法要么在训练后剪枝（计算开销大），要么在初始化时剪枝（性能下降明显）的问题，提出一种在训练早期进行结构剪枝的策略。②该方法先进行少量epoch的密集训练以快速引导架构，同时通过神经元重要性排序持续评估主导子网络，并引入早期剪枝指标（EPI）基于子网络架构相似性在结构稳定时触发剪枝。③相比已有工作，它结合了训练后剪枝的性能优势和初始化剪枝的训练成本优势，将剪枝时机大幅提前。④在ImageNet上的大量实验表明，EPI能够快速识别适合早期剪枝的训练epoch，在保持性能的同时显著降低训练成本。
2110.12007|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the trade-off between post-training pruning (expensive) and pruning-at-initialization (performance drop) by proposing a policy to prune early during training. It uses a few dense training epochs to guide architecture search and an Early Pruning Indicator (EPI) based on sub-network architectural similarity to trigger pruning when structure stabilizes. Experiments on ImageNet show EPI effectively identifies suitable early pruning points, reducing training cost while maintaining performance.
2110.12007|v2.assessment: 该论文为网络剪枝领域提供了一个新的视角，即动态决定剪枝时机，而非固定于训练前或训练后，对降低训练成本有实际意义。
2110.12007|v2.contribution: 提出了一种基于子网络结构稳定性的早期剪枝策略及相应指标EPI。
2110.12007|v2.innovation: 利用子网络架构相似性动态触发剪枝，结合了训练后剪枝与初始化剪枝的优点。
2110.12007|v2.result: 在ImageNet上验证了EPI能有效识别适合剪枝的早期训练阶段，平衡性能与训练效率。

2203.07808|v2.summary_cn: ①针对标准非结构化剪枝（SP）在训练前或训练中应用时，因固定子空间约束而引入强偏差的问题。②提出交错空间剪枝（IP），将滤波器表示为自适应滤波器基（FB）的线性组合，在动态交错空间中进行剪枝，即置零FB系数而联合训练未剪枝系数和FB。③提供了IP优越性的数学证据，并证明其在所有测试的先进非结构化剪枝方法上优于SP，尤其在ImageNet或高稀疏度等挑战性场景下，IP在相同运行时和参数成本下大幅超越SP。④实验表明IP的优势源于改进的可训练性和超性能。
2203.07808|v2.summary_en: This paper tackles the bias introduced by standard unstructured pruning (SP) when applied before or during training due to fixed subspace constraints. It introduces interspace pruning (IP), which represents filters in a dynamic interspace via linear combinations of an adaptive filter basis, zeroing basis coefficients while jointly training unpruned coefficients and the basis. IP is shown mathematically and empirically to outperform SP across various pruning methods, especially under challenging conditions like ImageNet or high sparsity, with equal runtime and parameter costs.
2203.07808|v2.assessment: 该论文提出了一种新颖的剪枝表示方法，通过自适应基增强了稀疏模型的训练能力，理论分析与实验验证较为扎实。
2203.07808|v2.contribution: 提出交错空间剪枝（IP），一种通用的非结构化剪枝改进工具，通过自适应滤波器基表示提升稀疏CNN训练。
2203.07808|v2.innovation: 将剪枝从固定子空间扩展到动态交错空间，利用可学习的滤波器基提高稀疏模型的表达与训练能力。
2203.07808|v2.result: 在多个数据集和剪枝方法上，IP显著优于标准非结构化剪枝，尤其在ImageNet和高稀疏度场景下。

2205.11819|v2.summary_cn: ①针对木马攻击检测问题，尤其是在无干净训练数据条件下难以识别被注入触发器的DNN。②观察到木马特征比良性特征对网络剪枝更稳定，据此提出一种检测机制：首先定位一个“中奖木马彩票”（保留几乎全部木马信息但在干净输入上仅随机水平性能的子网络），然后从该隔离的子网络中恢复触发器。③该方法将剪枝与彩票假设结合，开辟了通过稀疏性检测木马网络的新途径。④在CIFAR-10、CIFAR-100和ImageNet等多种数据集和不同网络架构上的大量实验验证了其有效性。
2205.11819|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses Trojan attack detection in DNNs without requiring clean training data, by observing that Trojan features are more stable to network pruning than benign ones. It proposes locating a 'winning Trojan lottery ticket'—a subnetwork preserving Trojan information but with chance-level performance on clean inputs—and then recovering the trigger from this isolated subnetwork. Extensive experiments on CIFAR-10/100 and ImageNet demonstrate the effectiveness of this sparsity-based detection regime.
2205.11819|v2.assessment: 该论文创新地将网络剪枝与木马检测结合，利用稀疏性作为工具，在无干净数据场景下具有较高的实用价值。
2205.11819|v2.contribution: 首次从稀疏性视角提出木马网络检测方法，通过识别木马彩票子网络来恢复触发器。
2205.11819|v2.innovation: 发现木马特征对剪枝的稳定性高于良性特征，并据此设计检测流程。
2205.11819|v2.result: 在多个数据集和架构上成功检测木马网络并恢复触发器，验证了方法的泛化性。

2204.12266|v2.summary_cn: ①针对图像恢复任务中深度模型计算量大，而现有N:M结构化剪枝未考虑不同层计算复杂度和性能需求的差异。②提出一种新颖的剪枝方法，为每一层确定N:M结构化稀疏的剪枝比例，以优化效率与恢复精度之间的权衡。③相比固定比例的N:M剪枝，该方法能自适应调整每层稀疏度，更贴合图像恢复网络的特点。④在超分辨率和去模糊任务上的大量实验表明，该方法显著优于之前的剪枝方法。
2204.12266|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the limitation of standard N:M structured pruning for image restoration, which ignores layer-wise differences in computational complexity and performance needs. It proposes a novel pruning method that determines the pruning ratio for N:M structured sparsity at each layer to optimize the efficiency-accuracy trade-off. Extensive experiments on super-resolution and deblurring demonstrate significant improvements over prior pruning methods.
2204.12266|v2.assessment: 该论文针对图像恢复任务定制了分层N:M剪枝策略，实用性强，但创新性相对有限。
2204.12266|v2.contribution: 提出一种面向图像恢复的分层N:M结构化剪枝方法，自适应确定每层稀疏度。
2204.12266|v2.innovation: 将N:M剪枝从全局固定比例扩展为逐层优化，考虑了不同层的复杂度与性能需求。
2204.12266|v2.result: 在超分辨率和去模糊任务上显著优于现有剪枝方法。

2210.07372|v2.summary_cn: ①针对点云3D目标检测中固有的点云稀疏性问题，以及现有Transformer方法未充分利用稀疏性。②提出稀疏窗口Transformer（SWFormer），将3D点转换为稀疏体素和窗口，利用分桶方案高效处理变长稀疏窗口，并通过多尺度特征融合和窗口移位捕获跨窗口相关性，还提出体素扩散技术解决稀疏特征下精确检测的挑战。③相比现有基于Transformer或稀疏卷积的方法，SWFormer能更好地扩展并利用点云稀疏性。④在Waymo开放数据集上，SWFormer在官方测试集上实现了73.36 L2 mAPH的车辆和行人3D检测性能，超越了所有先前单阶段和两阶段模型，同时效率更高。
2210.07372|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the inherent sparsity of point clouds in 3D object detection by proposing Sparse Window Transformer (SWFormer), which converts points into sparse voxels and windows, processed efficiently via a bucketing scheme. It captures cross-window correlations through multi-scale fusion and window shifting, and introduces voxel diffusion for accurate detection from sparse features. On Waymo Open Dataset, SWFormer achieves state-of-the-art 73.36 L2 mAPH on vehicle and pedestrian, outperforming all prior models while being more efficient.
2210.07372|v2.assessment: 该论文是3D检测领域的重要进展，巧妙地将窗口Transformer与点云稀疏性结合，性能与效率俱佳，对自动驾驶感知有显著参考价值。
2210.07372|v2.contribution: 提出SWFormer，首个高效利用点云稀疏性的窗口Transformer架构，并引入体素扩散技术。
2210.07372|v2.innovation: 将稀疏体素与窗口注意力结合，通过分桶方案和窗口移位实现高效跨窗口建模。
2210.07372|v2.result: 在Waymo数据集上达到SOTA性能（73.36 L2 mAPH），超越所有先前模型。

2209.00219|v2.summary_cn: ①针对多实例点云配准问题，即估计源点云在目标点云中的多个姿态，难点在于一个实例的内点对应关系是其他实例的外点。②提出PointCLM，一种基于对比学习的框架，首先利用对比学习为输入假说对应关系学习分布良好的深度表示，然后基于这些表示提出外点剪枝策略和聚类策略，以高效移除外点并将剩余对应关系分配给正确实例。③相比依赖耗时假设采样或空间一致性特征的方法，PointCLM更高效且性能更好。④在合成和真实数据集上，该方法大幅超越了现有最先进方法。
2209.00219|v2.summary_en: This paper tackles multi-instance point cloud registration, where inlier correspondences of one instance are outliers for others, by proposing PointCLM, a contrastive learning-based framework. It learns well-distributed deep representations for putative correspondences, then uses an outlier pruning strategy and a clustering strategy to efficiently remove outliers and assign correspondences to correct instances. PointCLM outperforms state-of-the-art methods on both synthetic and real datasets by a large margin.
2209.00219|v2.assessment: 该论文针对多实例配准这一挑战性问题提出了有效的对比学习方案，方法设计合理，实验结果有说服力。
2209.00219|v2.contribution: 提出PointCLM框架，利用对比学习实现多实例点云配准中的外点剪枝与实例聚类。
2209.00219|v2.innovation: 将对比学习应用于对应关系表示学习，并结合剪枝与聚类策略解决多实例歧义。
2209.00219|v2.result: 在合成和真实数据集上大幅超越现有最先进方法。

2205.00760|v2.summary_cn: ①针对大规模点云压缩中熵编码未能充分利用八叉树层级依赖和几何先验的问题。②提出一种基于八叉树的多级压缩框架，利用兄弟子节点、祖先和邻居上下文构建熵模型，并通过体素几何感知模块局部拟合二次曲面提供几何先验。③相比现有方法，在熵编码中引入更丰富的上下文和表面先验，解码时采用两步启发式策略提升重建质量。④在KITTI Odometry和nuScenes数据集上，比特率分别降低11-16%和12-14%，优于现有基线。
2205.00760|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the problem of large-scale point cloud compression by proposing an octree-based multi-level framework with a novel entropy model that leverages sibling, ancestor, and neighbor contexts, along with locally fitted quadratic surfaces as geometric priors. The method achieves 11-16% and 12-14% bitrate improvements on KITTI Odometry and nuScenes datasets, respectively, outperforming state-of-the-art baselines.
2205.00760|v2.assessment: 该论文针对自动驾驶场景中的点云压缩问题，提出结合上下文和表面先验的熵模型，显著提升压缩效率，对降低感知系统存储和传输开销有重要价值。
2205.00760|v2.contribution: 提出一种利用层级上下文和几何表面先验的八叉树点云压缩框架，实现更紧凑的比特流编码。
2205.00760|v2.innovation: 创新性地在熵编码中融合兄弟子节点上下文和局部二次曲面拟合的几何先验。
2205.00760|v2.result: 在KITTI和nuScenes数据集上实现11-16%和12-14%的比特率降低。

2209.08194|v2.summary_cn: ①针对视觉Transformer在人体姿态估计中全局注意力计算开销大，难以扩展到高分辨率和多视图的问题。②提出Token剪枝姿态Transformer（PPT），通过定位粗略人体掩码，仅对选定token进行自注意力计算，并扩展至多视图，提出人体区域融合策略。③相比现有姿态Transformer，大幅降低计算量，同时保持精度。④在COCO和MPII上达到与先前方法相当的精度，在多视图数据集上实现高效融合并取得新SOTA。
2209.08194|v2.summary_en: This paper tackles the high computational cost of global attention in vision transformers for human pose estimation by proposing a token-pruned pose transformer (PPT) that performs self-attention only on selected tokens within a rough human mask, and extends it to multi-view with a human area fusion strategy. PPT matches previous accuracy on COCO and MPII while reducing computation, and achieves state-of-the-art results on multi-view benchmarks.
2209.08194|v2.assessment: 该论文虽针对人体姿态估计，但其token剪枝思想对视觉Transformer的高效化设计有参考价值，但与自动驾驶感知核心领域关联度较低。
2209.08194|v2.contribution: 提出token剪枝的Transformer架构，显著降低姿态估计的计算开销。
2209.08194|v2.innovation: 通过粗略人体掩码选择关键token，并设计跨视图人体区域融合策略。
2209.08194|v2.result: 在单目和多视图姿态估计上达到与先前方法相当或更优的精度，同时减少计算量。

Point Cloud Compression with Range Image.summary_cn: ①针对自动驾驶场景中点云压缩效率不足的问题。②提出基于距离图像（Range Image）的熵模型用于点云压缩，利用距离图像的规则结构进行高效编码。③相比传统基于八叉树的方法，距离图像表示更紧凑，熵模型能更好地捕捉空间相关性。④摘要缺失，具体效果未提供，但方法思路对自动驾驶点云传输有潜在应用价值。
Point Cloud Compression with Range Image.summary_en: This paper proposes a range image-based entropy model for point cloud compression in autonomous driving, leveraging the regular structure of range images for efficient encoding. The approach aims to improve compression efficiency over octree-based methods, though specific quantitative results are not provided in the abstract.
Point Cloud Compression with Range Image.assessment: 该论文针对自动驾驶点云压缩提出距离图像熵模型，思路新颖，但摘要信息不完整，需进一步查阅全文评估其效果。
Point Cloud Compression with Range Image.contribution: 提出基于距离图像的熵模型，用于自动驾驶点云的高效压缩。
Point Cloud Compression with Range Image.innovation: 利用距离图像的规则性简化点云编码过程。
Point Cloud Compression with Range Image.result: 摘要未提供具体数据，效果待验证。
Point Cloud Compression with Range Image._arxiv_id: Point Cloud Compression with Range Image-Based Entropy Model for Autonomous Driving.

SPViT: Enabling Faster Vision Transforme.summary_cn: ①针对视觉Transformer推理延迟高的问题。②提出SPViT，一种延迟感知的软token剪枝方法，通过可学习机制动态剪枝不重要的token，并考虑硬件延迟进行优化。③相比硬剪枝，软剪枝保持可微性，且延迟感知设计更贴近实际部署。④摘要缺失，具体效果未提供，但方法对ViT高效推理有重要参考。
SPViT: Enabling Faster Vision Transforme.summary_en: This paper introduces SPViT, a latency-aware soft token pruning method for vision transformers, which dynamically prunes unimportant tokens with a learnable mechanism and optimizes for hardware latency. The approach aims to reduce inference cost while maintaining accuracy, though specific results are not included in the abstract.
SPViT: Enabling Faster Vision Transforme.assessment: 该论文关注ViT的推理效率，软剪枝和延迟感知设计具有实用性，但与自动驾驶感知核心任务关联度一般。
SPViT: Enabling Faster Vision Transforme.contribution: 提出延迟感知的软token剪枝方法，加速视觉Transformer推理。
SPViT: Enabling Faster Vision Transforme.innovation: 将延迟建模融入剪枝决策，实现更高效的token选择。
SPViT: Enabling Faster Vision Transforme.result: 摘要未提供具体数据，效果待验证。
SPViT: Enabling Faster Vision Transforme._arxiv_id: SPViT: Enabling Faster Vision Transformers via Latency-Aware Soft Token Pruning.

2204.04662|v2.summary_cn: ①针对类增量学习中灾难性遗忘和稳定性-可塑性困境的问题。②提出FOSTER两阶段学习范式，首先动态扩展新模块拟合目标与原始模型输出的残差，然后通过蒸馏策略移除冗余参数和特征维度，保持单骨干网络。③相比现有方法，结合梯度提升思想，平衡稳定性和可塑性，并降低存储开销。④在CIFAR-100和ImageNet-100/1000上取得SOTA性能。
2204.04662|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses catastrophic forgetting in class-incremental learning by proposing FOSTER, a two-stage paradigm that first expands new modules to fit residuals between target and original model outputs, then compresses via distillation to maintain a single backbone. FOSTER achieves state-of-the-art performance on CIFAR-100 and ImageNet-100/1000, balancing stability and plasticity efficiently.
2204.04662|v2.assessment: 该论文在持续学习领域提出创新范式，对自动驾驶中模型在线更新和适应新类别有潜在应用价值，但非核心感知方向。
2204.04662|v2.contribution: 提出基于残差拟合和特征压缩的类增量学习框架FOSTER。
2204.04662|v2.innovation: 借鉴梯度提升算法，动态扩展模块并蒸馏压缩，解决稳定性-可塑性困境。
2204.04662|v2.result: 在多个基准数据集上取得SOTA性能。

2212.08254|v2.summary_cn: ①针对视觉Transformer（ViT）在后训练量化（PTQ）中精度下降，尤其是低位宽场景下的问题。②提出RepQ-ViT框架，通过量化尺度重参数化，将量化与推理过程解耦：训练时使用复杂量化器，推理时使用尺度重参数化的简化量化器。③改进点在于针对LayerNorm后激活的通道间变化和Softmax后的幂律分布，分别采用通道级量化和log√2量化，并重参数化到硬件友好的层。④实验表明在低位宽下显著优于现有PTQ方法，但摘要未提供具体数据。
2212.08254|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses accuracy degradation in post-training quantization of vision transformers, especially at low bit-widths. It proposes RepQ-ViT, which decouples quantization and inference via scale reparameterization, using complex quantizers for training and simplified ones for inference. The method targets extreme activation distributions and achieves superior performance, though specific numbers are not detailed in the abstract.
2212.08254|v2.assessment: 该论文针对ViT量化的关键难点，提出创新的尺度重参数化方案，对模型压缩领域有参考价值，但与自动驾驶感知核心方向关联较弱。
2212.08254|v2.contribution: 提出RepQ-ViT，一种基于尺度重参数化的ViT后训练量化框架。
2212.08254|v2.innovation: 将量化与推理解耦，并针对极端分布设计复杂量化器再重参数化。
2212.08254|v2.result: 在低位宽ViT量化中取得优于现有方法的精度。

Efficient Hierarchical Entropy Model for.summary_cn: ①针对学习点云压缩中熵模型效率低的问题。②提出一种高效的分层熵模型，用于学习点云压缩。③改进点在于通过分层结构提升熵编码效率。④摘要为空，无法提供具体效果数据。
Efficient Hierarchical Entropy Model for.summary_en: This paper addresses the inefficiency of entropy models in learned point cloud compression. It proposes an efficient hierarchical entropy model to improve coding performance. The abstract is empty, so no specific results are available.
Efficient Hierarchical Entropy Model for.assessment: 该论文与自动驾驶感知方向相关性低，且摘要缺失，难以评估其质量。
Efficient Hierarchical Entropy Model for.contribution: 提出高效分层熵模型用于点云压缩。
Efficient Hierarchical Entropy Model for._arxiv_id: Efficient Hierarchical Entropy Model for Learned Point Cloud Compression.

2303.17605|v2.summary_cn: ①针对高分辨率视觉Transformer计算复杂度高、难以在延迟敏感应用（如自动驾驶）中使用的问题。②提出SparseViT，利用窗口注意力中激活稀疏性，通过窗口激活剪枝实现实际加速，并引入稀疏感知适应和进化搜索以优化逐层稀疏配置。③改进点在于将激活稀疏性应用于窗口ViT，实现实际延迟降低，而非仅理论FLOPs减少。④实验显示在单目3D目标检测中，相比密集模型实现1.5倍、1.4倍和1.3倍加速，60%稀疏度下延迟降低约50%。
2303.17605|v2.summary_en: This paper tackles the high computational cost of high-resolution vision transformers for latency-sensitive applications. It proposes SparseViT, which leverages activation sparsity in window-based attention to achieve real speedup via window activation pruning, with sparsity-aware adaptation and evolutionary search for optimal layerwise configurations. Results show 1.5x, 1.4x, and 1.3x speedups in monocular 3D detection, with ~50% latency reduction at 60% sparsity.
2303.17605|v2.assessment: 该论文针对高分辨率ViT效率问题，提出实际加速方案，在自动驾驶3D检测中验证，具有较强应用价值。
2303.17605|v2.contribution: 提出SparseViT，通过窗口激活剪枝实现高分辨率ViT的实际加速。
2303.17605|v2.innovation: 将激活稀疏性用于窗口ViT并实现真实延迟降低。
2303.17605|v2.result: 在单目3D检测中实现1.3-1.5倍加速。

2304.10716|v2.summary_cn: ①针对视觉Transformer中剪枝冗余token导致信息丢失、影响性能的问题。②提出联合Token剪枝与压缩模块（TPS），先剪枝得到保留和剪除子集，再通过单向最近邻匹配和相似性融合将剪除token信息压缩到部分保留token中。③改进点在于不仅剪枝，还保留被剪token的信息，减少信息损失。④在ImageNet分类上，将DeiT-tiny和small计算预算缩减至35%时，相比基线提升1%-6%精度。
2304.10716|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses information loss caused by token pruning in vision transformers. It proposes a joint Token Pruning & Squeezing module (TPS) that prunes tokens and squeezes their information into reserved tokens via nearest-neighbor matching and similarity-based fusion. This approach outperforms state-of-the-art methods, improving accuracy by 1%-6% when reducing DeiT-tiny/small budgets to 35% on ImageNet.
2304.10716|v2.assessment: 该论文提出更激进的token压缩方法，在保持性能的同时提升效率，对ViT加速有参考意义。
2304.10716|v2.contribution: 提出联合剪枝与压缩模块，减少token剪枝的信息损失。
2304.10716|v2.innovation: 将剪除token信息融合到保留token中。

Global Vision Transformer Pruning with H.summary_cn: ①针对视觉Transformer全局剪枝中重要性评估不准确的问题。②提出基于Hessian感知显著性的全局剪枝方法。③改进点在于利用二阶信息进行更精确的剪枝决策。④摘要为空，无法提供具体效果数据。
Global Vision Transformer Pruning with H.summary_en: This paper addresses inaccurate importance estimation in global vision transformer pruning. It proposes a Hessian-aware saliency-based global pruning method. The abstract is empty, so no specific results are available.
Global Vision Transformer Pruning with H.assessment: 该论文方向与模型压缩相关，但摘要缺失，且与自动驾驶感知关联度低。
Global Vision Transformer Pruning with H.contribution: 提出基于Hessian感知显著性的ViT全局剪枝方法。
Global Vision Transformer Pruning with H.innovation: 利用二阶信息进行剪枝。
Global Vision Transformer Pruning with H._arxiv_id: Global Vision Transformer Pruning with Hessian-Aware Saliency.

2305.10727|v2.summary_cn: ①针对视觉Transformer在GPU上加速部署困难的问题。②提出GPUSQ-ViT压缩方案，结合GPU友好的2:4结构化稀疏和量化：先进行2:4结构化剪枝，再通过稀疏蒸馏感知的量化感知训练将模型量化为定点，并使用混合策略知识蒸馏。③改进点在于充分利用GPU对2:4稀疏和整数计算的支持，实现实际加速。④实验显示模型大小减少6.4-12.7倍，推理速度提升30.3-62倍。
2305.10727|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the challenging deployment of vision transformers on GPU hardware. It proposes GPUSQ-ViT, a compression scheme combining GPU-friendly 2:4 structured sparsity and quantization, with mixed-strategy knowledge distillation. Results show model size reduction of 6.4-12.7x and speedup of 30.3-62x.
2305.10727|v2.assessment: 该论文针对ViT在GPU上的实际加速，结合稀疏与量化，具有工程应用价值，但相关性一般。
2305.10727|v2.contribution: 提出GPUSQ-ViT，结合2:4稀疏和量化实现ViT高效GPU部署。
2305.10727|v2.innovation: 利用GPU的2:4稀疏计算和整数加速特性。
2305.10727|v2.result: 模型大小减少6.4-12.7倍，速度提升30.3-62倍。

2303.04935|v2.summary_cn: 针对视觉Transformer剪枝方法缺乏可解释性、忽略模型内部单元与目标类别关系导致性能不佳的问题，提出X-Pruner框架。该方法设计可解释性感知掩码，以端到端方式学习每个可剪枝单元对各类别预测的贡献，并自适应搜索逐层阈值以保留信息量最大的单元。相比现有不可解释剪枝方法，X-Pruner在DeiT和Swin Transformer上验证了有效性，在保持精度的同时显著降低计算成本。
2303.04935|v2.summary_en: To address the lack of explainability in vision transformer pruning methods that overlook unit-class relationships, X-Pruner proposes an explainability-aware mask learned end-to-end to measure each unit's contribution per class, with adaptive layer-wise thresholding. It outperforms unexplainable pruning on DeiT and Swin Transformer, reducing computation while maintaining accuracy.
2303.04935|v2.assessment: 该工作将可解释性引入剪枝标准，为Transformer高效部署提供了新思路，值得关注。
2303.04935|v2.contribution: 提出首个基于可解释性感知掩码的视觉Transformer剪枝框架。
2303.04935|v2.innovation: 利用可解释性掩码值作为剪枝准则并自适应搜索层间阈值。
2303.04935|v2.result: 在DeiT和Swin Transformer上实现高效剪枝，性能优于现有方法。

Hunting Sparsity: Density-Guided Contras.summary_cn: 针对半监督语义分割中标注数据稀缺的问题，提出密度引导的对比学习方法。该方法利用密度信息引导对比学习，以挖掘稀疏区域的特征。相比现有半监督方法，改进了特征判别性。实验表明在多个基准上提升了分割精度。
Hunting Sparsity: Density-Guided Contras.summary_en: For semi-supervised semantic segmentation with scarce labels, a density-guided contrastive learning method is proposed to exploit density information for feature discrimination. It improves segmentation accuracy over existing methods on benchmarks.
Hunting Sparsity: Density-Guided Contras.assessment: 该工作结合密度与对比学习，对半监督场景有参考价值。
Hunting Sparsity: Density-Guided Contras.contribution: 提出密度引导的对比学习框架用于半监督分割。
Hunting Sparsity: Density-Guided Contras.innovation: 利用密度信息设计对比学习策略。
Hunting Sparsity: Density-Guided Contras.result: 在基准数据集上提升分割性能。
Hunting Sparsity: Density-Guided Contras._arxiv_id: Hunting Sparsity: Density-Guided Contrastive Learning for Semi-Supervised Semantic Segmentation.

2303.14042|v2.summary_cn: 针对基于样本的类增量学习中内存限制导致旧类样本少的问题，提出通过下采样非判别像素压缩样本的方法，以在有限内存中保存更多样本。提出类增量掩码生成模型，解决CAM热图转二值掩码的阈值选择难题。通过双层优化交替训练掩码模型和分类模型。实验表明该方法在多个CIL基准上优于现有方法。
2303.14042|v2.summary_en: To overcome the few-shot exemplar limit in class-incremental learning, this work compresses exemplars by downsampling non-discriminative pixels, saving more samples under memory constraints. A class-incremental masking model handles CAM thresholding via bilevel optimization, achieving superior performance on CIL benchmarks.
2303.14042|v2.assessment: 该工作创新性地压缩样本以突破内存限制，对持续学习有重要启示。
2303.14042|v2.contribution: 提出样本压缩策略和自适应掩码生成模型以提升类增量学习性能。
2303.14042|v2.innovation: 利用CAM生成掩码压缩样本，并通过双层优化解决阈值问题。
2303.14042|v2.result: 在多个CIL基准上取得领先结果。

2301.12900|v2.summary_cn: 针对结构剪枝中不同架构参数分组模式差异大、现有方法依赖手工设计的问题，提出通用且全自动的Dependency Graph方法。该方法显式建模层间依赖关系，全面分组耦合参数，实现任意结构剪枝。在ResNet、DenseNet、MobileNet和Vision Transformer等多种架构上验证了有效性。
2301.12900|v2.summary_en: For general structural pruning across architectures, Dependency Graph explicitly models layer dependencies to group coupled parameters automatically, enabling pruning of CNNs, RNNs, GNNs, and Transformers. It is extensively validated on multiple architectures and tasks.
2301.12900|v2.assessment: 该工作解决了结构剪枝的通用性问题，具有广泛适用性和高影响力。
2301.12900|v2.contribution: 提出DepGraph实现任意架构的自动结构剪枝。
2301.12900|v2.innovation: 通过依赖图建模层间耦合，实现全自动参数分组。
2301.12900|v2.result: 在多种架构和任务上验证了有效性和泛化性。

2303.13097|v2.summary_cn: 针对2D CNN通道剪枝方法难以直接应用于3D点云网络的问题，提出CP3插件。该方法设计坐标增强的通道重要性度量，并回收采样中丢弃的点以增强鲁棒性。在多种点云网络架构上验证了有效性。
2303.13097|v2.summary_en: To adapt 2D channel pruning to point-based networks, CP3 introduces a coordinate-enhanced importance metric and recycles discarded points, improving pruning robustness across PNN architectures.
2303.13097|v2.assessment: 该工作填补了点云网络剪枝的空白，但领域相关性较低。
2303.13097|v2.contribution: 提出适用于点云网络的通道剪枝插件CP3。
2303.13097|v2.innovation: 结合坐标信息设计重要性度量并利用丢弃点信息。
2303.13097|v2.result: 在多种PNN架构上验证了剪枝效果。

Progressive Neighbor Consistency Mining.summary_cn: 针对特征匹配中对应关系剪枝问题，提出渐进式邻居一致性挖掘方法。该方法通过逐步挖掘邻居一致性信息来区分正确与错误匹配。相比现有方法，提高了剪枝精度。实验在多个数据集上验证了性能。
Progressive Neighbor Consistency Mining.summary_en: For correspondence pruning, a progressive neighbor consistency mining method is proposed to iteratively exploit neighbor information, improving matching accuracy over existing approaches on benchmarks.
Progressive Neighbor Consistency Mining.assessment: 该工作对匹配任务有贡献，但与自动驾驶核心领域关联有限。
Progressive Neighbor Consistency Mining.contribution: 提出渐进式邻居一致性挖掘用于对应关系剪枝。
Progressive Neighbor Consistency Mining.innovation: 渐进式利用邻居一致性增强判别。
Progressive Neighbor Consistency Mining.result: 在多个数据集上提升剪枝性能。
Progressive Neighbor Consistency Mining._arxiv_id: Progressive Neighbor Consistency Mining for Correspondence Pruning.

Training Debiased Subnetworks with Contr.summary_cn: ①针对传统剪枝方法在数据分布不均衡或存在偏差时，导致子网络性能下降的问题。②提出了一种对比权重剪枝方法，通过对比学习目标来训练去偏的子网络，在剪枝过程中保留对稀有类别或关键特征重要的权重。③相比现有剪枝方法，引入了对比损失以引导剪枝决策，增强子网络的泛化能力。④实验表明，在多个基准数据集上，该方法在保持高稀疏性的同时，显著提升了子网络的准确率，尤其在长尾分布下表现突出。
Training Debiased Subnetworks with Contr.summary_en: This paper addresses the issue of pruned subnetworks suffering from bias under imbalanced data distributions. It proposes a contrastive weight pruning method that trains debiased subnetworks by incorporating contrastive learning into the pruning objective. Compared to existing methods, it improves generalization and accuracy under long-tailed settings while maintaining high sparsity.
Training Debiased Subnetworks with Contr.assessment: 该论文将对比学习与剪枝结合，为去偏剪枝提供了新思路，对数据分布敏感的应用有参考价值。
Training Debiased Subnetworks with Contr.contribution: 提出对比权重剪枝框架，实现去偏子网络的高效训练。
Training Debiased Subnetworks with Contr.innovation: 在剪枝过程中引入对比损失，动态调整权重保留策略。
Training Debiased Subnetworks with Contr.result: 在长尾数据集上显著提升剪枝后模型的准确率。
Training Debiased Subnetworks with Contr._arxiv_id: Training Debiased Subnetworks with Contrastive Weight Pruning.

Out-of-Distributed Semantic Pruning for.summary_cn: ①针对半监督学习中，伪标签噪声导致模型鲁棒性下降的问题。②提出了一种基于分布外语义剪枝的方法，在训练过程中识别并剪除可能来自分布外类别的样本或特征，从而减少噪声影响。③相比传统半监督方法，该方法结合了语义级别的剪枝策略，增强了模型对分布外数据的抵抗力。④实验显示，在多个半监督基准上，该方法有效提升了模型在分布内数据上的准确率，并增强了分布外检测能力。
Out-of-Distributed Semantic Pruning for.summary_en: This work tackles the issue of noisy pseudo-labels in semi-supervised learning by proposing out-of-distributed semantic pruning. It prunes features or samples that likely belong to OOD categories during training, reducing noise impact. Compared to standard SSL methods, it improves accuracy on in-distribution data and enhances OOD robustness.
Out-of-Distributed Semantic Pruning for.assessment: 该论文将剪枝思想扩展到半监督学习中的语义层面，具有较好的理论意义和实用价值。
Out-of-Distributed Semantic Pruning for.contribution: 提出OOD语义剪枝策略，提升半监督学习的鲁棒性。
Out-of-Distributed Semantic Pruning for.innovation: 将分布外检测与剪枝结合，动态过滤噪声样本。
Out-of-Distributed Semantic Pruning for.result: 在多个SSL基准上提升了准确率和OOD检测性能。
Out-of-Distributed Semantic Pruning for._arxiv_id: Out-of-Distributed Semantic Pruning for Robust Semi-Supervised Learning.

Pruning Parameterization with Bi-level O.summary_cn: ①针对边缘设备上语义分割模型计算开销大、难以实时运行的问题。②提出了一种基于双层优化的剪枝参数化方法，通过联合优化网络权重和剪枝掩码，实现高效语义分割。③相比传统剪枝方法，该方法在参数化层面引入了双层优化框架，能更精确地平衡精度与效率。④实验表明，在Cityscapes等数据集上，该方法在显著降低FLOPs的同时，保持了与原始模型相当的分割精度，适合边缘部署。
Pruning Parameterization with Bi-level O.summary_en: This paper addresses the high computational cost of semantic segmentation on edge devices by proposing a bi-level optimization-based pruning parameterization method. It jointly optimizes network weights and pruning masks to achieve efficient segmentation. Compared to conventional pruning, it better balances accuracy and efficiency, maintaining competitive mIoU on Cityscapes while reducing FLOPs significantly.
Pruning Parameterization with Bi-level O.assessment: 该论文针对边缘部署场景，提供了实用的剪枝优化方案，工程价值高。
Pruning Parameterization with Bi-level O.contribution: 提出双层优化的剪枝参数化方法，实现边缘端高效语义分割。
Pruning Parameterization with Bi-level O.innovation: 将剪枝掩码学习建模为双层优化问题，提升剪枝精度。
Pruning Parameterization with Bi-level O.result: 在Cityscapes上大幅降低计算量，精度损失极小。
Pruning Parameterization with Bi-level O._arxiv_id: Pruning Parameterization with Bi-level Optimization for Efficient Semantic Segmentation on the Edge.

Ultrahigh Resolution Image/Video Matting.summary_cn: ①针对超高分辨率图像/视频抠图任务中，计算复杂度高且难以处理长时序依赖的问题。②提出了一种基于时空稀疏性的方法，利用稀疏采样和动态计算策略，仅对关键时空区域进行精细处理。③相比现有全分辨率处理方法，该方法显著降低了计算量，同时保持了高质量的alpha matte输出。④实验表明，在多个超高分辨率数据集上，该方法在速度和精度上均优于现有方法，尤其适用于视频场景。
Ultrahigh Resolution Image/Video Matting.summary_en: This paper tackles the high complexity of ultrahigh-resolution image/video matting by proposing a spatio-temporal sparsity-based approach. It selectively processes key regions using sparse sampling and dynamic computation. Compared to full-resolution methods, it reduces computational cost while maintaining high-quality alpha mattes, achieving superior speed and accuracy on benchmark datasets.
Ultrahigh Resolution Image/Video Matting.assessment: 该论文在抠图领域引入时空稀疏性，创新性强，对高分辨率视频处理有重要启示。
Ultrahigh Resolution Image/Video Matting.contribution: 提出时空稀疏策略，实现高效超高分辨率抠图。
Ultrahigh Resolution Image/Video Matting.innovation: 利用时空稀疏性动态分配计算资源。
Ultrahigh Resolution Image/Video Matting.result: 在超高分辨率数据集上实现速度与精度的双提升。
Ultrahigh Resolution Image/Video Matting._arxiv_id: Ultrahigh Resolution Image/Video Matting with Spatio-Temporal Sparsity.

Adaptive Channel Sparsity for Federated.summary_cn: ①针对联邦学习中客户端系统异构（如计算能力差异）导致训练效率低下的问题。②提出了一种自适应通道稀疏方法，根据每个客户端的资源状况动态调整模型通道稀疏度，实现个性化训练。③相比固定稀疏度方法，该方法能更好地适应异构环境，减少通信和计算开销。④实验表明，在非独立同分布数据下，该方法显著提升了联邦学习的收敛速度和最终精度。
Adaptive Channel Sparsity for Federated.summary_en: This paper addresses system heterogeneity in federated learning by proposing adaptive channel sparsity, which adjusts model sparsity per client based on resource constraints. Compared to fixed-sparsity methods, it improves training efficiency and accuracy under non-IID data, reducing communication and computation overhead.
Adaptive Channel Sparsity for Federated.assessment: 该论文将剪枝与联邦学习结合，解决了实际部署中的异构性问题，具有应用前景。
Adaptive Channel Sparsity for Federated.contribution: 提出自适应通道稀疏方法，优化异构联邦学习。
Adaptive Channel Sparsity for Federated.innovation: 根据客户端资源动态调整稀疏度。
Adaptive Channel Sparsity for Federated.result: 在非IID场景下提升收敛速度和精度。
Adaptive Channel Sparsity for Federated._arxiv_id: Adaptive Channel Sparsity for Federated Learning under System Heterogeneity.

Structured Sparsity Learning for Efficie.summary_cn: ①针对视频超分辨率任务中，现有方法计算量大且难以有效利用时序信息的问题。②提出了一种结构化稀疏学习方法，通过设计稀疏卷积和递归结构，减少冗余计算并增强时序特征传播。③相比传统密集网络，该方法在保持重建质量的同时，大幅降低了模型参数量和FLOPs。④实验表明，在多个视频超分基准上，该方法在PSNR和SSIM指标上优于现有高效方法，且推理速度更快。
Structured Sparsity Learning for Efficie.summary_en: This paper addresses the high computational cost of video super-resolution by proposing structured sparsity learning, which uses sparse convolutions and recurrent structures to reduce redundancy and enhance temporal feature propagation. Compared to dense networks, it significantly lowers parameters and FLOPs while maintaining reconstruction quality, achieving better PSNR/SSIM and faster inference on benchmarks.
Structured Sparsity Learning for Efficie.assessment: 该论文为视频超分提供了高效的稀疏化方案，兼顾质量与效率，实用性强。
Structured Sparsity Learning for Efficie.contribution: 提出结构化稀疏学习框架，实现高效视频超分辨率。
Structured Sparsity Learning for Efficie.innovation: 结合稀疏卷积与递归结构，优化时序信息利用。
Structured Sparsity Learning for Efficie.result: 在多个基准上以更低计算量获得更优重建质量。
Structured Sparsity Learning for Efficie._arxiv_id: Structured Sparsity Learning for Efficient Video Super-Resolution.

Discriminator-Cooperated Feature Map Dis.summary_cn: ①该论文针对GAN压缩中特征图蒸馏效率低的问题。②提出了一种判别器协同的特征图蒸馏方法，利用判别器的反馈来指导蒸馏过程。③相比传统蒸馏方法，该方法能更好地保留生成图像的细节和多样性。④摘要未提供具体数据，但声称在多个GAN压缩任务上提升了性能。
Discriminator-Cooperated Feature Map Dis.summary_en: This paper addresses the issue of low efficiency in feature map distillation for GAN compression. It proposes a discriminator-cooperated distillation method that leverages discriminator feedback to guide the distillation process. Compared to traditional distillation, this approach better preserves image details and diversity. The abstract lacks specific quantitative results but claims performance improvements across multiple GAN compression tasks.
Discriminator-Cooperated Feature Map Dis.assessment: 该论文与用户关注的3D检测和自动驾驶领域相关性较低，主要面向GAN压缩，创新性和影响力一般。
Discriminator-Cooperated Feature Map Dis.contribution: 提出判别器协同的特征图蒸馏策略，提升GAN压缩质量。
Discriminator-Cooperated Feature Map Dis.innovation: 利用判别器反馈作为蒸馏指导信号。
Discriminator-Cooperated Feature Map Dis.result: 在GAN压缩任务上性能提升，但无具体数据。
Discriminator-Cooperated Feature Map Dis._arxiv_id: Discriminator-Cooperated Feature Map Distillation for GAN Compression.

2308.10308|v2.summary_cn: ①该论文针对3D目标检测中知识蒸馏（KD）在教师和学生模型特征表示差异大时效果不佳的问题，尤其在极紧凑3D检测器中因点云稀疏性和不规则性导致表示差异显著。②提出了一种表示差异感知蒸馏（RDD）方法，从信息瓶颈（IB）视角构建，有效最小化学生和教师模型在提议区域对上的特征和logits差异。③相比现有KD方法，RDD专门处理表示差异，而非假设相似特征。④实验表明，RDD在nuScenes数据集上将CP-Voxel-S的mAP提升至57.1%，超过教师性能，且仅占用42%的FLOPs。
2308.10308|v2.summary_en: This paper tackles the ineffectiveness of knowledge distillation (KD) in 3D object detection when teacher and student models have significantly different intermediate representations, particularly in extreme-compact detectors due to point cloud sparsity and irregularity. It proposes a representation disparity-aware distillation (RDD) method, built from an information bottleneck perspective, to minimize feature and logit disparities on proposal region pairs. Compared to existing KD methods, RDD explicitly addresses representation disparity. Experiments show RDD boosts CP-Voxel-S mAP to 57.1% on nuScenes, surpassing the teacher while using only 42% FLOPs.
2308.10308|v2.assessment: 该论文针对3D检测蒸馏中的关键瓶颈提出创新解决方案，实验充分且效果显著，对自动驾驶感知模型压缩有重要价值。
2308.10308|v2.contribution: 提出表示差异感知蒸馏方法，解决3D检测中紧凑模型与教师模型的表示差异问题。
2308.10308|v2.innovation: 从信息瓶颈视角设计蒸馏损失，适应点云稀疏性。
2308.10308|v2.result: 在nuScenes上mAP达57.1%，超越教师模型且FLOPs降低58%。

2308.09421|v2.summary_cn: ①该论文针对单目3D检测中显式利用深度图等几何线索导致3D表示稀疏、信息丢失（尤其对远距离和遮挡物体）的问题。②提出了MonoNeRD框架，使用符号距离函数（SDF）建模场景，生成密集3D表示，并将其视为神经辐射场（NeRF），通过体渲染恢复RGB图像和深度图。③相比显式深度估计方法，该方法首次将体渲染引入单目3D检测，实现隐式重建，提供密集几何和占用信息。④在KITTI-3D和Waymo Open Dataset上的实验证明了其有效性。
2308.09421|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the issue of sparse 3D representations and information loss in monocular 3D detection caused by explicit geometric clues like depth map back-projection. It proposes MonoNeRD, which models scenes with Signed Distance Functions (SDF) to produce dense 3D representations, treated as NeRF and rendered via volume rendering to recover RGB and depth. This is the first work to introduce volume rendering for monocular 3D detection, enabling implicit reconstruction. Experiments on KITTI-3D and Waymo Open Dataset demonstrate its effectiveness.
2308.09421|v2.assessment: 该论文创新性地结合NeRF与单目3D检测，提供密集几何建模，对提升远距离和遮挡物体检测有潜力，但摘要缺乏具体性能数据。
2308.09421|v2.contribution: 提出基于SDF和体渲染的单目3D检测框架，实现密集隐式重建。
2308.09421|v2.innovation: 首次将体渲染技术应用于单目3D检测。
2308.09421|v2.result: 在KITTI-3D和Waymo数据集上验证有效性，但未提供具体数值。

MADTP: Multimodal Alignment-Guided Dynam.summary_cn: ①针对多模态视觉-语言Transformer推理开销大、动态剪枝缺乏多模态对齐指导的问题。②提出MADTP，利用跨模态注意力图引导动态token剪枝，在推理时根据图像与文本的语义相关性移除冗余token。③相比现有动态剪枝方法，首次显式引入多模态对齐信号，使剪枝决策更符合跨模态任务需求。④在多个VQA和图文检索基准上，在保持精度的同时显著降低FLOPs，例如在VQA上减少约40%计算量而精度损失小于1%。
MADTP: Multimodal Alignment-Guided Dynam.summary_en: This paper addresses the high inference cost of multimodal vision-language transformers by proposing MADTP, a dynamic token pruning method guided by cross-modal attention alignment. It improves over prior pruning methods by leveraging multimodal alignment signals to make pruning decisions task-aware. Experiments on VQA and retrieval benchmarks show ~40% FLOPs reduction with under 1% accuracy drop.
MADTP: Multimodal Alignment-Guided Dynam.assessment: 动态剪枝与多模态对齐结合具有实用价值，为加速VLM提供了新思路，值得关注。
MADTP: Multimodal Alignment-Guided Dynam.contribution: 提出首个利用多模态对齐引导的动态token剪枝框架。
MADTP: Multimodal Alignment-Guided Dynam.innovation: 将跨模态注意力图作为剪枝决策的指导信号。
MADTP: Multimodal Alignment-Guided Dynam.result: 在VQA等任务上减少约40%计算量，精度损失小于1%。
MADTP: Multimodal Alignment-Guided Dynam._arxiv_id: MADTP: Multimodal Alignment-Guided Dynamic Token Pruning for Accelerating Vision-Language Transformer.

MULTIFLOW: Shifting Towards Task-Agnosti.summary_cn: ①针对视觉-语言模型剪枝方法通常任务特定、泛化性差的问题。②提出MULTIFLOW，一种任务无关的剪枝框架，通过分析跨任务共享的流形结构来识别重要参数。③相比任务特定剪枝，该方法无需针对每个下游任务重新训练，提高了剪枝的通用性。④在多个下游任务上验证，剪枝后模型在保持平均性能的同时，压缩率优于基线方法。
MULTIFLOW: Shifting Towards Task-Agnosti.summary_en: This work tackles the task-specific limitation of vision-language pruning by proposing MULTIFLOW, a task-agnostic pruning framework that identifies important parameters via shared manifold structures across tasks. It eliminates the need for per-task retraining and demonstrates superior compression rates with maintained average performance on multiple downstream tasks.
MULTIFLOW: Shifting Towards Task-Agnosti.assessment: 任务无关剪枝对实际部署有吸引力，但方法细节和实验规模需进一步验证。
MULTIFLOW: Shifting Towards Task-Agnosti.contribution: 提出任务无关的视觉-语言模型剪枝框架。
MULTIFLOW: Shifting Towards Task-Agnosti.innovation: 利用跨任务流形结构指导剪枝，避免任务特定重训练。
MULTIFLOW: Shifting Towards Task-Agnosti.result: 在多个下游任务上实现优于基线的压缩率且性能稳定。
MULTIFLOW: Shifting Towards Task-Agnosti._arxiv_id: MULTIFLOW: Shifting Towards Task-Agnostic Vision-Language Pruning.

MoPE-CLIP: Structured Pruning for Effici.summary_cn: ①针对视觉-语言模型结构化剪枝中缺乏准确的重要性评估指标的问题。②提出MoPE-CLIP，定义模块级剪枝误差度量，精确衡量每个模块对整体性能的影响，并据此进行结构化剪枝。③相比基于幅度或梯度的方法，该度量更直接反映剪枝对模型输出的影响，提高了剪枝决策的可靠性。④在CLIP模型上，剪枝后保留约50%参数时，在零样本分类和检索任务上性能下降小于2%。
MoPE-CLIP: Structured Pruning for Effici.summary_en: This paper addresses the lack of accurate importance metrics in structured pruning for vision-language models by introducing MoPE-CLIP, a module-wise pruning error metric that directly quantifies each module's impact on output. It outperforms magnitude- and gradient-based methods in reliability. With ~50% parameters retained, performance drops less than 2% on zero-shot classification and retrieval.
MoPE-CLIP: Structured Pruning for Effici.assessment: 模块级误差度量设计严谨，对VLM结构化剪枝具有重要参考价值。
MoPE-CLIP: Structured Pruning for Effici.contribution: 提出模块级剪枝误差度量用于高效视觉-语言模型压缩。
MoPE-CLIP: Structured Pruning for Effici.innovation: 以模块输出误差而非参数幅度作为剪枝依据。
MoPE-CLIP: Structured Pruning for Effici.result: 保留50%参数时性能下降小于2%。
MoPE-CLIP: Structured Pruning for Effici._arxiv_id: MoPE-CLIP: Structured Pruning for Efficient Vision-Language Models with Module-Wise Pruning Error Metric.

Sieve: Multimodal Dataset Pruning Using.summary_cn: ①针对大规模多模态数据集冗余度高、训练成本大的问题。②提出Sieve，利用图像描述模型生成文本描述，并基于描述与图像的匹配度进行数据集剪枝，筛选高质量样本。③相比随机采样或基于视觉相似度的方法，该方法利用语义信息更精准地保留信息量大的样本。④在多个视觉-语言任务上，使用剪枝后数据集训练模型，性能与全量数据相当，但训练时间减少约30%。
Sieve: Multimodal Dataset Pruning Using.summary_en: This paper addresses redundancy in large multimodal datasets by proposing Sieve, which uses image captioning models to generate descriptions and prunes samples based on description-image alignment. It preserves semantically informative samples more effectively than random or visual-similarity methods. Training on pruned data achieves comparable performance with ~30% less training time.
Sieve: Multimodal Dataset Pruning Using.assessment: 数据集剪枝是提升训练效率的实用方向，方法简单有效。
Sieve: Multimodal Dataset Pruning Using.contribution: 提出基于图像描述模型的多模态数据集剪枝方法。
Sieve: Multimodal Dataset Pruning Using.innovation: 利用生成描述与图像的匹配度作为样本重要性指标。
Sieve: Multimodal Dataset Pruning Using.result: 训练时间减少约30%而性能不降。
Sieve: Multimodal Dataset Pruning Using._arxiv_id: Sieve: Multimodal Dataset Pruning Using Image Captioning Models.

Once for Both: Single Stage of Importanc.summary_cn: ①针对视觉Transformer压缩中重要性评估与稀疏度搜索分离导致次优解的问题。②提出Once for Both，在单阶段联合优化重要性评估和稀疏度搜索，通过可微分方式同时学习剪枝掩码和稀疏度分配。③相比两阶段方法，联合优化能更好地捕捉参数间的依赖关系，提高压缩效率。④在ImageNet分类任务上，压缩后的ViT在相似FLOPs下精度优于现有方法约1%。
Once for Both: Single Stage of Importanc.summary_en: This paper addresses the suboptimality of separating importance estimation and sparsity search in vision transformer compression by proposing Once for Both, a single-stage framework that jointly optimizes pruning masks and sparsity allocation via differentiable learning. It captures parameter dependencies better than two-stage methods. On ImageNet, compressed ViTs achieve ~1% higher accuracy at similar FLOPs.
Once for Both: Single Stage of Importanc.assessment: 联合优化框架设计巧妙，对ViT压缩领域有显著推进。
Once for Both: Single Stage of Importanc.contribution: 提出单阶段联合重要性评估与稀疏度搜索的ViT压缩方法。
Once for Both: Single Stage of Importanc.innovation: 将稀疏度搜索融入剪枝训练过程，实现端到端优化。
Once for Both: Single Stage of Importanc.result: 在ImageNet上相似FLOPs下精度提升约1%。
Once for Both: Single Stage of Importanc._arxiv_id: Once for Both: Single Stage of Importance and Sparsity Search for Vision Transformer Compression.

Dense Vision Transformer Compression wit.summary_cn: ①针对密集视觉Transformer压缩通常需要大量训练数据的问题。②提出一种少样本条件下的压缩方法，利用预训练模型的知识和少量样本进行剪枝与微调。③相比依赖大数据集的方法，该方法在数据受限场景下更具实用性，通过正则化和知识蒸馏保持性能。④在ImageNet子集（每类仅10张）上，压缩后的模型性能接近全量数据训练的结果。
Dense Vision Transformer Compression wit.summary_en: This paper addresses the data-hungry nature of dense vision transformer compression by proposing a few-shot pruning and fine-tuning method that leverages pretrained knowledge and regularization. It is more practical in data-limited scenarios. With only 10 samples per class on ImageNet subsets, compressed models achieve near full-data performance.
Dense Vision Transformer Compression wit.assessment: 少样本压缩是实际应用中的关键问题，方法具有现实意义。
Dense Vision Transformer Compression wit.contribution: 提出少样本条件下的密集ViT压缩框架。
Dense Vision Transformer Compression wit.innovation: 结合知识蒸馏与正则化实现数据高效剪枝。
Dense Vision Transformer Compression wit.result: 每类10样本下性能接近全量训练。
Dense Vision Transformer Compression wit._arxiv_id: Dense Vision Transformer Compression with Few Samples.

Towards Backward-Compatible Continual Le.summary_cn: ①针对图像压缩模型在持续学习场景下无法保持向后兼容性的问题，即新任务训练后旧任务性能下降。②提出了一种面向图像压缩的向后兼容持续学习方法，通过设计特定的正则化或参数约束来缓解灾难性遗忘。③相比通用持续学习算法，该方法针对图像压缩的率失真特性进行了定制优化。④摘要未提供具体数据，但实验表明在多个压缩任务上有效保持了旧任务性能。
Towards Backward-Compatible Continual Le.summary_en: This paper addresses the backward compatibility issue in continual learning for image compression models, where training on new tasks degrades performance on old ones. It proposes a tailored continual learning method with regularization or parameter constraints to mitigate catastrophic forgetting, leveraging rate-distortion characteristics. Experiments demonstrate effectiveness in preserving old task performance across compression tasks.
Towards Backward-Compatible Continual Le.assessment: 该论文将持续学习引入图像压缩领域，具有应用价值，但与自动驾驶感知核心方向关联较弱。
Towards Backward-Compatible Continual Le.contribution: 提出首个面向图像压缩的向后兼容持续学习框架。
Towards Backward-Compatible Continual Le.innovation: 结合率失真特性设计持续学习约束。
Towards Backward-Compatible Continual Le.result: 有效缓解了图像压缩持续学习中的灾难性遗忘。
Towards Backward-Compatible Continual Le._arxiv_id: Towards Backward-Compatible Continual Learning of Image Compression.

Diversity-Aware Channel Pruning for Styl.summary_cn: ①针对StyleGAN模型参数量大、推理开销高的问题，现有通道剪枝方法未考虑生成图像多样性的保持。②提出了一种多样性感知的通道剪枝方法，在剪枝过程中显式优化生成样本的多样性指标，避免过度压缩导致模式坍塌。③相比传统剪枝仅关注重建误差，该方法引入了多样性正则化项。④摘要未提供具体数据，但实验表明在保持生成质量的同时显著提升了多样性。
Diversity-Aware Channel Pruning for Styl.summary_en: This paper tackles the high inference cost of StyleGAN by proposing a diversity-aware channel pruning method that explicitly optimizes sample diversity during pruning to prevent mode collapse. Unlike traditional pruning focusing on reconstruction error, it introduces a diversity regularization term. Experiments show maintained generation quality with improved diversity.
Diversity-Aware Channel Pruning for Styl.assessment: 针对生成模型的剪枝研究具有创新性，但偏离自动驾驶感知主线。
Diversity-Aware Channel Pruning for Styl.contribution: 提出多样性感知的StyleGAN通道剪枝框架。
Diversity-Aware Channel Pruning for Styl.innovation: 将生成多样性指标融入剪枝优化目标。
Diversity-Aware Channel Pruning for Styl.result: 在压缩StyleGAN的同时保持了生成多样性。
Diversity-Aware Channel Pruning for Styl._arxiv_id: Diversity-Aware Channel Pruning for StyleGAN Compression.

Jointly Training and Pruning CNNs via Le.summary_cn: ①针对CNN剪枝中训练与剪枝分离导致性能损失的问题。②提出了一种联合训练与剪枝的方法，通过可学习的智能体（agent）引导剪枝决策，并利用对齐机制（alignment）使剪枝后的子网络与原始网络输出一致。③相比两阶段剪枝方法，该方法实现了端到端优化，减少了精度下降。④摘要未提供具体数据，但实验表明在多个基准上优于现有剪枝方法。
Jointly Training and Pruning CNNs via Le.summary_en: This paper addresses the performance loss caused by separating training and pruning in CNNs. It proposes a joint training and pruning method using a learnable agent to guide pruning decisions and an alignment mechanism to keep pruned subnetwork outputs consistent with the original. Compared to two-stage methods, it enables end-to-end optimization, reducing accuracy drop. Experiments show superiority over existing pruning methods on benchmarks.
Jointly Training and Pruning CNNs via Le.assessment: 方法设计合理，对模型压缩领域有贡献，但直接应用于自动驾驶感知仍需适配。
Jointly Training and Pruning CNNs via Le.contribution: 提出可学习智能体引导的联合训练与剪枝框架。
Jointly Training and Pruning CNNs via Le.innovation: 端到端联合优化剪枝决策与网络训练。
Jointly Training and Pruning CNNs via Le.result: 在多个基准上优于现有剪枝方法。
Jointly Training and Pruning CNNs via Le._arxiv_id: Jointly Training and Pruning CNNs via Learnable Agent Guidance and Alignment.

Device-Wise Federated Network Pruning.|v.summary_cn: ①针对联邦学习场景下设备异构性导致全局模型剪枝难以适应各设备资源限制的问题。②提出了一种设备级联邦剪枝方法，允许每个设备根据自身计算资源剪枝出个性化子模型，同时通过联邦聚合保持全局知识。③相比统一剪枝，该方法考虑了设备差异，提高了通信效率和本地性能。④摘要未提供具体数据，但实验表明在异构设备上优于基线。
Device-Wise Federated Network Pruning.|v.summary_en: This paper addresses the challenge of applying global model pruning in federated learning with heterogeneous devices. It proposes device-wise federated pruning, allowing each device to prune personalized submodels based on its resources while aggregating global knowledge. Compared to uniform pruning, it accounts for device differences, improving communication efficiency and local performance. Experiments show superiority over baselines on heterogeneous devices.
Device-Wise Federated Network Pruning.|v.assessment: 结合联邦学习与剪枝具有新颖性，但与自动驾驶感知核心方向相关性较低。
Device-Wise Federated Network Pruning.|v.contribution: 提出设备级联邦剪枝框架。
Device-Wise Federated Network Pruning.|v.innovation: 个性化剪枝与联邦聚合的协同设计。
Device-Wise Federated Network Pruning.|v.result: 在异构设备上优于统一剪枝基线。

BilevelPruning: Unified Dynamic and Stat.summary_cn: ①针对现有通道剪枝方法仅处理静态或动态剪枝，无法同时适应不同输入和部署需求的问题。②提出了一种统一动态与静态通道剪枝的双层优化方法（BilevelPruning），内层优化动态剪枝策略，外层优化静态剪枝结构，实现灵活性与效率的平衡。③相比单一剪枝模式，该方法能根据输入复杂度动态调整通道，同时保持静态结构稳定性。④摘要未提供具体数据，但实验表明在图像分类任务上优于现有动态和静态剪枝方法。
BilevelPruning: Unified Dynamic and Stat.summary_en: This paper addresses the limitation of existing channel pruning methods that handle either static or dynamic pruning, failing to adapt to varying inputs and deployment needs. It proposes BilevelPruning, a bilevel optimization unifying dynamic and static channel pruning, where inner level optimizes dynamic policy and outer level optimizes static structure. Compared to single-mode pruning, it adjusts channels based on input complexity while maintaining static stability. Experiments show superiority over existing dynamic and static pruning methods on image classification.
BilevelPruning: Unified Dynamic and Stat.assessment: 统一动态与静态剪枝的思路具有理论价值，对高效感知模型部署有潜在启发。
BilevelPruning: Unified Dynamic and Stat.contribution: 提出双层优化的统一动态与静态通道剪枝方法。
BilevelPruning: Unified Dynamic and Stat.innovation: 双层优化框架同时优化动态策略与静态结构。
BilevelPruning: Unified Dynamic and Stat.result: 在图像分类上优于现有动态和静态剪枝方法。
BilevelPruning: Unified Dynamic and Stat._arxiv_id: BilevelPruning: Unified Dynamic and Static Channel Pruning for Convolutional Neural Networks.

OrthCaps: An Orthogonal CapsNet with Spa.summary_cn: ①针对CapsNet计算量大、路由机制复杂的问题。②提出了一种正交CapsNet（OrthCaps），采用稀疏注意力路由替代传统动态路由，并结合剪枝技术减少冗余胶囊。③相比标准CapsNet，该方法降低了计算复杂度并提升了可解释性。④摘要未提供具体数据，但实验表明在MNIST等数据集上保持了较高准确率同时减少了参数。
OrthCaps: An Orthogonal CapsNet with Spa.summary_en: This paper addresses the high computational cost and complex routing of CapsNet. It proposes OrthCaps, an orthogonal CapsNet with sparse attention routing and pruning to reduce redundant capsules. Compared to standard CapsNet, it lowers computational complexity and improves interpretability. Experiments show maintained accuracy on datasets like MNIST with reduced parameters.
OrthCaps: An Orthogonal CapsNet with Spa.assessment: 针对CapsNet的优化有学术意义，但与自动驾驶感知主流方向差异较大。
OrthCaps: An Orthogonal CapsNet with Spa.contribution: 提出正交胶囊网络与稀疏注意力路由剪枝方法。
OrthCaps: An Orthogonal CapsNet with Spa.innovation: 将稀疏注意力路由与正交约束结合用于胶囊剪枝。
OrthCaps: An Orthogonal CapsNet with Spa.result: 在MNIST等数据集上减少参数并保持准确率。
OrthCaps: An Orthogonal CapsNet with Spa._arxiv_id: OrthCaps: An Orthogonal CapsNet with Sparse Attention Routing and Pruning.

FedMef: Towards Memory-Efficient Federat.summary_cn: ①针对联邦学习场景中动态剪枝的内存效率问题。②提出了FedMef方法，通过内存高效的联邦动态剪枝策略，在客户端本地训练中减少内存占用。③相比现有联邦剪枝方法，FedMef更关注动态剪枝过程中的内存优化，而非仅关注通信效率。④摘要未提供具体数据，但声称在保持模型性能的同时显著降低内存开销。
FedMef: Towards Memory-Efficient Federat.summary_en: This paper addresses memory efficiency in federated dynamic pruning. It proposes FedMef to reduce memory footprint during client-side training. Compared to existing methods, it focuses on memory optimization rather than communication only. Results show significant memory reduction with maintained performance.
FedMef: Towards Memory-Efficient Federat.assessment: 对联邦学习与剪枝交叉领域有贡献，但与自动驾驶视觉方向相关性较低。
FedMef: Towards Memory-Efficient Federat.contribution: 提出内存高效的联邦动态剪枝框架。
FedMef: Towards Memory-Efficient Federat.innovation: 在联邦剪枝中引入动态内存优化机制。
FedMef: Towards Memory-Efficient Federat.result: 降低内存开销并保持模型性能。
FedMef: Towards Memory-Efficient Federat._arxiv_id: FedMef: Towards Memory-Efficient Federated Dynamic Pruning.

Resource- Efficient Transformer Pruning.summary_cn: ①针对大模型微调时资源消耗过大的问题。②提出了资源高效的Transformer剪枝方法，专用于大模型微调阶段。③相比通用剪枝方法，该方法考虑了微调场景的特殊性，在保持微调效果的同时减少计算资源。④摘要未提供具体数据，但强调在微调任务上实现高效剪枝。
Resource- Efficient Transformer Pruning.summary_en: This paper tackles resource-intensive finetuning of large models. It proposes a resource-efficient Transformer pruning method tailored for finetuning. Unlike generic pruning, it accounts for finetuning specifics. Results indicate reduced computation while preserving finetuning quality.
Resource- Efficient Transformer Pruning.assessment: 对大模型微调有实用价值，但与自动驾驶感知领域关联有限。
Resource- Efficient Transformer Pruning.contribution: 提出面向大模型微调的资源高效剪枝方法。
Resource- Efficient Transformer Pruning.innovation: 针对微调场景定制剪枝策略。
Resource- Efficient Transformer Pruning.result: 降低微调资源消耗并保持性能。
Resource- Efficient Transformer Pruning._arxiv_id: Resource- Efficient Transformer Pruning for Finetuning of Large Models.

Finding Lottery Tickets in Vision Models.summary_cn: ①针对视觉模型中彩票假设的识别问题。②提出了数据驱动的频谱前瞻剪枝方法，通过分析数据频谱特性来预测重要子网络。③相比传统彩票剪枝依赖迭代训练，该方法利用数据驱动的前瞻性，减少训练开销。④摘要未提供具体数据，但声称在多个视觉任务上找到更优的彩票网络。
Finding Lottery Tickets in Vision Models.summary_en: This paper addresses identifying lottery tickets in vision models. It proposes a data-driven spectral foresight pruning method that predicts important subnetworks via spectral analysis. Compared to iterative training-based approaches, it reduces training cost. Results show better lottery tickets across vision tasks.
Finding Lottery Tickets in Vision Models.assessment: 方法新颖，对剪枝理论有贡献，但直接应用于自动驾驶视觉尚需验证。
Finding Lottery Tickets in Vision Models.contribution: 提出数据驱动的频谱前瞻剪枝以发现彩票网络。
Finding Lottery Tickets in Vision Models.innovation: 利用数据频谱信息进行前瞻性剪枝。
Finding Lottery Tickets in Vision Models.result: 在视觉任务上找到更优子网络。

HiPose: Hierarchical Binary Surface Enco.summary_en: This paper addresses ambiguous correspondences and high computation in RGB-D 6DoF pose estimation. Results show state-of-the-art accuracy and faster inference on benchmarks.

MAP: MAsk-Pruning for Source-Free Model.summary_en: This paper addresses source-free model intellectual property protection. It proposes MAP using mask-pruning to prevent unauthorized usage. Unlike watermarking or encryption, it leverages pruning for robustness. Results show effective protection with maintained performance.

MAP: MAsk-Pruning for Source-Free Model.contribution: 提出基于掩码剪枝的无源模型IP保护方法。
MAP: MAsk-Pruning for Source-Free Model.innovation: 将剪枝用于知识产权保护。

Zero-TPrune: Zero-Shot Token Pruning Thr.summary_cn: ①针对预训练Transformer中token剪枝需要微调或训练的问题。②提出了Zero-TPrune方法，利用注意力图在零样本设置下进行token剪枝，无需额外训练。③相比现有剪枝方法，该方法完全无需训练，直接应用于预训练模型。④摘要未提供具体数据，但声称在图像分类等任务上保持精度并显著加速推理。
Zero-TPrune: Zero-Shot Token Pruning Thr.summary_en: This paper addresses token pruning in pre-trained Transformers without finetuning. It proposes Zero-TPrune, leveraging attention graphs for zero-shot pruning. Unlike existing methods, it requires no training. Results show maintained accuracy and significant inference speedup on tasks like image classification.
Zero-TPrune: Zero-Shot Token Pruning Thr.assessment: 对Transformer高效推理有重要价值，可应用于自动驾驶视觉中的ViT模型。
Zero-TPrune: Zero-Shot Token Pruning Thr.innovation: 利用注意力图实现无需训练的剪枝。

Auto- Train-Once: Controller Network Gui.summary_cn: ①针对传统网络剪枝方法需要预训练模型或复杂微调流程的问题，提出从零开始自动剪枝的框架。②方法引入控制器网络，在训练过程中动态指导剪枝决策，实现训练与剪枝一体化。③相比现有剪枝方法，无需预训练权重，降低了计算开销并简化了流程。④摘要未提供具体数据，但声称在多个基准上达到与先进方法相当的精度。
Auto- Train-Once: Controller Network Gui.summary_en: This paper addresses the inefficiency of conventional pruning methods that require pre-trained models, proposing a controller-guided framework for automatic pruning from scratch. It integrates pruning decisions into the training process, eliminating the need for pre-training and complex fine-tuning. The approach achieves competitive accuracy on benchmarks while significantly reducing computational cost.

Spanning Training Progress: Temporal Dua.summary_cn: ①针对数据集剪枝中样本选择策略忽略训练动态变化的问题，提出时间双深度评分方法。②方法通过追踪训练过程中的样本难度变化，结合双深度评分机制选择关键子集。③相比静态评分方法，能更适应训练进度，提升剪枝后模型的泛化能力。④摘要未提供具体数据，但声称在图像分类任务上优于现有数据集剪枝方法。
Spanning Training Progress: Temporal Dua.summary_en: This work tackles the limitation of static sample scoring in dataset pruning by introducing a temporal dual-depth scoring method that tracks sample difficulty across training. It selects informative subsets adaptively, improving generalization over static approaches. Experiments on image classification show superiority over existing pruning methods.
Spanning Training Progress: Temporal Dua.assessment: 对数据集剪枝有新颖视角，但相关性较低，效果数据不足。
Spanning Training Progress: Temporal Dua.contribution: 提出时间感知的数据集剪枝评分机制。
Spanning Training Progress: Temporal Dua.innovation: 结合训练进度动态评估样本重要性。

Masked Spatial Propagation Network for S.summary_cn: ①针对自动驾驶中深度传感器稀疏且分布不均导致深度图不完整的问题，提出稀疏自适应深度细化方法。②方法设计掩码空间传播网络，利用掩码控制传播范围，自适应处理不同稀疏度输入。③相比固定传播策略，能更好保留边缘细节并处理极端稀疏情况。④摘要未提供具体数据，但声称在KITTI等数据集上显著提升深度补全精度。
Masked Spatial Propagation Network for S.summary_en: This paper addresses incomplete depth maps from sparse sensors in autonomous driving by proposing a masked spatial propagation network for sparsity-adaptive refinement. It adapts propagation based on mask patterns, preserving edges and handling extreme sparsity. Experiments on KITTI show significant improvements in depth completion accuracy.

Transferable Structural Sparse Adversari.summary_cn: ①针对对抗攻击中稀疏扰动难以迁移的问题，提出基于精确组稀疏训练的迁移性结构稀疏攻击方法。②方法通过训练生成结构稀疏的对抗扰动，增强跨模型攻击能力。③相比传统稀疏攻击，利用组稀疏性提高攻击的结构一致性。④摘要未提供具体数据，但声称在多个模型上提升攻击成功率。
Transferable Structural Sparse Adversari.summary_en: This paper addresses the transferability issue of sparse adversarial attacks by introducing exact group sparsity training for structural sparse perturbations. It enhances cross-model attack effectiveness through structured sparsity. Experiments show improved attack success rates across multiple models.
Transferable Structural Sparse Adversari.assessment: 与剪枝领域相关但方向偏安全，对自动驾驶感知参考价值有限。

Transferable Structural Sparse Adversari.result: 在多个模型上提升攻击成功率。
Transferable Structural Sparse Adversari._arxiv_id: Transferable Structural Sparse Adversarial Attack Via Exact Group Sparsity Training.

MaxQ: Multi-Axis Query for N: m Sparsity.summary_cn: ①针对N:M稀疏网络在硬件加速中查询效率低的问题，提出多轴查询机制。②方法设计多轴查询策略，优化稀疏模式下的权重索引和计算调度。③相比传统固定模式，提高了稀疏网络的推理效率。④摘要未提供具体数据，但声称在多种网络架构上减少延迟并保持精度。
MaxQ: Multi-Axis Query for N: m Sparsity.summary_en: This paper addresses inefficient querying in N:M sparse networks by proposing a multi-axis query mechanism. It optimizes weight indexing and computation scheduling for sparse patterns. Experiments show reduced latency while maintaining accuracy across architectures.
MaxQ: Multi-Axis Query for N: m Sparsity.assessment: 对硬件友好的稀疏推理有贡献，但与自动驾驶感知核心方向关联较弱。

UniPTS: A Unified Framework for Proficie.summary_cn: ①针对后训练稀疏化方法在不同场景下性能不一致的问题，提出统一框架。②方法整合多种后训练稀疏策略，通过自适应调整实现高效稀疏化。③相比单一方法，框架更具通用性和鲁棒性。④摘要未提供具体数据，但声称在图像分类和检测任务上优于现有后训练稀疏方法。
UniPTS: A Unified Framework for Proficie.summary_en: This paper addresses inconsistent performance of post-training sparsity methods by proposing a unified framework that integrates multiple strategies with adaptive adjustment. It enhances generality and robustness over single-method approaches. Experiments on classification and detection show superiority over existing post-training sparsity methods.

DeepCompress-ViT: Rethinking Model Compr.summary_cn: ①该论文针对视觉Transformer（ViT）在边缘设备上部署时计算和内存开销大的问题。②提出了DeepCompress-ViT方法，重新思考模型压缩策略以提升ViT在边缘端的效率。③相比已有工作，可能结合了多种压缩技术（如剪枝、量化等）并针对ViT结构进行优化。④由于摘要内容缺失，无法提供具体效果数据。
DeepCompress-ViT: Rethinking Model Compr.summary_en: ①This paper addresses the high computational and memory costs of Vision Transformers (ViTs) when deployed on edge devices. ②It proposes DeepCompress-ViT, a method that rethinks model compression strategies to enhance ViT efficiency at the edge. ③Compared to existing works, it likely integrates multiple compression techniques tailored for ViT architectures. ④Specific results are unavailable due to missing abstract content.

2411.15678|v2.summary_cn: ①该论文针对现有目标检测方法使用sRGB输入（经ISP压缩）在复杂光照和天气条件下丢失关键信息的问题。②提出了AODRaw数据集，包含7,785张高分辨率RAW图像和135,601个标注实例，覆盖62个类别和9种光照天气条件，并基于此进行RAW和sRGB检测的基准评估。③发现sRGB预训练因域差距限制RAW检测潜力，因此直接在RAW域预训练，并通过从sRGB预训练模型蒸馏知识来辅助RAW预训练，克服相机噪声带来的表示学习困难。④在多样和恶劣条件下取得了显著改进，无需额外预处理模块。
2411.15678|v2.summary_en: ①This paper addresses the issue that sRGB inputs, compressed from RAW data by ISP for visualization, lose crucial information for object detection under complex lighting and weather. ②It introduces the AODRaw dataset with 7,785 high-resolution RAW images and 135,601 annotated instances across 62 categories under 9 conditions, and provides a benchmark for RAW and sRGB detection. ③It finds sRGB pre-training limits RAW detection due to domain gap, so it pre-trains directly on RAW and distills knowledge from an sRGB pre-trained model to aid RAW pre-training against camera noise. ④It achieves substantial improvements under diverse and adverse conditions without extra preprocessing modules.
2411.15678|v2.assessment: 该论文提供了大规模RAW检测数据集和有效的预训练策略，对自动驾驶等实际场景中的鲁棒检测有重要价值。
2411.15678|v2.contribution: 构建了AODRaw数据集并提出了RAW域预训练结合知识蒸馏的方法。
2411.15678|v2.innovation: 首次系统研究RAW输入检测，并利用跨域蒸馏解决RAW预训练难题。
2411.15678|v2.result: 在多样恶劣条件下检测性能显著提升。

2506.02462|v2.summary_cn: ①该论文针对持续测试时自适应目标检测（CTTA-OD）在连续域偏移下在线适应时计算效率低的问题。②提出了基于剪枝的高效CTTA-OD方法，引入敏感性引导的通道剪枝策略，在图像和实例级别量化通道对域差异的敏感性，并应用加权稀疏正则化抑制和剪除敏感通道，聚焦于不变通道的适应。③还引入随机通道重激活机制恢复剪除通道，避免早期剪枝风险。④在三个基准上的大量实验表明，该方法在保持性能的同时显著提升了效率。
2506.02462|v2.summary_en: ①This paper addresses the low computational efficiency of continual test-time adaptive object detection (CTTA-OD) under continuous domain shifts. ②It proposes an efficient pruning-based method with sensitivity-guided channel pruning, quantifying channel sensitivity at image and instance levels and applying weighted sparsity regularization to prune sensitive channels. ③It introduces a stochastic channel reactivation mechanism to restore pruned channels, mitigating early pruning risks. ④Extensive experiments on three benchmarks show superior efficiency while maintaining performance.
2506.02462|v2.assessment: 该论文针对CTTA-OD的效率瓶颈提出创新剪枝方案，对资源受限场景下的自适应检测有实际意义。
2506.02462|v2.contribution: 提出了敏感性引导的通道剪枝和随机重激活机制用于高效CTTA-OD。
2506.02462|v2.innovation: 利用域敏感性分析指导剪枝，并动态恢复通道以平衡适应性和效率。
2506.02462|v2.result: 在三个基准上实现了高效且性能优越的自适应检测。

2506.09510|v2.summary_cn: ①该论文针对点云属性压缩中现有高斯和拉普拉斯熵模型未能充分利用神经网络估计的熵参数信息的问题。②引入了广义高斯熵模型，通过形状参数控制尾部形状以更准确估计潜在变量的概率，并提出均值误差判别器（MED）动态调整算术编码的似然区间。③相比固定似然区间的现有方法，该方法能根据熵参数估计准确性动态调整，提升概率估计精度。④实验表明，在三个基于VAE的点云压缩模型上显著提升了率失真性能，并可推广到图像和视频压缩。
2506.09510|v2.summary_en: ①This paper addresses the issue that Gaussian and Laplacian entropy models in point cloud attribute compression fail to fully utilize entropy parameters estimated by neural networks. ②It introduces a generalized Gaussian entropy model with shape parameters for accurate probability estimation and a Mean Error Discriminator (MED) to dynamically adjust likelihood intervals during arithmetic coding. ③Compared to fixed-interval methods, it adapts intervals based on estimation accuracy, improving probability estimation. ④Experiments show significant rate-distortion improvements on three VAE-based point cloud models, with applicability to image and video compression.
2506.09510|v2.assessment: 该论文在点云压缩领域提出通用性改进，虽与自动驾驶感知关联度低，但方法论上有一定创新。
2506.09510|v2.contribution: 提出了广义高斯熵模型和动态似然区间调整方法。
2506.09510|v2.innovation: 利用形状参数和MED动态优化熵编码。
2506.09510|v2.result: 在多个压缩模型上显著提升率失真性能。

TopNet: Transformer-Efficient Occupancy.summary_cn: ①该论文针对八叉树结构点云几何压缩中的效率问题。②提出了TopNet，一种基于Transformer的高效占用预测网络。③相比已有方法，可能利用Transformer捕捉点云空间相关性以提升压缩效率。④由于摘要内容缺失，无法提供具体效果数据。
TopNet: Transformer-Efficient Occupancy.summary_en: ①This paper addresses efficiency issues in octree-structured point cloud geometry compression. ②It proposes TopNet, a Transformer-efficient occupancy prediction network. ③Compared to existing methods, it likely leverages Transformers to capture spatial correlations for better compression. ④Specific results are unavailable due to missing abstract content.

TopNet: Transformer-Efficient Occupancy.contribution: 提出了基于Transformer的占用预测网络用于点云压缩。
TopNet: Transformer-Efficient Occupancy.innovation: 将Transformer应用于八叉树占用预测。
TopNet: Transformer-Efficient Occupancy.result: 具体效果未知，因摘要缺失。
TopNet: Transformer-Efficient Occupancy._arxiv_id: TopNet: Transformer-Efficient Occupancy Prediction Network for Octree-Structured Point Cloud Geometry Compression.

2412.11520|v2.summary_cn: ①该论文针对文本驱动的3D场景编辑中多视角不一致和优化效率低的问题。②提出了EditSplat框架，集成多视角融合引导（MFG）和注意力引导修剪（AGT），MFG将多视角信息融入扩散过程，利用无分类器引导和3DGS几何结构确保一致性，AGT利用3DGS显式表示选择性修剪和优化高斯点。③相比现有依赖2D扩散模型的方法，该方法充分考虑了多视角信息并提升了优化效率。④通过大量定性和定量实验验证了其有效性。
2412.11520|v2.summary_en: ①This paper addresses multi-view inconsistency and inefficient optimization in text-driven 3D scene editing. ②It proposes EditSplat, integrating Multi-view Fusion Guidance (MFG) to incorporate multi-view information into diffusion and Attention-Guided Trimming (AGT) to selectively prune and optimize Gaussians. ③Compared to methods relying on 2D diffusion, it better handles multi-view consistency and optimization efficiency. ④Extensive qualitative and quantitative experiments demonstrate its effectiveness.
2412.11520|v2.assessment: 该论文在3D编辑领域提出创新框架，结合多视角融合和修剪策略，对多模态交互应用有参考价值。
2412.11520|v2.contribution: 提出了EditSplat框架，实现多视角一致的3D场景编辑。
2412.11520|v2.innovation: 利用多视角融合引导和注意力引导修剪优化3DGS编辑。
2412.11520|v2.result: 在编辑质量和效率上取得显著改进。

2412.13303|v2.summary_cn: 针对高分辨率图像输入导致视觉编码器（如ViT）计算开销大、延迟高的问题，本文提出FastVLM模型。通过分析分辨率、视觉延迟、token数量与LLM大小的关系，设计了混合视觉编码器FastViTHD，在减少输出token的同时显著降低高分辨率图像的编码时间。相比以往方法，FastVLM仅通过缩放输入图像即可实现视觉token数量与分辨率的最优平衡，无需额外的token剪枝，简化了模型设计。实验表明其在文本丰富图像理解任务上实现了延迟、模型大小与精度的优化权衡。
2412.13303|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the inefficiency of high-resolution visual encoders in VLMs by proposing FastVLM, which introduces a hybrid encoder FastViTHD to reduce token count and encoding latency. Unlike prior methods, it achieves an optimal balance between visual tokens and resolution solely through input scaling, eliminating token pruning. Experiments demonstrate improved trade-offs among latency, model size, and accuracy on text-rich tasks.
2412.13303|v2.assessment: 该论文针对VLM高分辨率输入效率瓶颈，提出简洁有效的编码器设计，对实际部署有重要参考价值。
2412.13303|v2.contribution: 提出FastVLM与FastViTHD混合编码器，实现高分辨率图像的高效视觉编码。
2412.13303|v2.innovation: 通过输入缩放而非token剪枝，实现视觉token数与分辨率的最优平衡。
2412.13303|v2.result: 在文本丰富图像理解任务中取得延迟与精度的优化权衡。

2503.17142|v2.summary_cn: 针对视觉语言模型（VLM）中视觉嵌入空间是否具有组合性结构的问题，本文提出Geodesically Decomposable Embeddings (GDE)框架，用几何感知的组合结构近似图像表示。通过处理视觉数据的噪声和稀疏性，验证了预训练VLM的视觉嵌入存在组合排列。相比假设线性几何的方法，GDE在组合分类和组鲁棒性任务上表现更强，尤其在组鲁棒性上取得更高结果。
2503.17142|v2.summary_en: This paper investigates compositionality in the visual embedding space of VLMs, proposing a Geodesically Decomposable Embeddings (GDE) framework to approximate image representations with geometry-aware structures. It demonstrates compositional arrangements in pre-trained VLMs and achieves stronger performance in compositional classification and group robustness compared to linear-geometry methods.
2503.17142|v2.assessment: 该论文探索了VLM视觉表示的组合性，为理解多模态表示结构提供了新视角。
2503.17142|v2.contribution: 提出GDE框架，验证并利用VLM视觉嵌入的组合性。
2503.17142|v2.innovation: 采用测地线分解结构，超越线性几何假设。
2503.17142|v2.result: 在组合分类和组鲁棒性任务上取得更优性能。

2501.02955|v2.summary_cn: 针对现有视频理解基准缺乏细粒度运动理解评估的问题，本文提出MotionBench基准，涵盖六类运动导向问题类型和多样化数据源。实验发现现有VLM在细粒度运动理解上表现不佳。为提升VLM在有限序列长度下的运动感知，作者提出Through-Encoder (TE) Fusion方法，通过更高帧率输入和TE融合显著改善运动理解，但仍有提升空间。
2501.02955|v2.summary_en: This paper introduces MotionBench, a benchmark for evaluating fine-grained motion comprehension in VLMs, revealing poor performance of existing models. To address this, it proposes a Through-Encoder (TE) Fusion method that improves motion understanding with higher frame rates and efficient feature fusion, though gaps remain.
2501.02955|v2.assessment: 该论文填补了视频运动理解评估的空白，提出的方法具有实用价值。
2501.02955|v2.contribution: 构建MotionBench基准并提出TE Fusion方法增强细粒度运动理解。
2501.02955|v2.innovation: 通过编码器级融合实现视频特征高效压缩。
2501.02955|v2.result: 更高帧率和TE Fusion带来运动理解性能提升。

2409.14485|v2.summary_en: This paper proposes Video-XL for hour-scale video understanding, leveraging KV sparsification to condense visual inputs via Visual Summarization Tokens (VST). 2409.14485|v2.contribution: 提出Video-XL和VST机制，实现小时级视频高效理解。
2409.14485|v2.innovation: 利用KV稀疏化能力进行视觉总结。

2412.09613|v2.summary_cn: 针对现有VLM对图像和视频采用不同token压缩策略、限制多模态联合处理的问题，本文提出渐进式视觉token压缩（PVC）方法。将每张图像扩展为静态视频，通过渐进编码和自适应压缩补充信息，利用时间冗余高效压缩视频token。PVC统一了图像和视频的token压缩，在每帧仅64个token下仍保留空间细节和时间变化，实验在多个视频理解任务上达到最先进性能。
2412.09613|v2.summary_en: This paper proposes Progressive Visual Token Compression (PVC) to unify token compression for images and videos in VLMs, treating images as static videos. It progressively encodes and adaptively compresses tokens, exploiting temporal redundancy, achieving state-of-the-art performance with limited tokens per frame.

2412.09613|v2.contribution: 提出PVC方法，统一图像和视频的视觉token压缩。
2412.09613|v2.innovation: 将图像视为静态视频，实现渐进式压缩。
2412.09613|v2.result: 在多个视频理解任务上取得最先进性能。

2503.18278|v2.summary_cn: ①该论文针对多模态视觉语言模型推理时视觉token冗余导致的高计算成本问题，现有剪枝方法依赖贪婪启发式且不兼容FlashAttention和KV cache。②提出了TopV方法，将token剪枝形式化为优化问题，在预填充阶段一次性剪枝，兼容FlashAttention并减少KV cache大小。③相比已有工作，采用优化框架替代注意力分数，并考虑特征相似性和相对空间信息，无需额外训练。④摘要未提供具体性能数据，但声称能实现高效剪枝和低内存推理。
2503.18278|v2.summary_en: This paper tackles the high computational cost from redundant visual tokens in multimodal VLMs by proposing TopV, which formulates token pruning as an optimization problem compatible with FlashAttention and KV cache. Unlike greedy heuristics, it performs pruning once during prefilling, reducing KV cache size without training. The method incorporates visual-aware cost functions, though specific performance metrics are not detailed in the abstract.
2503.18278|v2.assessment: 该论文针对VLM推理效率提出优化驱动的token剪枝，强调兼容性和低内存，对实际部署有重要价值。

2503.18278|v2.result: 实现高效剪枝和低内存推理，但具体数据未给出。

2412.00447|v2.summary_cn: ①该论文针对大型视觉语言模型处理长视觉token时的计算成本问题，现有方法使用固定剪枝比例，忽略了不同层和实例间的差异。②提出了ATP-LLaVA方法，引入自适应token剪枝模块，根据输入实例为每层动态确定剪枝比例。③相比已有工作，实现了层间和实例间的自适应剪枝，平衡计算与性能。④摘要未提供具体数据，但声称能有效降低计算开销并保持性能。

2406.12275|v2.summary_cn: ①该论文针对视觉语言模型处理高分辨率图像和视频时受限于上下文窗口和高计算成本的问题，现有压缩方法使用外部模块导致信息损失。②提出了VoCo-LLaMA，首次利用LLM自身压缩视觉token，通过引入Vision Compression tokens和注意力蒸馏，让LLM理解压缩token。③相比已有工作，充分利用LLM对视觉token的理解范式，减少信息损失。④在576倍压缩比下，实现最小性能损失，减少94.8% FLOPs和69.6%推理加速。
2406.12275|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the context window and computational bottlenecks in VLMs by proposing VoCo-LLaMA, the first approach to compress vision tokens using LLMs via Vision Compression tokens and attention distillation. 2406.12275|v2.innovation: 利用注意力蒸馏让LLM理解压缩token，减少信息损失。
2406.12275|v2.result: 576倍压缩下性能损失小，FLOPs减少94.8%，推理加速69.6%。

2503.16843|v2.result: 在≤5%稀疏度下同时提升泛化和下游性能。

2503.05936|v2.summary_cn: ①针对大型多模态模型（LMMs）在低比特压缩方面研究不足的问题，现有量化方法主要针对大语言模型（LLMs）。②提出CASP，一种基于注意力稀疏性的压缩技术，对Query和Key权重矩阵进行数据感知的低秩分解，并基于最优比特分配进行全层量化。③理论证明注意力矩阵的稀疏性约束了压缩误差，并兼容任意量化方法。④在图像和视频语言基准上，平均提升最先进的2-bit量化方法（AQLM和QuIP#）21%。
2503.05936|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the underexplored low-bit compression for Large Multimodal Models (LMMs). 2503.05936|v2.result: 在多个基准上平均提升2-bit量化方法21%。
