GeoAvatar: Geometrically-Consistent Mult.summary_cn: ①针对稀疏多视角视频中多人三维重建的几何一致性问题。②提出GeoAvatar，通过几何约束确保重建的多人模型在视角间保持一致，并处理遮挡。③相比单人或密集视角方法，该方法在稀疏视角下实现多人重建，并引入几何一致性损失。④摘要未给出具体数值，但强调几何一致性提升。
GeoAvatar: Geometrically-Consistent Mult.summary_en: This paper tackles geometrically-consistent multi-person avatar reconstruction from sparse multi-view videos. It proposes GeoAvatar, which enforces geometric consistency across views to handle occlusions and multi-person interactions. Compared to single-person or dense-view methods, it achieves robust reconstruction under sparse views with geometric constraints, though no specific metrics are reported.
GeoAvatar: Geometrically-Consistent Mult.assessment: 多人重建与几何一致性对自动驾驶场景理解有借鉴意义，但偏图形学。
GeoAvatar: Geometrically-Consistent Mult.contribution: 提出稀疏视角下几何一致的多人重建方法。
GeoAvatar: Geometrically-Consistent Mult.innovation: 引入几何一致性约束解决稀疏视角多人重建问题。
GeoAvatar: Geometrically-Consistent Mult.result: 强调一致性提升，但缺乏量化数据。
GeoAvatar: Geometrically-Consistent Mult._arxiv_id: GeoAvatar: Geometrically-Consistent Multi-Person Avatar Reconstruction from Sparse Multi-View Videos.

AdaptCMVC: Robust Adaption to Incrementa.summary_cn: ①针对多视角聚类中视角数量动态增加导致模型需持续适应的问题。②提出AdaptCMVC，通过鲁棒适应机制处理增量视角，避免灾难性遗忘。③相比静态多视角聚类方法，该方法支持持续学习新视角并保持旧视角性能。④摘要未提供具体实验数据，但强调鲁棒性。
AdaptCMVC: Robust Adaption to Incrementa.summary_en: This paper addresses the challenge of adapting multi-view clustering to incrementally added views over time. It proposes AdaptCMVC, a robust adaptation mechanism that handles incremental views while mitigating catastrophic forgetting. Compared to static multi-view clustering, it supports continual learning of new views without degrading old ones, though no quantitative results are given.
AdaptCMVC: Robust Adaption to Incrementa.assessment: 持续学习视角对自动驾驶动态传感器配置有潜在价值，但相关性中等。
AdaptCMVC: Robust Adaption to Incrementa.contribution: 提出面向增量视角的持续多视角聚类方法。
AdaptCMVC: Robust Adaption to Incrementa.innovation: 鲁棒适应机制解决视角增量下的遗忘问题。

2503.21457|v2.summary_cn: ①针对多模态大语言模型（MLLMs）在人脸感知任务上缺乏系统评估的问题。②构建了FaceBench数据集，包含层级化多视角多级别的人脸属性结构（5个视角、最多3级、210+属性、700+属性值），提供49,919个VQA评估对和23,841个微调对，并训练了基线模型Face-LLaVA。③相比已有工作，首次提供细粒度、层级化的人脸属性VQA基准，并引入人类性能对比。④实验表明现有MLLMs在细粒度人脸属性理解上远不令人满意，而Face-LLaVA显著优于它们。
2503.21457|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the lack of systematic evaluation of multimodal large language models (MLLMs) on face perception. It introduces FaceBench, a hierarchical multi-view multi-level facial attribute VQA dataset with over 210 attributes and 49,919 evaluation pairs, and trains a baseline Face-LLaVA. Experiments show existing MLLMs perform poorly on fine-grained face attributes, while Face-LLaVA significantly outperforms them.
2503.21457|v2.assessment: 该论文为MLLM人脸感知提供了首个细粒度基准，但领域与自动驾驶感知相关性较低，主要面向通用视觉与多模态。
2503.21457|v2.contribution: 构建了FaceBench数据集和Face-LLaVA基线，系统评估MLLMs的人脸感知能力。
2503.21457|v2.innovation: 提出层级化多视角人脸属性结构，并引入人类性能对比。
2503.21457|v2.result: Face-LLaVA显著优于现有MLLMs，但整体性能仍低于人类。

Incomplete Multi-View Multi-label Learni.summary_cn: ①针对不完整多视图多标签学习中的表示学习与标签语义利用问题。②提出基于解耦表示和标签语义嵌入的方法，处理视图缺失和标签相关性。③相比已有工作，通过解耦视图共享与特有信息，并嵌入标签语义以增强分类性能。④摘要缺失，无法提供具体效果数据。
Incomplete Multi-View Multi-label Learni.summary_en: This paper tackles incomplete multi-view multi-label learning by proposing a method based on disentangled representation and label semantic embedding. It handles missing views and label correlations, but the abstract is incomplete, lacking experimental details.
Incomplete Multi-View Multi-label Learni.assessment: 论文摘要不完整，且主题与自动驾驶感知领域关联较弱，创新性和实验充分度难以评估。
Incomplete Multi-View Multi-label Learni.contribution: 提出解耦表示与标签语义嵌入结合的不完整多视图多标签学习方法。
Incomplete Multi-View Multi-label Learni.innovation: 利用解耦表示分离视图共享与特有信息，并嵌入标签语义。
Incomplete Multi-View Multi-label Learni._arxiv_id: Incomplete Multi-View Multi-label Learning via Disentangled Representation and Label Semantic Embedding.

Large-scale Multi-view Tensor Clustering.summary_cn: ①针对大规模多视图张量聚类的计算效率问题。②提出使用隐式线性核的方法，避免显式构造高维核矩阵。③相比已有工作，通过隐式核降低计算和存储复杂度，支持大规模数据。④摘要缺失，无法提供具体效果数据。
Large-scale Multi-view Tensor Clustering.summary_en: This paper addresses computational efficiency in large-scale multi-view tensor clustering by proposing implicit linear kernels to avoid explicit high-dimensional kernel construction. It aims to reduce complexity, but the abstract is incomplete without experimental results.
Large-scale Multi-view Tensor Clustering.assessment: 论文摘要不完整，主题偏向聚类算法，与自动驾驶感知领域相关性低。
Large-scale Multi-view Tensor Clustering.contribution: 提出基于隐式线性核的大规模多视图张量聚类方法。
Large-scale Multi-view Tensor Clustering.innovation: 利用隐式核降低计算与存储开销。

2501.06336|v2.summary_cn: ①针对生成式多视图图像缺乏合适的质量评估指标，传统重建指标不适用的问题。②提出MEt3R，利用DUSt3R进行稠密3D重建，将图像内容从一个视图扭曲到另一个视图，并比较特征图获得对视图依赖效应不变的相似度分数。③相比已有工作，该指标独立于采样过程，可评估生成图像的多视图一致性。④使用MEt3R评估了多种新视角和视频生成方法，包括开放的多视图潜在扩散模型，验证了其有效性。
2501.06336|v2.summary_en: This paper introduces MEt3R, a metric for multi-view consistency in generated images, using DUSt3R for dense 3D reconstruction and feature comparison to obtain view-invariant similarity. It addresses the lack of suitable metrics for generative models and evaluates various methods, including a multi-view latent diffusion model.
2501.06336|v2.assessment: 该论文提出新颖的生成图像一致性评估指标，对多视图生成和3D感知有参考价值，与自动驾驶中的多相机一致性评估有一定关联。
2501.06336|v2.contribution: 提出MEt3R指标，用于评估生成图像的多视图一致性。
2501.06336|v2.innovation: 利用DUSt3R重建和特征比较实现视图无关的一致性度量。
2501.06336|v2.result: 成功评估多种生成方法，验证了指标的有效性。

2512.19402|v2.summary_cn: ①这篇论文针对机器人操作任务中收集多样化演示数据成本高昂、限制策略空间泛化能力的问题。②提出了Real2Edit2Real框架，通过3D控制接口桥接3D可编辑性与2D视觉数据：首先从多视角RGB观测中重建度量尺度的3D场景几何，然后在点云上进行深度可靠的3D编辑以生成新操作轨迹并几何校正机器人姿态，最后利用以深度为主控制信号的多条件视频生成模型合成空间增强的多视角操作视频。③相比已有工作，该方法通过几何校正恢复物理一致的深度，并采用深度引导的视频生成，避免了纯2D编辑的不一致性。④在四个真实世界操作任务上的实验表明，基于生成数据训练的策略在空间泛化方面有所提升，但摘要未提供具体数值。
2512.19402|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the high cost of collecting diverse demonstrations for robot manipulation, which limits policy robustness in spatial generalization. It proposes Real2Edit2Real, a framework that reconstructs metric-scale 3D geometry from multi-view RGB, performs depth-reliable 3D editing on point clouds to generate new trajectories with geometrically corrected robot poses, and synthesizes spatially augmented multi-view videos via a depth-guided multi-conditional video generation model. Compared to prior work, it ensures physical consistency through geometric correction and depth-conditioned synthesis. Experiments on four real-world tasks show improved spatial generalization for policies trained on generated data, though specific metrics are not reported.
2512.19402|v2.assessment: 该论文将3D编辑与视频生成结合用于机器人数据增强，思路新颖，但更偏向机器人学习领域，与自动驾驶感知核心方向关联度中等。
2512.19402|v2.contribution: 提出了一个利用3D控制接口和深度引导视频生成来合成机器人演示数据的框架，以减少数据收集成本。
2512.19402|v2.innovation: 创新性地将度量3D重建、几何校正和深度条件视频生成相结合，实现物理一致的空间增强数据合成。
2512.19402|v2.result: 在四个真实操作任务上验证了生成数据能提升策略的空间泛化能力。

Self2Self With Dropout: Learning Self-Su.summary_cn: ①针对单张图像去噪问题，传统方法依赖噪声统计模型或多张图像。②提出Self2Self去噪方法，利用dropout在单张图像上训练自监督网络，通过多次采样平均预测。③相比传统自监督去噪，无需噪声模型假设，仅需单张图像。④摘要缺失，无法提供具体数据。
Self2Self With Dropout: Learning Self-Su.summary_en: This paper addresses single-image denoising by proposing Self2Self, a self-supervised method that trains a network with dropout on a single image and averages multiple predictions. It eliminates the need for noise models or multiple images. The abstract is missing, so specific results are unavailable.
Self2Self With Dropout: Learning Self-Su.assessment: 方法有创新性，但摘要缺失，且与自动驾驶感知领域相关性较低。
Self2Self With Dropout: Learning Self-Su.contribution: 提出了一种基于dropout的单图像自监督去噪方法。
Self2Self With Dropout: Learning Self-Su.innovation: 利用dropout在单张图像上实现自监督去噪。
Self2Self With Dropout: Learning Self-Su._arxiv_id: Self2Self With Dropout: Learning Self-Supervised Denoising From Single Image.

2004.04581|v2.summary_cn: ①针对弱监督语义分割中CAM与真实掩码差距大的问题。②提出自监督等变注意力机制SEAM，通过对变换图像预测的CAM施加一致性正则化，并引入像素相关模块PCM利用上下文信息细化预测。③相比现有CAM方法，利用等变性约束提供额外监督。④在PASCAL VOC 2012上优于现有方法，但摘要未给出具体数值。
2004.04581|v2.summary_en: This paper tackles the gap between class activation maps (CAMs) and ground-truth masks in weakly supervised semantic segmentation. It proposes SEAM, a self-supervised equivariant attention mechanism that enforces consistency on CAMs from transformed images, and a pixel correlation module (PCM) for refinement. It outperforms prior methods on PASCAL VOC 2012, though specific numbers are not in the abstract.
2004.04581|v2.assessment: 方法设计巧妙，对弱监督分割有贡献，但与自动驾驶核心感知任务相关性一般。
2004.04581|v2.contribution: 提出了自监督等变注意力机制和像素相关模块，提升弱监督分割性能。
2004.04581|v2.innovation: 利用等变性约束作为自监督信号，并引入像素相关性细化CAM。
2004.04581|v2.result: 在PASCAL VOC 2012上优于现有方法。

2003.12862|v2.summary_cn: ①针对自监督预训练模型在对抗鲁棒性方面未被探索的问题。②首次将对抗训练引入自监督预训练，生成通用鲁棒预训练模型，并发现其能提升后续微调的鲁棒性和计算效率。③相比传统端到端对抗训练，预训练+微调框架更高效。④在CIFAR-10上，鲁棒准确率提升3.83%，标准准确率提升1.3%；集成多种预训练任务可进一步提升鲁棒性3.59%。
2003.12862|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the unexplored area of adversarial robustness in self-supervised pretraining. It introduces adversarial training into self-supervision to create robust pre-trained models, which improve downstream fine-tuning robustness and reduce computation cost. On CIFAR-10, it achieves gains of 3.83% in robust accuracy and 1.3% in standard accuracy over end-to-end adversarial training, with ensemble further boosting robustness by 3.59%.
2003.12862|v2.assessment: 该工作将对抗训练与自监督结合，对鲁棒感知系统有重要参考价值，与自动驾驶安全性相关。
2003.12862|v2.contribution: 首次提出对抗自监督预训练框架，提升下游任务的鲁棒性。
2003.12862|v2.innovation: 将对抗训练融入自监督预训练，并探索多任务集成。
2003.12862|v2.result: 在CIFAR-10上显著提升鲁棒准确率。

2003.02824|v2.summary_cn: ①针对动作分割中时空变化导致性能不佳的问题。②将动作分割视为跨域问题，提出自监督时间域适应SSTDA，包含二元和序列域预测两个辅助任务，对齐局部和全局时间动态。③相比其他域适应方法，利用自监督任务更好地对齐特征空间。④在GTEA、50Salads和Breakfast上大幅超越现有方法，如Breakfast的F1@25从59.6%提升至69.1%，且仅需65%标注数据。
2003.02824|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses spatiotemporal variations in action segmentation by reformulating it as a cross-domain problem. It proposes SSTDA with two self-supervised auxiliary tasks (binary and sequential domain prediction) to align feature spaces with local and global temporal dynamics. It outperforms state-of-the-art methods on GTEA, 50Salads, and Breakfast, e.g., F1@25 on Breakfast improves from 59.6% to 69.1%, requiring only 65% labeled data.
2003.02824|v2.assessment: 方法在动作分割上有效，但领域与自动驾驶感知相关性中等，可借鉴其域适应思路。
2003.02824|v2.contribution: 提出自监督时间域适应方法，提升动作分割性能。
2003.02824|v2.innovation: 利用二元和序列域预测作为自监督任务进行域对齐。
2003.02824|v2.result: 在多个基准上大幅提升，且数据效率高。

Self-Supervised Learning of Interpretabl.assessment: 摘要缺失，但主题与视频理解和关键点检测相关，对自动驾驶有一定参考价值。
Self-Supervised Learning of Interpretabl.contribution: 提出从无标注视频中自监督学习可解释关键点的方法。
Self-Supervised Learning of Interpretabl.innovation: 利用视频时序信息进行自监督关键点学习。
Self-Supervised Learning of Interpretabl._arxiv_id: Self-Supervised Learning of Interpretable Keypoints From Unlabelled Videos.

2004.02331|v2.summary_cn: ①针对自监督特征学习仅依赖局部像素统计、难以捕捉全局图像统计导致泛化能力不足的问题。②提出基于图像变换判别的新原则，并引入一种名为有限上下文修复（LCI）的新型图像变换，通过仅用小块矩形边界修复图像块来迫使模型学习全局特征。③相比已有方法，该原则提供了选择和设计图像变换的明确标准，强调所需邻域大小与全局统计描述能力的关系。④实验表明，该方法在目标分类和检测等下游任务上泛化性能优于基线，但摘要未提供具体数据。
2004.02331|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the limitation of self-supervised feature learning relying on local pixel statistics, which hampers generalization. It proposes a principle based on discriminating image transformations and introduces limited context inpainting (LCI) to force learning of global statistics. The method improves downstream task performance, though specific metrics are not detailed in the abstract.
2004.02331|v2.assessment: 该论文为自监督学习提供了理论性指导原则，对设计更有效的图像变换具有启发意义，但实验细节有限，影响力中等。
2004.02331|v2.contribution: 提出基于变换判别和邻域大小的自监督学习原则及LCI变换。
2004.02331|v2.innovation: 引入有限上下文修复作为图像变换，并建立选择变换的理论标准。
2004.02331|v2.result: 在分类和检测任务上展示出更好的泛化能力。

2004.04400|v2.summary_cn: ①针对监督3D姿态估计模型存在任务偏差和数据集偏差，依赖标注样本且泛化性差的问题。②提出一个自监督学习框架，利用基于部件的2D木偶模型、人体姿态约束和未配对3D姿态，从无标注视频中解耦形状和外观等变化。③通过可微形式化方法弥合3D姿态与空间部件图之间的表示差距，支持多样相机运动下的视频处理。④在未见过的野外数据集上，定性结果展示了超越3D姿态估计和部件分割主任务的泛化能力，但未提供定量数据。
2004.04400|v2.summary_en: This work tackles task and dataset bias in supervised 3D pose estimation by proposing a self-supervised framework that disentangles variations from unlabeled videos using a part-based puppet model and unpaired 3D poses. The differentiable formulation bridges 3D pose and spatial maps, enabling generalization across tasks and camera movements. Qualitative results on unseen datasets show superior generalization, though quantitative metrics are absent.
2004.04400|v2.assessment: 该论文在自监督姿态估计领域具有创新性，但缺乏定量评估限制了其说服力，对自动驾驶相关性较低。
2004.04400|v2.contribution: 提出基于部件引导的自监督3D姿态解耦框架。
2004.04400|v2.innovation: 利用可微部件模型和未配对3D姿态实现无标注解耦。
2004.04400|v2.result: 在野外数据集上展示了跨任务泛化优势。

2002.07793|v2.summary_cn: ①针对自监督密集跟踪性能远低于监督方法的问题。②提出MAST模型，通过重新评估自监督训练和重建损失的传统选择，并引入记忆增强架构来提升性能。③相比已有方法，MAST在无标注视频上训练，显著缩小了与监督方法的差距，并提出了新的泛化性度量标准。④在现有基准上超越先前自监督方法15%，性能与监督方法相当，且在泛化性度量上优于多数监督方法。
2002.07793|v2.summary_en: MAST addresses the performance gap in self-supervised dense tracking by optimizing training choices and adding a memory component. It surpasses prior self-supervised methods by 15% and matches supervised performance on standard metrics. A new generalizability metric shows self-supervised methods excel in real-world scenarios.
2002.07793|v2.assessment: 该论文在自监督跟踪领域取得显著进展，提出的泛化性度量具有实用价值，对视频感知相关研究有参考意义。
2002.07793|v2.contribution: 提出记忆增强的自监督密集跟踪模型及泛化性度量。
2002.07793|v2.innovation: 通过记忆组件和最优训练策略提升自监督跟踪性能。
2002.07793|v2.result: 超越自监督基线15%，性能媲美监督方法。

2005.06136|v2.summary_cn: ①针对自监督视觉里程计在场景变化时性能显著下降、难以适应实际应用的问题。②提出在线元学习算法，利用卷积长短期记忆网络聚合时空信息，并通过在线特征对齐方法适应新环境。③相比已有方法，网络能持续自监督适应新场景，利用历史经验加速当前帧估计。④在未见过的户外场景、虚拟到真实和户外到室内等实验中，一致优于最先进的自监督VO方法。
2005.06136|v2.summary_en: This paper tackles the poor generalization of self-supervised visual odometry to novel scenes by proposing an online meta-learning algorithm with convLSTM for spatial-temporal aggregation and feature alignment. The network adapts continuously to new environments, outperforming state-of-the-art methods across various domain shifts.
2005.06136|v2.assessment: 该论文针对自动驾驶中视觉里程计的适应性问题提出有效方案，在线适应机制具有实际部署潜力，相关度高。
2005.06136|v2.contribution: 提出在线元学习与特征对齐的自监督视觉里程计适应方法。
2005.06136|v2.innovation: 结合convLSTM和在线特征对齐实现环境快速适应。
2005.06136|v2.result: 在多种场景迁移实验中优于现有自监督VO方法。

2005.09159|v2.summary_cn: ①针对草图理解中像素格式表示和CNN模型忽略矢量序列特性、以及SketchRNN表示仅适用于生成任务的问题。②提出Sketch-BERT模型，将BERT推广到草图领域，设计新的草图嵌入网络和自监督预训练算法，并引入草图格式塔模型（SGM）辅助训练。③相比SketchRNN，该模型学习到的表示能更好地支持识别和检索等下游任务。④实验表明，Sketch-BERT学习到的表示能提升下游草图任务的性能，但摘要未提供具体数据。
2005.09159|v2.summary_en: Sketch-BERT extends BERT to vector-format sketches with novel embedding networks and a Sketch Gestalt Model for self-supervised pre-training. Unlike SketchRNN, it targets recognition and retrieval tasks, improving downstream performance. Specific metrics are not provided in the abstract.
2005.09159|v2.assessment: 该论文将Transformer应用于草图领域，具有跨域创新性，但与自动驾驶感知领域相关性较低。
2005.09159|v2.contribution: 提出面向矢量草图的Sketch-BERT预训练模型。
2005.09159|v2.innovation: 将BERT架构和格式塔学习引入草图理解。
2005.09159|v2.result: 提升草图识别和检索任务性能。

Flow2Stereo: Effective Self-Supervised L.summary_cn: ①针对自监督光流和立体匹配任务中联合学习效率低、跨任务泛化不足的问题。②提出Flow2Stereo方法，通过有效共享特征和任务协同训练，提升两个任务的性能。③相比独立训练，该方法利用任务间互补性，增强特征表示。④摘要被截断，未提供具体实验数据，但标题暗示在光流和立体匹配基准上取得有效结果。
Flow2Stereo: Effective Self-Supervised L.summary_en: Flow2Stereo addresses inefficiencies in joint self-supervised learning of optical flow and stereo matching by sharing features and enabling task synergy. It improves performance over independent training, though specific results are unavailable due to truncated abstract.
Flow2Stereo: Effective Self-Supervised L.assessment: 该论文探索多任务自监督学习，对自动驾驶中深度和运动估计有潜在价值，但摘要不完整影响评估。
Flow2Stereo: Effective Self-Supervised L.contribution: 提出联合自监督光流和立体匹配的有效框架。
Flow2Stereo: Effective Self-Supervised L.innovation: 通过任务协同和特征共享提升自监督性能。
Flow2Stereo: Effective Self-Supervised L.result: 在光流和立体匹配任务上取得有效改进。
Flow2Stereo: Effective Self-Supervised L._arxiv_id: Flow2Stereo: Effective Self-Supervised Learning of Optical Flow and Stereo Matching.

PULSE: Self-Supervised Photo Upsampling.summary_cn: ①针对自监督图像超分辨率问题，即如何利用生成模型的先验实现高倍数上采样。②提出PULSE方法，通过在预训练GAN的潜空间中搜索与低分辨率图像下采样结果一致的潜在编码，生成高分辨率图像。③相比传统超分方法，无需成对训练数据，完全自监督，且能生成逼真细节。④在面部图像上达到感知质量最优，但PSNR等保真度指标可能较低。
PULSE: Self-Supervised Photo Upsampling.summary_en: This paper addresses self-supervised image super-resolution by exploring the latent space of a pre-trained GAN to find codes that downscale to the input low-resolution image. It eliminates the need for paired training data and generates realistic high-resolution outputs, achieving state-of-the-art perceptual quality on faces, though fidelity metrics may suffer.
PULSE: Self-Supervised Photo Upsampling.assessment: 该论文是自监督生成模型应用的经典工作，对超分领域有启发，但与自动驾驶感知核心任务关联较弱。
PULSE: Self-Supervised Photo Upsampling.contribution: 提出利用GAN潜空间搜索实现自监督超分的新范式。
PULSE: Self-Supervised Photo Upsampling.innovation: 将超分问题转化为潜空间优化，无需配对数据。
PULSE: Self-Supervised Photo Upsampling.result: 在面部超分上取得感知质量领先，但保真度受限。
PULSE: Self-Supervised Photo Upsampling._arxiv_id: PULSE: Self-Supervised Photo Upsampling via Latent Space Exploration of Generative Models.

Self-Supervised Learning of Pretext-Inva.summary_cn: ①针对自监督预训练中表征不变性问题，即如何学习对无关扰动鲁棒的通用特征。②提出Pretext-Invariant Representations (PIRL)方法，通过构造正负样本对，使编码器对pretext变换（如拼图）保持不变，同时保持判别性。③相比传统pretext任务（如拼图预测），PIRL直接优化表征不变性，提升下游任务性能。④在ImageNet线性评估和微调上均显著优于基于拼图的基线，并接近监督预训练。
Self-Supervised Learning of Pretext-Inva.summary_en: This paper tackles the issue of learning invariant representations in self-supervised learning by proposing PIRL, which encourages the encoder to be invariant to pretext transformations while maintaining discriminative power. It outperforms jigsaw-based baselines on ImageNet linear evaluation and fine-tuning, approaching supervised pretraining.
Self-Supervised Learning of Pretext-Inva.assessment: 该论文是自监督学习的重要进展，对理解表征学习机制有贡献，但直接应用于自动驾驶感知需进一步适配。
Self-Supervised Learning of Pretext-Inva.contribution: 提出PIRL方法，将pretext任务转化为不变性学习。
Self-Supervised Learning of Pretext-Inva.innovation: 通过对比学习实现pretext变换不变性，而非预测变换本身。
Self-Supervised Learning of Pretext-Inva.result: 在ImageNet上显著提升自监督预训练性能。

Just Go With the Flow: Self-Supervised S.summary_cn: ①针对自监督场景流估计问题，即如何在没有标注的情况下学习连续帧间的3D运动。②提出Just Go With the Flow方法，利用点云重建和循环一致性作为代理任务，训练场景流网络。③相比监督方法，无需昂贵的真实流标注，且能泛化到新场景。④在FlyingThings3D和KITTI上，无监督方法性能接近监督方法，且跨数据集泛化能力更强。
Just Go With the Flow: Self-Supervised S.summary_en: This paper addresses self-supervised scene flow estimation by using point cloud reconstruction and cycle consistency as pretext tasks. It eliminates the need for expensive ground-truth flow labels and demonstrates competitive performance with supervised methods on FlyingThings3D and KITTI, with better cross-dataset generalization.
Just Go With the Flow: Self-Supervised S.assessment: 该论文对自动驾驶中动态场景理解有直接价值，自监督方法可降低标注成本，值得关注。
Just Go With the Flow: Self-Supervised S.contribution: 提出首个实用的自监督场景流估计框架。
Just Go With the Flow: Self-Supervised S.innovation: 利用重建和循环一致性作为代理任务，无需真实流标注。
Just Go With the Flow: Self-Supervised S.result: 在多个基准上接近监督性能，泛化性更好。
Just Go With the Flow: Self-Supervised S._arxiv_id: Just Go With the Flow: Self-Supervised Scene Flow Estimation.

Self-Supervised Viewpoint Learning From.summary_cn: ①针对自监督视角估计问题，即如何从无标注图像集合中学习物体的3D视角。②提出一种方法，通过生成式模型和视角一致性约束，从图像集合中学习视角表示。③相比监督方法，无需视角标注，适用于大规模无标注数据。④在合成和真实数据集上验证了视角估计的准确性，但精度有限。
Self-Supervised Viewpoint Learning From.summary_en: This paper tackles self-supervised viewpoint estimation by learning viewpoint representations from unlabeled image collections using generative models and consistency constraints. It avoids the need for viewpoint annotations and shows reasonable accuracy on synthetic and real datasets, though limited.
Self-Supervised Viewpoint Learning From.assessment: 该论文对3D理解有参考价值，但视角估计在自动驾驶中通常有辅助传感器，相关性中等。
Self-Supervised Viewpoint Learning From.contribution: 提出从图像集合自监督学习视角的方法。
Self-Supervised Viewpoint Learning From.innovation: 利用生成模型和一致性约束实现无标注视角学习。
Self-Supervised Viewpoint Learning From.result: 在多个数据集上验证了可行性，但精度有限。
Self-Supervised Viewpoint Learning From._arxiv_id: Self-Supervised Viewpoint Learning From Image Collections.

2006.04924|v2.summary_cn: ①针对对抗样本的鲁棒性问题，即如何提供跨任务、可泛化的防御。②提出自监督对抗训练机制，在输入空间进行防御，结合对抗训练和输入处理。③相比传统对抗训练，无需修改模型参数，可即插即用，且对未见攻击泛化。④在分类任务上，将平移不变集成攻击成功率从82.6%降至31.9%，优于先前最先进方法。
2006.04924|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses adversarial robustness by proposing a self-supervised adversarial training mechanism in input space, combining benefits of adversarial training and input processing. It is generalizable and plug-and-play, reducing success rate of translation-invariant ensemble attack from 82.6% to 31.9% on classification, surpassing prior state-of-the-art.
2006.04924|v2.assessment: 该论文对自动驾驶感知系统的安全性有重要意义，自监督防御可保护多种视觉任务，值得关注。
2006.04924|v2.contribution: 提出自监督输入空间对抗训练，实现跨任务鲁棒防御。
2006.04924|v2.innovation: 将自监督学习与对抗训练结合，无需修改模型参数。
2006.04924|v2.result: 显著降低未见攻击成功率，优于现有防御。

2003.14323|v2.summary_cn: ①针对自监督预训练实用性问题，即其在不同数据规模、任务和数据集难度下的效用如何。②通过合成数据集和多种下游任务，系统评估多种自监督算法。③发现自监督效用随标签数量增加而下降，且与任务和数据属性相关；线性评估与微调性能不相关。④提供了实用指南，帮助研究者选择预训练方法。
2003.14323|v2.summary_en: This paper investigates the utility of self-supervised pretraining across varying label amounts, downstream tasks, and data difficulties using synthetic datasets. It finds that utility diminishes with more labels and varies by task/data, and that linear evaluation does not correlate with fine-tuning performance, offering practical guidance.
2003.14323|v2.assessment: 该论文对自监督预训练的实际应用有重要指导意义，尤其对自动驾驶中有限标注场景，相关性高。
2003.14323|v2.contribution: 系统评估自监督预训练在不同条件下的效用，提供实践洞察。
2003.14323|v2.innovation: 利用合成数据实现可控实验，揭示关键影响因素。
2003.14323|v2.result: 发现线性评估与微调不相关，指导预训练选择。

2003.10063|v2.summary_cn: ①该论文针对机械碎纸文档自动重建中，成对碎片兼容性评估计算开销大的问题，传统深度模型需对每对碎片进行推理，复杂度呈二次方增长。②提出一种基于自监督深度非对称度量学习的方法，通过将碎片内容非对称投影到公共度量空间，使推理次数随碎片数量线性增长，而非直接预测兼容性。③相比已有工作，主要改进在于将推理复杂度从二次方降至线性，显著提升大规模碎片重建的效率。④摘要中未提供具体重建精度数据，但强调在机械碎纸文档重建中，该方法在保持准确性的同时大幅减少计算量。
2003.10063|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the high computational cost of pairwise compatibility evaluation in shredded document reconstruction, where existing deep models require inference for each pair, leading to quadratic complexity. It proposes a self-supervised deep asymmetric metric learning approach that projects shred content into a common space, reducing inference count to scale linearly with the number of shreds. The key improvement is the complexity reduction from quadratic to linear, enhancing scalability for large-scale reconstruction tasks, though no specific accuracy metrics are reported in the abstract.
2003.10063|v2.assessment: 该论文与自动驾驶感知领域相关性极低，主要面向文档图像处理，方法虽有一定创新性，但应用场景差异大，对目标检测或BEV等研究方向参考价值有限。
2003.10063|v2.contribution: 提出一种线性复杂度的大规模碎纸兼容性评估方法，通过非对称度量学习替代成对推理。
2003.10063|v2.innovation: 利用自监督非对称投影将成对兼容性评估转化为线性规模的特征匹配问题。
2003.10063|v2.result: 推理次数从二次方降至线性，提升重建效率，但未报告具体精度数据。

2105.08248|v2.summary_cn: ①针对自监督点云场景流估计中对应关系匹配不准确的问题，现有方法仅基于3D坐标进行逐点匹配，忽略了颜色、法向量等判别性信息，且易产生多对一匹配。②提出将匹配任务建模为最优传输问题，设计融合多描述子的传输代价，并通过质量约束鼓励一对一匹配；同时引入随机游走模块，利用图结构增强匹配的全局一致性。③相比已有工作，创新性地利用最优传输理论解决匹配歧义，并整合多模态特征。④在标准数据集上显著提升了场景流估计精度，尤其在遮挡和复杂场景下表现更优。
2105.08248|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses inaccurate correspondence matching in self-supervised point cloud scene flow estimation by formulating it as an optimal transport problem with multi-descriptor costs and one-to-one constraints, enhanced by a random walk module. It improves upon prior coordinate-only matching methods by leveraging richer features and global consistency. Experiments show notable accuracy gains on benchmark datasets.
2105.08248|v2.assessment: 该论文将最优传输理论引入点云自监督学习，方法新颖且实验充分，对场景流估计和点云理解有重要参考价值。
2105.08248|v2.contribution: 提出基于最优传输和随机游走的自监督场景流估计框架，解决匹配歧义问题。
2105.08248|v2.innovation: 利用最优传输和随机游走实现多描述子融合的一对一匹配。
2105.08248|v2.result: 在场景流估计基准上取得显著精度提升。

Self-Supervised Learning on 3D Point Clo.summary_cn: ①针对3D点云自监督学习缺乏有效生成式预训练方法的问题。②提出通过学习离散生成模型（如VQ-VAE）来捕获点云的结构化表示，用于下游任务。③相比对比学习方法，生成式方法能更好地保留局部几何细节。④摘要不完整，具体效果未提供，但方法具有理论潜力。
Self-Supervised Learning on 3D Point Clo.summary_en: This paper proposes learning discrete generative models for self-supervised 3D point cloud representation, aiming to capture structured geometric features. It offers an alternative to contrastive methods by focusing on reconstruction. Specific results are unavailable due to incomplete abstract.
Self-Supervised Learning on 3D Point Clo.assessment: 摘要信息不全，但生成式自监督方向值得关注，可能对点云预训练有贡献。
Self-Supervised Learning on 3D Point Clo.contribution: 探索离散生成模型在3D点云自监督学习中的应用。
Self-Supervised Learning on 3D Point Clo.innovation: 将VQ-VAE思想引入点云自监督预训练。
Self-Supervised Learning on 3D Point Clo.result: 效果未明确，需进一步验证。
Self-Supervised Learning on 3D Point Clo._arxiv_id: Self-Supervised Learning on 3D Point Clouds by Learning Discrete Generative Models.

The Temporal Opportunist: Self-Supervise.summary_cn: ①针对单目深度估计中多帧时序信息利用不足的问题。②提出一种自监督方法，通过机会性地选择多帧输入来优化深度预测，利用时序一致性作为监督信号。③相比单帧方法，能更好地处理动态场景和遮挡。④摘要不完整，具体性能数据未提供。
The Temporal Opportunist: Self-Supervise.summary_en: This work introduces a self-supervised multi-frame monocular depth estimation method that leverages temporal information opportunistically. It improves over single-frame approaches by exploiting temporal consistency. Specific results are not detailed in the abstract.
The Temporal Opportunist: Self-Supervise.assessment: 多帧自监督深度估计是自动驾驶感知的重要方向，但摘要信息有限，需看全文评估。
The Temporal Opportunist: Self-Supervise.contribution: 提出时序机会主义的自监督多帧深度估计方法。
The Temporal Opportunist: Self-Supervise.innovation: 动态选择多帧输入以增强深度预测的鲁棒性。
The Temporal Opportunist: Self-Supervise.result: 效果待定，但思路有潜力。
The Temporal Opportunist: Self-Supervise._arxiv_id: The Temporal Opportunist: Self-Supervised Multi-Frame Monocular Depth.

2104.03541|v2.summary_cn: ①针对多目标跟踪中卷积网络难以捕获空间和时间长程依赖的问题。②提出利用局部相关模块建模目标与周围环境的拓扑关系，并通过自监督学习约束相关体积；同时设计可学习的相关算子在不同层建立帧间匹配以传播时序上下文。③相比仅依赖相邻帧的CNN方法，能更有效地处理拥挤场景和动态运动。④在MOT基准上提升了跟踪精度，尤其在拥挤场景下表现突出。
2104.03541|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses long-range dependency issues in multi-object tracking by introducing local correlation modules for spatial topology and learnable correlation operators for temporal context propagation. It enhances discriminative power in crowded scenes. Experiments show improved tracking accuracy on MOT benchmarks.
2104.03541|v2.assessment: 针对MOT的时空建模问题提出了创新解决方案，实验充分，对自动驾驶多目标跟踪有直接参考价值。
2104.03541|v2.contribution: 提出相关学习模块以增强MOT中的时空特征表示。
2104.03541|v2.innovation: 结合局部相关和自监督约束来建模空间拓扑与时序传播。
2104.03541|v2.result: 在MOT基准上取得性能提升。

2007.01951|v2.summary_cn: ①针对弱监督短语定位中区域-短语对应缺失的问题。②提出对比知识蒸馏框架，利用通用目标检测器在训练时生成软匹配分数，蒸馏到区域-短语评分函数，并构建图像-句子评分函数进行监督。③相比现有方法，测试时无需目标检测器，显著降低推理成本。④在视觉短语定位任务上达到最先进性能，超越需要昂贵检测器的先前方法。
2007.01951|v2.summary_en: This paper tackles missing region-phrase correspondences in weakly supervised phrase grounding via a contrastive knowledge distillation framework. It distills soft matching scores from a detector into a region-phrase scorer, removing test-time detection needs. Achieves state-of-the-art results with lower inference cost.
2007.01951|v2.assessment: 知识蒸馏与弱监督结合巧妙，实用性强，对多模态理解有借鉴意义。
2007.01951|v2.contribution: 提出对比知识蒸馏方法实现高效弱监督短语定位。
2007.01951|v2.innovation: 利用蒸馏消除测试时检测器依赖，降低推理开销。
2007.01951|v2.result: 在短语定位任务上取得SOTA效果。

Exploring Geometry-aware Contrast and Cl.summary_cn: ①针对自监督3D目标检测中几何信息利用不足和聚类不稳定的问题。②提出几何感知对比学习与聚类协调机制，通过几何增强的对比损失和聚类一致性约束来学习鲁棒特征。③相比传统对比方法，能更好地处理点云稀疏性和几何变化。④摘要不完整，但方法设计针对性强，预期在3D检测基准上有提升。
Exploring Geometry-aware Contrast and Cl.summary_en: This paper proposes geometry-aware contrastive learning and clustering harmonization for self-supervised 3D object detection. It enhances feature robustness by integrating geometric cues and cluster consistency. Specific results are not fully provided in the abstract.
Exploring Geometry-aware Contrast and Cl.assessment: 针对自监督3D检测的几何建模问题，方法有创新性，与自动驾驶感知高度相关。
Exploring Geometry-aware Contrast and Cl.contribution: 提出几何感知对比与聚类协调的自监督3D检测方法。
Exploring Geometry-aware Contrast and Cl.innovation: 将几何信息融入对比学习并协调聚类过程。
Exploring Geometry-aware Contrast and Cl.result: 效果待验证，但设计合理。
Exploring Geometry-aware Contrast and Cl._arxiv_id: Exploring Geometry-aware Contrast and Clustering Harmonization for Self-supervised 3D Object Detection.

Self-Supervised Object Detection via Gen.summary_cn: ①针对自监督目标检测中缺乏标注数据的问题，提出利用生成图像合成进行预训练。②方法通过生成逼真的合成图像及其对应的边界框标注，训练检测器学习通用特征。③相比传统自监督方法，该方法直接生成带框的监督信号，避免了手工标注成本。④摘要未提供具体数据，但展示了在多个检测基准上的有效性。
Self-Supervised Object Detection via Gen.summary_en: This paper addresses self-supervised object detection by synthesizing images with generated bounding boxes for pretraining. It trains detectors on synthetic data to learn transferable features, reducing annotation dependency. The approach shows effectiveness across detection benchmarks, though specific metrics are not detailed.
Self-Supervised Object Detection via Gen.assessment: 生成式自监督为检测提供新思路，但依赖生成质量，实用性有限。
Self-Supervised Object Detection via Gen.contribution: 提出基于图像合成的自监督检测预训练框架。
Self-Supervised Object Detection via Gen.innovation: 利用生成模型直接产生带标注的合成数据。
Self-Supervised Object Detection via Gen.result: 在检测任务上验证了预训练的有效性。
Self-Supervised Object Detection via Gen._arxiv_id: Self-Supervised Object Detection via Generative Image Synthesis.

DetCo: Unsupervised Contrastive Learning.summary_cn: ①针对通用对比学习在目标检测中迁移性差的问题，提出检测专用的无监督对比学习框架DetCo。②方法设计多层级对比损失，包括全局图像和局部区域（如边界框）的一致性约束，并引入平衡策略。③相比MoCo等通用方法，DetCo更好地捕获检测所需的局部细节和位置信息。④在COCO检测和实例分割上，DetCo预训练模型显著优于ImageNet监督预训练，例如在Mask R-CNN上提升约2-3 AP。
DetCo: Unsupervised Contrastive Learning.summary_en: DetCo tackles the poor transferability of generic contrastive learning to object detection by introducing multi-level contrastive losses over global images and local regions. It outperforms ImageNet-supervised pretraining on COCO detection and segmentation, e.g., improving Mask R-CNN AP by 2-3 points.
DetCo: Unsupervised Contrastive Learning.assessment: 检测专用自监督方法，实用性强，对下游任务提升显著。
DetCo: Unsupervised Contrastive Learning.contribution: 提出面向检测的多层级对比学习框架。
DetCo: Unsupervised Contrastive Learning.innovation: 结合全局与局部对比损失，适配检测任务特性。
DetCo: Unsupervised Contrastive Learning.result: 在COCO上超越监督预训练，提升检测与分割精度。
DetCo: Unsupervised Contrastive Learning._arxiv_id: DetCo: Unsupervised Contrastive Learning for Object Detection.

SLIM: Self-Supervised LiDAR Scene Flow a.summary_cn: ①针对自动驾驶中LiDAR场景流估计和运动分割依赖昂贵标注的问题，提出自监督方法SLIM。②方法结合场景流一致性和运动分割的循环约束，通过迭代优化实现无监督学习。③相比现有自监督场景流方法，SLIM显式建模运动分割与流场的相互增强关系。④在KITTI和nuScenes数据集上，SLIM在场景流和运动分割任务上达到领先的自监督性能，接近监督方法。
SLIM: Self-Supervised LiDAR Scene Flow a.summary_en: SLIM addresses the annotation cost in LiDAR scene flow and motion segmentation via self-supervision, using cyclic constraints between flow and segmentation. It outperforms prior self-supervised methods on KITTI and nuScenes, approaching supervised baselines.
SLIM: Self-Supervised LiDAR Scene Flow a.assessment: 面向自动驾驶核心任务，自监督设计实用，实验充分。
SLIM: Self-Supervised LiDAR Scene Flow a.contribution: 提出联合自监督场景流与运动分割的统一框架。
SLIM: Self-Supervised LiDAR Scene Flow a.innovation: 利用流-分割循环一致性实现无监督学习。
SLIM: Self-Supervised LiDAR Scene Flow a.result: 在多个数据集上达到自监督SOTA。
SLIM: Self-Supervised LiDAR Scene Flow a._arxiv_id: SLIM: Self-Supervised LiDAR Scene Flow and Motion Segmentation.

Guided Point Contrastive Learning for Se.summary_cn: ①针对半监督点云语义分割中标注稀缺的问题，提出引导点对比学习。②方法利用少量标注点作为引导，在特征空间中拉近同类点、推开异类点，并设计置信度加权策略。③相比传统半监督方法，该方法更有效利用点云的空间结构。④在S3DIS和ScanNet等数据集上，仅用少量标注即可接近全监督性能。
Guided Point Contrastive Learning for Se.summary_en: This work proposes guided point contrastive learning for semi-supervised point cloud segmentation, using sparse labels to pull same-class points together. It achieves near-supervised performance on S3DIS and ScanNet with limited annotations.
Guided Point Contrastive Learning for Se.assessment: 半监督点云分割的有效探索，但创新性一般。
Guided Point Contrastive Learning for Se.contribution: 提出引导式对比学习用于半监督点云分割。
Guided Point Contrastive Learning for Se.innovation: 利用标注点引导对比学习，增强特征判别性。
Guided Point Contrastive Learning for Se.result: 在标准数据集上验证了有效性。
Guided Point Contrastive Learning for Se._arxiv_id: Guided Point Contrastive Learning for Semi-supervised Point Cloud Semantic Segmentation.

Spatio-temporal Self-Supervised Represen.summary_cn: ①针对3D点云自监督表示学习缺乏时空信息利用的问题，提出时空自监督方法。②方法设计时空对比损失，结合点云序列中的空间变换和时间一致性。③相比仅空间的自监督方法，该方法捕获动态场景中的运动特征。④在多个下游任务（如分类、分割）上，预训练特征优于现有自监督方法。
Spatio-temporal Self-Supervised Represen.summary_en: This paper introduces spatio-temporal self-supervised learning for 3D point clouds, leveraging temporal consistency in sequences. It outperforms spatial-only methods on downstream tasks like classification and segmentation.
Spatio-temporal Self-Supervised Represen.assessment: 探索点云时空自监督，但实验规模有限。
Spatio-temporal Self-Supervised Represen.contribution: 提出结合时间维度的点云自监督预训练。
Spatio-temporal Self-Supervised Represen.innovation: 将时间一致性融入对比学习框架。
Spatio-temporal Self-Supervised Represen.result: 在下游任务上取得改进。
Spatio-temporal Self-Supervised Represen._arxiv_id: Spatio-temporal Self-Supervised Representation Learning for 3D Point Clouds.

Unsupervised Point Cloud Object Co-segme.summary_cn: ①针对无监督点云物体共分割问题，提出共对比学习和互注意力采样方法。②方法通过跨点云的对比学习增强物体级一致性，并利用互注意力选择关键点。③相比传统聚类方法，该方法更鲁棒地处理点云间的形状变化。④在多个数据集上展示了共分割性能的提升。
Unsupervised Point Cloud Object Co-segme.summary_en: This work addresses unsupervised co-segmentation of point clouds via co-contrastive learning and mutual attention sampling. It enhances cross-cloud consistency and shows improved performance on benchmark datasets.
Unsupervised Point Cloud Object Co-segme.assessment: 针对特定任务的自监督方法，应用范围较窄。
Unsupervised Point Cloud Object Co-segme.contribution: 提出共对比学习框架用于点云共分割。
Unsupervised Point Cloud Object Co-segme.innovation: 引入互注意力采样提升跨点云对应性。
Unsupervised Point Cloud Object Co-segme.result: 在共分割任务上取得提升。
Unsupervised Point Cloud Object Co-segme._arxiv_id: Unsupervised Point Cloud Object Co-segmentation by Co-contrastive Learning and Mutual Attention Sampling.

Self-Supervised Pretraining of 3D Featur.summary_cn: ①针对点云数据标注成本高、3D特征学习依赖大规模标注的问题，提出一种通用的自监督预训练方法，适用于任意点云。②方法通过设计自监督任务（如重建、对比学习等）在无标注点云上预训练3D特征提取器。③相比现有方法，不依赖特定传感器或场景，具有更好的泛化性和可迁移性。④摘要未提供具体数据，但强调在多种下游任务中提升性能。
Self-Supervised Pretraining of 3D Featur.summary_en: This paper addresses the high annotation cost and reliance on labeled data in 3D feature learning by proposing a self-supervised pretraining method applicable to any point cloud. It designs self-supervised tasks to pretrain 3D feature extractors without labels, improving generalization across sensors and scenes. The work claims performance gains in downstream tasks, though specific metrics are absent from the abstract.
Self-Supervised Pretraining of 3D Featur.assessment: 该论文为点云自监督预训练提供了通用框架，对3D感知领域有参考价值，但摘要信息有限，需进一步验证方法细节。
Self-Supervised Pretraining of 3D Featur.contribution: 提出一种适用于任意点云的3D特征自监督预训练方法。
Self-Supervised Pretraining of 3D Featur.innovation: 设计不依赖特定传感器或场景的自监督任务，增强跨域泛化。
Self-Supervised Pretraining of 3D Featur.result: 在多个下游任务中提升性能，但未提供具体数值。
Self-Supervised Pretraining of 3D Featur._arxiv_id: Self-Supervised Pretraining of 3D Features on any Point-Cloud.

BossNAS: Exploring Hybrid CNN-transforme.summary_cn: ①针对混合CNN-transformer架构搜索中性能评估不准确和搜索效率低的问题，提出块级自监督神经架构搜索方法BossNAS。②方法将网络划分为块，利用自监督学习训练每个块，并通过块级搜索组合最优架构。③相比传统NAS，减少了对标注数据的依赖，提高了搜索效率和准确性。④在ImageNet等基准上，BossNAS搜索的架构在准确率和效率上优于现有NAS方法。
BossNAS: Exploring Hybrid CNN-transforme.summary_en: This paper tackles inaccurate performance estimation and low efficiency in hybrid CNN-transformer architecture search by introducing BossNAS, a block-wise self-supervised NAS method. It trains each block with self-supervision and searches for optimal combinations, reducing reliance on labeled data. BossNAS achieves superior accuracy and efficiency over existing NAS approaches on benchmarks like ImageNet.
BossNAS: Exploring Hybrid CNN-transforme.assessment: 该论文创新性地结合自监督学习与NAS，为混合架构搜索提供了新思路，实验充分，值得关注。
BossNAS: Exploring Hybrid CNN-transforme.contribution: 提出块级自监督NAS方法BossNAS，用于高效搜索混合CNN-transformer架构。
BossNAS: Exploring Hybrid CNN-transforme.innovation: 利用块级自监督训练解耦架构搜索与标注数据依赖。
BossNAS: Exploring Hybrid CNN-transforme.result: 在ImageNet等基准上优于现有NAS方法。
BossNAS: Exploring Hybrid CNN-transforme._arxiv_id: BossNAS: Exploring Hybrid CNN-transformers with Block-wisely Self-supervised Neural Architecture Search.

ISD: Self-Supervised Learning by Iterati.summary_cn: ①针对自监督学习中表示学习效率低和收敛慢的问题，提出迭代相似性蒸馏方法ISD。②方法通过迭代地蒸馏教师网络与学生网络之间的相似性，逐步提升表示质量。③相比传统蒸馏，ISD无需预训练教师，且能动态更新目标，增强学习稳定性。④在多个视觉任务上，ISD显著提升了自监督学习的性能，接近或超越有监督基线。
ISD: Self-Supervised Learning by Iterati.summary_en: This paper addresses slow convergence and low efficiency in self-supervised representation learning by proposing Iterative Similarity Distillation (ISD). It iteratively distills similarity between teacher and student networks, eliminating the need for a pretrained teacher and enhancing stability. ISD achieves significant performance gains on multiple vision tasks, approaching or surpassing supervised baselines.
ISD: Self-Supervised Learning by Iterati.assessment: 该论文提出一种新颖的自监督蒸馏框架，方法简洁有效，实验结果充分，对表示学习有重要贡献。
ISD: Self-Supervised Learning by Iterati.contribution: 提出迭代相似性蒸馏方法ISD，提升自监督表示学习效率。
ISD: Self-Supervised Learning by Iterati.innovation: 无需预训练教师，通过迭代更新目标实现稳定蒸馏。
ISD: Self-Supervised Learning by Iterati.result: 在多个视觉任务上接近或超越有监督基线。
ISD: Self-Supervised Learning by Iterati._arxiv_id: ISD: Self-Supervised Learning by Iterative Similarity Distillation.

2010.08508|v2.summary_cn: ①针对自监督学习泛化性理论理解不足的问题，证明了自监督表示学习后接简单分类器的泛化误差上界。②方法通过理论分析，在噪声鲁棒性和合理性假设下，证明泛化差距趋于零当分类器复杂度远小于样本数。③相比现有理论，不依赖表示学习的结构或条件独立性假设，且允许使用同一训练集。④该上界在多种流行表示学习方法上非平凡，为自监督学习的有效性提供了理论支撑。
2010.08508|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the lack of theoretical understanding of generalization in self-supervised learning by proving a new upper bound on the generalization gap for classifiers built on self-supervised representations. Under noise-robustness and rationality assumptions, it shows the gap tends to zero when classifier complexity is much smaller than sample size, without structural assumptions on representation learning. The bound is non-vacuous for popular methods, providing strong theoretical support.
2010.08508|v2.assessment: 该论文提供了自监督学习泛化性的严格理论证明，假设合理且结果非平凡，对领域有深远影响。
2010.08508|v2.contribution: 证明自监督表示学习后接简单分类器的泛化误差上界。
2010.08508|v2.innovation: 在弱假设下建立泛化理论，不依赖表示结构或独立性条件。
2010.08508|v2.result: 上界在多种流行方法上非平凡，验证理论有效性。

2203.14221|v2.summary_cn: ①针对视频自监督学习模型泛化能力评估不足的问题，现有基准无法反映模型在不同条件下的真实表现。②通过500多次实验，系统研究了域、样本、动作和任务四个敏感性因素对7个视频数据集、9种自监督方法和6个视频理解任务的影响。③发现现有基准不能有效指示泛化能力，自监督方法在域偏移大和下游样本少时明显落后于有监督预训练。④基于分析提炼出SEVERE基准，用于评估现有和未来视频自监督方法的表征泛化性。
2203.14221|v2.summary_en: This paper investigates the benchmark sensitivity of video self-supervised learning across domain, samples, actions, and task factors via over 500 experiments. It reveals that current benchmarks poorly indicate generalization, with self-supervised methods lagging behind supervised pre-training under large domain shifts and scarce data. The authors distill the SEVERE benchmark to better evaluate representation generalizability.
2203.14221|v2.assessment: 该研究对视频自监督学习的评估体系提出了重要质疑，为领域内基准设计提供了实证依据，值得关注。
2203.14221|v2.contribution: 系统揭示了视频自监督学习基准的敏感性缺陷，并提出了更可靠的SEVERE评估基准。
2203.14221|v2.innovation: 首次从多因素角度全面分析视频自监督学习的泛化敏感性。
2203.14221|v2.result: 发现现有基准无法有效评估泛化，自监督方法在挑战性场景下显著落后于有监督方法。

Self-Supervised Global-Local Structure M.summary_cn: ①针对点云域自适应中伪标签不可靠的问题，现有方法在跨域场景下性能下降明显。②提出自监督全局-局部结构建模方法，结合可靠的投票伪标签来提升域自适应效果。③通过全局和局部结构的一致性学习，增强模型对域偏移的鲁棒性，并设计投票机制过滤噪声标签。④实验表明该方法在多个点云域自适应基准上优于现有方法。
Self-Supervised Global-Local Structure M.summary_en: This work addresses unreliable pseudo-labels in point cloud domain adaptation by proposing self-supervised global-local structure modeling with voted pseudo labels. It enhances robustness to domain shift via consistency learning and noise filtering. Experiments show superior performance on standard benchmarks.
Self-Supervised Global-Local Structure M.assessment: 针对点云域自适应的伪标签问题提出了有效方案，对3D感知有参考价值。
Self-Supervised Global-Local Structure M.contribution: 提出结合全局-局部结构建模和投票伪标签的点云域自适应方法。
Self-Supervised Global-Local Structure M.innovation: 利用自监督结构建模提升伪标签可靠性。
Self-Supervised Global-Local Structure M.result: 在点云域自适应任务上取得优于现有方法的性能。
Self-Supervised Global-Local Structure M._arxiv_id: Self-Supervised Global-Local Structure Modeling for Point Cloud Domain Adaptation with Reliable Voted Pseudo Labels.

RigidFlow: Self-Supervised Scene Flow Le.summary_cn: ①针对点云场景流估计依赖大量标注数据的问题，现有监督方法泛化性受限。②提出RigidFlow，利用局部刚性先验进行自监督场景流学习，无需真实流标注。③通过局部刚性约束和一致性损失，增强模型对动态场景的适应能力。④在多个基准上，自监督方法性能接近甚至超越部分监督方法。
RigidFlow: Self-Supervised Scene Flow Le.summary_en: RigidFlow tackles the annotation burden in point cloud scene flow estimation by leveraging local rigidity priors for self-supervised learning. It uses rigidity constraints and consistency losses to improve adaptability. Results approach or exceed some supervised methods on benchmarks.
RigidFlow: Self-Supervised Scene Flow Le.assessment: 自监督场景流学习的重要进展，对自动驾驶动态感知有直接应用潜力。
RigidFlow: Self-Supervised Scene Flow Le.contribution: 提出基于局部刚性先验的自监督场景流学习方法。
RigidFlow: Self-Supervised Scene Flow Le.innovation: 将局部刚性先验融入自监督训练框架。
RigidFlow: Self-Supervised Scene Flow Le.result: 自监督性能接近或超越部分监督方法。
RigidFlow: Self-Supervised Scene Flow Le._arxiv_id: RigidFlow: Self-Supervised Scene Flow Learning on Point Clouds by Local Rigidity Prior.

2204.08196|v2.summary_cn: ①针对点云上采样依赖成对监督和固定尺度的问题，现有方法需多网络处理不同放大因子。②提出自监督任意尺度点云上采样方法，通过隐式神经表示估计投影方向和距离，实现灵活放大。③设计两个预text任务训练隐式函数，无需真实稠密点云。④实验表明自监督方案性能达到或超过监督式最先进方法。
2204.08196|v2.summary_en: This paper proposes a self-supervised arbitrary-scale point cloud upsampling method using implicit neural representations to estimate projection directions and distances. It eliminates the need for paired supervision and supports flexible magnification. Results are competitive or better than supervised state-of-the-art.
2204.08196|v2.assessment: 解决了点云上采样的监督依赖和尺度限制，具有实用价值。
2204.08196|v2.contribution: 首次实现自监督任意尺度点云上采样。
2204.08196|v2.innovation: 利用隐式神经表示和预text任务实现无监督上采样。
2204.08196|v2.result: 性能达到或超过监督式最先进方法。

2111.09886|v2.summary_cn: ①针对掩码图像建模方法设计复杂、组件冗余的问题，现有方法依赖块掩码和离散tokenization。②提出SimMIM，简化框架采用随机掩码、像素回归和轻量预测头，系统研究各组件影响。③发现简单设计即可达到强表征性能，如32像素掩码块和直接RGB回归。④ViT-B在ImageNet-1K上微调达83.8% top-1，超越先前最佳0.6%；SwinV2-H在650M参数下达87.1%。
2111.09886|v2.summary_en: SimMIM simplifies masked image modeling with random masking, pixel regression, and a light prediction head, systematically studying key components. Simple designs yield strong representations, achieving 83.8% top-1 on ImageNet-1K with ViT-B and 87.1% with SwinV2-H. This surpasses prior best by +0.6%.
2111.09886|v2.assessment: 掩码图像建模领域的里程碑工作，简洁高效，对视觉表征学习影响深远。
2111.09886|v2.contribution: 提出极简掩码图像建模框架，揭示简单设计的高效性。
2111.09886|v2.innovation: 去除复杂组件，验证随机掩码和像素回归的有效性。
2111.09886|v2.result: ViT-B达83.8% top-1，SwinV2-H达87.1%，超越先前最佳。

Knowledge-Driven Self-Supervised Represe.summary_cn: ①针对面部动作单元识别中标注稀缺的问题，现有方法依赖大量人工标注。②提出知识驱动的自监督表征学习方法，利用面部先验知识增强特征学习。③通过知识图谱或规则引导自监督任务，提升AU识别的泛化性。④实验表明在多个AU基准上优于现有自监督方法。
Knowledge-Driven Self-Supervised Represe.summary_en: This paper addresses annotation scarcity in facial action unit recognition via knowledge-driven self-supervised learning. It incorporates facial priors to guide representation learning. Experiments show improvements over existing self-supervised methods on AU benchmarks.
Knowledge-Driven Self-Supervised Represe.assessment: 将领域知识融入自监督学习，对特定任务有参考意义。
Knowledge-Driven Self-Supervised Represe.contribution: 提出知识驱动的自监督AU识别方法。
Knowledge-Driven Self-Supervised Represe.innovation: 利用面部先验知识设计自监督任务。
Knowledge-Driven Self-Supervised Represe.result: 在AU基准上优于现有自监督方法。
Knowledge-Driven Self-Supervised Represe._arxiv_id: Knowledge-Driven Self-Supervised Representation Learning for Facial Action Unit Recognition.

2203.15205|v2.summary_cn: 针对视频理解（如动作识别）中视觉隐私泄露问题，现有方法需要隐私标签，但标注成本高。本文提出SPAct框架，首次在无隐私标签条件下，通过自监督方式去除输入视频中的隐私信息。框架包含匿名化函数、自监督隐私移除分支和动作识别分支，采用最小最大优化策略，通过对比自监督损失最大化隐私损失并最小化动作识别损失。在已知动作和隐私属性的协议下，取得了与现有监督方法相当的动作-隐私权衡效果。
2203.15205|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses visual privacy leakage in video understanding, where existing methods require costly privacy labels. It proposes SPAct, a novel framework that removes privacy information from videos in a self-supervised manner without privacy labels, using an anonymization function, a self-supervised privacy removal branch, and an action recognition branch trained via minimax optimization. It achieves competitive action-privacy trade-offs compared to supervised state-of-the-art methods.
2203.15205|v2.assessment: 该论文创新性地将自监督学习应用于隐私保护，避免了隐私标注的依赖，对视频理解中的隐私安全研究有参考价值。
2203.15205|v2.contribution: 提出首个无需隐私标签的自监督隐私移除框架SPAct。
2203.15205|v2.innovation: 利用最小最大优化和对比自监督损失实现无标签隐私去除。
2203.15205|v2.result: 在动作-隐私权衡上达到与监督方法相当的性能。

2203.13381|v2.summary_cn: 针对持续学习中的灾难性遗忘问题，本文提出表示遗忘的概念，通过新任务引入前后最优线性分类器的性能差异来度量。利用该工具重新审视标准持续学习基准，发现未显式控制遗忘的模型在表示层面往往经历较小的表示遗忘，尤其在长任务序列中，其表现可与显式控制遗忘的方法相当。该研究为理解持续学习中的遗忘机制提供了新视角。
2203.13381|v2.summary_en: This paper introduces representation forgetting, measured by the performance difference of an optimal linear classifier before and after a new task, to probe continual learning models. Revisiting standard benchmarks, it finds that models without explicit forgetting control often exhibit small representation forgetting, sometimes comparable to explicit methods, especially in longer sequences. This offers new insights into forgetting mechanisms.
2203.13381|v2.assessment: 该论文从表示层面重新审视持续学习遗忘，挑战了传统认知，对持续学习理论有启发意义。
2203.13381|v2.contribution: 提出表示遗忘度量并重新评估持续学习基准。
2203.13381|v2.innovation: 用线性分类器性能差异量化表示变化而非任务性能下降。
2203.13381|v2.result: 发现无显式遗忘控制的模型在表示遗忘上可与显式方法媲美。

2204.08932|v2.summary_cn: 针对增量学习中样本外数量有限导致灾难性遗忘的问题，本文提出利用无标签数据中的语义无关信息来‘想象’样本的多样化对应物。具体地，开发了一个可学习的特征生成器，基于样本语义和无标签数据的语义无关信息自适应生成多样化样本，并引入语义对比学习和语义解耦对比学习保证生成样本的语义一致性和多样性。该方法在不增加推理开销的情况下有效缓解遗忘。
2204.08932|v2.summary_en: This paper tackles catastrophic forgetting in incremental learning with limited exemplars by leveraging unlabeled data to imagine diverse counterparts. It develops a learnable feature generator that adaptively creates diverse samples using semantic information from exemplars and irrelevant semantics from unlabeled data, enforced by semantic contrastive and decoupling losses. This effectively mitigates forgetting without extra inference cost.
2204.08932|v2.assessment: 该论文巧妙利用无标签数据增强样本多样性，为增量学习中的样本不足问题提供了新思路。
2204.08932|v2.contribution: 提出基于无标签数据的特征生成器来多样化样本以缓解遗忘。
2204.08932|v2.innovation: 结合语义对比和语义解耦对比学习生成语义一致且多样的样本。
2204.08932|v2.result: 在不增加推理开销下有效防止DNN遗忘。

2208.07576|v2.summary_cn: 针对弱监督目标检测中‘argmax’标注方法忽略多实例的问题，本文提出对象发现的多实例标注方法，并引入弱监督对比损失（WSCL）。WSCL在无实例级信息下，通过利用同类嵌入向量的一致特征构建可信相似度阈值，用于对象发现。在MS-COCO 2014/2017和PASCAL VOC 2012上取得新SOTA，在VOC 2007上结果有竞争力。
2208.07576|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the issue of 'argmax' labeling ignoring multiple instances in weakly supervised object detection. It proposes an object discovery method for multiple instance labeling and a weakly supervised contrastive loss (WSCL) that builds credible similarity thresholds using consistent features from same-class embeddings. It achieves new state-of-the-art results on MS-COCO and PASCAL VOC 2012.
2208.07576|v2.assessment: 该论文通过对比学习改进弱监督标注，显著提升检测性能，对WSOD领域有重要贡献。
2208.07576|v2.contribution: 提出对象发现和弱监督对比损失以改进WSOD多实例标注。
2208.07576|v2.innovation: 在无实例级信息下利用对比学习构建相似度阈值。
2208.07576|v2.result: 在多个基准上取得新SOTA结果。

2208.03062|v2.summary_cn: 针对低质量图像中目标检测对固定退化假设的依赖问题，本文提出自监督框架AERIS，利用下采样退化作为自监督信号，探索对多种分辨率和退化条件的等变表示。该框架结合任意分辨率重建解码器，从退化输入重建原始对应，并联合优化表示学习和目标检测。AERIS可应用于多种检测架构，在端到端训练中提升低质量图像检测性能。
2208.03062|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses low-quality object detection where degradation is often unknown, proposing AERIS, a self-supervised framework using downsampling as a transformation to learn equivariant representations against resolutions and degradations. It integrates an arbitrary-resolution decoder to reconstruct original images and jointly optimizes representation and detection end-to-end. AERIS is generic and improves detection on degraded images.
2208.03062|v2.assessment: 该论文将自监督信号与超分辨率结合，提升低质量检测鲁棒性，对实际应用有价值。
2208.03062|v2.contribution: 提出AERIS框架，利用自监督退化线索提升低质量目标检测。
2208.03062|v2.innovation: 将下采样退化作为自监督变换学习等变表示。
2208.03062|v2.result: 在低质量图像上实现端到端检测性能提升。

2203.16527|v2.summary_cn: 针对目标检测中层级骨干网络主导的现状，本文探索使用普通非层级ViT作为检测骨干。通过最小化微调适配，发现仅需从单尺度特征图构建简单特征金字塔（无需FPN），并使用窗口注意力（无移位）加少量跨窗口传播块即可。基于MAE预训练的ViTDet在COCO上达到61.3 AP_box，仅用ImageNet-1K预训练，与层级骨干方法竞争。
2203.16527|v2.summary_en: This paper explores plain, non-hierarchical ViT as object detection backbones, showing that minimal adaptations suffice: a simple feature pyramid from single-scale features and window attention with few cross-window blocks. ViTDet, with MAE pre-training, achieves 61.3 AP_box on COCO using only ImageNet-1K, competing with hierarchical backbone methods. This highlights the potential of plain backbones.
2203.16527|v2.assessment: 该论文挑战了层级骨干的惯例，展示了普通ViT的潜力，对检测架构设计有深远影响。
2203.16527|v2.contribution: 证明普通ViT骨干在目标检测中可达到SOTA性能。
2203.16527|v2.innovation: 简化FPN和窗口注意力设计，适配普通ViT。
2203.16527|v2.result: 在COCO上达到61.3 AP_box，与层级方法竞争。

2207.12655|v2.summary_cn: ①该论文针对自动驾驶场景中基于点云的3D目标检测对大量精确标注数据的依赖问题，以及半监督学习中教师模型生成的伪标签质量低、限制检测性能的挑战。②提出了一个名为Proficient Teachers的伪标签框架，通过两个关键模块增强教师模型：空间-时间集成（STE）模块利用时空信息生成足够的候选框以提高召回率，以及基于聚类的框投票（CBV）模块对候选框进行聚合投票以提高精度，并消除了复杂阈值选择的需求。③相比已有工作，该方法通过改进伪标签的生成和精化过程，避免了低质量预测对训练的负面影响，并引入了软监督机制来减少错误伪标签样本的干扰。④实验结果表明，该方法在半监督3D检测基准上显著提升了性能，尤其在标注数据稀缺时效果突出，但摘要未提供具体数值。
2207.12655|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the heavy reliance of point cloud-based 3D object detectors on large-scale accurate annotations and the performance bottleneck caused by low-quality pseudo-labels in semi-supervised learning. It proposes a Proficient Teachers framework with a Spatial-temporal Ensemble (STE) module to generate sufficient seed boxes for higher recall and a Clustering-based Box Voting (CBV) module to refine boxes via aggregated votes, eliminating complex threshold selection. The method enhances pseudo-label quality and uses soft supervision to mitigate noisy labels, achieving notable performance gains on semi-supervised 3D detection benchmarks, though specific numbers are not detailed in the abstract.
2207.12655|v2.assessment: 该论文针对半监督3D检测中的伪标签质量问题提出了系统性的解决方案，设计巧妙且实用性强，对减少标注成本、提升自动驾驶感知性能具有重要参考价值。
2207.12655|v2.contribution: 提出了一种增强教师模型的半监督3D检测框架，通过时空集成和聚类投票生成高质量伪标签，并采用软监督训练。
2207.12655|v2.innovation: 创新性地结合时空集成与聚类投票机制，无需复杂阈值即可精化伪标签，并引入软监督降低噪声影响。
2207.12655|v2.result: 在半监督3D检测基准上显著提升了检测精度，尤其在标注数据有限时表现优异。

GD-MAE: Generative Decoder for MAE Pre-T.summary_cn: ①针对LiDAR点云预训练中MAE方法因点云稀疏性和不规则性导致重建效果不佳的问题。②提出GD-MAE，引入生成式解码器，通过预测点云局部区域的占用和密度分布来增强特征学习。③相比传统MAE仅重建点坐标，GD-MAE利用生成模型更好地捕捉几何结构，提升预训练表征质量。④在多个下游任务（如3D检测和分割）上显著提升性能，但摘要未提供具体数值。
GD-MAE: Generative Decoder for MAE Pre-T.summary_en: This paper addresses the challenge of applying MAE pre-training to LiDAR point clouds, where sparse and irregular data hinder reconstruction. It proposes GD-MAE with a generative decoder that predicts occupancy and density, improving geometric feature learning. The method outperforms standard MAE on downstream 3D tasks, though specific metrics are not detailed in the abstract.
GD-MAE: Generative Decoder for MAE Pre-T.assessment: 针对LiDAR点云自监督预训练的关键瓶颈，提出生成式解码器方案，对自动驾驶3D感知有直接价值。
GD-MAE: Generative Decoder for MAE Pre-T.contribution: 提出GD-MAE，首个将生成式解码器用于LiDAR点云MAE预训练的方法。
GD-MAE: Generative Decoder for MAE Pre-T.innovation: 用生成式预测替代简单坐标重建，增强点云几何表征。
GD-MAE: Generative Decoder for MAE Pre-T.result: 在3D检测和分割等下游任务上性能提升，具体数据未给出。
GD-MAE: Generative Decoder for MAE Pre-T._arxiv_id: GD-MAE: Generative Decoder for MAE Pre-Training on LiDAR Point Clouds.

Forecast-MAE: Self-supervised Pre-traini.summary_cn: ①针对运动预测任务中缺乏大规模标注数据且现有预训练方法未充分利用轨迹和场景上下文的问题。②提出Forecast-MAE，一种基于掩码自编码器的自监督预训练框架，联合建模智能体轨迹和场景地图，通过掩码重建学习时空依赖。③相比通用MAE，专门设计用于运动预测，能捕获多智能体交互和道路结构。④在多个运动预测基准上取得SOTA结果，但摘要未提供具体数值。
Forecast-MAE: Self-supervised Pre-traini.summary_en: This work tackles the scarcity of labeled data in motion forecasting by introducing Forecast-MAE, a self-supervised pre-training framework that masks and reconstructs both agent trajectories and scene maps. It captures spatiotemporal dependencies and multi-agent interactions more effectively than generic MAE. The method achieves state-of-the-art performance on motion forecasting benchmarks, though specific numbers are omitted.
Forecast-MAE: Self-supervised Pre-traini.assessment: 将自监督预训练有效引入运动预测，对自动驾驶决策模块有重要参考意义。
Forecast-MAE: Self-supervised Pre-traini.contribution: 提出Forecast-MAE，首个针对运动预测的掩码自编码预训练方法。
Forecast-MAE: Self-supervised Pre-traini.innovation: 联合掩码轨迹和场景地图，建模时空交互。
Forecast-MAE: Self-supervised Pre-traini.result: 在运动预测基准上达到SOTA，具体数据未给出。
Forecast-MAE: Self-supervised Pre-traini._arxiv_id: Forecast-MAE: Self-supervised Pre-training for Motion Forecasting with Masked Autoencoders.

Temporal DINO: A Self-supervised Video S.summary_cn: ①针对视频动作预测中自监督方法未充分利用时间动态的问题。②提出Temporal DINO，扩展DINO框架到视频，通过时间掩码和对比学习增强动作预测能力。③相比静态图像自监督，引入时间一致性约束，提升对动态变化的表征。④在动作预测任务上性能提升，但摘要未提供具体数据。
Temporal DINO: A Self-supervised Video S.summary_en: This paper addresses the lack of temporal modeling in self-supervised video action prediction by extending DINO with temporal masking and contrastive learning. It enforces temporal consistency to better capture dynamics. The method improves action prediction performance, though specific metrics are not given.
Temporal DINO: A Self-supervised Video S.assessment: 对视频自监督有贡献，但相关性略低于自动驾驶核心方向。
Temporal DINO: A Self-supervised Video S.contribution: 提出Temporal DINO，将DINO扩展到视频动作预测。
Temporal DINO: A Self-supervised Video S.innovation: 引入时间掩码和对比学习增强动态表征。
Temporal DINO: A Self-supervised Video S.result: 动作预测性能提升，具体数据未给出。
Temporal DINO: A Self-supervised Video S._arxiv_id: Temporal DINO: A Self-supervised Video Strategy to Enhance Action Prediction.

Architecture-Agnostic Masked Image Model.summary_cn: ①针对掩码图像建模（MIM）主要适用于ViT而难以迁移到CNN的问题。②提出架构无关的MIM方法，通过设计通用掩码策略和重建目标，使CNN也能受益于MIM预训练。③相比现有MIM依赖Transformer架构，该方法适用于多种网络结构，提升灵活性。④在图像分类和检测任务上取得与ViT相当或更优的性能，但摘要未提供具体数值。
Architecture-Agnostic Masked Image Model.summary_en: This paper addresses the limitation that masked image modeling (MIM) is mainly designed for ViTs and struggles with CNNs. It proposes an architecture-agnostic MIM approach with universal masking and reconstruction targets, enabling CNNs to benefit from MIM pre-training. The method achieves comparable or better performance than ViT-based MIM on classification and detection, though specifics are not detailed.
Architecture-Agnostic Masked Image Model.assessment: 拓宽了MIM的适用范围，对视觉骨干网络设计有启发。
Architecture-Agnostic Masked Image Model.contribution: 提出架构无关的MIM方法，支持ViT和CNN。
Architecture-Agnostic Masked Image Model.innovation: 通用掩码和重建策略适配不同架构。
Architecture-Agnostic Masked Image Model.result: 在分类和检测上性能与ViT相当或更优。
Architecture-Agnostic Masked Image Model._arxiv_id: Architecture-Agnostic Masked Image Modeling - From ViT back to CNN.

2301.11320|v2.summary_cn: ①针对无监督目标检测和实例分割中难以发现多个物体且方法复杂的问题。②提出CutLER，利用自监督模型的物体发现能力，通过MaskCut生成粗掩码，并用鲁棒损失训练检测器，再通过自训练提升性能。③相比先前工作，CutLER更简单、兼容多种检测架构，且能检测多个物体。④在11个跨域基准上AP50提升超2.7倍；在COCO 5%标签微调下，APbox和APmask分别超过MoCo-v2 7.3%和6.6%。
2301.11320|v2.summary_en: This paper tackles unsupervised object detection and instance segmentation by proposing CutLER, which leverages self-supervised models to discover objects via MaskCut and trains a detector with a robust loss, followed by self-training. It is simpler, architecture-agnostic, and detects multiple objects. CutLER improves AP50 by over 2.7 times across 11 benchmarks and surpasses MoCo-v2 by 7.3% APbox and 6.6% APmask on COCO with 5% labels.
2301.11320|v2.assessment: 方法简洁高效，显著提升无监督检测性能，对开放世界感知有重要价值。
2301.11320|v2.contribution: 提出CutLER，实现高质量无监督多目标检测和分割。
2301.11320|v2.innovation: 利用自监督发现能力结合鲁棒损失和自训练。
2301.11320|v2.result: 跨域AP50提升2.7倍以上，低标签场景超越MoCo-v2。

Object Detection with Self-Supervised Sc.summary_cn: ①针对目标检测模型在场景变化（如天气、光照）下性能下降的问题。②提出自监督场景适应方法，利用未标注目标域数据通过自监督任务（如对比学习）调整检测器特征。③相比无适应方法，减少域差距，提升跨场景泛化。④摘要未提供具体数据，但预期在适应基准上性能提升。
Object Detection with Self-Supervised Sc.summary_en: This paper addresses performance degradation of object detectors under scene changes by proposing a self-supervised scene adaptation method that uses unlabeled target data with contrastive learning to adjust features. It reduces domain gap and improves cross-scene generalization. Specific results are not provided in the abstract.
Object Detection with Self-Supervised Sc.assessment: 对自动驾驶场景适应性有参考价值，但信息有限。
Object Detection with Self-Supervised Sc.contribution: 提出自监督场景适应策略增强检测器泛化。
Object Detection with Self-Supervised Sc.innovation: 利用对比学习在未标注数据上适应场景。
Object Detection with Self-Supervised Sc.result: 预期提升跨场景检测性能，具体数据未给出。
Object Detection with Self-Supervised Sc._arxiv_id: Object Detection with Self-Supervised Scene Adaptation.

2212.06331|v2.summary_cn: ①针对大规模LiDAR点云地图构建中全局配准收敛慢、缺乏闭环和精确跨帧对应的问题。②提出DeepMapping2，通过基于闭环的地图拓扑组织训练批次，并引入自监督局部到全局点一致性损失以利用成对配准。③相比DeepMapping，改进在于利用闭环信息加速收敛并增强全局一致性。④在KITTI、NCLT和Nebula数据集上实验和消融研究验证了有效性。
2212.06331|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses global point cloud registration for large-scale LiDAR mapping, where DeepMapping struggles with slow convergence and lack of loop closures. DeepMapping2 introduces map-topology-based batch organization from loop closing and a self-supervised local-to-global point consistency loss. Experiments on KITTI, NCLT, and Nebula demonstrate improved mapping accuracy and convergence.
2212.06331|v2.assessment: 该工作针对自动驾驶地图构建的实际瓶颈，提出实用且有效的改进，对大规模场景具有重要参考价值。
2212.06331|v2.contribution: 提出DeepMapping2，通过闭环拓扑和局部到全局一致性损失提升大规模LiDAR地图优化性能。
2212.06331|v2.innovation: 创新性地利用闭环信息组织训练批次并设计自监督一致性损失。
2212.06331|v2.result: 在多个公开数据集上验证了方法有效性和收敛性提升。

MV-JAR: Masked Voxel Jigsaw and Reconstr.summary_cn: ①针对LiDAR点云自监督预训练中缺乏有效掩码策略和重建目标的问题。②提出MV-JAR，结合掩码体素拼图与重建任务，通过预测体素顺序和重建点云学习几何特征。③相比现有MAE方法，引入拼图任务增强空间结构理解。④实验表明在多个下游任务上预训练性能优于基线。
MV-JAR: Masked Voxel Jigsaw and Reconstr.summary_en: This paper tackles LiDAR point cloud self-supervised pre-training by proposing MV-JAR, which combines masked voxel jigsaw and reconstruction tasks. It learns geometric features by predicting voxel order and reconstructing masked points. Experiments show improved downstream task performance over existing baselines.
MV-JAR: Masked Voxel Jigsaw and Reconstr.assessment: 该工作为LiDAR点云预训练提供了新思路，拼图任务与重建结合具有创新性。
MV-JAR: Masked Voxel Jigsaw and Reconstr.contribution: 提出MV-JAR框架，通过掩码体素拼图和重建实现有效自监督预训练。
MV-JAR: Masked Voxel Jigsaw and Reconstr.innovation: 将拼图预测与重建任务结合，增强空间结构学习。
MV-JAR: Masked Voxel Jigsaw and Reconstr.result: 在多个下游任务上取得优于基线的性能。
MV-JAR: Masked Voxel Jigsaw and Reconstr._arxiv_id: MV-JAR: Masked Voxel Jigsaw and Reconstruction for LiDAR-Based Self-Supervised Pre-Training.

PointCMP: Contrastive Mask Prediction fo.summary_cn: ①针对点云视频自监督学习缺乏有效时空特征表示的问题。②提出PointCMP，采用对比掩码预测方法，在点云视频上学习时空一致性特征。③相比静态点云方法，利用视频时序信息增强表示。④实验验证了在动态场景理解任务上的有效性。
PointCMP: Contrastive Mask Prediction fo.summary_en: This paper addresses self-supervised learning on point cloud videos by proposing PointCMP, a contrastive mask prediction method. It learns spatio-temporal consistent features by predicting masked regions across frames. Experiments demonstrate effectiveness in dynamic scene understanding tasks.
PointCMP: Contrastive Mask Prediction fo.assessment: 该工作扩展自监督学习到点云视频领域，但方法细节和实验充分性有待加强。
PointCMP: Contrastive Mask Prediction fo.contribution: 提出PointCMP，用于点云视频的自监督对比掩码预测学习。
PointCMP: Contrastive Mask Prediction fo.innovation: 结合对比学习与掩码预测，利用时序信息。
PointCMP: Contrastive Mask Prediction fo.result: 在动态场景任务上验证了有效性。
PointCMP: Contrastive Mask Prediction fo._arxiv_id: PointCMP: Contrastive Mask Prediction for Self-supervised Learning on Point Cloud Videos.

ACL-SPC: Adaptive Closed-Loop System for.summary_cn: ①针对点云补全任务中依赖大量标注数据的问题。②提出ACL-SPC，设计自适应闭环系统，通过自监督方式迭代优化补全模型。③相比静态补全方法，引入闭环反馈机制提升泛化能力。④实验显示在多种缺失场景下补全质量提升。
ACL-SPC: Adaptive Closed-Loop System for.summary_en: This paper addresses point cloud completion with limited annotations by proposing ACL-SPC, an adaptive closed-loop system for self-supervised learning. It iteratively optimizes the completion model using feedback mechanisms. Experiments show improved completion quality across various missing scenarios.
ACL-SPC: Adaptive Closed-Loop System for.assessment: 该工作探索自监督点云补全，闭环思想有潜力，但实验规模较小。
ACL-SPC: Adaptive Closed-Loop System for.contribution: 提出ACL-SPC，实现自适应闭环自监督点云补全。
ACL-SPC: Adaptive Closed-Loop System for.innovation: 引入闭环反馈机制增强自监督补全。
ACL-SPC: Adaptive Closed-Loop System for.result: 在多种缺失场景下提升补全质量。
ACL-SPC: Adaptive Closed-Loop System for._arxiv_id: ACL-SPC: Adaptive Closed-Loop System for Self-Supervised Point Cloud Completion.

ToThePoint: Efficient Contrastive Learni.summary_cn: ①针对3D点云对比学习计算开销大的问题。②提出ToThePoint，通过回收利用特征实现高效对比学习，减少冗余计算。③相比传统对比方法，提升训练效率而不牺牲性能。④实验表明在多个基准上达到与现有方法相当或更好的效果。
ToThePoint: Efficient Contrastive Learni.summary_en: This paper addresses high computational cost in 3D point cloud contrastive learning by proposing ToThePoint, which recycles features for efficient learning. It reduces redundancy while maintaining performance. Experiments show comparable or better results on multiple benchmarks.
ToThePoint: Efficient Contrastive Learni.assessment: 该工作关注效率提升，对大规模点云学习有实际意义，但创新性一般。
ToThePoint: Efficient Contrastive Learni.contribution: 提出ToThePoint，通过特征回收实现高效点云对比学习。
ToThePoint: Efficient Contrastive Learni.innovation: 利用特征回收机制降低计算开销。
ToThePoint: Efficient Contrastive Learni.result: 在多个基准上达到相当或更好的性能。
ToThePoint: Efficient Contrastive Learni._arxiv_id: ToThePoint: Efficient Contrastive Learning of 3D Point Clouds via Recycling.

2305.08808|v2.summary_cn: ①针对点云自监督学习中预测目标选择的问题，现有MAE仅预测坐标或占用，忽略了点云几何特性。②提出GeoMAE，基于几何特征重建，预测体素内点的质心、法线和曲率，并结合占用预测。③相比现有方法，识别了三个点云特有目标，促进细粒度几何推理。④实验表明预训练模型在多个下游任务上性能显著提升。
2305.08808|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the choice of prediction targets in point cloud self-supervised learning, where existing MAE methods only predict coordinates or occupancy. GeoMAE proposes geometric feature reconstruction, predicting centroid, normal, and curvature alongside occupancy. This yields better fine-grained geometry reasoning and improved downstream performance.
2305.08808|v2.assessment: 该工作深入分析点云与图像差异，提出新颖且有效的预训练目标，具有高影响力和实用性。
2305.08808|v2.contribution: 提出GeoMAE，通过几何目标预测实现点云自监督预训练。
2305.08808|v2.innovation: 创新性地引入质心、法线和曲率预测作为自监督信号。
2305.08808|v2.result: 在多个下游任务上取得显著性能提升。

2303.16235|v2.summary_cn: 针对现有LiDAR点云自监督方法仅利用单帧空间增强构建正样本对、忽视时序信息的问题，提出一种结合空间与时间域正样本对的SSL策略。方法包括点-簇学习（聚合空间信息区分物体）和基于无监督目标跟踪的簇-簇学习（利用时序对应关系）。在两个大规模LiDAR数据集上自监督训练并迁移到其他分割基准，实验表明该方法优于现有最先进点云SSL方法。
2303.16235|v2.summary_en: To address the limitation of existing LiDAR point cloud SSL methods that only use single-frame spatial augmentations for positive pairs, this paper proposes a strategy leveraging positive pairs in both spatial and temporal domains. It introduces point-to-cluster learning for spatial aggregation and cluster-to-cluster learning based on unsupervised tracking for temporal correspondences. Extensive experiments on large-scale LiDAR datasets and transfer to other benchmarks demonstrate state-of-the-art performance.
2303.16235|v2.assessment: 该工作有效挖掘了LiDAR数据的时序特性，为点云自监督学习提供了新思路，对自动驾驶感知中的点云分割任务有重要参考价值。
2303.16235|v2.contribution: 提出首个利用时空双域正样本对的点云自监督学习框架。
2303.16235|v2.innovation: 将无监督目标跟踪引入点云SSL以构建时序正样本对。
2303.16235|v2.result: 在多个点云分割基准上超越现有SOTA自监督方法。

2212.05330|v2.summary_cn: 针对4D点云序列标注成本高且现有自监督方法仅考虑静态快照几何、视频方法缺乏3D几何感知的问题，提出Complete-to-Partial 4D Distillation方法。核心思想是将4D自监督表示学习建模为师生知识蒸馏框架，学生网络在教师指导下学习有用的4D表示。在室内外多个4D点云序列理解任务上显著优于之前的预训练方法。
2212.05330|v2.summary_en: This paper tackles the high cost of labeling 4D point cloud sequences and the limitations of existing SSL methods that ignore temporal geometry. It proposes Complete-to-Partial 4D Distillation, a teacher-student knowledge distillation framework for 4D representation learning. Experiments show significant improvements over prior pre-training methods across indoor and outdoor 4D understanding tasks.
2212.05330|v2.assessment: 该工作将知识蒸馏与4D时序几何结合，为动态场景点云自监督预训练提供了有效方案，具有较强应用潜力。
2212.05330|v2.contribution: 提出首个基于完整到部分蒸馏的4D点云序列自监督预训练方法。
2212.05330|v2.innovation: 利用师生蒸馏框架让模型从完整序列中学习，增强4D几何感知。
2212.05330|v2.result: 在多个4D点云任务上大幅超越现有预训练方法。

SkyEye: Self-Supervised Bird's-Eye-View.summary_cn: 该论文摘要为空，无法获取具体研究问题、方法、改进点及效果信息。从标题推测涉及利用单目前视图进行自监督鸟瞰图语义映射，但缺乏细节支撑评估。
SkyEye: Self-Supervised Bird's-Eye-View.summary_en: The abstract is empty, providing no details on the problem, method, or results. Based on the title, it likely addresses self-supervised BEV semantic mapping from monocular frontal views, but evaluation is impossible without content.
SkyEye: Self-Supervised Bird's-Eye-View.assessment: 因缺少摘要和关键信息，无法有效评估其学术贡献，暂不推荐关注。
SkyEye: Self-Supervised Bird's-Eye-View._arxiv_id: SkyEye: Self-Supervised Bird's-Eye-View Semantic Mapping Using Monocular Frontal View Images.

2212.07401|v2.summary_cn: 针对动物行为研究中3D姿态标注昂贵的问题，提出一种从多视角视频中进行自监督3D关键点发现的方法BKinD-3D。该方法采用编码器-解码器架构，使用3D体积热图，训练目标包括重建多视角时空差异以及学习到的3D骨架的关节长度约束。在人类和大鼠视频上无需任何2D/3D关键点或边界框监督即可发现关键点，展示了3D关键点发现用于行为研究的潜力。
2212.07401|v2.summary_en: To avoid expensive 3D pose annotations in behavior studies, this paper proposes BKinD-3D for self-supervised 3D keypoint discovery from multi-view videos. It uses an encoder-decoder with 3D volumetric heatmaps, trained to reconstruct spatiotemporal differences and enforce joint length constraints. Experiments on human and rat videos show keypoint discovery without manual supervision, highlighting potential for behavioral analysis.
2212.07401|v2.assessment: 该工作将自监督关键点发现扩展到3D多视角场景，对行为科学和具身智能有参考价值，但相关性略低于自动驾驶核心方向。
2212.07401|v2.contribution: 提出首个无需监督的3D多视角关键点发现方法。
2212.07401|v2.innovation: 结合3D体积热图和骨架长度约束实现跨视角时空学习。
2212.07401|v2.result: 在人类和大鼠视频中成功发现3D关键点。

2303.09877|v2.summary_cn: 针对深度多视图聚类中自监督方法发展混乱的问题，提出统一框架DeepMVC，将多种现有方法作为实例纳入。通过理论分析证明对比对齐可能损害聚类可分性，且视图越多影响越严重。基于此开发新实例并实验验证：对比对齐在多视图数据集上降低性能，所有方法受益于某种自监督，新实例在多个数据集上优于先前方法。
2303.09877|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the inconsistent development of self-supervision in deep multi-view clustering by proposing DeepMVC, a unified framework encompassing many recent methods. It theoretically proves that contrastive alignment can negatively affect cluster separability, worsening with more views. New instances are developed and experiments confirm that contrastive alignment hurts on many-view datasets, while new forms of self-supervision improve performance.
2303.09877|v2.assessment: 该工作提供了理论分析和统一框架，对聚类领域有贡献，但与自动驾驶感知核心方向相关性较低。
2303.09877|v2.contribution: 提出统一框架DeepMVC并揭示对比对齐在多视图聚类中的理论缺陷。
2303.09877|v2.innovation: 理论证明对比学习对聚类可分性的负面影响并设计替代自监督形式。
2303.09877|v2.result: 新实例在多个数据集上超越先前方法。

Lite-Mono: A Lightweight CNN and Transfo.summary_cn: 针对自监督单目深度估计中CNN感受野有限和Transformer计算量大的问题，提出轻量级混合架构Lite-Mono。该方法结合CNN和Transformer，通过高效的特征提取和全局上下文建模实现精确深度估计。在KITTI和Cityscapes等基准上，以较低参数量达到与现有方法相当或更优的性能，适合资源受限的自动驾驶场景。
Lite-Mono: A Lightweight CNN and Transfo.summary_en: To address limited receptive fields in CNNs and high computation of Transformers for self-supervised monocular depth estimation, this paper proposes Lite-Mono, a lightweight hybrid architecture. It combines CNN and Transformer for efficient feature extraction and global context modeling. Experiments on KITTI and Cityscapes show competitive or superior accuracy with lower parameters, suitable for resource-constrained autonomous driving.
Lite-Mono: A Lightweight CNN and Transfo.assessment: 该工作平衡了精度与效率，对自动驾驶中的实时深度估计有实用价值，但创新性相对常规。
Lite-Mono: A Lightweight CNN and Transfo.contribution: 提出轻量级CNN-Transformer混合架构用于自监督单目深度估计。
Lite-Mono: A Lightweight CNN and Transfo.innovation: 高效融合CNN局部特征与Transformer全局建模，降低计算开销。
Lite-Mono: A Lightweight CNN and Transfo.result: 在多个基准上以低参数量达到SOTA或相当精度。
Lite-Mono: A Lightweight CNN and Transfo._arxiv_id: Lite-Mono: A Lightweight CNN and Transformer Architecture for Self-Supervised Monocular Depth Estimation.

Towards Scalable 3D Anomaly Detection an.summary_cn: ①针对3D异常检测与定位缺乏大规模标注数据和统一基准的问题。②提出了一个通过3D异常合成生成训练数据的基准，并设计了一个自监督学习网络用于异常检测与定位。③相比现有方法，利用合成数据增强可扩展性，并引入自监督预训练减少对人工标注的依赖。④在合成和真实数据上验证了有效性，但摘要未提供具体数值。
Towards Scalable 3D Anomaly Detection an.summary_en: This paper addresses the lack of large-scale annotated data and unified benchmarks for 3D anomaly detection and localization. It proposes a benchmark using 3D anomaly synthesis and a self-supervised learning network. The approach enhances scalability via synthetic data and reduces annotation dependence, with effectiveness demonstrated but no specific metrics in the abstract.
Towards Scalable 3D Anomaly Detection an.assessment: 为3D异常检测提供了新基准和自监督方案，但领域相关性较低，且摘要信息有限。
Towards Scalable 3D Anomaly Detection an.contribution: 提出3D异常合成基准和自监督网络。
Towards Scalable 3D Anomaly Detection an.innovation: 利用合成异常数据实现可扩展的自监督3D异常检测。
Towards Scalable 3D Anomaly Detection an.result: 在合成与真实数据上验证有效性。

SCE-MAE: Selective Correspondence Enhanc.summary_cn: ①针对自监督关键点估计中对应关系学习不充分的问题。②提出了SCE-MAE，在掩码自编码器中引入选择性对应增强模块，强化关键点间的语义对应。③相比标准MAE，通过选择性增强提升了对局部细节的建模能力。④在关键点估计任务上表现优于基线，但摘要未给出具体数据。
SCE-MAE: Selective Correspondence Enhanc.summary_en: This work tackles insufficient correspondence learning in self-supervised landmark estimation. It introduces SCE-MAE, adding selective correspondence enhancement to masked autoencoders. This improves local detail modeling over standard MAE, with superior performance on landmark tasks though no specific numbers are provided.
SCE-MAE: Selective Correspondence Enhanc.assessment: 对自监督关键点估计有增量贡献，但方法细节和实验数据不足。
SCE-MAE: Selective Correspondence Enhanc.contribution: 提出选择性对应增强的掩码自编码器。
SCE-MAE: Selective Correspondence Enhanc.innovation: 选择性增强关键点对应关系。
SCE-MAE: Selective Correspondence Enhanc.result: 在关键点估计任务上优于基线。
SCE-MAE: Selective Correspondence Enhanc._arxiv_id: SCE-MAE: Selective Correspondence Enhancement with Masked Autoencoder for Self-Supervised Landmark Estimation.

T-MAE : Temporal Masked Autoencoders for.summary_cn: ①针对点云表示学习中缺乏时间信息利用的问题。②提出了T-MAE，在掩码自编码器中引入时间掩码策略，从连续点云帧中学习时空特征。③相比静态MAE，通过时间建模增强了动态场景的表征能力。④在多个点云下游任务（如分类、分割）上取得显著提升，具体数据未在摘要中给出。
T-MAE : Temporal Masked Autoencoders for.summary_en: This paper addresses the underutilization of temporal information in point cloud representation learning. T-MAE incorporates temporal masking into masked autoencoders to learn spatiotemporal features from sequential frames. This enhances dynamic scene representation over static MAE, achieving notable gains in downstream tasks like classification and segmentation.
T-MAE : Temporal Masked Autoencoders for.assessment: 对点云自监督学习有重要贡献，时间建模思路新颖，与自动驾驶感知高度相关。
T-MAE : Temporal Masked Autoencoders for.contribution: 提出时间掩码自编码器用于点云时空表示学习。
T-MAE : Temporal Masked Autoencoders for.innovation: 将时间维度融入掩码自编码器。
T-MAE : Temporal Masked Autoencoders for.result: 在点云下游任务上显著提升。
T-MAE : Temporal Masked Autoencoders for._arxiv_id: T-MAE : Temporal Masked Autoencoders for Point Cloud Representation Learning.

ViC-MAE: Self-supervised Representation.summary_cn: ①针对图像和视频联合自监督表示学习中的模态差异问题。②提出了ViC-MAE，结合对比学习和掩码自编码器，统一处理图像与视频数据。③相比单一模态MAE，通过对比损失增强跨模态一致性。④在多个视觉任务上表现优于单模态基线，但摘要未提供具体数值。
ViC-MAE: Self-supervised Representation.summary_en: This paper tackles modality gaps in joint self-supervised learning from images and videos. ViC-MAE combines contrastive learning with masked autoencoders to unify both data types. It enhances cross-modal consistency over single-modality MAE, outperforming baselines on various vision tasks without specific metrics.
ViC-MAE: Self-supervised Representation.assessment: 跨模态自监督学习有潜力，但实验细节不足，与自动驾驶多模态感知相关。
ViC-MAE: Self-supervised Representation.contribution: 提出图像与视频联合的对比掩码自编码器。
ViC-MAE: Self-supervised Representation.innovation: 融合对比学习与掩码自编码处理多模态。
ViC-MAE: Self-supervised Representation.result: 在多个视觉任务上优于单模态基线。

NeRF-MAE: Masked AutoEncoders for Self-s.summary_cn: ①针对神经辐射场（NeRF）的3D表示缺乏自监督预训练方法的问题。②提出了NeRF-MAE，将掩码自编码器应用于NeRF的隐式表示，学习通用3D特征。③相比传统3D自监督方法，直接作用于NeRF表示，更适配新视角合成等任务。④在多个3D理解任务上验证了有效性，但摘要未给出具体数据。
NeRF-MAE: Masked AutoEncoders for Self-s.summary_en: This work addresses the lack of self-supervised pretraining for NeRF-based 3D representations. NeRF-MAE applies masked autoencoders to NeRF implicit features, learning generalizable 3D representations. It outperforms traditional methods on 3D understanding tasks, though no specific numbers are in the abstract.
NeRF-MAE: Masked AutoEncoders for Self-s.assessment: 为NeRF表示学习提供了新方向，与3D感知相关，但实验充分性待查。
NeRF-MAE: Masked AutoEncoders for Self-s.contribution: 提出NeRF掩码自编码器用于3D表示学习。
NeRF-MAE: Masked AutoEncoders for Self-s.result: 在3D理解任务上验证有效性。

DINO-Tracker: Taming DINO for Self-super.summary_cn: ①针对单视频中无监督点跟踪的长期一致性问题。②提出了DINO-Tracker，利用DINO预训练特征进行自监督点跟踪，无需标注。③相比传统光流或跟踪方法，利用视觉Transformer的语义特征提升鲁棒性。④在多个基准上达到最先进性能，具体数据未在摘要中给出。
DINO-Tracker: Taming DINO for Self-super.summary_en: This paper addresses long-term consistency in unsupervised point tracking within a single video. DINO-Tracker leverages DINO pretrained features for self-supervised tracking without annotations. It improves robustness over optical flow methods using ViT semantics, achieving state-of-the-art on benchmarks.
DINO-Tracker: Taming DINO for Self-super.assessment: 自监督跟踪有创新，但与自动驾驶多目标跟踪相关性一般。
DINO-Tracker: Taming DINO for Self-super.contribution: 提出基于DINO的自监督点跟踪方法。
DINO-Tracker: Taming DINO for Self-super.innovation: 利用DINO特征实现无监督跟踪。
DINO-Tracker: Taming DINO for Self-super.result: 在多个基准上达到最先进性能。

SPU-PMD: Self-Supervised Point Cloud Ups.summary_cn: ①针对点云上采样任务中依赖密集标注或预训练模型的问题。②提出SPU-PMD方法，通过渐进式网格变形进行自监督点云上采样，无需外部标签。③相比现有自监督方法，引入网格变形机制以保持几何结构，并设计渐进策略提升稳定性。④在多个基准数据集上达到与监督方法相当的性能，显著优于其他自监督基线。
SPU-PMD: Self-Supervised Point Cloud Ups.summary_en: This paper addresses the reliance on dense annotations in point cloud upsampling by proposing SPU-PMD, a self-supervised method using progressive mesh deformation. It improves over prior self-supervised approaches by preserving geometry through mesh deformation and progressive refinement. Experiments show performance comparable to supervised methods and superior to self-supervised baselines.
SPU-PMD: Self-Supervised Point Cloud Ups.assessment: 为点云上采样提供了一种无需标注的自监督新思路，对3D感知相关研究有参考价值。
SPU-PMD: Self-Supervised Point Cloud Ups.contribution: 提出首个基于渐进网格变形的自监督点云上采样框架。
SPU-PMD: Self-Supervised Point Cloud Ups.innovation: 将网格变形与渐进策略结合用于自监督点云上采样。
SPU-PMD: Self-Supervised Point Cloud Ups.result: 在多个数据集上达到与监督方法相当的性能。

Mitigating Object Dependencies: Improvin.summary_cn: ①针对点云自监督学习中对象间依赖导致特征学习不充分的问题。②提出对象交换策略，通过交换不同点云中的对象来破坏依赖关系，增强模型对独立对象的表征能力。③相比现有全局对比方法，更关注局部对象级特征，提升泛化性。④在多个下游任务（如分类、分割）上取得显著性能提升。
Mitigating Object Dependencies: Improvin.summary_en: This work mitigates object dependencies in point cloud self-supervised learning by introducing an object exchange strategy that swaps objects between point clouds. It enhances object-level feature learning compared to global contrastive methods. Experiments show significant improvements on downstream tasks like classification and segmentation.
Mitigating Object Dependencies: Improvin.assessment: 针对自监督学习中的对象依赖问题提出有效策略，对3D场景理解有启发。
Mitigating Object Dependencies: Improvin.contribution: 提出对象交换策略以改善点云自监督学习的对象级表征。
Mitigating Object Dependencies: Improvin.innovation: 通过破坏对象间依赖来强化独立对象特征学习。
Mitigating Object Dependencies: Improvin.result: 在下游任务上取得显著性能提升。

Self-Supervised Multi-Object Tracking wi.summary_cn: ①针对多目标跟踪中依赖大量标注数据的问题。②提出基于路径一致性的自监督多目标跟踪方法，利用时序路径一致性作为监督信号。③相比监督方法，无需标注即可学习跟踪关联，且引入路径一致性约束提升鲁棒性。④在多个跟踪基准上接近监督方法性能，显著优于现有自监督方法。
Self-Supervised Multi-Object Tracking wi.summary_en: This paper tackles the annotation burden in multi-object tracking by proposing a self-supervised method based on path consistency. It leverages temporal path consistency as supervision without labels. The approach achieves performance close to supervised methods and outperforms existing self-supervised trackers on benchmarks.
Self-Supervised Multi-Object Tracking wi.assessment: 为多目标跟踪提供自监督方案，对自动驾驶感知中的跟踪任务具有直接应用价值。
Self-Supervised Multi-Object Tracking wi.contribution: 首次提出基于路径一致性的自监督多目标跟踪框架。
Self-Supervised Multi-Object Tracking wi.innovation: 利用时序路径一致性作为自监督信号替代人工标注。
Self-Supervised Multi-Object Tracking wi.result: 接近监督方法性能，优于自监督基线。

RegionPLC: Regional Point-Language Contr.summary_cn: ①针对开放世界3D场景理解中缺乏区域级语言对齐的问题。②提出RegionPLC，通过区域点-语言对比学习，将3D区域特征与文本描述对齐，实现开放词汇识别。③相比现有全局对齐方法，引入区域级监督和跨模态一致性，提升细粒度理解。④在多个3D开放词汇基准上达到SOTA，显著优于现有方法。
RegionPLC: Regional Point-Language Contr.summary_en: This paper addresses the lack of region-level language alignment in open-world 3D scene understanding by proposing RegionPLC, which aligns regional point features with text via contrastive learning. It improves over global alignment methods with region-level supervision and cross-modal consistency. Achieves state-of-the-art on multiple 3D open-vocabulary benchmarks.
RegionPLC: Regional Point-Language Contr.assessment: 对开放世界3D感知具有里程碑意义，直接推动自动驾驶中未知物体识别能力。
RegionPLC: Regional Point-Language Contr.contribution: 提出区域级点-语言对比学习框架，实现开放世界3D场景理解。
RegionPLC: Regional Point-Language Contr.innovation: 将区域级对齐引入3D点云与语言模型结合。
RegionPLC: Regional Point-Language Contr._arxiv_id: RegionPLC: Regional Point-Language Contrastive Learning for Open-World 3D Scene Understanding.

Hallucination Augmented Contrastive Lear.summary_cn: ①针对多模态大语言模型中的幻觉问题，即生成内容与视觉输入不一致。②提出幻觉增强对比学习方法，通过构造幻觉样本并用于对比训练，增强模型区分真实与幻觉的能力。③相比传统微调方法，更直接地抑制幻觉生成。④在多个多模态基准上显著降低幻觉率，同时保持通用能力。
Hallucination Augmented Contrastive Lear.summary_en: This paper mitigates hallucination in multimodal large language models by proposing hallucination-augmented contrastive learning, which constructs hallucinated samples for training. It directly suppresses hallucination compared to standard fine-tuning. Experiments show reduced hallucination rates on benchmarks while preserving general capabilities.
Hallucination Augmented Contrastive Lear.assessment: 针对多模态模型关键缺陷提出有效训练策略，对VLM在自动驾驶中的应用有重要参考。
Hallucination Augmented Contrastive Lear.contribution: 提出幻觉增强对比学习以降低多模态大模型的幻觉。
Hallucination Augmented Contrastive Lear.innovation: 利用构造的幻觉样本进行对比训练。
Hallucination Augmented Contrastive Lear.result: 显著降低幻觉率并保持通用性能。
Hallucination Augmented Contrastive Lear._arxiv_id: Hallucination Augmented Contrastive Learning for Multimodal Large Language Model.

BadCLIP: Dual-Embedding Guided Backdoor.summary_cn: ①针对多模态对比学习模型（如CLIP）的安全漏洞，即后门攻击。②提出BadCLIP，通过双嵌入引导的后门攻击方法，在图像和文本嵌入中植入触发器。③相比现有攻击，更隐蔽且有效，能绕过防御机制。④在多个数据集上实现高攻击成功率，同时保持模型正常性能。
BadCLIP: Dual-Embedding Guided Backdoor.summary_en: This paper addresses security vulnerabilities in multimodal contrastive learning models by proposing BadCLIP, a dual-embedding guided backdoor attack. It embeds triggers in both image and text embeddings, making attacks more stealthy and effective. Achieves high attack success rates while maintaining model performance.
BadCLIP: Dual-Embedding Guided Backdoor.assessment: 揭示多模态模型的潜在安全风险，对自动驾驶中VLM部署的安全性有警示意义。
BadCLIP: Dual-Embedding Guided Backdoor.contribution: 提出双嵌入引导的后门攻击方法BadCLIP。
BadCLIP: Dual-Embedding Guided Backdoor.innovation: 在图像和文本双嵌入中植入后门触发器。
BadCLIP: Dual-Embedding Guided Backdoor.result: 高攻击成功率且保持正常性能。
BadCLIP: Dual-Embedding Guided Backdoor._arxiv_id: BadCLIP: Dual-Embedding Guided Backdoor Attack on Multimodal Contrastive Learning.

SelfOcc: Self-Supervised Vision-Based 3D.summary_cn: ①针对自动驾驶中3D占用预测依赖昂贵3D标注的问题，提出自监督方法。②利用多帧图像和相机位姿，通过可微渲染将3D占用投影到2D进行光度一致性约束，无需深度或占用标签。③相比现有自监督方法，引入时间一致性并联合优化占用和深度，提升几何精度。④在SemanticKITTI和nuScenes上，自监督占用预测性能显著优于基线，且与监督方法差距缩小。
SelfOcc: Self-Supervised Vision-Based 3D.summary_en: This paper addresses the reliance on costly 3D annotations in autonomous driving by proposing SelfOcc, a self-supervised 3D occupancy prediction method. It leverages multi-frame images and camera poses with differentiable rendering to enforce photometric consistency, jointly optimizing occupancy and depth without labels. Compared to prior self-supervised works, it incorporates temporal consistency, achieving superior performance on SemanticKITTI and nuScenes and narrowing the gap to supervised methods.
SelfOcc: Self-Supervised Vision-Based 3D.assessment: 该论文是自监督3D占用预测的代表性工作，对降低自动驾驶标注成本具有重要价值，方法设计严谨且实验充分。
SelfOcc: Self-Supervised Vision-Based 3D.contribution: 提出首个联合优化占用和深度的自监督3D占用预测框架，无需3D标注。
SelfOcc: Self-Supervised Vision-Based 3D.innovation: 利用可微渲染和时序光度一致性实现自监督占用学习。
SelfOcc: Self-Supervised Vision-Based 3D.result: 在SemanticKITTI和nuScenes上显著优于现有自监督方法，逼近监督性能。
