1911.07053|v2.summary_cn: ①针对类增量学习中的灾难性遗忘问题，指出知识蒸馏虽能维持旧类内的判别性，但无法解决模型偏向新类导致的公平性缺失。②提出权重对齐方法，在正常训练后校正全连接层的偏置权重，并结合知识蒸馏保持旧类判别性。③相比仅用蒸馏的方法，显式处理了分类器权重的偏差，简单有效。④实验表明该方法在多个基准上显著提升增量学习性能，尤其在任务数较多时。
1911.07053|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses catastrophic forgetting in class incremental learning, showing that knowledge distillation maintains intra-old-class discrimination but fails to ensure fairness between old and new classes. It proposes Weight Aligning to correct biased FC-layer weights post-training, combined with KD, achieving state-of-the-art results on benchmarks.
1911.07053|v2.assessment: 方法简洁且理论动机清晰，是增量学习中的代表性工作，值得关注其权重校正思路。
1911.07053|v2.contribution: 提出权重对齐机制，有效缓解类增量学习中的分类器偏置问题。
1911.07053|v2.innovation: 首次从FC层权重偏置角度分析并校正灾难性遗忘。
1911.07053|v2.result: 在多个标准数据集上显著优于现有增量学习方法。

Adversarial Continual Learning.|v2.summary_cn: ①针对持续学习中灾难性遗忘与任务间干扰问题，提出对抗性持续学习框架。②通过生成对抗网络将新任务样本投影到旧任务特征空间，并利用对抗训练增强特征的可迁移性。③相比传统正则化方法，显式建模任务间分布差异，提升泛化能力。④实验在多个持续学习基准上取得最优平均准确率。
Adversarial Continual Learning.|v2.summary_en: This work proposes an adversarial continual learning framework that projects new task samples into old task feature spaces via GANs, reducing catastrophic forgetting and improving generalization. It achieves superior average accuracy on standard benchmarks.
Adversarial Continual Learning.|v2.assessment: 将对抗训练引入持续学习，思路新颖，对多任务场景有启发。
Adversarial Continual Learning.|v2.contribution: 提出对抗性特征投影机制，缓解持续学习中的任务干扰。
Adversarial Continual Learning.|v2.innovation: 利用GAN实现任务间特征对齐，增强模型稳定性。
Adversarial Continual Learning.|v2.result: 在多个基准上平均准确率优于现有方法。

Online Continual Learning Under Extreme.summary_cn: ①针对在线持续学习在极端内存限制下的挑战，提出高效样本存储与更新策略。②设计基于重要性采样的内存管理方法，并配合轻量级模型更新规则。③相比现有方法，在极低内存预算下保持较高性能。④实验显示在内存受限场景下准确率下降幅度显著减小。
Online Continual Learning Under Extreme.summary_en: This paper tackles online continual learning under extreme memory constraints, proposing importance-based sample storage and efficient update rules. It maintains competitive accuracy with significantly reduced memory budgets.
Online Continual Learning Under Extreme.assessment: 实用性强，对资源受限的自动驾驶场景有参考价值。
Online Continual Learning Under Extreme.contribution: 提出极端内存约束下的在线持续学习策略。
Online Continual Learning Under Extreme.innovation: 结合重要性采样优化内存分配。
Online Continual Learning Under Extreme.result: 在低内存预算下性能优于基线方法。
Online Continual Learning Under Extreme._arxiv_id: Online Continual Learning Under Extreme Memory Constraints.

Imbalanced Continual Learning with Parti.summary_cn: ①针对非平衡数据下的持续学习问题，提出分区水库采样方法。②将样本按类别分区存储，并动态调整采样比例以平衡新旧类分布。③相比统一采样，能更好处理类别不平衡导致的遗忘。④实验在长尾分布数据集上显著提升少数类准确率。
Imbalanced Continual Learning with Parti.summary_en: This paper addresses imbalanced continual learning via partitioning reservoir sampling, which stores samples per class and adjusts sampling ratios to balance distributions. It improves minority-class accuracy on long-tailed benchmarks.
Imbalanced Continual Learning with Parti.assessment: 针对数据不平衡的持续学习有实际意义，但方法复杂度较高。
Imbalanced Continual Learning with Parti.contribution: 提出分区采样策略解决持续学习中的类别不平衡。
Imbalanced Continual Learning with Parti.innovation: 动态采样比例设计增强少数类记忆。
Imbalanced Continual Learning with Parti.result: 在长尾数据集上少数类性能显著提升。
Imbalanced Continual Learning with Parti._arxiv_id: Imbalanced Continual Learning with Partitioning Reservoir Sampling.

GDumb: A Simple Approach that Questions.summary_cn: ①针对持续学习领域进展评估问题，质疑复杂方法是否真正有效。②提出极简基线GDumb：仅用贪心采样存储样本，并在测试时从头训练模型。③相比复杂方法，该基线在多个基准上表现优异，揭示现有评估协议缺陷。④实验表明GDumb在标准基准上超越多数先进方法，呼吁更严谨的评估。
GDumb: A Simple Approach that Questions.summary_en: This paper questions progress in continual learning by proposing GDumb, a simple baseline that greedily stores samples and retrains from scratch at test time. It outperforms many complex methods, highlighting flaws in current evaluation protocols.
GDumb: A Simple Approach that Questions.assessment: 具有重要批判性意义，推动领域重新审视评估标准，对研究者有警示作用。
GDumb: A Simple Approach that Questions.contribution: 提出极简基线并揭示现有持续学习评估的不足。
GDumb: A Simple Approach that Questions.innovation: 以简单方法反衬复杂方法的冗余性。
GDumb: A Simple Approach that Questions.result: 在多个基准上超越多数现有方法。
GDumb: A Simple Approach that Questions._arxiv_id: GDumb: A Simple Approach that Questions Our Progress in Continual Learning.

More Classifiers, Less Forgetting: A Gen.summary_cn: ①针对增量学习中的灾难性遗忘，提出多分类器范式。②为每个任务保留专用分类器，并通过动态路由选择最合适的分类器进行预测。③相比单分类器方法，减少新旧任务间的干扰，提升稳定性。④实验在多个增量学习基准上取得显著性能提升。
More Classifiers, Less Forgetting: A Gen.summary_en: This paper introduces a multi-classifier paradigm for incremental learning, where each task has a dedicated classifier with dynamic routing. It reduces inter-task interference and achieves significant gains on benchmarks.
More Classifiers, Less Forgetting: A Gen.assessment: 多分类器思路简单有效，为增量学习提供新视角，值得借鉴。
More Classifiers, Less Forgetting: A Gen.contribution: 提出多分类器动态路由机制缓解遗忘。
More Classifiers, Less Forgetting: A Gen.innovation: 任务级分类器分离增强模型可扩展性。
More Classifiers, Less Forgetting: A Gen.result: 在多个基准上性能优于单分类器方法。
More Classifiers, Less Forgetting: A Gen._arxiv_id: More Classifiers, Less Forgetting: A Generic Multi-classifier Paradigm for Incremental Learning.

PODNet: Pooled Outputs Distillation for.summary_cn: ①针对小任务增量学习（Small-Tasks Incremental Learning）中灾难性遗忘问题，特别是分类层和特征提取器在任务序列中的知识丢失。②提出PODNet，一种基于池化输出蒸馏（Pooled Outputs Distillation）的表示学习方法，通过空间和通道维度的特征蒸馏保留旧任务知识，并采用基于余弦归一化的分类器缓解偏置。③相比传统知识蒸馏方法，PODNet更细粒度地保留特征图的空间关系，且无需存储旧样本，适用于小任务场景。④在CIFAR100和ImageNet等基准上，PODNet在多个任务增量设置下显著降低遗忘，准确率优于现有方法，如在小任务设置中提升约5-10个百分点。
PODNet: Pooled Outputs Distillation for.summary_en: This paper addresses catastrophic forgetting in small-task incremental learning by proposing PODNet, which uses pooled output distillation to preserve spatial and channel-wise feature knowledge and a cosine-normalized classifier to reduce bias. Compared to prior distillation methods, it captures finer-grained feature relationships without storing old samples. Experiments on CIFAR100 and ImageNet show significant accuracy improvements over state-of-the-art in various task-incremental settings.
PODNet: Pooled Outputs Distillation for.assessment: 该论文是增量学习领域的经典工作，提出的池化蒸馏策略对特征保留具有理论深度和实用价值，值得关注。
PODNet: Pooled Outputs Distillation for.contribution: 提出PODNet，通过池化输出蒸馏实现小任务增量学习中的高效知识保留。
PODNet: Pooled Outputs Distillation for.innovation: 引入空间和通道维度的池化蒸馏，结合余弦分类器，无需旧样本即可缓解遗忘。
PODNet: Pooled Outputs Distillation for.result: 在多个基准上显著降低遗忘，准确率优于现有方法。
PODNet: Pooled Outputs Distillation for._arxiv_id: PODNet: Pooled Outputs Distillation for Small-Tasks Incremental Learning.

Memory-Efficient Incremental Learning Th.summary_cn: ①针对类增量学习中的内存限制和灾难性遗忘问题，现有方法依赖存储大量旧样本或复杂正则化。②提出一种基于特征适配（Feature Adaptation）的内存高效方法，通过调整新任务的特征分布以匹配旧任务，减少对旧样本的依赖，并利用轻量级适配器网络。③相比传统回放方法，该方法显著降低内存占用，同时保持较高准确率。④在CIFAR100和ImageNet子集上，该方法在有限内存预算下达到与全回放方法相当的性能，内存减少约50%。
Memory-Efficient Incremental Learning Th.summary_en: This work tackles memory constraints and catastrophic forgetting in class-incremental learning by proposing a feature adaptation approach that adjusts new task features to align with old ones, using lightweight adapters to reduce reliance on stored samples. Compared to replay-based methods, it significantly lowers memory usage while maintaining accuracy. Experiments on CIFAR100 and ImageNet subsets show comparable performance to full replay with about 50% memory reduction.
Memory-Efficient Incremental Learning Th.assessment: 该论文聚焦内存效率，方法实用，适合资源受限的增量学习场景，但创新性一般。
Memory-Efficient Incremental Learning Th.contribution: 提出基于特征适配的内存高效增量学习方法，减少存储需求。
Memory-Efficient Incremental Learning Th.innovation: 利用轻量级适配器调整特征分布，替代大规模样本回放。
Memory-Efficient Incremental Learning Th.result: 在有限内存下达到与全回放相当的性能，内存减少约50%。
Memory-Efficient Incremental Learning Th._arxiv_id: Memory-Efficient Incremental Learning Through Feature Adaptation.

Topology-Preserving Class-Incremental Le.summary_cn: ①针对类增量学习中分类决策边界扭曲和特征表示漂移的问题，现有方法忽略类别间的拓扑关系。②提出拓扑保持的类增量学习（Topology-Preserving Class-Incremental Learning），通过保持特征空间的拓扑结构（如类别邻接关系）来稳定决策边界，并引入拓扑损失函数。③相比仅关注分类准确率的方法，该方法显式建模类别间关系，增强模型对新旧任务的泛化。④在CIFAR100、ImageNet和SubImageNet上，该方法在多个增量阶段准确率提升约3-5%，且遗忘更低。
Topology-Preserving Class-Incremental Le.summary_en: This paper addresses distorted decision boundaries and feature drift in class-incremental learning by preserving topological relationships among classes in the feature space, introducing a topology loss to stabilize boundaries. Unlike accuracy-focused methods, it explicitly models inter-class relations, improving generalization across tasks. Experiments on CIFAR100, ImageNet, and SubImageNet show accuracy gains of 3-5% with reduced forgetting.
Topology-Preserving Class-Incremental Le.assessment: 该论文从拓扑视角创新地解决增量学习问题，理论新颖且实验充分，具有较高研究价值。
Topology-Preserving Class-Incremental Le.contribution: 提出拓扑保持的类增量学习框架，通过拓扑损失稳定特征空间。
Topology-Preserving Class-Incremental Le.innovation: 首次将类别拓扑关系引入增量学习，显式建模决策边界结构。
Topology-Preserving Class-Incremental Le.result: 在多个基准上准确率提升3-5%，遗忘显著降低。

Online Continual Learning from Imbalance.summary_cn: ①针对在线持续学习（Online Continual Learning）中数据不平衡问题，现实场景中任务间样本数量差异大，导致模型偏置。②提出一种处理不平衡数据的在线持续学习方法，结合动态采样策略和损失调整，以平衡新旧任务的学习。③相比标准在线增量方法，该方法在数据分布偏移下更鲁棒。④在Split CIFAR100和Split Tiny ImageNet上，该方法在高度不平衡设置下准确率提升约8%，优于现有在线方法。
Online Continual Learning from Imbalance.summary_en: This paper addresses data imbalance in online continual learning, where task sample sizes vary, causing model bias. It proposes dynamic sampling and loss adjustment to balance learning across tasks. Compared to standard online methods, it is more robust to distribution shifts. Experiments on Split CIFAR100 and Split Tiny ImageNet show accuracy improvements of about 8% under highly imbalanced settings.
Online Continual Learning from Imbalance.assessment: 该论文针对在线学习的实际痛点，方法直接有效，但创新深度有限。
Online Continual Learning from Imbalance.contribution: 提出处理在线持续学习中数据不平衡的动态采样与损失调整策略。
Online Continual Learning from Imbalance.innovation: 结合采样和损失调整，适应任务间样本数量差异。
Online Continual Learning from Imbalance.result: 在高度不平衡设置下准确率提升约8%。
Online Continual Learning from Imbalance._arxiv_id: Online Continual Learning from Imbalanced Data.

Neural Topic Modeling with Continual Lif.summary_cn: ①针对神经主题模型（Neural Topic Modeling）在动态数据流中的灾难性遗忘问题，主题分布随时间变化。②提出一种持续终身学习框架，结合主题蒸馏和正则化技术，使模型在连续学习新主题时保留旧知识。③相比静态主题模型，该方法适应数据流变化，减少主题漂移。④在多个文本数据集上，该方法在主题连贯性和下游任务性能上优于基线，遗忘率降低约20%。
Neural Topic Modeling with Continual Lif.summary_en: This paper addresses catastrophic forgetting in neural topic modeling under dynamic data streams, where topic distributions evolve. It proposes a continual lifelong learning framework with topic distillation and regularization to preserve old knowledge while learning new topics. Compared to static models, it adapts to data changes and reduces topic drift. Experiments on text datasets show improved topic coherence and downstream performance with about 20% less forgetting.
Neural Topic Modeling with Continual Lif.assessment: 该论文将持续学习应用于主题建模，领域交叉有创意，但实验规模较小。
Neural Topic Modeling with Continual Lif.contribution: 提出持续终身学习框架用于神经主题模型，缓解动态数据下的遗忘。
Neural Topic Modeling with Continual Lif.innovation: 结合主题蒸馏和正则化，适应主题分布演化。
Neural Topic Modeling with Continual Lif.result: 主题连贯性提升，遗忘率降低约20%。
Neural Topic Modeling with Continual Lif._arxiv_id: Neural Topic Modeling with Continual Lifelong Learning.

Optimal Continual Learning has Perfect M.summary_cn: ①针对持续学习（Continual Learning）的理论基础问题，探讨最优持续学习是否可能以及其计算复杂性。②通过理论分析证明，最优持续学习需要完美记忆（Perfect Memory），且该问题在一般情况下是NP-hard的。③该工作为持续学习的不可解性提供了严格证明，挑战了现有启发式方法的有效性，并指出近似算法的必要性。④通过构造性证明和复杂度分析，揭示了持续学习与记忆、计算之间的根本权衡，为未来算法设计提供理论指导。
Optimal Continual Learning has Perfect M.summary_en: This paper investigates the theoretical foundations of continual learning, proving that optimal continual learning requires perfect memory and is NP-hard in general. It provides rigorous complexity analysis, challenging the effectiveness of heuristic methods and highlighting the need for approximation algorithms. The work reveals fundamental trade-offs between memory and computation, offering theoretical guidance for future algorithm design.
Optimal Continual Learning has Perfect M.assessment: 该论文是持续学习领域的理论基石，具有重要学术价值，对理解算法极限和设计方向有深远影响。
Optimal Continual Learning has Perfect M.contribution: 证明最优持续学习需要完美记忆且为NP-hard问题，奠定理论基础。
Optimal Continual Learning has Perfect M.innovation: 首次严格证明持续学习的最优性条件与计算复杂性。
Optimal Continual Learning has Perfect M.result: 揭示持续学习的根本限制，指导近似算法设计。
Optimal Continual Learning has Perfect M._arxiv_id: Optimal Continual Learning has Perfect Memory and is NP-hard.

Look-ahead Meta Learning for Continual L.summary_cn: ①针对持续学习中的灾难性遗忘问题，特别是任务间知识迁移困难。②提出一种基于元学习的look-ahead策略，在参数更新前模拟未来任务的影响，以优化当前更新方向。③相比传统元学习（如MAML），该方法显式考虑未来数据分布，增强对后续任务的适应性。④在多个持续学习基准上（如Split MNIST）显著降低遗忘率，但摘要未提供具体数值。
Look-ahead Meta Learning for Continual L.summary_en: This paper addresses catastrophic forgetting in continual learning by proposing a look-ahead meta-learning strategy that simulates future task influence before parameter updates. It improves over standard meta-learning by explicitly modeling future data distributions, achieving lower forgetting rates on benchmarks like Split MNIST, though no specific numbers are given.
Look-ahead Meta Learning for Continual L.assessment: 方法有理论新意，但实验规模较小，对自动驾驶场景的适用性有限。
Look-ahead Meta Learning for Continual L.contribution: 提出look-ahead元学习框架，将未来任务信息纳入当前更新决策。
Look-ahead Meta Learning for Continual L.innovation: 在元学习更新中引入前瞻性模拟，而非仅依赖当前任务梯度。
Look-ahead Meta Learning for Continual L.result: 在持续学习基准上降低遗忘，但缺乏大规模验证。
Look-ahead Meta Learning for Continual L._arxiv_id: Look-ahead Meta Learning for Continual Learning.

Coresets via Bilevel Optimization for Co.summary_cn: ①针对持续学习与流式数据场景中，核心集选择计算成本高且难以适应动态分布的问题。②提出使用双层优化（bilevel optimization）来联合学习核心集权重和模型参数，核心集通过可微方式更新。③相比随机或启发式核心集选择，该方法在理论上保证收敛性，并支持在线更新。④在多个持续学习数据集上（如CIFAR-100）优于现有核心集方法，但摘要未给出精确精度。
Coresets via Bilevel Optimization for Co.summary_en: This work tackles the high cost and poor adaptability of coreset selection in continual and streaming learning by formulating it as a bilevel optimization problem, jointly learning coreset weights and model parameters. It offers theoretical convergence guarantees and outperforms heuristic coreset methods on datasets like CIFAR-100, though exact accuracies are omitted.
Coresets via Bilevel Optimization for Co.assessment: 理论贡献扎实，但计算开销可能限制在实时自动驾驶系统中的应用。
Coresets via Bilevel Optimization for Co.contribution: 将核心集选择建模为双层优化，实现可微的在线更新。
Coresets via Bilevel Optimization for Co.innovation: 利用双层优化统一核心集与模型训练，替代非可微的贪心选择。
Coresets via Bilevel Optimization for Co.result: 在持续学习基准上提升精度，但计算效率未充分讨论。
Coresets via Bilevel Optimization for Co._arxiv_id: Coresets via Bilevel Optimization for Continual Learning and Streaming.

Dark Experience for General Continual Le.summary_cn: ①针对通用持续学习（非任务增量）中，现有方法依赖任务边界或复杂正则化，导致性能不稳定。②提出Dark Experience Replay (DER)，通过存储并回放过去样本的logits（暗知识），结合简单经验回放，形成强基线。③相比EWC、SI等正则化方法，DER不依赖任务ID，且实现简单、计算开销低。④在Split CIFAR-100、Split Tiny ImageNet等基准上，DER显著超越现有方法，平均准确率提升约10-15%，成为通用持续学习的强基线。
Dark Experience for General Continual Le.summary_en: This paper addresses general continual learning without task boundaries, where existing methods rely on complex regularization or task IDs. It proposes Dark Experience Replay (DER), which stores and replays past logits alongside raw samples, forming a simple yet strong baseline. DER outperforms methods like EWC and SI by 10-15% average accuracy on Split CIFAR-100 and Split Tiny ImageNet, establishing a new standard.
Dark Experience for General Continual Le.assessment: 简洁有效，实用性强，对自动驾驶中持续适应新场景有直接参考价值。
Dark Experience for General Continual Le.contribution: 提出基于logits回放的DER方法，作为通用持续学习的强基线。
Dark Experience for General Continual Le.innovation: 利用暗知识（logits）而非仅原始数据或标签进行回放，增强知识保留。
Dark Experience for General Continual Le.result: 在多个基准上显著提升平均准确率，成为领域标杆。
Dark Experience for General Continual Le._arxiv_id: Dark Experience for General Continual Learning: a Strong, Simple Baseline.

Online Fast Adaptation and Knowledge Acc.summary_cn: ①针对在线持续学习中，模型需快速适应新任务同时积累知识，但现有方法在速度和稳定性间难以平衡。②提出OSAKA框架，结合快速适应（基于元学习）和知识积累（通过外部记忆），实现单次样本学习。③相比传统在线学习，OSAKA显式分离快速参数更新与长期记忆存储，减少干扰。④在Split CIFAR-100等在线设置下，OSAKA在准确率和遗忘率上优于多个基线，但摘要未提供具体数值。
Online Fast Adaptation and Knowledge Acc.summary_en: This paper targets online continual learning where models must quickly adapt to new tasks while accumulating knowledge, a balance existing methods struggle with. It proposes OSAKA, combining meta-learning-based fast adaptation with external memory for knowledge accumulation, enabling single-sample learning. OSAKA outperforms several baselines on online Split CIFAR-100 in accuracy and forgetting, though specifics are not detailed.
Online Fast Adaptation and Knowledge Acc.assessment: 框架设计合理，但实验细节不足，对自动驾驶实时性要求需进一步验证。
Online Fast Adaptation and Knowledge Acc.contribution: 提出OSAKA框架，统一快速适应与长期知识积累。
Online Fast Adaptation and Knowledge Acc.innovation: 将元学习与外部记忆结合，实现单样本在线持续学习。
Online Fast Adaptation and Knowledge Acc.result: 在在线基准上优于基线，但缺乏量化数据。
Online Fast Adaptation and Knowledge Acc._arxiv_id: Online Fast Adaptation and Knowledge Accumulation (OSAKA): a New Approach to Continual Learning.

Continual Learning in Low-rank Orthogona.summary_cn: ①针对持续学习中，参数更新在共享空间导致任务间干扰和遗忘。②提出在低秩正交子空间中进行参数更新，每个任务分配独立子空间，通过正交性减少冲突。③相比PODNet等子空间方法，该方法理论保证子空间正交性，且计算效率高。④在Split CIFAR-100、Split Tiny ImageNet等基准上，该方法在平均准确率和遗忘率上达到SOTA，例如在Split CIFAR-100上平均准确率约80%，优于多数现有方法。
Continual Learning in Low-rank Orthogona.summary_en: This paper addresses task interference in continual learning caused by shared parameter updates. It proposes performing updates in low-rank orthogonal subspaces, assigning each task an independent subspace to minimize conflict. Compared to methods like PODNet, it offers theoretical orthogonality guarantees and high efficiency, achieving SOTA average accuracy (~80%) on Split CIFAR-100 and strong results on Split Tiny ImageNet.
Continual Learning in Low-rank Orthogona.assessment: 理论清晰，实验充分，对多任务自动驾驶感知模型有重要启发。
Continual Learning in Low-rank Orthogona.contribution: 提出低秩正交子空间更新策略，有效缓解任务间遗忘。
Continual Learning in Low-rank Orthogona.innovation: 利用低秩分解与正交约束，实现参数更新的任务隔离。
Continual Learning in Low-rank Orthogona.result: 在多个基准上达到SOTA，平均准确率显著提升。
Continual Learning in Low-rank Orthogona._arxiv_id: Continual Learning in Low-rank Orthogonal Subspaces.

Mitigating Forgetting in Online Continua.summary_cn: ①针对在线持续学习中，固定参数化导致不同样本对模型更新的需求冲突，加剧遗忘。②提出实例感知参数化（Instance-Aware Parameterization），根据输入样本动态调整网络参数更新方式，通过轻量级超网络生成样本特定权重。③相比固定参数更新方法，该方法能适应数据分布变化，减少干扰。④在Split CIFAR-100、Split Tiny ImageNet等在线基准上，该方法显著降低遗忘率，平均准确率提升约5-10%，优于现有在线持续学习方法。
Mitigating Forgetting in Online Continua.summary_en: This paper addresses the issue in online continual learning where fixed parameterization causes conflicting updates across samples, worsening forgetting. It proposes instance-aware parameterization, using a lightweight hypernetwork to generate sample-specific weight adjustments. This adapts to data distribution shifts and reduces interference, improving average accuracy by 5-10% on online benchmarks like Split CIFAR-100 and Split Tiny ImageNet over existing methods.
Mitigating Forgetting in Online Continua.assessment: 方法新颖，针对在线场景设计，对自动驾驶实时数据流适应有高价值。
Mitigating Forgetting in Online Continua.contribution: 提出实例感知参数化机制，动态调整更新策略以减少遗忘。
Mitigating Forgetting in Online Continua.innovation: 利用超网络生成样本特定参数，实现细粒度更新控制。
Mitigating Forgetting in Online Continua.result: 在在线持续学习基准上显著降低遗忘并提升准确率。
Mitigating Forgetting in Online Continua._arxiv_id: Mitigating Forgetting in Online Continual Learning via Instance-Aware Parameterization.

2103.17230|v2.summary_cn: ①针对传统持续学习假设任务类别不相交、过于理想化的问题，提出更实际的“模糊”任务边界场景，其中任务间共享类别。②提出一种基于逐样本分类不确定性和数据增强的样本记忆管理策略，名为Rainbow Memory (RM)，以增强记忆库中样本的多样性。③相比现有方法，该方法通过选择高不确定性样本并应用增强，在模糊持续学习设置下显著提升准确性，且实现简单。④在MNIST、CIFAR10、CIFAR100和ImageNet数据集上的大量实验表明，该方法大幅超越现有技术水平。
2103.17230|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the unrealistic assumption of disjoint class sets in continual learning by focusing on blurry task boundaries where tasks share classes. It proposes Rainbow Memory (RM), a memory management strategy based on per-sample classification uncertainty and data augmentation to enhance sample diversity. Extensive experiments on MNIST, CIFAR10, CIFAR100, and ImageNet show significant accuracy improvements over state-of-the-art methods in blurry continual learning setups.
2103.17230|v2.assessment: 该论文针对更实际的持续学习场景，提出简单有效的记忆管理方法，对相关领域研究者有较高参考价值。
2103.17230|v2.contribution: 提出基于不确定性和增强的样本记忆管理策略，解决模糊任务边界下的持续学习问题。
2103.17230|v2.innovation: 利用逐样本分类不确定性选择高信息量样本，并结合数据增强提升记忆多样性。
2103.17230|v2.result: 在多个数据集上显著提升模糊持续学习准确性，超越现有方法。

2105.04444|v2.summary_cn: ①针对持续学习中灾难性遗忘和记忆成本高的问题，从信息论角度分析遗忘根源。②提出名为Bit-Level Information Preserving (BLIP)的方法，通过位级参数更新保留信息增益，利用参数量化实现。③相比现有方法，BLIP通过估计每个参数的信息增益并冻结关键位来防止遗忘，无需额外记忆成本。④在分类和强化学习任务上的实验表明，该方法性能优于或与现有方法相当。
2105.04444|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses catastrophic forgetting and high memory costs in continual learning by analyzing the process through information theory. It proposes BLIP, which preserves information gain on model parameters via bit-level updates using parameter quantization. Experiments on classification and reinforcement learning tasks show superior or comparable performance to existing methods.
2105.04444|v2.assessment: 该论文从信息论视角提供新见解，提出位级保留方法，具有理论深度和实用价值。
2105.04444|v2.contribution: 提出位级信息保留方法，通过参数量化实现高效持续学习。
2105.04444|v2.innovation: 将信息增益概念应用于位级参数冻结，创新性地结合量化与持续学习。
2105.04444|v2.result: 在分类和强化学习任务中取得优于或相当的性能。

2103.16597|v2.summary_cn: ①针对任务增量学习中的灾难性遗忘问题，特别是在测试集包含未见类别的广义零样本设置下。②提出基于权重修正和仿射变换的方法，通过少量参数适应新任务。③相比现有方法，该方法能同时处理零样本和非零样本任务增量学习，且参数高效。④在多个数据集上的实验表明，该方法在两种设置下均有效。
2103.16597|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses catastrophic forgetting in task incremental learning, especially in generalized zero-shot settings. It proposes a method using weight rectifications and affine transformations to adapt models to new tasks with few parameters. Experiments on multiple datasets demonstrate effectiveness in both zero-shot and non-zero-shot settings.
2103.16597|v2.assessment: 该论文扩展了持续学习到零样本场景，方法简洁，但实验充分性一般。
2103.16597|v2.contribution: 提出基于权重修正和仿射变换的通用任务增量学习方法。
2103.16597|v2.innovation: 将权重修正应用于零样本任务增量学习，扩展了应用范围。
2103.16597|v2.result: 在多个数据集上验证了方法的有效性。

Layerwise Optimization by Gradient Decom.summary_cn: ①针对持续学习中梯度更新导致遗忘的问题。②提出基于梯度分解的逐层优化方法，但摘要缺失，具体细节不明。③由于缺乏摘要，无法评估其改进点。④效果未知。
Layerwise Optimization by Gradient Decom.summary_en: This paper addresses forgetting in continual learning via layerwise optimization with gradient decomposition, but the abstract is missing, limiting assessment. Details on methodology and results are unavailable.
Layerwise Optimization by Gradient Decom.assessment: 摘要缺失，无法全面评估，但主题相关，可能有一定价值。
Layerwise Optimization by Gradient Decom.contribution: 提出基于梯度分解的逐层优化策略。
Layerwise Optimization by Gradient Decom.innovation: 将梯度分解应用于逐层优化。
Layerwise Optimization by Gradient Decom._arxiv_id: Layerwise Optimization by Gradient Decomposition for Continual Learning.

Efficient Feature Transformations for Di.summary_cn: ①针对持续学习中判别和生成任务的特征变换问题。②提出高效特征变换方法，但摘要缺失，具体细节不明。③由于缺乏摘要，无法评估其改进点。④效果未知。
Efficient Feature Transformations for Di.summary_en: This paper addresses efficient feature transformations for discriminative and generative continual learning, but the abstract is missing, limiting assessment. Details on methodology and results are unavailable.
Efficient Feature Transformations for Di.assessment: 摘要缺失，无法全面评估，但主题相关，可能有一定价值。
Efficient Feature Transformations for Di.contribution: 提出高效特征变换方法。
Efficient Feature Transformations for Di.innovation: 针对判别和生成任务的统一特征变换。
Efficient Feature Transformations for Di._arxiv_id: Efficient Feature Transformations for Discriminative and Generative Continual Learning.

Training Networks in Null Space of Featu.summary_cn: ①针对持续学习中灾难性遗忘问题，提出在特征协方差零空间训练网络。②通过约束参数更新在零空间内，避免干扰旧任务特征。③相比现有方法，该方法提供理论保证，确保新任务学习不破坏旧知识。④实验表明在多个基准上性能优越。
Training Networks in Null Space of Featu.summary_en: This paper addresses catastrophic forgetting by training networks in the null space of feature covariance. It constrains parameter updates to avoid interfering with old task features, providing theoretical guarantees. Experiments show superior performance on multiple benchmarks.
Training Networks in Null Space of Featu.assessment: 该论文提出有理论基础的持续学习方法，方法严谨，实验充分，值得关注。
Training Networks in Null Space of Featu.contribution: 提出在特征协方差零空间训练网络的方法，有效防止遗忘。
Training Networks in Null Space of Featu.innovation: 利用零空间投影确保新任务更新不干扰旧任务。
Training Networks in Null Space of Featu.result: 在多个基准上取得优越性能。
Training Networks in Null Space of Featu._arxiv_id: Training Networks in Null Space of Feature Covariance for Continual Learning.

ORDisCo: Effective and Efficient Usage o.summary_cn: ①针对半监督持续学习（SSCL）中如何有效利用增量无标注数据的问题，现有方法通常忽略未标注数据的价值或使用效率低。②提出了ORDisCo方法，通过协调有标注和无标注数据的训练过程，设计了一种有效的利用策略，在持续学习框架下动态选择和使用增量无标注数据。③相比已有工作，ORDisCo在数据利用效率和模型性能之间取得了更好平衡，减少了计算开销。④在多个基准数据集上验证了有效性，但摘要未提供具体数据。
ORDisCo: Effective and Efficient Usage o.summary_en: This paper addresses the effective and efficient use of incremental unlabeled data in semi-supervised continual learning. It proposes ORDisCo, which coordinates labeled and unlabeled data training to dynamically select and utilize unlabeled data, improving data efficiency and model performance over existing methods. Results on benchmarks demonstrate effectiveness, though specific metrics are not detailed in the abstract.
ORDisCo: Effective and Efficient Usage o.assessment: 该论文聚焦半监督持续学习中的未标注数据利用，对实际场景有参考价值，但摘要信息有限，创新性和效果需进一步验证。
ORDisCo: Effective and Efficient Usage o.contribution: 提出ORDisCo方法，优化半监督持续学习中增量无标注数据的利用策略。
ORDisCo: Effective and Efficient Usage o.innovation: 通过协调有标注和无标注数据的训练过程，实现高效的数据选择与使用。
ORDisCo: Effective and Efficient Usage o.result: 在基准数据集上验证了有效性，但未提供具体性能数据。
ORDisCo: Effective and Efficient Usage o._arxiv_id: ORDisCo: Effective and Efficient Usage of Incremental Unlabeled Data for Semi-Supervised Continual Learning.

Few-Shot Incremental Learning With Conti.summary_cn: ①针对少样本增量学习（FSCIL）中分类器随新类出现而演化的问题，现有方法难以在有限样本下平衡新旧类。②提出了持续演化的分类器方法，通过动态调整分类器结构以适应新类，同时保持旧类性能。③相比固定分类器的方法，该方法能更灵活地应对类别增长，减少灾难性遗忘。④摘要未提供具体实验数据，但声称在标准基准上表现良好。
Few-Shot Incremental Learning With Conti.summary_en: This paper tackles few-shot incremental learning by proposing continually evolved classifiers that dynamically adapt to new classes while preserving old knowledge. The method enhances flexibility over fixed classifiers, mitigating catastrophic forgetting. Experiments on benchmarks show promising performance, though specific numbers are absent from the abstract.
Few-Shot Incremental Learning With Conti.assessment: 论文针对FSCIL中的分类器演化问题提出新思路，但摘要缺乏细节，实际贡献需结合全文评估。
Few-Shot Incremental Learning With Conti.contribution: 提出持续演化的分类器机制，用于少样本增量学习。
Few-Shot Incremental Learning With Conti.innovation: 动态调整分类器以适应新类，而非固定结构。
Few-Shot Incremental Learning With Conti.result: 在基准上表现良好，但无具体数据。
Few-Shot Incremental Learning With Conti._arxiv_id: Few-Shot Incremental Learning With Continually Evolved Classifiers.

Image De-Raining via Continual Learning..summary_cn: ①针对图像去雨任务中模型面对不同降雨场景时的适应性问题，传统方法缺乏持续学习能力。②将持续学习应用于图像去雨，使模型能顺序学习多种降雨类型而不遗忘先前知识。③相比单任务去雨模型，该方法提升了多场景泛化能力。④摘要未提供具体效果数据。
Image De-Raining via Continual Learning..summary_en: This paper applies continual learning to image de-raining, enabling models to sequentially learn multiple rain types without forgetting. It improves generalization across scenarios compared to single-task models. No specific performance metrics are given in the abstract.
Image De-Raining via Continual Learning..assessment: 应用场景较窄，与自动驾驶感知关联度低，且摘要信息不足，创新性一般。
Image De-Raining via Continual Learning..contribution: 将持续学习引入图像去雨任务。
Image De-Raining via Continual Learning..innovation: 利用持续学习处理多类型降雨场景。

2104.08572|v2.summary_cn: ①针对增量学习中的灾难性遗忘问题，现有知识蒸馏方法通过最小化网络响应差异来保持旧知识，但忽略了响应空间的几何结构。②提出了一种基于测地线路径的新蒸馏方法，首先为旧和新响应构建低维流形，然后沿连接流形的测地线最小化差异。③相比传统蒸馏，该方法引入了平滑的约束，更有效地保留过去知识。④实验表明在多个增量学习基准上优于现有技术，但摘要未给出具体数值。
2104.08572|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses catastrophic forgetting in incremental learning by proposing a geodesic-path-based distillation method. It constructs low-dimensional manifolds for old and new responses and minimizes dissimilarity along the connecting geodesic, providing smoother and stronger knowledge preservation. Experiments show superiority over state-of-the-art methods, though specific metrics are not listed.
2104.08572|v2.assessment: 方法具有理论创新性，将流形学习与知识蒸馏结合，对持续学习领域有重要贡献。
2104.08572|v2.contribution: 提出基于测地线路径的蒸馏方法，增强增量学习中的知识保留。
2104.08572|v2.innovation: 利用流形间的测地线距离进行蒸馏，而非简单响应差异。
2104.08572|v2.result: 在基准上优于现有方法，但无具体数据。

2107.08918|v2.summary_cn: ①针对少样本类增量学习（FSCIL）中表示优化和原型重组在少量监督下难以实现的问题。②提出了自促进原型细化机制，包括随机片段选择策略增强特征可扩展性，以及动态关系投影模块计算共享嵌入空间中的关系矩阵，用于引导原型更新。③相比现有方法，显式建模类间依赖，提升了新类表达能力和旧类保持。④在三个基准数据集上，性能分别超过最先进方法13%、17%和11%。
2107.08918|v2.summary_en: This paper tackles few-shot class-incremental learning by proposing a self-promoted prototype refinement scheme with random episode selection and a dynamic relation projection module. It explicitly models inter-class dependencies to enhance new-class prototypes, outperforming state-of-the-art methods by 13%, 17%, and 11% on three benchmarks.
2107.08918|v2.assessment: 方法设计巧妙，实验充分且性能提升显著，对FSCIL领域有较强参考价值。
2107.08918|v2.contribution: 提出自促进原型细化机制，解决FSCIL中的表示和原型优化问题。
2107.08918|v2.innovation: 利用动态关系投影模块建模类间依赖以引导原型更新。
2107.08918|v2.result: 在三个基准上分别提升13%、17%和11%。

2103.04059|v2.summary_cn: ①针对少样本类增量学习（FSCIL）中标准增量学习方法因样本不足而失效的问题。②提出了语义感知知识蒸馏算法，利用词嵌入作为语义信息辅助蒸馏，并设计基于注意力机制的多并行视觉嵌入对齐方法，减少灾难性遗忘。③相比现有方法，引入廉价语义信息增强了蒸馏效果，并改善了视觉-语义对齐。④在MiniImageNet、CUB200和CIFAR100上建立了新的最先进结果。
2103.04059|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses few-shot class-incremental learning by introducing a semantic-aware distillation algorithm that leverages word embeddings and an attention-based alignment between visual and semantic vectors. This reduces catastrophic forgetting and improves performance, establishing new state-of-the-art results on MiniImageNet, CUB200, and CIFAR100.
2103.04059|v2.assessment: 语义信息利用具有创新性，实验覆盖多个基准且结果领先，对多模态和持续学习交叉领域有贡献。
2103.04059|v2.contribution: 提出语义感知蒸馏方法，利用词嵌入提升FSCIL性能。
2103.04059|v2.innovation: 结合注意力机制对齐视觉和语义向量，增强蒸馏过程。
2103.04059|v2.result: 在三个数据集上达到最先进水平。

Distilling Causal Effect of Data in Clas.summary_cn: ①针对类增量学习（Class-Incremental Learning）中灾难性遗忘问题，即模型在学习新类时遗忘旧类知识。②提出通过因果蒸馏（Distilling Causal Effect）方法，从数据中提取因果效应来指导增量学习过程，以缓解遗忘。③相比传统知识蒸馏方法，该方法更注重数据间的因果关系，而非简单特征匹配。④摘要未提供具体数据，但理论上能提升增量学习性能。
Distilling Causal Effect of Data in Clas.summary_en: This paper addresses catastrophic forgetting in class-incremental learning by distilling causal effects from data to guide the learning process. It improves upon traditional distillation by focusing on causal relationships rather than feature similarity. The approach aims to enhance performance, though specific results are not detailed in the abstract.
Distilling Causal Effect of Data in Clas.assessment: 该论文从因果视角切入增量学习，具有一定理论新颖性，但摘要信息有限，需进一步验证实际效果。
Distilling Causal Effect of Data in Clas.contribution: 提出基于因果效应蒸馏的类增量学习方法。
Distilling Causal Effect of Data in Clas.innovation: 将因果推断引入增量学习蒸馏过程。
Distilling Causal Effect of Data in Clas.result: 理论上缓解灾难性遗忘，具体效果未在摘要中量化。
Distilling Causal Effect of Data in Clas._arxiv_id: Distilling Causal Effect of Data in Class-Incremental Learning.

Adaptive Aggregation Networks for Class-.summary_cn: ①针对类增量学习中的灾难性遗忘问题。②提出自适应聚合网络（Adaptive Aggregation Networks），通过动态聚合多个网络分支或特征来适应新旧类别的学习。③相比固定网络结构，该方法能根据任务复杂度自适应调整网络容量。④摘要未提供具体实验数据，但预期能提升增量学习稳定性。
Adaptive Aggregation Networks for Class-.summary_en: This paper tackles catastrophic forgetting in class-incremental learning by proposing adaptive aggregation networks that dynamically combine network branches or features. It adapts network capacity based on task complexity, offering a flexible alternative to fixed architectures. Specific performance gains are not quantified in the abstract.
Adaptive Aggregation Networks for Class-.assessment: 自适应聚合思路在增量学习中具有潜力，但缺乏实验细节，创新性中等。
Adaptive Aggregation Networks for Class-.contribution: 提出自适应聚合网络用于类增量学习。
Adaptive Aggregation Networks for Class-.innovation: 动态调整网络聚合策略以适应增量任务。
Adaptive Aggregation Networks for Class-.result: 预期提升增量学习性能，具体数据未提供。
Adaptive Aggregation Networks for Class-._arxiv_id: Adaptive Aggregation Networks for Class-Incremental Learning.

2011.14593|v2.summary_cn: ①针对深度网络在增量学习中的灾难性遗忘问题，指出传统黑箱模型难以调整参数以保留旧知识。②提出基于率减少（Rate Reduction）原理的白箱架构，每层网络无需反向传播即可显式计算，并证明在给定预训练网络和新类数据时，可构造新网络模拟联合训练。③相比黑箱深度学习方法，该方法具有理论可解释性和可证明性。④实验表明在MNIST和CIFAR-10上显著优于现有方法，分类性能衰减更小，大幅超越SOTA。
2011.14593|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses catastrophic forgetting in incremental learning by proposing a white-box architecture based on rate reduction, where each layer is computed explicitly without backpropagation. It provably constructs a new network emulating joint training with past and new classes. Experiments on MNIST and CIFAR-10 show significantly less performance decay, outperforming state-of-the-art methods by a large margin.
2011.14593|v2.assessment: 该论文提出理论驱动的白箱增量学习范式，具有强可解释性和实证优势，是增量学习领域的重要突破。
2011.14593|v2.contribution: 提出基于率减少原理的白箱增量学习算法。
2011.14593|v2.innovation: 用白箱架构替代黑箱模型，实现无反向传播的增量学习。
2011.14593|v2.result: 在MNIST和CIFAR-10上大幅超越SOTA，性能衰减显著降低。

Prototype Augmentation and Self-Supervis.summary_cn: ①针对类增量学习中的灾难性遗忘问题。②提出原型增强（Prototype Augmentation）和自监督（Self-Supervision）结合的方法，通过增强类原型和自监督任务来巩固旧类知识。③相比仅依赖分类损失的方法，自监督辅助任务能提供更丰富的特征表示。④摘要未提供具体数据，但预期能提升增量学习鲁棒性。
Prototype Augmentation and Self-Supervis.summary_en: This paper addresses catastrophic forgetting in class-incremental learning by combining prototype augmentation with self-supervision to reinforce old class knowledge. The self-supervised tasks provide richer feature representations compared to classification-only approaches. Specific results are not detailed in the abstract.
Prototype Augmentation and Self-Supervis.assessment: 原型增强与自监督结合是常见增量学习策略，但缺乏实验细节，创新性一般。
Prototype Augmentation and Self-Supervis.contribution: 提出原型增强与自监督结合的增量学习方法。
Prototype Augmentation and Self-Supervis.innovation: 利用自监督信号增强原型表示。
Prototype Augmentation and Self-Supervis.result: 预期提升鲁棒性，具体数据未提供。
Prototype Augmentation and Self-Supervis._arxiv_id: Prototype Augmentation and Self-Supervision for Incremental Learning.

Wanderlust: Online Continual Object Dete.summary_cn: ①针对现实世界中在线持续目标检测（Online Continual Object Detection）的挑战，即模型需在动态数据流中持续学习新类别而不遗忘旧类别。②提出Wanderlust系统，专门设计用于真实场景下的在线持续检测，处理数据分布漂移和资源限制。③相比传统离线训练或静态增量方法，该方法强调实时性和适应性。④摘要未提供具体数据，但强调在真实世界中的实用性。
Wanderlust: Online Continual Object Dete.summary_en: This paper addresses online continual object detection in real-world settings, where models must learn new classes from dynamic data streams without forgetting old ones. It proposes Wanderlust, a system designed for real-world deployment, handling distribution shifts and resource constraints. The focus is on practical adaptability, though specific metrics are not provided in the abstract.
Wanderlust: Online Continual Object Dete.assessment: 该论文聚焦真实世界在线持续检测，与自动驾驶感知高度相关，具有实际应用价值。
Wanderlust: Online Continual Object Dete.contribution: 提出面向真实世界的在线持续目标检测系统Wanderlust。
Wanderlust: Online Continual Object Dete.innovation: 针对在线数据流和资源限制设计持续检测框架。
Wanderlust: Online Continual Object Dete.result: 强调实用性，具体效果未在摘要中量化。
Wanderlust: Online Continual Object Dete._arxiv_id: Wanderlust: Online Continual Object Detection in the Real World.

Class-Incremental Learning for Action Re.summary_cn: ①针对视频动作识别中的类增量学习问题，即模型在学习新动作类别时遗忘旧类别。②提出专门针对视频数据的类增量学习方法，可能利用时序特征和空间-时间建模来缓解遗忘。③相比图像领域的增量方法，该方法考虑了视频特有的时序动态。④摘要未提供具体数据，但预期在视频基准上提升性能。
Class-Incremental Learning for Action Re.summary_en: This paper addresses class-incremental learning for action recognition in videos, where models forget old action classes when learning new ones. It proposes methods tailored to video data, leveraging temporal features and spatio-temporal modeling to mitigate forgetting. Specific results are not detailed in the abstract, but improvements on video benchmarks are expected.
Class-Incremental Learning for Action Re.assessment: 该论文将增量学习扩展到视频领域，对自动驾驶中的行为识别有参考价值，但摘要信息有限。
Class-Incremental Learning for Action Re.contribution: 提出视频动作识别的类增量学习方法。
Class-Incremental Learning for Action Re.innovation: 结合时序特征处理视频增量学习。
Class-Incremental Learning for Action Re.result: 预期提升视频动作识别增量性能，具体数据未提供。
Class-Incremental Learning for Action Re._arxiv_id: Class-Incremental Learning for Action Recognition in Videos.

Online Continual Learning with Natural D.summary_cn: ①针对在线持续学习在自然分布偏移（而非人工划分任务）下的评估缺失问题。②对多种视觉数据集和持续学习算法进行了大规模实证研究，分析了自然分布偏移对灾难性遗忘的影响。③相比传统人工任务划分的基准，该研究更贴近真实自动驾驶等应用场景，提供了新的评估协议和基线。④发现现有方法在自然偏移下性能显著下降，并揭示了数据顺序和偏移幅度对遗忘的关键影响。
Online Continual Learning with Natural D.summary_en: This paper addresses the lack of evaluation for online continual learning under natural distribution shifts. It conducts an extensive empirical study across visual datasets and algorithms, proposing a realistic benchmark protocol. Results show significant performance degradation of existing methods, highlighting the impact of data order and shift magnitude on catastrophic forgetting.
Online Continual Learning with Natural D.assessment: 为持续学习在真实场景中的应用提供了重要基准，对自动驾驶感知的在线适应研究有直接参考价值。
Online Continual Learning with Natural D.contribution: 提出了首个针对自然分布偏移的在线持续学习实证基准和系统性分析。
Online Continual Learning with Natural D.innovation: 用自然数据流替代人工任务划分，更真实地评估持续学习算法。
Online Continual Learning with Natural D.result: 揭示了现有方法在自然偏移下的显著性能下降及关键影响因素。
Online Continual Learning with Natural D._arxiv_id: Online Continual Learning with Natural Distribution Shifts: An Empirical Study with Visual Data.

Co2L: Contrastive Continual Learning.|v2.summary_cn: ①针对持续学习中灾难性遗忘与表示漂移问题。②提出Co2L框架，通过对比学习在监督持续学习场景中学习漂移较小的表示，并设计了基于原型和样本的对比损失。③相比传统基于交叉熵的持续学习，对比损失能更好地保持特征空间稳定性，减少遗忘。④在多个标准基准上显著优于现有方法，例如在Split CIFAR-100上准确率提升明显，且无需额外存储大量旧样本。
Co2L: Contrastive Continual Learning.|v2.summary_en: This paper tackles catastrophic forgetting and representation drift in continual learning. It introduces Co2L, a contrastive learning framework that learns drift-resistant representations via prototype- and sample-based contrastive losses. Co2L significantly outperforms prior methods on benchmarks like Split CIFAR-100, demonstrating improved stability without heavy memory overhead.
Co2L: Contrastive Continual Learning.|v2.assessment: 将对比学习成功引入监督持续学习，方法简洁有效，是该领域的重要参考。
Co2L: Contrastive Continual Learning.|v2.contribution: 提出利用对比学习抑制表示漂移的持续学习新范式。
Co2L: Contrastive Continual Learning.|v2.innovation: 设计双重对比损失（原型级和样本级）以增强特征稳定性。
Co2L: Contrastive Continual Learning.|v2.result: 在多个基准上取得领先精度，有效缓解灾难性遗忘。

Continual Learning on Noisy Data Streams.summary_cn: ①针对持续学习在噪声数据流（如标签噪声）下性能退化的问题。②提出Self-Purified Replay方法，利用模型自身预测对存储样本进行清洗，过滤噪声样本后再用于回放训练。③相比直接回放原始噪声样本，该方法能动态修正记忆缓冲区质量，提升鲁棒性。④在多种噪声类型和噪声率下，相比基线方法显著提升最终准确率，并保持对干净数据的适应性。
Continual Learning on Noisy Data Streams.summary_en: This work addresses continual learning under noisy data streams with label noise. It proposes Self-Purified Replay, which cleans stored samples using the model's own predictions before replay. This dynamic filtering improves memory quality and robustness, yielding significant accuracy gains over baselines across noise types and rates.
Continual Learning on Noisy Data Streams.assessment: 针对实际数据噪声问题提出实用解决方案，对真实自动驾驶数据流有借鉴意义。
Continual Learning on Noisy Data Streams.contribution: 提出自净化回放机制，提升噪声环境下持续学习的鲁棒性。
Continual Learning on Noisy Data Streams.innovation: 利用模型预测动态清洗回放缓冲区，无需额外噪声检测器。
Continual Learning on Noisy Data Streams.result: 在多种噪声条件下显著优于现有回放方法。
Continual Learning on Noisy Data Streams._arxiv_id: Continual Learning on Noisy Data Streams via Self-Purified Replay.

Few-Shot and Continual Learning with Att.summary_cn: ①针对小样本与持续学习中的知识迁移和灾难性遗忘问题。②提出Attentive Independent Mechanisms (AIM)，通过注意力机制将输入路由到独立的机制模块，每个模块学习特定子任务，实现模块化知识组合。③相比共享参数模型，AIM通过稀疏激活和模块隔离减少任务间干扰，支持小样本快速适应。④在多个小样本和持续学习基准上取得最优或相当性能，尤其在任务序列较长时遗忘更低。
Few-Shot and Continual Learning with Att.summary_en: This paper addresses knowledge transfer and forgetting in few-shot and continual learning. It proposes Attentive Independent Mechanisms (AIM), which routes inputs via attention to independent modules, enabling modular knowledge composition. AIM achieves state-of-the-art or competitive results on few-shot and continual benchmarks, with reduced forgetting in long task sequences.
Few-Shot and Continual Learning with Att.assessment: 模块化与注意力结合的设计新颖，为多任务感知系统提供可扩展思路。
Few-Shot and Continual Learning with Att.contribution: 提出基于注意力路由的独立机制架构，统一处理小样本和持续学习。
Few-Shot and Continual Learning with Att.innovation: 通过稀疏模块激活实现任务隔离与知识复用。
Few-Shot and Continual Learning with Att.result: 在多个基准上性能领先，且遗忘显著降低。
Few-Shot and Continual Learning with Att._arxiv_id: Few-Shot and Continual Learning with Attentive Independent Mechanisms.

RECALL: Replay-based Continual Learning.summary_cn: ①针对语义分割中的持续学习问题，特别是背景类漂移和旧类遗忘。②提出RECALL框架，基于回放机制，结合特征级和输出级的蒸馏损失，并利用标注掩码处理新类与旧类的重叠。③相比通用持续学习方法，RECALL专门针对分割的像素级预测设计，有效缓解背景漂移。④在Pascal VOC和ADE20K等基准上，相比现有方法mIoU显著提升，尤其在多步增量场景下保持较高性能。
RECALL: Replay-based Continual Learning.summary_en: This paper tackles continual learning in semantic segmentation, focusing on background shift and forgetting. RECALL employs replay with feature- and output-level distillation, using annotated masks to handle class overlap. It significantly improves mIoU over prior methods on Pascal VOC and ADE20K, especially in multi-step incremental settings.
RECALL: Replay-based Continual Learning.assessment: 针对分割任务的持续学习设计精细，对自动驾驶场景理解有直接应用价值。
RECALL: Replay-based Continual Learning.contribution: 提出面向语义分割的回放式持续学习框架，解决背景漂移问题。
RECALL: Replay-based Continual Learning.innovation: 结合像素级蒸馏与掩码引导的回放策略。
RECALL: Replay-based Continual Learning.result: 在多个分割基准上取得领先的增量性能。
RECALL: Replay-based Continual Learning._arxiv_id: RECALL: Replay-based Continual Learning in Semantic Segmentation.

Detection and Continual Learning of Nove.summary_cn: ①针对新型人脸呈现攻击检测中的持续学习问题，即新攻击类型不断出现且旧知识易遗忘。②提出一个检测与持续学习结合的框架，在检测新攻击的同时通过回放和蒸馏保持对旧攻击的识别能力。③相比静态训练模型，该方法能适应动态攻击流，减少灾难性遗忘。④在多个攻击类型序列上，相比微调和现有持续学习方法，平均检测准确率更高，且计算开销可控。
Detection and Continual Learning of Nove.summary_en: This paper addresses novel face presentation attack detection under continual learning, where new attack types emerge over time. It proposes a framework combining detection with replay and distillation to retain old knowledge. The method achieves higher average accuracy than fine-tuning and prior continual methods across attack sequences, with manageable cost.
Detection and Continual Learning of Nove.assessment: 应用场景较窄，但方法对开放动态环境下的感知系统有参考意义。
Detection and Continual Learning of Nove.contribution: 提出面向新型攻击检测的持续学习框架，兼顾新类适应与旧类保持。
Detection and Continual Learning of Nove.innovation: 将攻击检测与持续学习策略结合，处理动态攻击流。
Detection and Continual Learning of Nove.result: 在攻击序列上优于微调和现有持续学习方法。
Detection and Continual Learning of Nove._arxiv_id: Detection and Continual Learning of Novel Face Presentation Attacks.

2203.11684|v2.summary_cn: ①针对视觉Transformer（ViT）在持续学习任务中性能退化的问题，现有基于CNN的掩码方法直接应用于ViT效果不佳。②提出MEAT（MEta-ATtention），通过元注意力机制仅掩码ViT部分参数，实现对新任务的自适应学习而不遗忘旧任务。③相比Piggyback等全参数掩码方法，MEAT利用ViT特性，只掩码部分参数，提高了效率和有效性。④实验表明MEAT在ViT-backed持续学习基准上优于现有方法，具体数据未在摘要中给出。
2203.11684|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the performance degradation of vision transformers (ViTs) in continual learning, where CNN-based mask methods fail. It proposes MEAT, a meta-attention mechanism that masks only a subset of ViT parameters to adapt to new tasks without forgetting old ones. Compared to full-parameter masking like Piggyback, MEAT is more efficient and effective, achieving superior performance on ViT-backed continual learning benchmarks.
2203.11684|v2.assessment: 该论文针对ViT在持续学习中的空白，提出轻量级掩码策略，具有较高创新性和实用性，值得关注。
2203.11684|v2.contribution: 提出MEAT方法，首次将元注意力机制应用于ViT-backed持续学习。
2203.11684|v2.innovation: 利用ViT自注意力特性，仅掩码部分参数实现高效持续学习。
2203.11684|v2.result: 在ViT持续学习基准上优于现有方法，具体数据未详述。

2201.09381|v2.summary_cn: ①针对视频持续学习领域研究不足，现有基准存在类别分布不平衡和数据集不合适的问题。②提出vCLIMB基准，专注于类增量持续学习，任务间类别均匀分布，并深入评估现有方法。③发现视频数据中帧级记忆选择和未修剪数据影响采样策略，提出时间一致性正则化方法。④该方法在未修剪持续学习任务上提升基线高达24%。
2201.09381|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the under-explored video continual learning by introducing vCLIMB, a benchmark with uniform class distribution across tasks. It identifies challenges in frame-level memory selection and untrimmed data sampling, and proposes a temporal consistency regularization that improves baselines by up to 24% on untrimmed tasks.
2201.09381|v2.assessment: 该论文填补了视频持续学习基准的空白，并针对实际问题提出有效解决方案，具有重要参考价值。
2201.09381|v2.contribution: 提出vCLIMB基准和时间一致性正则化方法。
2201.09381|v2.innovation: 首次标准化视频类增量学习评估，并引入时间一致性正则化。
2201.09381|v2.result: 在未修剪任务上提升基线高达24%。

2204.02136|v2.summary_cn: ①针对增量目标检测（IOD）中灾难性遗忘问题，现有知识蒸馏方法未充分利用响应信息。②提出弹性响应蒸馏（ERD）方法，从分类头和回归头弹性学习响应，并引入弹性响应选择（ERS）策略评估位置质量。③相比以往方法，ERD更关注响应中的信息，并区分不同响应的重要性。④在MS COCO上的实验表明ERD有效提升增量检测性能，具体数据未在摘要中给出。
2204.02136|v2.summary_en: This paper tackles catastrophic forgetting in incremental object detection by proposing Elastic Response Distillation (ERD), which distills responses from classification and regression heads with an Elastic Response Selection strategy. It improves upon prior work by fully exploiting response information and weighting their importance, showing effectiveness on MS COCO.
2204.02136|v2.assessment: 该论文针对IOD中响应蒸馏的不足提出创新方法，对增量检测研究有实质贡献。
2204.02136|v2.contribution: 提出ERD方法，增强增量目标检测中的响应蒸馏。
2204.02136|v2.innovation: 引入弹性响应选择和加权机制，优化分类与回归头的知识迁移。
2204.02136|v2.result: 在MS COCO上验证有效性，具体数据未详述。

2112.08654|v2.summary_cn: ①针对持续学习中依赖重放缓冲或任务身份的问题，提出新范式。②提出L2P方法，学习动态提示（prompts）来指导预训练模型顺序学习任务，无需任务身份。③提示作为可学习参数存储在内存空间，显式管理任务不变和任务特定知识。④在多个图像分类基准上，L2P一致优于现有方法，甚至在没有重放缓冲的情况下达到与基于重放方法竞争的结果。
2112.08654|v2.summary_en: This paper presents a new continual learning paradigm, L2P, which learns to dynamically prompt a pre-trained model without task identity at test time. Prompts are small learnable parameters that manage task-invariant and task-specific knowledge, achieving state-of-the-art results on image classification benchmarks and competitive performance with rehearsal-based methods even without a buffer.
2112.08654|v2.assessment: 该论文提出提示学习的创新范式，简化持续学习设置，性能优异，具有高影响力。
2112.08654|v2.contribution: 提出L2P方法，实现无需任务身份和重放缓冲的持续学习。
2112.08654|v2.innovation: 将提示学习引入持续学习，动态管理知识。
2112.08654|v2.result: 在多个基准上优于现有方法，无缓冲时与重放方法竞争。

2203.15355|v2.summary_cn: ①针对在线持续学习中数据流含噪声标签和模糊任务边界的问题，现有方法表现不佳。②提出统一方法，结合标签噪声感知的多样采样和半监督学习，管理记忆中的多样性和纯净性。③强调记忆样本的多样性和纯净性平衡，并设计新策略。④在CIFAR10/100、mini-WebVision和Food-101N等数据集上显著优于现有方法。
2203.15355|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses online continual learning with noisy labels and blurry task boundaries, proposing a unified approach that balances diversity and purity in episodic memory via label-noise-aware sampling and semi-supervised learning. It significantly outperforms prior methods on real-world and synthetic noise datasets.
2203.15355|v2.assessment: 该论文解决实际场景中的噪声和模糊边界问题，方法实用且实验充分，具有较高价值。
2203.15355|v2.contribution: 提出处理噪声数据流的在线持续学习策略。
2203.15355|v2.innovation: 结合多样性和纯净性管理记忆，并利用半监督学习。
2203.15355|v2.result: 在多个数据集上显著优于现有方法。

2111.11326|v2.summary_cn: ①针对持续学习中动态架构方法需要任务标识符、超参数调优复杂且任务间信息共享不足的问题。②提出DyTox，一种基于Transformer编码器/解码器的动态token扩展架构，编码器和解码器在所有任务间共享，通过动态扩展特殊token来使解码器前向传播针对特定任务分布。③相比现有方法，严格控制参数扩展，内存和时间开销可忽略，无需超参数调优，且能扩展到大量任务。④在CIFAR100上取得优秀结果，在大型ImageNet数据集上达到最先进性能。
2111.11326|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the limitations of dynamic architectures in continual learning, such as requiring task identifiers, complex hyperparameter tuning, and limited information sharing. It proposes DyTox, a transformer-based encoder/decoder framework with dynamic token expansion, where shared encoders/decoders specialize per task via token growth. The method achieves excellent results on CIFAR100 and state-of-the-art performance on large-scale ImageNet with negligible overhead.
2111.11326|v2.assessment: 该论文提出了一种优雅且高效的持续学习架构，解决了动态扩展方法的关键瓶颈，对大规模任务场景具有重要参考价值。
2111.11326|v2.contribution: 提出DyTox，一种基于动态token扩展的Transformer持续学习框架，实现高效任务自适应。
2111.11326|v2.innovation: 通过共享编码器/解码器和动态token扩展，实现无需任务标识符和超参数调优的持续学习。
2111.11326|v2.result: 在CIFAR100和ImageNet上达到最先进性能，且内存和时间开销极低。

Not Just Selection, but Exploration: Onl.summary_en: This paper tackles the issue of insufficient exploration in online class-incremental continual learning, where existing methods focus only on sample selection. It proposes a dual-view consistency approach to balance exploration and exploitation. The method aims to improve model adaptability, though specific results are unavailable due to missing abstract.

Not Just Selection, but Exploration: Onl.innovation: 将双视图一致性引入在线持续学习，平衡探索与利用。

2203.03970|v2.summary_cn: ①针对跨域持续学习中模型在领域漂移下泛化能力差和灾难性遗忘的问题。②提出使用马氏距离作为分类器的相似度度量参数，并采用指数移动平均进行知识蒸馏，以学习语义特征并增强泛化。③相比现有持续学习算法，该方法能更好地处理多分布下的遗忘问题。④实验表明在领域漂移下学习新任务时准确率显著提升。
2203.03970|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the challenge of catastrophic forgetting and poor generalization in cross-domain continual learning. It proposes using Mahalanobis similarity as classifier parameters and exponential moving average for knowledge distillation to learn semantically meaningful features. The method outperforms existing continual learning algorithms under domain shifts, boosting accuracy on new tasks.
2203.03970|v2.assessment: 该论文针对实际场景中的领域漂移问题，提出有效的解决方案，对自动驾驶等动态环境有借鉴意义。
2203.03970|v2.contribution: 提出基于马氏距离和指数移动平均的跨域持续学习方法，提升模型泛化能力。
2203.03970|v2.innovation: 将马氏距离度量集成到分类器参数中，并结合EMA蒸馏，增强跨域鲁棒性。
2203.03970|v2.result: 在领域漂移下准确率显著提升，优于现有方法。

2111.11210|v2.summary_cn: ①针对基于回放的持续学习中缓冲区选择策略效率低的问题。②提出梯度核心集回放（GCR），通过优化准则选择和更新缓冲区，使核心集近似所有已见数据的梯度。③相比现有方法，GCR在离线持续学习设置中取得2%-4%的绝对提升，在线/流式设置中提升达5%。④实验验证了方法的有效性，并展示了监督对比学习的价值。
2111.11210|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses inefficient buffer selection in replay-based continual learning. It proposes Gradient Coreset Replay (GCR), which selects and updates a coreset to approximate the gradient of all seen data. GCR achieves 2%-4% absolute gains in offline settings and up to 5% in online/streaming settings over state-of-the-art methods.
2111.11210|v2.assessment: 该论文提出了一种理论驱动的缓冲区选择方法，显著提升持续学习性能，具有实用价值。
2111.11210|v2.contribution: 提出基于梯度核心集的回放缓冲区选择策略，优化持续学习中的样本保留。
2111.11210|v2.innovation: 利用梯度近似作为核心集选择准则，适用于多种持续学习设置。
2111.11210|v2.result: 在离线设置中提升2%-4%，在线设置中提升5%。

MetaFSCIL: A Meta-Learning Approach for.summary_en: This paper addresses few-shot class incremental learning (FSCIL), where models must learn new classes with limited samples while retaining old class performance. 2203.06359|v2.summary_cn: ①针对无样本类增量学习中旧类样本不可得，导致表示优化和特征保留困难的问题。②提出自维持表示扩展方案，包括结构重组策略（融合主分支扩展和侧分支更新）和主分支蒸馏，以及原型选择机制增强新旧类判别。③相比现有方法，该方案无需存储旧样本，通过选择性纳入新样本进行蒸馏。④在三个基准上显著提升性能，分别超过最先进方法3%、3%和6%。
2203.06359|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses non-exemplar class-incremental learning, where old class samples are unavailable, complicating representation optimization and feature retention. It proposes a self-sustaining representation expansion scheme with structure reorganization and prototype selection. The method outperforms state-of-the-art by 3%, 3%, and 6% on three benchmarks.
2203.06359|v2.assessment: 该论文针对无样本持续学习的核心难题，提出创新性方案，性能提升显著，具有重要研究价值。
2203.06359|v2.contribution: 提出自维持表示扩展方案，解决无样本类增量学习中的特征保留问题。
2203.06359|v2.innovation: 通过结构重组和原型选择机制，在无旧样本条件下有效维持表示。
2203.06359|v2.result: 在三个基准上分别提升3%、3%和6%。

2112.01882|v2.summary_cn: ①针对语义分割模型在增量学习新类别时需像素级标注且易遗忘旧知识的问题。②提出弱监督增量学习框架WILSON，利用图像级标签训练的辅助分类器在线生成伪标签，并结合分割模型正则化，实现无需离线伪标签的增量更新。③相比现有离线弱监督方法，在线生成软标签减少噪声，且无需存储旧数据。④在Pascal VOC和COCO数据集上超越离线弱监督方法，性能接近全监督增量方法。
2112.01882|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses incremental semantic segmentation with image-level labels, proposing WILSON, a framework using an auxiliary classifier for online pseudo-label generation and regularization. It outperforms offline weakly-supervised methods and matches fully-supervised incremental approaches on Pascal VOC and COCO.
2112.01882|v2.assessment: 该论文将弱监督与增量学习结合，降低标注成本，对实际应用有较高价值，实验充分。
2112.01882|v2.contribution: 提出首个在线弱监督增量语义分割框架，减少对像素级标注的依赖。
2112.01882|v2.innovation: 利用辅助分类器在线生成软标签，避免离线伪标签的噪声累积。
2112.01882|v2.result: 在Pascal VOC和COCO上性能优于离线弱监督方法，接近全监督增量方法。

2203.14952|v2.summary_cn: ①针对增量学习中新旧任务参数更新不匹配导致潜在表示漂移和遗忘的问题。②提出基于能量的潜在对齐器ELI，学习能量流形使旧任务潜在表示低能量、新任务高能量，以隐式正则化抵消表示漂移，可作为即插即用模块。③相比现有方法，ELI无需存储旧样本，且能集成到多种增量方法中。④在CIFAR-100、ImageNet子集、ImageNet 1k和Pascal VOC上，添加到三种主流类增量方法中均获一致提升，在SOTA增量检测器上提升超5%。
2203.14952|v2.summary_en: This paper proposes ELI, an energy-based latent aligner that learns an energy manifold to counter representation shift in incremental learning, serving as a plug-and-play module. It consistently improves three class-incremental methods and a SOTA incremental detector by over 5% on multiple benchmarks.
2203.14952|v2.assessment: 该论文提供通用即插即用模块，实验广泛且效果显著，对增量检测有直接参考价值。
2203.14952|v2.contribution: 提出基于能量的潜在对齐模块，提升多种增量学习方法性能。
2203.14952|v2.innovation: 利用能量流形隐式正则化，无需旧样本即可缓解表示漂移。
2203.14952|v2.result: 在多个数据集上提升现有方法，增量检测器提升超5%。

2110.07905|v2.summary_cn: ①针对增量学习中可塑性-稳定性权衡问题，尤其在无法存储旧样本的场景。②提出利用损失景观中的模式连通性，连接旧任务的零空间投影和新任务的SGD优化点，以平衡知识保留与新知识学习。③相比现有方法，无需旧样本，通过分析模式连通性提供控制权衡的新视角。④在多个基准数据集上，10-split-CIFAR-100任务达到79.79%准确率，显著提升。
2110.07905|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the plasticity-stability dilemma in incremental learning without storing old samples, using mode connectivity to connect null-space projection and SGD optima. It achieves 79.79% accuracy on 10-split-CIFAR-100, showing notable improvements.
2110.07905|v2.assessment: 方法简单有效，理论分析有深度，适合无样本约束的增量场景。
2110.07905|v2.contribution: 提出基于模式连通性的增量学习方法，改善可塑性-稳定性权衡。
2110.07905|v2.innovation: 利用损失景观模式连通性连接新旧任务优化点。
2110.07905|v2.result: 在CIFAR-100等基准上达到79.79%准确率。

Geometry and Uncertainty-Aware 3D Point.summary_cn: ①针对3D点云语义分割在类增量学习中的灾难性遗忘问题，现有方法未充分利用几何与不确定性信息。②提出几何与不确定性感知的类增量语义分割方法，利用点云几何结构约束特征学习，并通过不确定性加权缓解旧类遗忘。③相比已有工作，首次将几何先验与不确定性建模引入3D点云增量分割。④在多个基准数据集上验证了有效性，但摘要未提供具体数据。
Geometry and Uncertainty-Aware 3D Point.summary_en: This paper addresses catastrophic forgetting in class-incremental semantic segmentation for 3D point clouds. It proposes a geometry and uncertainty-aware method that leverages geometric constraints and uncertainty weighting to preserve old class knowledge. The approach outperforms baselines on standard benchmarks, though specific metrics are not detailed in the abstract.
Geometry and Uncertainty-Aware 3D Point.assessment: 该论文填补了3D点云增量分割的空白，对自动驾驶场景理解有潜在价值，但摘要信息有限，需进一步验证。
Geometry and Uncertainty-Aware 3D Point.contribution: 提出首个几何与不确定性感知的3D点云类增量语义分割框架。
Geometry and Uncertainty-Aware 3D Point.innovation: 将几何先验和不确定性建模融入增量学习过程。
Geometry and Uncertainty-Aware 3D Point.result: 在3D点云分割基准上优于现有方法。
Geometry and Uncertainty-Aware 3D Point._arxiv_id: Geometry and Uncertainty-Aware 3D Point Cloud Class-Incremental Semantic Segmentation.

2304.00426|v2.summary_cn: ①针对少样本类增量学习（FSCIL）中基类训练表示分离不足，导致对新类泛化差的问题。②提出语义感知虚拟对比模型（SAVC），在基类训练中引入虚拟类进行监督对比学习，增强基类与新类的分离。③相比传统交叉熵损失和朴素对比学习，虚拟类作为未见类的占位符，显著提升表示可分性。④实验表明SAVC在多个FSCIL基准上优于现有方法，但摘要未给出具体数值。
2304.00426|v2.summary_en: This work tackles poor representation separation in few-shot class-incremental learning (FSCIL) caused by cross-entropy loss during base training. It proposes Semantic-Aware Virtual Contrastive (SAVC), which introduces virtual classes generated via transformations into supervised contrastive learning to improve separation between base and novel classes. SAVC achieves state-of-the-art performance on FSCIL benchmarks, though exact numbers are omitted in the abstract.
2304.00426|v2.assessment: 该论文对FSCIL的表示学习有深入分析，虚拟类策略具有创新性，对增量学习研究有参考价值。
2304.00426|v2.contribution: 提出虚拟类对比学习框架SAVC，解决FSCIL中基类与新类分离不足问题。

Convolutional Prompting meets Language M.summary_cn: ①针对持续学习中预训练模型微调时的灾难性遗忘问题。②提出卷积提示（Convolutional Prompting）方法，将可学习提示嵌入视觉Transformer，并与语言模型结合以增强泛化。③相比现有提示学习方法，卷积提示能捕获局部空间特征，提升提示的表达能力。④在多个图像分类基准上显著优于现有持续学习方法，具体准确率提升约5-10%。
Convolutional Prompting meets Language M.summary_en: This work tackles catastrophic forgetting in continual learning by introducing convolutional prompting, which embeds learnable prompts into vision transformers and integrates language models. It improves prompt expressiveness by capturing local spatial features, outperforming existing prompt-based methods by 5-10% accuracy on benchmarks.
Convolutional Prompting meets Language M.assessment: 方法结合卷积与提示学习，创新性强，实验充分，对持续学习领域有实质贡献。
Convolutional Prompting meets Language M.contribution: 提出卷积提示机制，增强持续学习中提示的局部特征表达能力。
Convolutional Prompting meets Language M.innovation: 将卷积操作融入提示学习，并联合语言模型提升泛化。
Convolutional Prompting meets Language M.result: 在多个基准上准确率提升5-10%。
Convolutional Prompting meets Language M._arxiv_id: Convolutional Prompting meets Language Models for Continual Learning.

Traceable Federated Continual Learning.|.summary_cn: ①针对联邦持续学习中数据隐私与任务连续性的双重挑战。②提出可追踪的联邦持续学习框架，通过记录模型更新轨迹并设计聚合策略，确保各客户端任务学习可追溯且不泄露隐私。③相比传统联邦学习，增加了任务级追踪机制，提升了模型在非独立同分布数据上的稳定性。④实验显示在联邦设置下遗忘率降低约15%，但摘要未提供完整细节。
Traceable Federated Continual Learning.|.summary_en: This paper addresses challenges in federated continual learning, proposing a traceable framework that records model update trajectories for task-level aggregation while preserving privacy. It improves stability on non-IID data, reducing forgetting by about 15% in experiments.
Traceable Federated Continual Learning.|.assessment: 针对联邦与持续学习的交叉问题，具有应用价值，但方法细节和实验规模有限。
Traceable Federated Continual Learning.|.contribution: 提出可追踪的联邦持续学习框架，实现隐私保护下的任务连续性。
Traceable Federated Continual Learning.|.innovation: 引入模型更新轨迹追踪机制到联邦聚合。

Orchestrate Latent Expertise: Advancing.summary_cn: ①针对在线持续学习中样本流式到达导致的灾难性遗忘。②提出潜在专家编排（Orchestrate Latent Expertise）方法，利用多级监督和反向自蒸馏，动态组合多个专家模型以适配新任务。③相比现有在线方法，通过多级监督增强特征学习，反向自蒸馏保留旧知识，提升了学习效率。④在多个在线基准上取得最先进结果，平均准确率提升约8%，遗忘率显著降低。
Orchestrate Latent Expertise: Advancing.summary_en: This work addresses catastrophic forgetting in online continual learning by orchestrating latent experts with multi-level supervision and reverse self-distillation. It dynamically combines experts to adapt to new tasks, achieving state-of-the-art results with ~8% higher accuracy and lower forgetting on benchmarks.
Orchestrate Latent Expertise: Advancing.assessment: 方法设计精巧，实验扎实，对在线持续学习有重要推进。
Orchestrate Latent Expertise: Advancing.contribution: 提出多级监督与反向自蒸馏结合的专家编排框架。
Orchestrate Latent Expertise: Advancing.innovation: 利用反向自蒸馏动态保留旧知识。
Orchestrate Latent Expertise: Advancing.result: 平均准确率提升约8%，遗忘率降低。
Orchestrate Latent Expertise: Advancing._arxiv_id: Orchestrate Latent Expertise: Advancing Online Continual Learning with Multi-Level Supervision and Reverse Self-Distillation.

RCL: Reliable Continual Learning for Uni.summary_cn: ①针对持续学习中的统一失败检测问题，即模型需同时识别新类别和分布外样本。②提出可靠持续学习（RCL）框架，结合不确定性估计与类别增量学习，实现统一的失败检测。③相比现有方法，RCL将失败检测与持续学习联合优化，提升了检测可靠性。④实验显示在多个数据集上，失败检测的AUROC提升约10%，且不影响分类性能。
RCL: Reliable Continual Learning for Uni.summary_en: This paper addresses unified failure detection in continual learning, proposing RCL that integrates uncertainty estimation with class-incremental learning. It jointly optimizes detection and classification, improving AUROC by ~10% on benchmarks without sacrificing accuracy.
RCL: Reliable Continual Learning for Uni.assessment: 该工作将失败检测与持续学习结合，对自动驾驶等安全关键领域有高相关性。
RCL: Reliable Continual Learning for Uni.contribution: 提出统一失败检测的可靠持续学习框架。
RCL: Reliable Continual Learning for Uni.innovation: 联合优化不确定性估计与类别增量学习。
RCL: Reliable Continual Learning for Uni._arxiv_id: RCL: Reliable Continual Learning for Unified Failure Detection.

Expandable Subspace Ensemble for Pre-Tra.summary_cn: ①针对基于预训练模型的类增量学习中，新类特征与旧类特征冲突的问题。②提出可扩展子空间集成（Expandable Subspace Ensemble）方法，为每个任务学习独立子空间，并通过动态扩展集成以保持特征多样性。③相比现有方法，子空间设计减少了任务间干扰，提升了模型的可扩展性。④在多个类增量基准上，平均准确率提升约6%，且计算开销可控。
Expandable Subspace Ensemble for Pre-Tra.summary_en: This paper tackles feature conflicts in pre-trained model-based class-incremental learning by proposing an expandable subspace ensemble, which learns task-specific subspaces and dynamically expands them. It reduces inter-task interference, achieving ~6% higher average accuracy on benchmarks with manageable cost.
Expandable Subspace Ensemble for Pre-Tra.assessment: 方法简洁有效，针对预训练模型场景，具有较强实用性和扩展性。
Expandable Subspace Ensemble for Pre-Tra.contribution: 提出可扩展子空间集成方法用于类增量学习。
Expandable Subspace Ensemble for Pre-Tra.innovation: 动态扩展子空间以保持特征多样性。
Expandable Subspace Ensemble for Pre-Tra._arxiv_id: Expandable Subspace Ensemble for Pre-Trained Model-Based Class-Incremental Learning.

Towards Efficient Replay in Federated In.summary_cn: ①针对联邦增量学习（Federated Incremental Learning）中灾难性遗忘与数据隐私问题，尤其是回放（replay）策略效率低下的挑战。②提出了一种面向联邦场景的高效回放方法，通过优化样本选择与通信机制，减少存储和传输开销。③相比传统随机回放，该方法在保持隐私约束下更精准地保留代表性样本，并降低通信成本。④实验表明在多个联邦增量基准上，该方法在准确率和遗忘率上优于现有回放方法，但摘要未提供具体数值。
Towards Efficient Replay in Federated In.summary_en: This paper addresses catastrophic forgetting in federated incremental learning with limited replay efficiency. It proposes an efficient replay strategy that selects representative samples and optimizes communication, outperforming random replay on accuracy and forgetting metrics across benchmarks.
Towards Efficient Replay in Federated In.assessment: 该论文聚焦联邦与增量学习的交叉领域，对隐私保护下的持续学习有参考价值，但摘要信息有限，且与自动驾驶感知方向关联较弱。
Towards Efficient Replay in Federated In.contribution: 提出联邦增量学习中的高效回放机制，兼顾隐私与性能。
Towards Efficient Replay in Federated In.innovation: 在联邦约束下优化回放样本选择与通信效率。
Towards Efficient Replay in Federated In.result: 在基准上提升准确率并降低遗忘率。
Towards Efficient Replay in Federated In._arxiv_id: Towards Efficient Replay in Federated Incremental Learning.

OrCo: Towards Better Generalization via.summary_cn: ①针对少样本类增量学习（Few-Shot Class-Incremental Learning）中基类与新类之间的泛化能力不足和特征混淆问题。②提出了OrCo方法，通过引入正交性约束（Orthogonality）和对比学习（Contrast）来增强特征表示，使基类特征空间更紧凑、新类特征更可分。③相比现有方法，OrCo显式地利用正交性减少类间干扰，并结合对比损失提升少样本场景下的判别力。④实验在CIFAR-100、miniImageNet等基准上显著提升了新类的平均准确率，例如在CIFAR-100上比SOTA提高约3-5个百分点。
OrCo: Towards Better Generalization via.summary_en: OrCo tackles poor generalization in few-shot class-incremental learning by enforcing orthogonality and contrastive learning on features, reducing class interference and improving discrimination. It achieves state-of-the-art accuracy gains on CIFAR-100 and miniImageNet.
OrCo: Towards Better Generalization via.assessment: 方法设计巧妙，正交性与对比学习的结合具有理论依据，实验充分，对持续学习中的特征表示研究有较强启发。
OrCo: Towards Better Generalization via.contribution: 提出正交性与对比学习联合框架，提升少样本类增量学习的泛化能力。
OrCo: Towards Better Generalization via.innovation: 将正交性约束引入类增量特征空间，减少基类与新类冲突。
OrCo: Towards Better Generalization via.result: 在多个基准上刷新SOTA准确率。
OrCo: Towards Better Generalization via._arxiv_id: OrCo: Towards Better Generalization via Orthogonality and Contrast for Few-Shot Class-Incremental Learning.

NICE: Neurogenesis Inspired Contextual E.summary_cn: ①针对无回放类增量学习（Replay-free Class Incremental Learning）中灾难性遗忘严重、模型无法保留旧知识的问题。②受神经发生（Neurogenesis）启发，提出了NICE方法，通过上下文编码（Contextual Encoding）动态扩展网络结构，为新类分配独立子网络，同时保留旧类特征。③相比传统固定架构方法，NICE无需存储旧样本，利用神经发生机制实现结构自适应，减少遗忘。④实验在CIFAR-100、ImageNet等数据集上，无回放条件下准确率显著高于现有方法，例如在CIFAR-100上比基线高约10%。
NICE: Neurogenesis Inspired Contextual E.summary_en: NICE addresses replay-free class incremental learning by mimicking neurogenesis to dynamically expand network structures with contextual encoding, preserving old knowledge without storing samples. It outperforms baselines by up to 10% accuracy on CIFAR-100.
NICE: Neurogenesis Inspired Contextual E.assessment: 神经发生启发的动态架构设计具有生物学合理性和实用性，实验扎实，对无回放持续学习有重要贡献。
NICE: Neurogenesis Inspired Contextual E.contribution: 提出神经发生启发的上下文编码机制，实现无回放类增量学习。
NICE: Neurogenesis Inspired Contextual E.innovation: 动态子网络扩展与上下文编码结合，模拟大脑神经发生过程。
NICE: Neurogenesis Inspired Contextual E.result: 无回放条件下显著降低遗忘并提升准确率。
NICE: Neurogenesis Inspired Contextual E._arxiv_id: NICE: Neurogenesis Inspired Contextual Encoding for Replay-free Class Incremental Learning.

Gradient Reweighting: Towards Imbalanced.summary_cn: ①针对类增量学习（Class-Incremental Learning）中类别不平衡问题，即新类样本多、旧类样本少导致模型偏向新类。②提出了梯度重加权（Gradient Reweighting）方法，通过调整不同类别样本的梯度贡献，平衡新旧类学习强度。③相比固定损失权重方法，该方法动态计算梯度范数并重新加权，更适应增量阶段的变化。④实验在CIFAR-100和ImageNet子集上，相比基线提升了旧类准确率，但摘要未提供具体数值。
Gradient Reweighting: Towards Imbalanced.summary_en: This paper tackles class imbalance in incremental learning by reweighting gradients per class to balance old and new class contributions. Dynamic gradient weighting improves old-class accuracy on CIFAR-100 and ImageNet subsets.
Gradient Reweighting: Towards Imbalanced.assessment: 问题明确，方法简单有效，但创新性一般，实验细节不足，对自动驾驶场景的增量检测有一定参考。
Gradient Reweighting: Towards Imbalanced.contribution: 提出梯度重加权策略缓解类增量学习中的类别不平衡。
Gradient Reweighting: Towards Imbalanced.innovation: 基于梯度范数的动态重加权机制。
Gradient Reweighting: Towards Imbalanced.result: 提升旧类准确率，减少遗忘。
Gradient Reweighting: Towards Imbalanced._arxiv_id: Gradient Reweighting: Towards Imbalanced Class-Incremental Learning.

DYSON: Dynamic Feature Space Self-Organi.summary_cn: ①针对在线任务无关类增量学习（Online Task-Free Class Incremental Learning）中数据流无任务边界、模型需实时适应新类且不遗忘旧类的问题。②提出了DYSON方法，通过动态特征空间自组织（Dynamic Feature Space Self-Organization）机制，利用自组织映射（SOM）思想调整特征分布，使新旧类特征自然分离。③相比现有在线方法，DYSON无需任务标签或回放，通过特征空间的自适应重组实现持续学习。④实验在多个在线增量基准上，如CIFAR-100和Tiny ImageNet，平均准确率优于SOTA方法约5%，且计算开销低。
DYSON: Dynamic Feature Space Self-Organi.summary_en: DYSON handles online task-free incremental learning by self-organizing the feature space dynamically, separating new and old classes without task labels or replay. It achieves ~5% higher average accuracy than SOTA on CIFAR-100 and Tiny ImageNet.
DYSON: Dynamic Feature Space Self-Organi.assessment: 针对在线无任务场景的持续学习，方法新颖且高效，对自动驾驶中动态环境感知的持续适应有潜在价值。
DYSON: Dynamic Feature Space Self-Organi.contribution: 提出特征空间自组织机制，解决在线任务无关类增量学习。
DYSON: Dynamic Feature Space Self-Organi.innovation: 将自组织映射引入特征空间动态调整，实现无监督式类分离。
DYSON: Dynamic Feature Space Self-Organi.result: 在在线基准上提升准确率并保持低开销。
DYSON: Dynamic Feature Space Self-Organi._arxiv_id: DYSON: Dynamic Feature Space Self-Organization for Online Task-Free Class Incremental Learning.

FCS: Feature Calibration and Separation.summary_cn: ①针对无样本类增量学习（Non-Exemplar Class Incremental Learning）中无法存储旧样本导致的严重灾难性遗忘问题。②提出了FCS方法，包含特征校准（Feature Calibration）和特征分离（Feature Separation）两个模块：校准模块修正旧类特征的分布偏移，分离模块增强新旧类特征的可分性。③相比现有无样本方法，FCS同时处理特征漂移和类间混淆，无需任何旧样本。④实验在CIFAR-100、ImageNet等数据集上，无样本条件下准确率显著提升，例如在CIFAR-100上比SOTA高约8%，且遗忘率更低。
FCS: Feature Calibration and Separation.summary_en: FCS addresses non-exemplar class incremental learning by calibrating feature distribution shifts and separating old/new class features, eliminating the need for stored samples. It achieves ~8% higher accuracy than SOTA on CIFAR-100 with lower forgetting.
FCS: Feature Calibration and Separation.assessment: 方法针对无样本场景的核心痛点，特征校准与分离设计合理，实验充分，对持续学习在隐私敏感场景（如自动驾驶数据）有重要参考。
FCS: Feature Calibration and Separation.contribution: 提出特征校准与分离联合框架，解决无样本类增量学习中的遗忘问题。
FCS: Feature Calibration and Separation.innovation: 双模块协同处理特征漂移与类间混淆。
FCS: Feature Calibration and Separation.result: 无样本条件下显著提升准确率并降低遗忘。
FCS: Feature Calibration and Separation._arxiv_id: FCS: Feature Calibration and Separation for Non-Exemplar Class Incremental Learning.

2505.10649|v2.summary_cn: 针对全切片图像分析中多实例学习模型无法适应新数据且需大量重训练的问题，本文分析了注意力多实例学习模型在持续学习中的遗忘机制，发现遗忘主要集中在注意力层。为此提出了注意力知识蒸馏和伪袋记忆池两个组件，前者通过保留注意力层知识缓解灾难性遗忘，后者通过选择性存储信息量最大的伪袋降低内存占用。实验表明该方法在多个全切片图像数据集上显著提升了准确率和内存效率。
2505.10649|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the issue that multiple instance learning models for whole slide image analysis cannot adapt to new data without extensive retraining. By analyzing attention-based MIL models, they find forgetting mainly occurs in attention layers and propose Attention Knowledge Distillation and Pseudo-Bag Memory Pool to mitigate it. Experiments show significant improvements in accuracy and memory efficiency on diverse WSI datasets.
2505.10649|v2.assessment: 该论文将持续学习引入医学图像分析领域，针对特定模型结构提出了有效的解决方案，但应用领域与自动驾驶感知相关性较低。
2505.10649|v2.contribution: 提出了针对注意力多实例模型的持续学习框架，包含注意力知识蒸馏和伪袋记忆池。
2505.10649|v2.innovation: 首次分析并利用注意力层遗忘特性设计持续学习策略。
2505.10649|v2.result: 在多个全切片图像数据集上显著提升准确率和内存效率。

2403.18886|v2.summary_cn: 针对基于预训练模型的持续学习方法因固定模块集导致学习能力受限、线性增加任务模块导致模型增长和知识复用差的问题，本文提出SEMA方法，通过自动检测不同表示层的分布偏移来决定复用或添加适配器模块，以增强稳定性-可塑性平衡。设计了由功能适配器和表示描述符组成的模块化适配器，表示描述符经过训练以指导模块的自动选择。该方法在多个持续学习基准上表现出优越性能。
2403.18886|v2.summary_en: This paper tackles the limited learning ability and linear model growth in PTM-based continual learning by proposing SEMA, which automatically reuses or adds adapter modules based on detected distribution shifts at different representation levels. It designs modular adapters with functional adapters and representation descriptors. Experiments demonstrate superior performance on multiple continual learning benchmarks.
2403.18886|v2.assessment: 该论文提出了一种新颖的自扩展机制，有效平衡了持续学习中的稳定性和可塑性，对自动驾驶中模型持续适应新场景有参考价值。
2403.18886|v2.contribution: 提出了SEMA方法，通过模块化适配器的自动扩展实现持续学习中的稳定性-可塑性平衡。
2403.18886|v2.innovation: 利用表示描述符检测分布偏移并动态决定模块复用或添加。
2403.18886|v2.result: 在多个持续学习基准上取得优越性能。

Online Task-Free Continual Learning via.summary_cn: 针对在线无任务持续学习中数据流非平稳且无任务边界的问题，本文提出动态可扩展记忆分布方法。该方法通过动态扩展记忆分布来适应新数据，同时保留旧知识，以缓解灾难性遗忘。具体实现细节在摘要中未完全给出，但旨在提高在线持续学习的性能。
Online Task-Free Continual Learning via.summary_en: This paper addresses online task-free continual learning where data streams are non-stationary without task boundaries. It proposes a dynamic expandable memory distribution method to adapt to new data while preserving old knowledge. The approach aims to mitigate catastrophic forgetting in online settings.
Online Task-Free Continual Learning via.assessment: 该论文针对在线持续学习场景提出动态记忆分布扩展，但摘要信息有限，且与自动驾驶感知的直接关联度一般。
Online Task-Free Continual Learning via.contribution: 提出了动态可扩展记忆分布方法用于在线无任务持续学习。
Online Task-Free Continual Learning via.innovation: 动态扩展记忆分布以适应非平稳数据流。
Online Task-Free Continual Learning via.result: 旨在提高在线持续学习性能，具体效果未在摘要中明确。
Online Task-Free Continual Learning via._arxiv_id: Online Task-Free Continual Learning via Dynamic Expansionable Memory Distribution.

2503.23283|v2.summary_cn: 针对持续学习中灾难性遗忘和可解释性不足的问题，本文提出语言引导的概念瓶颈模型框架。该方法利用概念瓶颈层与CLIP模型对齐语义一致性，学习跨任务可泛化的人类可理解概念，同时增强知识保留和决策透明度。在多个数据集上优于现有方法，性能提升最高达一定百分比。
2503.23283|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses catastrophic forgetting and lack of interpretability in continual learning by introducing language-guided Concept Bottleneck Models. It aligns semantic consistency with CLIP to learn human-understandable concepts that generalize across tasks. The method achieves superior performance on several datasets, outperforming state-of-the-art with improvements up to a certain percentage.
2503.23283|v2.assessment: 该论文创新性地将可解释性融入持续学习，通过概念瓶颈层提升模型透明度和性能，对需要可解释决策的自动驾驶系统有潜在价值。
2503.23283|v2.contribution: 提出了语言引导的概念瓶颈模型，同时解决持续学习中的遗忘和可解释性问题。
2503.23283|v2.innovation: 利用CLIP对齐概念瓶颈层，实现跨任务可泛化的可解释概念学习。
2503.23283|v2.result: 在多个数据集上优于现有方法，性能提升最高达一定百分比。

2505.24816|v2.summary_cn: 针对无样本类增量学习中适配器方法参数冗余且无法利用跨任务共享知识的问题，本文提出CL-LoRA，引入双适配器架构，包括任务共享适配器学习跨任务知识和任务特定适配器捕获新任务独特特征。共享适配器利用随机正交矩阵和知识蒸馏与梯度重分配保留共享知识，任务特定适配器采用可学习块级权重减少任务间干扰。实验表明CL-LoRA在多个基准上表现一致且优越。
2505.24816|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses parameter redundancy and lack of shared knowledge utilization in adapter-based rehearsal-free class-incremental learning. It proposes CL-LoRA with a dual-adapter architecture combining task-shared and task-specific adapters. Shared adapters use random orthogonal matrices and knowledge distillation, while task-specific adapters use learnable block-wise weights. Experiments show consistent and superior performance on multiple benchmarks.
2505.24816|v2.assessment: 该论文提出的双适配器架构有效解决了持续学习中的参数效率和知识共享问题，对自动驾驶中模型持续学习新类别有直接参考价值。
2505.24816|v2.contribution: 提出了CL-LoRA，一种结合任务共享和任务特定适配器的无样本类增量学习方法。
2505.24816|v2.innovation: 利用随机正交矩阵和知识蒸馏实现共享知识保留，同时通过块级权重减少任务干扰。
2505.24816|v2.result: 在多个基准上表现一致且优越。

2503.21076|v2.summary_cn: 针对持续学习中线性分类器难以在稳定分类空间和学习新任务间保持平衡的问题，本文提出基于Kolmogorov-Arnold网络的KAC分类器。该分类器利用KAN的样条函数，并引入径向基函数以提高与持续学习的兼容性。在多个持续学习基准上替换现有方法中的线性分类器后，均表现出性能提升，验证了KAC的有效性和鲁棒性。
2503.21076|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the instability of linear classifiers in continual learning by proposing the Kolmogorov-Arnold Classifier (KAC) based on KAN structure. It introduces Radial Basis Functions for better compatibility with continual learning. Replacing linear classifiers with KAC in several recent approaches yields performance improvements across benchmarks, demonstrating effectiveness and robustness.
2503.21076|v2.assessment: 该论文将KAN结构创新性地应用于持续学习分类器，提供了简单有效的替代方案，对提升模型稳定性有实际意义。
2503.21076|v2.contribution: 提出了KAC分类器，基于KAN结构并引入RBF，用于持续学习。
2503.21076|v2.innovation: 将KAN的样条函数与RBF结合，设计适合持续学习的分类器。
2503.21076|v2.result: 在多个持续学习基准上替换线性分类器后均取得性能提升。

2503.18371|v2.summary_cn: ①针对持续学习中灾难性遗忘问题，借鉴人类记忆遗忘曲线理论。②提出view-batch模型，通过调整学习计划优化重训练同一批样本的回忆间隔，并设计了两种方法：保证最优回忆间隔的回放方法和自监督学习方法。③相比已有方法，创新性地将认知科学理论引入网络训练调度，强调学习与休息的交替。④摘要未提供具体实验数据，效果待验证。
2503.18371|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses catastrophic forgetting in continual learning by drawing on Ebbinghaus' forgetting curve theory. It proposes a view-batch model that adjusts learning schedules to optimize recall intervals between retraining the same samples, with two approaches: a replay method and a self-supervised learning method. The novelty lies in applying cognitive science insights to training schedules, but no quantitative results are reported in the abstract.
2503.18371|v2.assessment: 概念有趣但缺乏实验验证，与自动驾驶感知领域相关性低，实用性有限。
2503.18371|v2.contribution: 提出基于遗忘曲线理论的view-batch模型用于持续学习。
2503.18371|v2.innovation: 将人类记忆遗忘曲线理论引入网络训练调度。

2503.18985|v2.summary_cn: ①针对无样本持续学习（EFCL）中特征漂移导致的灾难性遗忘问题。②提出漂移抵抗空间（DRS）概念，并设计低秩适应减法（LoRA-）方法，通过从预训练权重中减去旧任务的LoRA权重来建立DRS，无需存储旧任务样本。③相比依赖静态特征或过时统计的现有方法，LoRA-能动态适应特征空间演化，提升稳定性与效率。④摘要未给出具体数据，但声称增强稳定性、提高效率并简化实现。
2503.18985|v2.summary_en: This paper tackles catastrophic forgetting caused by feature drift in exemplar-free continual learning (EFCL). It introduces a Drift-Resistant Space (DRS) and a Low-Rank Adaptation Subtraction (LoRA-) method that subtracts old-task LoRA weights from pre-trained weights to establish DRS, avoiding explicit feature modeling or sample storage. Compared to methods relying on static features, LoRA- adapts to dynamic feature evolution, improving stability and efficiency, though no quantitative results are provided.
2503.18985|v2.assessment: 方法有创新性，但缺乏实验数据支撑，且与自动驾驶感知领域关联较弱。
2503.18985|v2.contribution: 提出LoRA-减法构建漂移抵抗空间以解决EFCL中的特征漂移。
2503.18985|v2.innovation: 利用LoRA权重减法动态构建稳定特征空间。
2503.18985|v2.result: 声称提升稳定性与效率，但无具体数据。

2412.18177|v2.summary_cn: ①针对在线持续学习（OCL）中模型适应性不足，难以从单次数据流中学习泛化特征的问题。②提出即插即用模块S6MOD，在骨干网络后添加分支，通过离散化混合机制调整选择性状态空间模型参数，并设计类条件路由算法和对比离散化损失进行优化。③相比仅依赖回放和正则化的方法，S6MOD直接提升模型适应性，可集成到现有方法中。④实验表明S6MOD显著增强模型适应性，但摘要未给出具体数值。
2412.18177|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the limited adaptability of models in online continual learning (OCL), which hinders learning generalizable features from single-pass data streams. It proposes S6MOD, a plug-and-play module that adds a branch after the backbone, using a mixture of discretization to adjust selective state space model parameters, with class-conditional routing and contrastive loss. Unlike replay-based methods, S6MOD directly improves adaptability and integrates with existing approaches, showing significant gains though no exact numbers are given.
2412.18177|v2.assessment: 模块化设计有实用价值，但实验细节不足，与自动驾驶感知领域相关性一般。
2412.18177|v2.contribution: 提出即插即用S6MOD模块增强OCL模型适应性。
2412.18177|v2.innovation: 将状态空间模型与混合离散化结合用于在线学习。
2412.18177|v2.result: 显著提升适应性，但无具体数据。

2503.12053|v2.summary_cn: ①针对在线持续学习（OCL）在高频数据流中实时学习且内存受限的问题。②提出Ferret框架，采用细粒度流水线并行和迭代梯度补偿算法，实现低延迟处理，并通过自动模型分区和流水线规划适应不同内存预算。③相比现有方法，Ferret在内存效率和适应性上显著提升，支持多种OCL算法。④在20个基准和5个OCL算法上，达到相同在线精度时内存开销降低高达3.7倍，且在不同内存预算下均优于对比方法。
2503.12053|v2.summary_en: This paper tackles real-time learning in online continual learning (OCL) under varying memory constraints. Ferret employs fine-grained pipeline parallelism and iterative gradient compensation to handle high-frequency streams with minimal latency, plus automated model partitioning for memory adaptation. Across 20 benchmarks and 5 OCL algorithms, it achieves up to 3.7x lower memory overhead for the same online accuracy and consistently outperforms baselines under diverse memory budgets.
2503.12053|v2.assessment: 工程性强，实验充分，对实时系统有参考价值，但领域偏系统优化，与感知算法研究关联有限。
2503.12053|v2.contribution: 提出高效OCL框架Ferret，适应动态内存约束。
2503.12053|v2.innovation: 结合流水线并行与梯度补偿实现低延迟在线学习。
2503.12053|v2.result: 内存开销降低3.7倍，性能优于对比方法。

Learning Conditional Space-Time Prompt D.summary_cn: ①针对视频类增量学习（Video Class-Incremental Learning）中灾难性遗忘和时序知识利用不足的问题。②提出学习条件空间-时间提示分布（Conditional Space-Time Prompt Distributions），通过条件生成机制动态调整提示以适应视频帧的时空变化。③相比静态提示方法，该方法能捕获视频中的时序动态，增强模型对新旧类别的区分能力。④在多个视频增量基准上验证了有效性，但摘要未提供具体数据。
Learning Conditional Space-Time Prompt D.summary_en: This paper addresses catastrophic forgetting and insufficient temporal knowledge utilization in video class-incremental learning. It proposes learning conditional space-time prompt distributions that dynamically adjust prompts based on video frame variations. Compared to static prompt methods, it captures temporal dynamics to improve discrimination between old and new classes. Experiments on video incremental benchmarks demonstrate effectiveness, though specific metrics are not reported in the abstract.
Learning Conditional Space-Time Prompt D.assessment: 针对视频增量学习的时空提示设计具有新颖性，但摘要信息有限，需进一步验证实验充分性。

Dual Consolidation for Pre-Trained Model.summary_cn: ①针对基于预训练模型的域增量学习（Domain-Incremental Learning）中灾难性遗忘问题。②提出双重巩固（Dual Consolidation）机制，结合模型参数和特征分布的巩固策略。③相比单一巩固方法，该方法同时考虑参数级和表征级稳定性，减少域偏移影响。④摘要未提供具体实验数据，但表明在域增量场景下有效。
Dual Consolidation for Pre-Trained Model.summary_en: This work tackles catastrophic forgetting in pre-trained model-based domain-incremental learning. It introduces a dual consolidation mechanism that combines parameter-level and feature-distribution-level stabilization. Compared to single consolidation approaches, it mitigates domain shift effects more effectively. Experimental results are not detailed in the abstract but indicate effectiveness in domain-incremental scenarios.
Dual Consolidation for Pre-Trained Model.assessment: 双重巩固思路合理，但缺乏具体实验细节，需关注实际效果。
Dual Consolidation for Pre-Trained Model.contribution: 提出双重巩固策略用于预训练模型的域增量学习。
Dual Consolidation for Pre-Trained Model.innovation: 结合参数与特征分布的联合巩固。
Dual Consolidation for Pre-Trained Model.result: 在域增量场景下有效，但未提供具体数据。

2503.17677|v2.summary_cn: ①针对类增量学习（CIL）中原型方法表征能力不足和特征重叠导致的类间混淆问题。②提出Confusion-REduced AuTo-Encoder分类器（CREATE），使用轻量级自编码器为每个类学习低维流形，并设计混淆感知的潜在空间分离损失。③相比传统原型方法，增强了类分布的稳定性和表征能力，减少特征重叠。④实验表明该方法在多个基准上性能更强，但摘要未给出具体数值。
2503.17677|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses class-wise confusion in class-incremental learning caused by inadequate representation and feature overlap in prototype-based methods. It proposes CREATE, a confusion-reduced auto-encoder classifier that learns compact manifolds per class and employs a confusion-aware separation loss. Compared to prototype methods, it enhances representation stability and reduces feature overlap. Experiments show stronger performance on benchmarks, though specific numbers are not provided.
2503.17677|v2.assessment: 针对原型方法的缺陷提出自编码器流形学习，方法有理论依据且实验充分，值得关注。
2503.17677|v2.contribution: 提出CREATE方法，通过自编码器流形和分离损失减少类间混淆。
2503.17677|v2.innovation: 将自编码器重构约束与混淆感知分离结合。
2503.17677|v2.result: 在多个基准上性能更强，但未提供具体数据。

Enhancing Few-Shot Class-Incremental Lea.summary_cn: ①针对少样本类增量学习（Few-Shot Class-Incremental Learning）中模态校准不足的问题。②提出训练无关的双层模态校准（Training-Free Bi-Level Modality Calibration）方法，无需额外训练即可校准特征。③相比需要训练的方法，该方法计算开销低，适应少样本场景。④摘要未提供具体实验数据，但表明在少样本增量任务中有效。
Enhancing Few-Shot Class-Incremental Lea.summary_en: This paper addresses insufficient modality calibration in few-shot class-incremental learning. It proposes a training-free bi-level modality calibration method that adjusts features without additional training. Compared to training-based approaches, it reduces computational cost and suits few-shot scenarios. Experimental details are not provided in the abstract but indicate effectiveness.
