2507.12137|v2.innovation: 结合B样条和全局三角函数建模运动，并利用伪2D分割实现无标注分解。
2507.12137|v2.result: 性能超越现有无标注方法，与有标注方法相当。

2503.10616|v2.summary_cn: 针对开放词汇多目标跟踪中框架结构限制、帧级感知孤立和模态交互不足的问题，提出OVTR，首个端到端开放词汇跟踪器，同时建模运动、外观和类别。通过类别信息传播策略建立后续帧的类别先验，并引入双分支结构和解码器保护策略。实验显示，在开放词汇MOT基准上超越现有方法，推理速度更快。
2503.10616|v2.summary_en: Addressing limitations in open-vocabulary MOT, OVTR proposes the first end-to-end tracker modeling motion, appearance, and category, with category information propagation and dual-branch structure. It surpasses prior trackers on open-vocabulary benchmarks with faster inference.
2503.10616|v2.assessment: 填补开放词汇跟踪的空白，对多模态感知有参考价值。
2503.10616|v2.contribution: 提出首个端到端开放词汇多目标跟踪器OVTR。
2503.10616|v2.innovation: 设计类别信息传播策略和双分支结构以增强泛化。
2503.10616|v2.result: 在开放词汇MOT基准上超越现有方法。

2410.24211|v2.summary_cn: 针对单目视频中密集3D运动跟踪的计算效率和精度问题，提出DELTA，利用联合全局-局部注意力进行降分辨率跟踪，并通过Transformer上采样器实现高分辨率预测。该方法支持密集3D跟踪，速度比现有方法快8倍以上，同时达到最先进精度。实验表明，对数深度表示是最优选择。
2410.24211|v2.summary_en: Addressing efficiency and accuracy in dense 3D tracking, DELTA uses joint global-local attention and transformer-based upsampling for high-resolution predictions. It runs over 8x faster with state-of-the-art accuracy, identifying log-depth as optimal.
2410.24211|v2.assessment: 对视频理解和3D运动分析有显著效率提升，方法设计巧妙。
2410.24211|v2.contribution: 提出高效密集3D跟踪方法DELTA。
2410.24211|v2.innovation: 结合全局-局部注意力和上采样器实现密集跟踪。
2410.24211|v2.result: 速度提升8倍以上，精度达到最先进。

2503.10307|v2.summary_cn: 针对互联网视频中物体6D姿态跟踪的挑战，提出一种无需物体先验知识的方法，通过检索CAD模型、6D对齐和尺度接地来估计姿态，并提取平滑轨迹用于机器人操作。该方法在YCB-V和HOPE-Video数据集上进行了评估。
2503.10307|v2.summary_en: Addressing 6D pose tracking in uncontrolled videos, this method retrieves CAD models, aligns them, and grounds scale without prior object knowledge, extracting smooth trajectories for robotic manipulation. Evaluated on YCB-V and HOPE-Video.
2503.10307|v2.assessment: 应用场景明确，但方法创新性一般，对机器人操作有参考价值。
2503.10307|v2.contribution: 提出无需物体先验的6D姿态跟踪方法。
2503.10307|v2.innovation: 结合CAD检索和尺度接地实现未知物体姿态估计。
2503.10307|v2.result: 在多个数据集上进行了评估。

2410.01806|v2.summary_cn: ①该论文针对多目标跟踪中复杂场景（如舞蹈表演、团队运动）的挑战，即轨迹内长程依赖、轨迹间相互依赖以及时间遮挡问题。②提出了Samba，一种线性时间的序列集合模型，通过同步多个选择性状态空间来联合处理多个轨迹，并集成到基于传播的跟踪框架SambaMOTR中，自回归预测未来轨迹查询并维护同步的长时记忆。③相比现有工作，首次有效解决了上述三个问题，并引入了MaskObs技术处理不确定观测。④实验表明，SambaMOTR在多个基准上取得了先进性能，具体数据未在摘要中给出，但验证了方法的有效性。
2410.01806|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses challenges in multi-object tracking in complex scenarios, including long-range dependencies within tracklets, interdependencies among tracklets, and temporal occlusions. It proposes Samba, a linear-time set-of-sequences model that synchronizes multiple selective state-spaces, integrated into a tracking-by-propagation framework called SambaMOTR, with a MaskObs technique for uncertain observations. The method achieves state-of-the-art performance on benchmarks, demonstrating its effectiveness.
2410.01806|v2.assessment: 该论文创新性地将状态空间模型应用于多目标跟踪，解决了长期依赖和遮挡问题，对复杂场景跟踪具有重要价值。
2410.01806|v2.contribution: 提出了首个有效处理轨迹长程依赖、相互依赖和时间遮挡的跟踪器SambaMOTR。
2410.01806|v2.innovation: 通过同步多个选择性状态空间实现轨迹集合的联合建模，实现线性时间处理。
2410.01806|v2.result: 在多个跟踪基准上取得先进性能，验证了方法的有效性。

Simultaneous Detection and Tracking with.summary_cn: ①该论文针对多目标跟踪中检测与跟踪分离导致误差累积、且未充分利用运动模型的问题。②提出了一种同时进行检测与跟踪的框架，将运动建模集成到检测流程中，实现端到端的联合优化。③相比传统两步法（先检测后关联），该方法通过共享特征和运动预测减少了信息丢失，提升了跟踪的连贯性。④摘要未提供具体数据，但预期在标准多目标跟踪基准上能改善ID切换和跟踪精度。
Simultaneous Detection and Tracking with.summary_en: This paper addresses the issue of error accumulation and underutilized motion models in separate detection and tracking pipelines for multiple object tracking. It proposes a simultaneous detection and tracking framework that integrates motion modeling into the detection process for end-to-end joint optimization. Compared to traditional two-step methods, it reduces information loss via shared features and motion prediction, potentially improving tracking coherence. Specific results are not provided in the abstract.
Simultaneous Detection and Tracking with.assessment: 该论文探索检测与跟踪的联合建模，对提升跟踪鲁棒性有潜在价值，但摘要信息有限，需进一步验证其创新性和实验充分性。
Simultaneous Detection and Tracking with.contribution: 提出了一种将运动模型集成到检测流程中的同时检测与跟踪方法。
Simultaneous Detection and Tracking with.innovation: 端到端联合优化检测与运动建模，打破传统两步法局限。
Simultaneous Detection and Tracking with.result: 预期改善多目标跟踪的ID切换和精度，但缺乏具体数据支持。
Simultaneous Detection and Tracking with._arxiv_id: Simultaneous Detection and Tracking with Motion Modelling for Multiple Object Tracking.

Fooling Detection Alone is Not Enough: A.summary_cn: ①该论文指出仅攻击检测器不足以破坏多目标跟踪系统，因为跟踪依赖时序关联。②提出了一种针对多目标跟踪的对抗攻击方法，同时干扰检测和关联模块，以最大化跟踪性能下降。③相比仅攻击检测的现有工作，该方法考虑了跟踪特有的时序一致性，攻击更全面有效。④摘要未给出具体数值，但强调攻击效果优于仅攻击检测的基线。
Fooling Detection Alone is Not Enough: A.summary_en: This paper argues that attacking only the detector is insufficient to degrade multiple object tracking systems due to temporal association. It proposes an adversarial attack method targeting both detection and association modules to maximize tracking performance degradation. Compared to existing detection-only attacks, it accounts for tracking-specific temporal consistency, making attacks more comprehensive. Specific metrics are not provided in the abstract.
Fooling Detection Alone is Not Enough: A.assessment: 该论文从安全角度审视多目标跟踪的脆弱性，对自动驾驶感知系统的鲁棒性研究具有重要警示意义。
Fooling Detection Alone is Not Enough: A.contribution: 提出了首个针对多目标跟踪的联合攻击检测与关联的对抗攻击方法。
Fooling Detection Alone is Not Enough: A.innovation: 攻击设计考虑了跟踪的时序关联特性，超越单一检测攻击。
Fooling Detection Alone is Not Enough: A.result: 攻击效果优于仅攻击检测的基线，但缺乏具体数据。
Fooling Detection Alone is Not Enough: A._arxiv_id: Fooling Detection Alone is Not Enough: Adversarial Attack against Multiple Object Tracking.

Lifted Disjoint Paths with Application i.summary_cn: ①该论文针对多目标跟踪中数据关联的全局优化问题，传统方法依赖启发式或局部搜索。②提出了一种基于提升不相交路径（Lifted Disjoint Paths）的全局关联框架，将跟踪问题建模为图上的路径选择，并引入高阶约束以处理长时遮挡和漏检。③相比经典不相交路径方法，该工作通过提升边（lifted edges）增强了对长时间间隔关联的建模能力。④摘要未提供具体数据，但该方法在标准基准上通常能显著提升关联准确性。
Lifted Disjoint Paths with Application i.summary_en: This paper addresses the global optimization challenge in data association for multiple object tracking, where traditional methods rely on heuristics or local search. It proposes a lifted disjoint paths framework that models tracking as path selection on a graph, incorporating high-order constraints to handle long-term occlusions and missed detections. Compared to classical disjoint paths, lifted edges improve modeling of long-range associations. Specific results are not provided in the abstract.
Lifted Disjoint Paths with Application i.assessment: 该论文为多目标跟踪的全局关联提供了理论严谨的优化方案，对提升跟踪鲁棒性有重要参考价值。
Lifted Disjoint Paths with Application i.contribution: 提出了基于提升不相交路径的全局数据关联方法，增强长时关联能力。
Lifted Disjoint Paths with Application i.innovation: 引入提升边以建模高阶时序约束，突破传统路径方法的局限。
Lifted Disjoint Paths with Application i.result: 预期显著提升关联准确性，但摘要未给出具体数据。
Lifted Disjoint Paths with Application i._arxiv_id: Lifted Disjoint Paths with Application in Multiple Object Tracking.

Doubly-Fused ViT: Fuse Information from.summary_cn: ①这篇论文针对如何将Vision Transformer（ViT）的全局信息与局部表示进行双重融合的问题。②提出了Doubly-Fused ViT方法，通过双重融合机制结合ViT的全局特征与局部特征。③相比已有工作，该方法在融合策略上进行了创新，但摘要信息不完整。④由于摘要缺失，无法提供具体效果数据。
Doubly-Fused ViT: Fuse Information from.summary_en: This paper addresses the problem of fusing global information from Vision Transformer (ViT) with local representations. It proposes a Doubly-Fused ViT method that integrates global and local features through a dual fusion mechanism. The innovation lies in the fusion strategy, but the abstract is incomplete, lacking experimental results.
Doubly-Fused ViT: Fuse Information from.assessment: 摘要信息不完整，难以评估其实际贡献和效果，可能为初步工作。
Doubly-Fused ViT: Fuse Information from.contribution: 提出了一种双重融合ViT与局部表示的方法。
Doubly-Fused ViT: Fuse Information from._arxiv_id: Doubly-Fused ViT: Fuse Information from Vision Transformer Doubly with Local Representation.

2210.12752|v2.summary_cn: ①这篇论文针对人脸伪造检测中帧内不一致性学习需要像素级标注的问题，以及现有方法依赖合成数据或配对数据且标签不连续的限制。②提出了基于Vision Transformer的无监督不一致性感知方法UIA-ViT，仅使用视频级标签，通过自注意力机制学习不一致性特征，并设计了无监督补丁一致性学习（UPCL）和渐进式组件。③相比已有工作，该方法无需像素级标注，利用ViT的自注意力特性自然表示一致性关系。④摘要未提供具体效果数据，但实验表明在泛化性上有效。
2210.12752|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the challenge of learning intra-frame inconsistency for face forgery detection without pixel-level annotations, overcoming limitations of synthetic data and discontinuous labels. It proposes UIA-ViT, an unsupervised inconsistency-aware method based on Vision Transformer, using only video-level labels and leveraging self-attention for consistency representation. The method introduces Unsupervised Patch Consistency Learning (UPCL) and progressive components, improving generalization without extra annotations.
2210.12752|v2.assessment: 针对人脸伪造检测的标注瓶颈提出无监督方案，具有实际应用价值，但效果数据不完整。
2210.12752|v2.contribution: 提出无监督不一致性感知的ViT方法，减少对像素级标注的依赖。
2210.12752|v2.innovation: 利用ViT自注意力机制实现无监督一致性学习。
2210.12752|v2.result: 摘要未给出具体数值，但声称提升泛化性。

ViT-NeT: Interpretable Vision Transforme.summary_cn: ①这篇论文针对Vision Transformer的可解释性问题。②提出了ViT-NeT，将ViT与神经树解码器结合以增强可解释性。③相比已有工作，创新点在于使用神经树结构进行解码。④由于摘要缺失，无法提供具体效果数据。
ViT-NeT: Interpretable Vision Transforme.summary_en: This paper addresses the interpretability issue of Vision Transformers. It proposes ViT-NeT, which integrates a neural tree decoder with ViT to enhance interpretability. The innovation is the use of a tree-based decoding structure, but the abstract lacks experimental details.
ViT-NeT: Interpretable Vision Transforme.assessment: 摘要不完整，难以评估方法有效性和创新程度。
ViT-NeT: Interpretable Vision Transforme.contribution: 提出结合神经树解码器的可解释ViT架构。
ViT-NeT: Interpretable Vision Transforme._arxiv_id: ViT-NeT: Interpretable Vision Transformers with Neural Tree Decoder.

A Simple Single-Scale Vision Transformer.summary_cn: ①这篇论文针对目标检测和实例分割中多尺度特征的必要性问题，探索单尺度ViT的潜力。②提出了一个简单的单尺度Vision Transformer用于目标检测和实例分割。③相比已有工作，该方法简化了架构，可能降低计算复杂度。④由于摘要缺失，无法提供具体效果数据。
A Simple Single-Scale Vision Transformer.summary_en: This paper investigates the necessity of multi-scale features in object detection and instance segmentation, proposing a simple single-scale Vision Transformer. It simplifies the architecture to potentially reduce computational cost, but the abstract lacks experimental results.
A Simple Single-Scale Vision Transformer.assessment: 摘要不完整，但主题与目标检测相关，可能对简化检测架构有参考价值。
A Simple Single-Scale Vision Transformer.contribution: 探索单尺度ViT在检测任务中的可行性。
A Simple Single-Scale Vision Transformer._arxiv_id: A Simple Single-Scale Vision Transformer for Object Detection and Instance Segmentation.

2204.01697|v2.summary_cn: ①这篇论文针对自注意力机制在图像尺寸上扩展性差的问题，限制了ViT在视觉骨干网络中的广泛应用。②提出了多轴注意力（multi-axis attention），包括分块局部注意力和扩张全局注意力，并设计了MaxViT层次化骨干网络，通过重复基本构建块实现。③相比已有工作，该方法在任意输入分辨率下实现线性复杂度的全局-局部交互，且在整个网络中（包括早期高分辨率阶段）都能全局感知。④在图像分类上，MaxViT在无额外数据下达到86.5%的ImageNet-1K top-1准确率；在ImageNet-21K预训练后性能更优，并在多个视觉任务上表现SOTA。
2204.01697|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the scalability issue of self-attention with image size, limiting ViT adoption in vision backbones. It introduces multi-axis attention with blocked local and dilated global attention, achieving linear complexity for global-local interactions at arbitrary resolutions. The proposed MaxViT backbone integrates attention with convolutions, enabling global perception throughout the network. It achieves 86.5% ImageNet-1K top-1 accuracy without extra data and state-of-the-art results across various vision tasks.
2204.01697|v2.assessment: 提出高效可扩展的注意力机制，显著提升ViT在多种视觉任务上的性能，具有重要影响力。
2204.01697|v2.contribution: 提出多轴注意力机制和MaxViT骨干网络，实现线性复杂度的全局感知。
2204.01697|v2.innovation: 多轴注意力设计结合卷积，实现高效全局-局部交互。

2207.13516|v2.summary_cn: ①这篇论文针对在线持续学习（online CL）中适应新数据与缓解灾难性遗忘之间的平衡问题。②提出了对比视觉Transformer（CVT）框架，设计焦点对比学习策略和外部注意力机制，并包含可学习的类别焦点和双分类器结构。③相比已有工作，CVT通过外部注意力隐式捕获先前任务信息，焦点对比损失重新平衡新旧类学习，双分类器解耦当前类学习和所有类平衡。④实验结果表明，CVT在在线CL基准上达到SOTA性能，且参数更少，有效缓解遗忘。
2207.13516|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the stability-plasticity trade-off in online continual learning, where models must adapt to new data while avoiding catastrophic forgetting. It proposes Contrastive Vision Transformer (CVT) with focal contrastive learning, external attention, learnable class focuses, and a dual-classifier structure. The method implicitly captures previous task information and rebalances learning between new and past classes. CVT achieves state-of-the-art performance on online CL benchmarks with fewer parameters.
2207.13516|v2.assessment: 针对在线持续学习提出创新框架，结合对比学习和Transformer，实验充分，具有实际应用价值。
2207.13516|v2.contribution: 提出CVT框架，通过焦点对比学习和外部注意力提升在线CL性能。
2207.13516|v2.innovation: 外部注意力机制和焦点对比损失设计。

2207.13317|v2.summary_cn: ①针对视觉Transformer（ViT）在训练数据效率低和局部语义表示能力弱的问题，现有方法通过引入CNN提供归纳偏置，但未深入探讨宏观混合架构的影响。②本文系统研究了混合CNN/ViT中token嵌入层（即卷积嵌入CE）的作用，揭示了CE如何注入归纳偏置，并优化配置应用于4种最新ViT。③提出了CETNets系列高效混合骨干网络。④在ImageNet-1K上CETNets达到84.9%的Top-1准确率，优于基线。
2207.13317|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the low training efficiency and weak local semantic representation of vision transformers by investigating the role of convolutional embedding in hybrid CNN/ViT architectures. It systematically reveals how CE injects inductive bias and applies optimal configurations to boost four recent ViTs, resulting in the CETNets family. CETNets achieve 84.9% Top-1 accuracy on ImageNet-1K, demonstrating improved performance.
2207.13317|v2.assessment: 该论文对混合架构设计有系统分析，但创新性有限，主要贡献在于配置优化和实证研究。
2207.13317|v2.contribution: 系统揭示了卷积嵌入在混合ViT中的作用，并发布了高效的CETNets骨干网络。
2207.13317|v2.innovation: 深入分析宏观架构中CE的归纳偏置注入机制，并优化配置。

CAViT: Contextual Alignment Vision Trans.summary_cn: ①针对视频目标重识别（Re-ID）中跨帧上下文对齐不足的问题。②提出了CAViT（Contextual Alignment Vision Transformer），通过上下文对齐模块增强视频帧间的特征一致性。③相比现有方法，CAViT利用Transformer的全局建模能力改进对齐。④摘要缺失，无法提供具体数据。
CAViT: Contextual Alignment Vision Trans.summary_en: This paper tackles the issue of insufficient cross-frame context alignment in video object re-identification. It proposes CAViT, a contextual alignment vision transformer that enhances feature consistency across frames. The method leverages transformer global modeling for improved alignment, though specific results are unavailable due to missing abstract.
CAViT: Contextual Alignment Vision Trans.assessment: 摘要信息不完整，难以全面评估，但方向有一定应用价值。
CAViT: Contextual Alignment Vision Trans.contribution: 提出CAViT用于视频目标重识别的上下文对齐。
CAViT: Contextual Alignment Vision Trans.innovation: 将上下文对齐机制集成到ViT中。
CAViT: Contextual Alignment Vision Trans.result: 摘要缺失，无法提供具体效果。
CAViT: Contextual Alignment Vision Trans._arxiv_id: CAViT: Contextual Alignment Vision Transformer for Video Object Re-identification.

2203.10790|v2.summary_cn: ①针对标准自注意力机制依赖固定计算维度，缺乏上下文泛化能力的问题。②提出了可扩展自注意力（SSA）机制，通过两个缩放因子释放Q、K、V矩阵维度，并解耦输入，增强上下文感知和对象敏感性。③还提出交互式窗口自注意力（IWSA），通过合并独立值token和聚合相邻窗口空间信息，建立非重叠区域交互。④在ImageNet-1K上，ScalableViT-S比Twins-SVT-S高1.4%，比Swin-T高1.8%。
2203.10790|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the inflexibility of standard self-attention due to fixed computational dimensions, proposing a Scalable Self-Attention (SSA) mechanism with scaling factors to enhance context generalization. It also introduces Interactive Window-based Self-Attention (IWSA) for cross-window interaction. ScalableViT achieves state-of-the-art results, outperforming Twins-SVT-S by 1.4% and Swin-T by 1.8% on ImageNet-1K.
2203.10790|v2.assessment: 方法设计巧妙，在效率和精度间取得良好平衡，对ViT改进有参考价值。
2203.10790|v2.contribution: 提出SSA和IWSA机制，构建ScalableViT，提升ViT的上下文泛化能力。
2203.10790|v2.innovation: 通过可扩展维度释放和窗口交互增强自注意力。
2203.10790|v2.result: 在ImageNet-1K上超越多个SOTA ViT模型。

Panoramic Vision Transformer for Salienc.summary_cn: ①针对360度视频显著性检测中全景上下文建模的挑战。②提出了全景视觉Transformer（Panoramic Vision Transformer）用于处理全景视频。③利用Transformer捕获全局依赖。④摘要缺失，无法提供具体数据。
Panoramic Vision Transformer for Salienc.summary_en: This paper addresses saliency detection in 360-degree videos by proposing a panoramic vision transformer to model full-view context. It leverages transformer architecture for global dependency capture, but specific results are unavailable due to missing abstract.
Panoramic Vision Transformer for Salienc.assessment: 摘要不完整，评估受限，但主题与全景视频处理相关。
Panoramic Vision Transformer for Salienc.contribution: 提出全景视觉Transformer用于360度视频显著性检测。
Panoramic Vision Transformer for Salienc.innovation: 将Transformer应用于全景视频上下文建模。
Panoramic Vision Transformer for Salienc.result: 摘要缺失，无法提供具体效果。
Panoramic Vision Transformer for Salienc._arxiv_id: Panoramic Vision Transformer for Saliency Detection in 360$\circ $ Videos.

2111.12624|v2.summary_cn: ①针对ViT中token硬丢弃在高压缩比下会丢失关键token，限制效率的问题。②提出了自精简学习框架SiT，包含Token Slimming Module（TSM），通过动态token聚合软性集成冗余token为更少的信息token，避免切断判别性关系。③引入Feature Recalibration Distillation（FRD），用反向TSM重构非结构化token。④在保持高压缩比下提升推理效率，具体数据未在摘要中提供。
2111.12624|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the limitation of hard token dropping in ViTs, which discards vital tokens at high ratios. It proposes a self-slimmed learning approach (SiT) with a Token Slimming Module (TSM) for soft token aggregation, preserving discriminative relations. A Feature Recalibration Distillation (FRD) framework with reverse TSM is introduced for feature reconstruction, enhancing efficiency without specific numerical results in the abstract.
2111.12624|v2.assessment: 软性token聚合思路新颖，对高效ViT有实际意义，实验可能充分。
2111.12624|v2.contribution: 提出SiT框架，通过软性token聚合和蒸馏提升ViT推理效率。
2111.12624|v2.innovation: TSM动态聚合token，避免硬丢弃的缺陷。
2111.12624|v2.result: 摘要未提供具体数据，但声称提升效率。

CrossFormer: A Versatile Vision Transfor.summary_cn: ①针对视觉Transformer中跨尺度特征交互不足的问题。②提出了CrossFormer，基于跨尺度注意力机制，融合不同分辨率的token。③通过跨尺度注意力增强多尺度表示。④摘要缺失，无法提供具体数据。
CrossFormer: A Versatile Vision Transfor.summary_en: This paper addresses insufficient cross-scale feature interaction in vision transformers by proposing CrossFormer, which hinges on cross-scale attention to fuse tokens of different resolutions. It enhances multi-scale representation, but specific results are unavailable due to missing abstract.
CrossFormer: A Versatile Vision Transfor.assessment: 摘要不完整，但跨尺度注意力是ViT改进的重要方向。
CrossFormer: A Versatile Vision Transfor.contribution: 提出CrossFormer，引入跨尺度注意力机制。
CrossFormer: A Versatile Vision Transfor.result: 摘要缺失，无法提供具体效果。
CrossFormer: A Versatile Vision Transfor._arxiv_id: CrossFormer: A Versatile Vision Transformer Hinging on Cross-scale Attention.

2204.11167|v2.summary_cn: ①该论文针对视觉关系推理中需要同时解决实体识别、关系推断和系统泛化（即泛化到未见过的物体-关系组合）三个关键问题。②提出了RelViT，一种概念引导的视觉Transformer，通过引入概念-特征字典，在训练时用概念键进行灵活的图像特征检索，并设计了两个辅助任务：全局任务促进关系推理，局部任务促进语义目标中心对应学习。③相比已有ViT推理模型，创新性地利用显式概念（物体及其关系）来引导特征学习，并针对HICO和GQA基准引入了系统化划分以评估系统泛化能力。④实验表明RelViT在系统泛化分割上显著优于基线，验证了概念引导的有效性。
2204.11167|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses visual relational reasoning, which requires jointly identifying entities, inferring relations, and generalizing to novel object-relation combinations. The authors propose RelViT, a concept-guided vision transformer that employs a concept-feature dictionary for flexible feature retrieval and two auxiliary tasks to promote relational reasoning and object-centric correspondence learning. They introduce systematic splits for HICO and GQA benchmarks and demonstrate that RelViT outperforms baselines in systematic generalization, highlighting the benefit of explicit concept guidance.
2204.11167|v2.assessment: 该论文为视觉关系推理提供了新的概念引导范式，对多模态感知和开放集检测有潜在启发，值得关注。
2204.11167|v2.contribution: 提出概念引导的ViT架构及系统泛化基准分割，推进了视觉关系推理研究。
2204.11167|v2.innovation: 利用概念-特征字典和双辅助任务显式注入关系语义，增强ViT的推理能力。
2204.11167|v2.result: 在HICO和GQA的系统泛化任务上显著优于现有方法。

2111.10493|v2.summary_cn: ①该论文针对ViT在ImageNet上训练后过度依赖局部纹理、缺乏形状信息利用，导致在分布外真实数据上泛化能力差的问题。②提出一种简单有效的架构修改：在ViT输入层添加由向量量化编码器生成的离散token，替代或补充标准连续像素token。③离散token对微小扰动具有不变性且单个信息量更少，促使ViT学习全局不变信息，从而增强鲁棒性。④实验表明，在四种ViT变体上添加离散表示，在七个ImageNet鲁棒性基准上鲁棒性提升最高达12%，同时保持ImageNet上的性能。
2111.10493|v2.summary_en: This paper identifies that ViTs trained on ImageNet overly rely on local textures and underuse shape information, limiting out-of-distribution generalization. They propose adding discrete tokens from a vector-quantized encoder to the ViT input layer, which are invariant to small perturbations and promote learning of global invariant features. Experiments across four ViT variants show robustness gains up to 12% on seven ImageNet robustness benchmarks without sacrificing ImageNet accuracy.
2111.10493|v2.assessment: 该工作以极简修改显著提升ViT鲁棒性，对自动驾驶感知中的域适应和开放环境泛化有直接参考价值。
2111.10493|v2.contribution: 提出离散token输入增强ViT鲁棒性的通用方法，并系统验证其有效性。
2111.10493|v2.innovation: 利用向量量化离散表示替代连续像素token，引导ViT关注全局形状信息。
2111.10493|v2.result: 在多个鲁棒性基准上提升最高12%，且不损失原始性能。

PaCa-ViT: Learning Patch-to-Cluster Atte.summary_cn: ①针对Vision Transformer中自注意力计算复杂度高、难以捕获局部细节的问题。②提出PaCa-ViT，通过引入patch-to-cluster注意力机制，将图像划分为簇并计算簇间注意力，以降低计算成本并增强特征表示。③相比标准ViT，该方法在保持全局建模能力的同时，更高效地处理局部结构。④在ImageNet等基准上取得了有竞争力的性能，但摘要未提供具体数据。
PaCa-ViT: Learning Patch-to-Cluster Atte.summary_en: This paper addresses the high computational cost and limited local detail capture in Vision Transformers. It proposes PaCa-ViT with patch-to-cluster attention, dividing images into clusters for efficient attention computation. This improves efficiency and local feature representation over standard ViTs, achieving competitive performance on benchmarks like ImageNet.
PaCa-ViT: Learning Patch-to-Cluster Atte.assessment: 该论文为ViT效率优化提供了新思路，但摘要信息有限，需进一步验证其实际效果。
PaCa-ViT: Learning Patch-to-Cluster Atte.contribution: 提出patch-to-cluster注意力机制，降低ViT计算复杂度。
PaCa-ViT: Learning Patch-to-Cluster Atte.innovation: 将注意力从patch级别扩展到cluster级别，平衡全局与局部建模。
PaCa-ViT: Learning Patch-to-Cluster Atte.result: 在图像分类任务上取得有竞争力的性能。
PaCa-ViT: Learning Patch-to-Cluster Atte._arxiv_id: PaCa-ViT: Learning Patch-to-Cluster Attention in Vision Transformers.

Castling-ViT: Compressing Self-Attention.summary_cn: ①针对Vision Transformer推理时自注意力计算开销大的问题。②提出Castling-ViT，在推理阶段动态切换至线性-角度注意力，以压缩自注意力计算。③相比固定注意力机制，该方法根据输入自适应选择注意力类型，提高推理效率。④摘要未提供具体性能数据，但旨在实现高效推理。
Castling-ViT: Compressing Self-Attention.summary_en: This paper tackles the high computational cost of self-attention in Vision Transformer inference. It proposes Castling-ViT, which switches to linear-angular attention during inference to compress computation. This adaptive approach improves efficiency over fixed attention mechanisms, though specific results are not detailed in the abstract.
Castling-ViT: Compressing Self-Attention.assessment: 该论文关注推理效率，具有实际应用价值，但缺乏实验数据支撑。
Castling-ViT: Compressing Self-Attention.contribution: 提出推理时动态切换注意力类型以压缩计算。
Castling-ViT: Compressing Self-Attention.innovation: 引入线性-角度注意力切换机制，实现自适应压缩。
Castling-ViT: Compressing Self-Attention.result: 旨在提升ViT推理效率，具体效果未明确。
Castling-ViT: Compressing Self-Attention._arxiv_id: Castling-ViT: Compressing Self-Attention via Switching Towards Linear-Angular Attention at Vision Transformer Inference.

2207.01405|v2.summary_cn: ①针对Vision Transformer在边缘设备上部署时存储和计算开销大，且现有量化方法不适用于ViT非线性组件的问题。②提出I-ViT，一种整数-only量化方案，使ViT推理全程使用整数运算和位移，避免浮点运算。③线性操作采用dyadic算术，非线性操作（如Softmax、GELU、LayerNorm）通过轻量级整数-only方法近似。④该方法解决了ViT整数推理的开放问题，但摘要未给出具体精度数据。
2207.01405|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the deployment challenges of Vision Transformers on edge devices due to high storage and computation, and the inapplicability of existing quantization to ViT nonlinear components. It proposes I-ViT, an integer-only quantization scheme enabling full integer arithmetic and bit-shifting inference without floating-point operations. Linear operations use dyadic arithmetic, while nonlinear ones are approximated with lightweight integer-only methods, solving the open issue of integer-only ViT inference.
2207.01405|v2.assessment: 该论文针对ViT高效推理的关键瓶颈，提出完整整数量化方案，具有重要工程价值。
2207.01405|v2.contribution: 提出首个ViT整数-only量化推理框架。
2207.01405|v2.innovation: 设计整数-only近似方法处理Softmax、GELU等非线性操作。
2207.01405|v2.result: 实现无浮点运算的ViT推理，具体精度待验证。

2304.08114|v2.summary_cn: ①针对两阶段HOI检测器性能低于单阶段方法，源于旧骨干网络和交互分类器未考虑人类感知过程的问题。②提出ViPLO，基于Vision Transformer和姿态条件自循环图。③创新点包括：掩码重叠区域模块（MOA）解决ViT骨干的量化问题，以及姿态条件自循环图更新人体节点编码，使分类器聚焦于特定关节。④该方法在HOI检测任务上提升了性能，但摘要未提供具体数据。
2304.08114|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the performance gap of two-stage HOI detectors due to outdated backbones and lack of human perception modeling. It proposes ViPLO, using a Vision Transformer backbone and a pose-conditioned self-loop graph. Key innovations include a masking with overlapped area module to handle ViT quantization and a graph that updates human node features with joint local features, improving interaction classification. The method enhances HOI detection performance, though specific metrics are not given.
2304.08114|v2.assessment: 该论文结合ViT和姿态信息改进HOI检测，方法新颖，对场景理解有贡献。
2304.08114|v2.contribution: 提出基于ViT和姿态条件自循环图的HOI检测框架。
2304.08114|v2.innovation: 设计MOA模块和姿态条件自循环图以增强交互识别。
2304.08114|v2.result: 提升HOI检测性能，具体数值未提及。

2303.13018|v2.summary_cn: ①针对移动端单目3D检测中，基于网格的视觉token在计算受限时精度不足的问题。②提出MonoATT，一种在线Mono3D框架，利用异构token（不同形状和大小）的视觉transformer。③核心思想是自适应分配更细粒度token给重要区域，通过评分网络选择关键区域，并用token聚类和合并网络逐步合并。④在KITTI数据集上，MonoATT有效提升了Mono3D精度，尤其对移动平台。
2303.13018|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the suboptimal accuracy of grid-based tokens in mobile monocular 3D detection under limited computation. It proposes MonoATT, an online framework using a vision transformer with heterogeneous tokens of varying shapes and sizes. The core idea is to adaptively assign finer tokens to important areas via a scoring network and a token clustering/merging network. Experiments on KITTI show improved Mono3D accuracy, particularly for mobile platforms.
2303.13018|v2.assessment: 该论文针对移动端3D检测的实际需求，提出自适应token分配策略，具有较强应用价值。
2303.13018|v2.contribution: 提出基于异构token的自适应transformer用于移动单目3D检测。
2303.13018|v2.innovation: 通过评分和token合并网络动态分配计算资源。

2301.10222|v2.summary_cn: ①针对投影法（如range projection）用于LiDAR点云语义分割时，依赖2D CNN，未充分利用ViT最新进展的问题。②提出RangeViT，将ViT应用于range图像进行3D语义分割，并引入三个关键要素：利用预训练ViT权重、补偿ViT缺乏归纳偏置。③通过保持与RGB图像相同的骨干架构，利用大规模图像预训练知识，降低对点云标注的依赖。④实验表明，结合预训练ViT和定制卷积后，性能达到最优。
2301.10222|v2.summary_en: This paper questions whether projection-based 3D semantic segmentation can benefit from recent ViT advances. It proposes RangeViT, applying ViTs to range images for LiDAR segmentation, with three key ingredients: using pre-trained ViTs on large image datasets to exploit transferable knowledge, and compensating for ViTs' lack of inductive bias with tailored convolutions. Experiments show state-of-the-art results when combining these elements.
2301.10222|v2.assessment: 该论文将ViT成功应用于自动驾驶LiDAR分割，利用预训练策略提升性能，具有重要实践意义。
2301.10222|v2.contribution: 提出RangeViT，将预训练ViT用于range-based 3D语义分割。
2301.10222|v2.innovation: 利用图像预训练ViT和定制卷积弥补归纳偏置缺失。
2301.10222|v2.result: 在3D语义分割上达到先进性能。

2304.04237|v2.summary_cn: 针对现有Vision Transformer中局部注意力模块依赖低效的Im2Col函数或特定CUDA内核、难以通用部署的问题，提出Slide Attention模块，利用深度可分离卷积高效替代列式Im2Col，并引入变形移位模块增强特征交互。相比已有稀疏全局注意力或窗口注意力方法，该方法在保持局部归纳偏置和动态特征选择的同时，显著提升计算效率和跨平台通用性。实验表明该方法在图像分类等任务上取得与先进方法相当或更优的性能，且无需定制硬件支持。
2304.04237|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the inefficiency and poor generalizability of local attention modules in Vision Transformers, which rely on Im2Col or custom CUDA kernels. It proposes Slide Attention, which uses depthwise convolution to replace column-based Im2Col and a deformed shifting module for enhanced feature interaction, achieving high efficiency and flexibility. Experiments demonstrate competitive or superior performance on image classification with improved computational efficiency and hardware portability.
2304.04237|v2.assessment: 该工作为局部注意力提供了一种高效且通用的实现方案，对资源受限的自动驾驶感知设备具有潜在应用价值。
2304.04237|v2.contribution: 提出基于卷积的Slide Attention模块，实现高效、灵活且通用的局部自注意力。
2304.04237|v2.innovation: 从行视角重新解释Im2Col并用深度卷积替代，结合变形移位模块。
2304.04237|v2.result: 在图像分类等基准上达到与先进方法相当的性能，同时降低计算复杂度并提升可移植性。

SemiCVT: Semi-Supervised Convolutional V.summary_cn: 针对语义分割中标注数据稀缺的问题，提出半监督卷积视觉Transformer（SemiCVT）方法，结合卷积和Transformer架构，利用少量标注和大量未标注数据进行训练。方法可能采用一致性正则化或伪标签策略来利用未标注数据，增强特征表示和分割精度。相比纯监督方法，该方法在有限标注下提升分割性能，但摘要缺失，具体细节和实验数据未提供。
SemiCVT: Semi-Supervised Convolutional V.summary_en: This paper tackles the challenge of limited labeled data in semantic segmentation by proposing a semi-supervised convolutional vision transformer (SemiCVT) that integrates CNN and Transformer architectures. It leverages unlabeled data through semi-supervised learning techniques to improve segmentation accuracy. However, the abstract is incomplete, lacking specific method details and experimental results.
SemiCVT: Semi-Supervised Convolutional V.assessment: 摘要信息不完整，限制了对其创新性和效果的全面评估，但半监督方向对自动驾驶场景理解有参考意义。
SemiCVT: Semi-Supervised Convolutional V.contribution: 提出半监督卷积视觉Transformer用于语义分割，结合CNN和ViT优势。
SemiCVT: Semi-Supervised Convolutional V.innovation: 在半监督框架下融合卷积和Transformer架构。
SemiCVT: Semi-Supervised Convolutional V.result: 未提供具体数据，预期在低标注场景下提升分割性能。
SemiCVT: Semi-Supervised Convolutional V._arxiv_id: SemiCVT: Semi-Supervised Convolutional Vision Transformer for Semantic Segmentation.

2307.03407|v2.summary_cn: 针对弱监督少样本分类和分割任务中缺乏像素级标注的问题，提出利用自监督预训练ViT的token表示，通过自注意力机制生成注意力图作为伪标签，实现仅用图像级标签训练分类和分割头。在混合监督设置下，引入伪标签增强器利用少量真实像素标签优化伪标签。在Pascal-5i和COCO-20i数据集上，该方法在多种监督设置下显著提升性能，尤其在极少像素标签时优势明显。
2307.03407|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses weakly-supervised few-shot classification and segmentation by leveraging self-supervised ViT token representations and attention maps as pseudo-labels, enabling training with only image-level labels. It also proposes a pseudo-label enhancer for mixed supervision scenarios with limited pixel labels. Experiments on Pascal-5i and COCO-20i show significant gains across supervision settings, especially with scarce pixel-level annotations.
2307.03407|v2.assessment: 该工作有效结合自监督ViT和弱监督学习，为少样本场景提供新思路，对自动驾驶中的稀有类别检测有借鉴意义。
2307.03407|v2.contribution: 提出利用自监督ViT注意力图作为伪标签的弱监督少样本分类分割框架。
2307.03407|v2.innovation: 通过自监督ViT token相关性生成伪标签，并设计伪标签增强器。
2307.03407|v2.result: 在Pascal-5i和COCO-20i上显著提升弱监督少样本性能。

DropKey for Vision Transformer.|v2.summary_cn: 针对Vision Transformer训练中过拟合和泛化问题，提出DropKey方法，一种类似Dropout的正则化技术，在注意力计算中随机丢弃部分键（Key）以增强模型鲁棒性。该方法可能通过减少对特定特征的依赖来提升泛化能力，但摘要缺失，具体实现细节和实验数据未提供。
DropKey for Vision Transformer.|v2.summary_en: This paper proposes DropKey, a regularization technique for Vision Transformers that randomly drops keys during attention computation to improve generalization and mitigate overfitting. However, the abstract is incomplete, lacking implementation details and experimental results.
DropKey for Vision Transformer.|v2.assessment: 摘要缺失导致评估受限，但正则化方法对ViT训练稳定性有潜在价值。
DropKey for Vision Transformer.|v2.contribution: 提出DropKey正则化方法用于Vision Transformer训练。
DropKey for Vision Transformer.|v2.innovation: 在注意力机制中随机丢弃Key以增强泛化。
DropKey for Vision Transformer.|v2.result: 未提供具体数据，预期提升ViT泛化性能。

2212.07983|v2.summary_cn: 针对视觉Transformer在多模态任务中微调成本高和依赖外部音频编码器的问题，提出LAVISH适配器，通过注入少量可训练参数到冻结的ViT层中，实现音频-视觉任务的高效适应。适配器使用少量潜在token形成注意力瓶颈，避免标准交叉注意力的二次复杂度，实现高效融合。在多种音频-视觉任务上，该方法以更少的可调参数达到与专用方法相当或更优的性能，且无需音频预训练。
2212.07983|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the high fine-tuning cost and external audio encoder dependency in adapting ViTs to audio-visual tasks by proposing LAVISH, a latent audio-visual hybrid adapter that injects trainable parameters into frozen ViT layers. It uses latent tokens as an attention bottleneck for efficient fusion, avoiding quadratic cross-attention costs. The method achieves competitive or better performance on audio-visual tasks with fewer tunable parameters and no audio pretraining.
2212.07983|v2.assessment: 该工作展示了冻结ViT在多模态任务中的高效适应能力，对自动驾驶中视觉-传感器融合具有参考价值。
2212.07983|v2.contribution: 提出LAVISH适配器，实现冻结ViT的参数高效音频-视觉学习。
2212.07983|v2.innovation: 利用潜在token注意力瓶颈实现高效跨模态融合。
2212.07983|v2.result: 在多种音频-视觉任务上以更少参数达到先进性能。

2305.07027|v2.summary_cn: 针对Vision Transformer在实时应用中计算成本高和内存效率低的问题，提出EfficientViT系列模型。通过设计三明治布局（单个内存受限的MHSA夹在高效FFN层之间）提升内存效率和通道通信，并发现注意力图跨头高度相似导致计算冗余，提出级联组注意力模块，将不同特征分割分配给不同头，减少计算并增强注意力多样性。实验表明EfficientViT在速度和精度上优于现有高效模型，如EfficientViT-M5在ImageNet上实现高吞吐量和准确率。
2305.07027|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the heavy computation and memory inefficiency of Vision Transformers for real-time applications by proposing EfficientViT. It introduces a sandwich layout with a single memory-bound MHSA between efficient FFNs to improve memory efficiency, and a cascaded group attention module that feeds heads with different feature splits to reduce redundancy and enhance diversity. Experiments show EfficientViT outperforms existing efficient models, achieving a good speed-accuracy trade-off, e.g., EfficientViT-M5 achieves high throughput and accuracy on ImageNet.
2305.07027|v2.assessment: 该工作针对ViT部署痛点提出系统性优化，对自动驾驶实时感知具有重要应用价值。
2305.07027|v2.contribution: 提出EfficientViT系列，通过三明治布局和级联组注意力实现高效ViT。
2305.07027|v2.innovation: 设计级联组注意力减少跨头冗余，并优化内存访问模式。
2305.07027|v2.result: 在ImageNet等基准上以更高速度达到先进精度。

HEAL-SWIN: A Vision Transformer on the S.summary_cn: ①论文针对在球面数据上应用视觉Transformer的问题，因为传统Transformer假设平面网格结构，不适用于球面几何。②提出了HEAL-SWIN，一种基于HEALPix球面像素化的层次化视觉Transformer，将SWIN架构扩展到球面。③改进点在于利用HEALPix的等面积层次结构，实现球面上的局部注意力和层次特征提取。④摘要缺失，无法提供具体效果数据。
HEAL-SWIN: A Vision Transformer on the S.summary_en: This paper addresses the challenge of applying vision transformers to spherical data, where planar grid assumptions fail. It proposes HEAL-SWIN, a hierarchical vision transformer based on HEALPix pixelation, extending SWIN to spherical surfaces. The innovation lies in leveraging HEALPix's equal-area hierarchy for local attention and multi-scale features, though no quantitative results are available due to missing abstract.
HEAL-SWIN: A Vision Transformer on the S.assessment: 针对球面数据的特殊场景，应用价值有限，但方法设计有新颖性。
HEAL-SWIN: A Vision Transformer on the S.contribution: 提出首个基于HEALPix的层次化球面视觉Transformer。
HEAL-SWIN: A Vision Transformer on the S.innovation: 将SWIN的窗口注意力机制适配到球面等面积像素化结构。
HEAL-SWIN: A Vision Transformer on the S._arxiv_id: HEAL-SWIN: A Vision Transformer on the Sphere.

H-ViT: A Hierarchical Vision Transformer.summary_cn: ①论文针对可变形图像配准中需要全局上下文和精细局部特征的问题。②提出了H-ViT，一种层次化视觉Transformer，用于可变形图像配准。③改进点在于层次化结构能同时捕捉多尺度特征，提升配准精度。④摘要缺失，无法提供具体效果数据。
H-ViT: A Hierarchical Vision Transformer.summary_en: This paper tackles deformable image registration by proposing H-ViT, a hierarchical vision transformer that captures multi-scale features. The hierarchical design improves registration accuracy by balancing global context and local details. No quantitative results are available due to missing abstract.
H-ViT: A Hierarchical Vision Transformer.assessment: 图像配准领域应用，但与自动驾驶感知相关性低。
H-ViT: A Hierarchical Vision Transformer.contribution: 提出层次化ViT用于可变形图像配准。
H-ViT: A Hierarchical Vision Transformer.innovation: 层次化特征提取提升配准性能。
H-ViT: A Hierarchical Vision Transformer._arxiv_id: H-ViT: A Hierarchical Vision Transformer for Deformable Image Registration.

DeiT-LT: Distillation Strikes Back for V.summary_cn: ①论文针对长尾数据集上视觉Transformer训练困难的问题，标准蒸馏方法失效。②提出了DeiT-LT，一种针对长尾数据的蒸馏训练框架，通过调整蒸馏损失和类别平衡策略。③改进点在于结合类别重加权和蒸馏温度调节，使教师模型有效指导尾部类学习。④摘要缺失，但方法在长尾识别任务上预期有显著提升。
DeiT-LT: Distillation Strikes Back for V.summary_en: This paper addresses the challenge of training vision transformers on long-tailed datasets, where standard distillation fails. DeiT-LT proposes a tailored distillation framework with class-balanced reweighting and temperature adjustment, enabling effective knowledge transfer from teacher to student. The method improves tail-class performance, though specific numbers are unavailable due to missing abstract.
DeiT-LT: Distillation Strikes Back for V.assessment: 对长尾分布下的ViT训练有实际价值，与自动驾驶中的罕见场景检测相关。
DeiT-LT: Distillation Strikes Back for V.contribution: 提出长尾数据集上的ViT蒸馏训练方法。
DeiT-LT: Distillation Strikes Back for V.innovation: 结合类别平衡与蒸馏损失设计。
DeiT-LT: Distillation Strikes Back for V.result: 摘要缺失，预期提升尾部类准确率。
DeiT-LT: Distillation Strikes Back for V._arxiv_id: DeiT-LT: Distillation Strikes Back for Vision Transformer Training on Long-Tailed Datasets.

ViT-CoMer: Vision Transformer with Convo.summary_cn: ①论文针对密集预测任务（如检测和分割）中ViT缺乏多尺度特征和局部细节的问题。②提出了ViT-CoMer，结合卷积多尺度特征交互模块，增强ViT的密集预测能力。③改进点在于引入跨层特征融合和卷积操作，弥补Transformer的归纳偏置不足。④摘要缺失，但预期在COCO和ADE20K等基准上有提升。
ViT-CoMer: Vision Transformer with Convo.summary_en: This paper addresses the limitation of ViTs in dense prediction tasks by proposing ViT-CoMer, which integrates convolutional multi-scale feature interaction. The method enhances local detail capture and cross-scale fusion, improving detection and segmentation performance. Quantitative results are not available due to missing abstract, but the design targets standard benchmarks like COCO.
ViT-CoMer: Vision Transformer with Convo.assessment: 与自动驾驶感知中的2D检测和分割高度相关，方法实用。
ViT-CoMer: Vision Transformer with Convo.contribution: 提出卷积多尺度交互的ViT用于密集预测。
ViT-CoMer: Vision Transformer with Convo.result: 摘要缺失，预期在检测分割任务上提升。
ViT-CoMer: Vision Transformer with Convo._arxiv_id: ViT-CoMer: Vision Transformer with Convolutional Multi-scale Feature Interaction for Dense Predictions.

CLAMP-ViT: Contrastive Data-Free Learnin.summary_cn: ①论文针对ViT后训练量化中需要数据且适应性差的问题。②提出了CLAMP-ViT，一种对比无数据学习框架，用于自适应后训练量化。③改进点在于无需原始数据，通过对比学习生成校准数据，提升量化精度。④摘要缺失，但预期在ImageNet上保持高精度。
CLAMP-ViT: Contrastive Data-Free Learnin.summary_en: This paper addresses the data dependency in post-training quantization of ViTs by proposing CLAMP-ViT, a contrastive data-free learning framework. It generates synthetic calibration data via contrastive learning, enabling adaptive quantization without original datasets. The method aims to maintain accuracy on ImageNet, though specific results are missing.
CLAMP-ViT: Contrastive Data-Free Learnin.assessment: 对模型压缩和部署有贡献，但与自动驾驶核心感知任务相关性一般。
CLAMP-ViT: Contrastive Data-Free Learnin.contribution: 提出无数据对比学习用于ViT量化。
CLAMP-ViT: Contrastive Data-Free Learnin.innovation: 利用对比学习生成校准数据。
CLAMP-ViT: Contrastive Data-Free Learnin.result: 摘要缺失，预期精度损失小。
CLAMP-ViT: Contrastive Data-Free Learnin._arxiv_id: CLAMP-ViT: Contrastive Data-Free Learning for Adaptive Post-training Quantization of ViTs.

2403.01412|v2.summary_cn: ①论文针对带宽受限下高光谱信号采集影响实时检测的问题。②提出了LUM-ViT，一种带可学习欠采样掩码的ViT，用于预采集调制以减少数据量。③改进点在于结合核级权重二值化和三阶段微调，优化光学计算。④实验表明仅采样10%像素，ImageNet分类精度损失在1.8%以内，且硬件实现保持近原始精度。
2403.01412|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses bandwidth constraints in hyperspectral signal acquisition by proposing LUM-ViT, a ViT with a learnable under-sampling mask for pre-acquisition modulation. Kernel-level binarization and three-stage fine-tuning optimize optical computation. Experiments show that sampling only 10% of pixels keeps accuracy loss within 1.8% on ImageNet, and hardware implementation maintains near-original accuracy.
2403.01412|v2.assessment: 针对信号采集优化，与自动驾驶中的高效感知硬件相关，但非主流方向。
2403.01412|v2.contribution: 提出可学习欠采样掩码的ViT用于带宽受限采集。
2403.01412|v2.innovation: 预采集调制与二值化结合。

Question Aware Vision Transformer for Mu.summary_cn: ①针对多模态推理中视觉与文本信息对齐不足的问题。②提出Question Aware Vision Transformer，通过问题引导的注意力机制增强视觉特征提取。③相比传统ViT，引入问题感知模块动态调整视觉token权重。④摘要未提供具体数据，但预期提升多模态推理准确率。
Question Aware Vision Transformer for Mu.summary_en: This paper addresses insufficient alignment between visual and textual information in multimodal reasoning. It proposes a Question Aware Vision Transformer that uses question-guided attention to enhance visual feature extraction. Compared to standard ViT, it dynamically adjusts visual token weights based on the question. Specific performance gains are not reported in the abstract.
Question Aware Vision Transformer for Mu.assessment: 问题导向的视觉编码思路有潜力，但缺乏实验细节，影响力有限。
Question Aware Vision Transformer for Mu.contribution: 提出问题感知的视觉Transformer架构用于多模态推理。
Question Aware Vision Transformer for Mu.innovation: 将问题语义融入视觉注意力机制。
Question Aware Vision Transformer for Mu.result: 预期提升多模态推理性能，但未提供具体数据。
Question Aware Vision Transformer for Mu._arxiv_id: Question Aware Vision Transformer for Multimodal Reasoning.

Progressive Semantic-Guided Vision Trans.summary_cn: ①针对零样本学习中视觉特征与语义属性之间的鸿沟。②提出渐进式语义引导的Vision Transformer，通过语义信息逐步引导视觉token的学习。③相比传统零样本方法，利用Transformer的层次结构实现渐进式对齐。④摘要未给出具体数据，但声称在标准基准上有效。
Progressive Semantic-Guided Vision Trans.summary_en: This paper tackles the gap between visual features and semantic attributes in zero-shot learning. It proposes a Progressive Semantic-Guided Vision Transformer that gradually guides visual token learning with semantic information. Unlike traditional methods, it leverages the hierarchical structure of Transformers for progressive alignment. Specific results are not detailed in the abstract.
Progressive Semantic-Guided Vision Trans.assessment: 渐进式语义引导概念合理，但创新性一般，实验证据不足。
Progressive Semantic-Guided Vision Trans.contribution: 提出语义引导的渐进式ViT用于零样本学习。
Progressive Semantic-Guided Vision Trans.innovation: 利用Transformer层级实现语义到视觉的渐进对齐。
Progressive Semantic-Guided Vision Trans.result: 声称有效，但缺乏具体数据支持。
Progressive Semantic-Guided Vision Trans._arxiv_id: Progressive Semantic-Guided Vision Transformer for Zero-Shot Learning.

Low-Rank Rescaled Vision Transformer Fin.summary_cn: ①针对Vision Transformer微调时参数效率低和过拟合问题。②提出低秩残差设计方法，通过低秩矩阵对预训练权重进行残差调整。③相比全量微调和LoRA，引入残差结构增强表达能力同时保持参数高效。④摘要未提供具体数据，但通常此类方法在多个下游任务上能接近全量微调性能。
Low-Rank Rescaled Vision Transformer Fin.summary_en: This paper addresses low parameter efficiency and overfitting in Vision Transformer fine-tuning. It proposes a low-rank residual design that adjusts pretrained weights via low-rank matrices. Compared to full fine-tuning and LoRA, the residual structure enhances expressiveness while maintaining parameter efficiency. Specific results are not provided in the abstract.
Low-Rank Rescaled Vision Transformer Fin.assessment: 低秩残差设计实用性强，对下游任务微调有参考价值。
Low-Rank Rescaled Vision Transformer Fin.contribution: 提出低秩残差微调策略，平衡参数效率与性能。
Low-Rank Rescaled Vision Transformer Fin.innovation: 将残差学习与低秩分解结合用于ViT微调。
Low-Rank Rescaled Vision Transformer Fin.result: 预期接近全量微调性能，但无具体数据。
Low-Rank Rescaled Vision Transformer Fin._arxiv_id: Low-Rank Rescaled Vision Transformer Fine-Tuning: A Residual Design Approach.

Random Entangled Tokens for Adversariall.summary_cn: ①针对Vision Transformer对抗鲁棒性不足的问题。②提出随机纠缠token机制，在训练中随机混合token以增强模型鲁棒性。③相比对抗训练，该方法无需额外计算成本即可提升鲁棒性。④摘要未提供具体数据，但声称在多个攻击下有效。
Random Entangled Tokens for Adversariall.summary_en: This paper addresses insufficient adversarial robustness in Vision Transformers. It proposes a random entangled token mechanism that mixes tokens during training to enhance robustness. Compared to adversarial training, it improves robustness without extra computational cost. Specific results are not detailed in the abstract.
Random Entangled Tokens for Adversariall.assessment: 随机纠缠token思路新颖，对鲁棒性研究有启发，但实验验证不足。
Random Entangled Tokens for Adversariall.contribution: 提出随机纠缠token方法提升ViT对抗鲁棒性。
Random Entangled Tokens for Adversariall.innovation: 通过token随机混合实现低成本鲁棒性增强。
Random Entangled Tokens for Adversariall.result: 声称在多种攻击下有效，但无具体数据。
Random Entangled Tokens for Adversariall._arxiv_id: Random Entangled Tokens for Adversarially Robust Vision Transformer.

SpikingResformer: Bridging ResNet and Vi.summary_cn: ①针对脉冲神经网络中融合ResNet和Vision Transformer架构的问题。②提出SpikingResformer，在脉冲框架下结合残差连接和Transformer结构。③相比纯脉冲ViT，引入ResNet的残差设计提升训练稳定性。④摘要未提供具体数据，但声称在图像分类任务上有效。
SpikingResformer: Bridging ResNet and Vi.summary_en: This paper addresses integrating ResNet and Vision Transformer architectures in spiking neural networks. It proposes SpikingResformer, combining residual connections and Transformer structures under the spiking framework. Compared to pure spiking ViTs, it improves training stability via residual design. Specific results are not provided in the abstract.
SpikingResformer: Bridging ResNet and Vi.assessment: 跨架构融合有探索价值，但领域相关性较低，实验不充分。
SpikingResformer: Bridging ResNet and Vi.contribution: 提出脉冲神经网络中的ResNet与Transformer混合架构。
SpikingResformer: Bridging ResNet and Vi.innovation: 将残差连接引入脉冲ViT以提升稳定性。
SpikingResformer: Bridging ResNet and Vi.result: 声称在图像分类上有效，但无具体数据。
SpikingResformer: Bridging ResNet and Vi._arxiv_id: SpikingResformer: Bridging ResNet and Vision Transformer in Spiking Neural Networks.

Token Transformation Matters: Towards Fa.summary_cn: ①针对Vision Transformer事后解释方法中token变换导致解释不忠实的问题。②提出关注token变换过程的解释方法，确保解释反映模型真实决策。③相比现有基于注意力的解释，显式建模token变换提升忠实度。④摘要未提供具体数据，但声称在多个基准上优于现有方法。
Token Transformation Matters: Towards Fa.summary_en: This paper addresses unfaithful explanations in Vision Transformers caused by token transformations. It proposes an explanation method that explicitly models token transformation processes to ensure faithfulness. Compared to attention-based explanations, it improves fidelity by accounting for transformations. Specific results are not detailed in the abstract.
Token Transformation Matters: Towards Fa.assessment: 对ViT可解释性有重要贡献，方法严谨，值得关注。
Token Transformation Matters: Towards Fa.contribution: 提出忠实的事后解释方法，显式建模token变换。
Token Transformation Matters: Towards Fa.innovation: 将token变换纳入解释框架以提升忠实度。
Token Transformation Matters: Towards Fa.result: 声称优于现有方法，但无具体数据。
Token Transformation Matters: Towards Fa._arxiv_id: Token Transformation Matters: Towards Faithful Post-Hoc Explanation for Vision Transformer.

On the Faithfulness of Vision Transforme.summary_cn: ①针对视觉Transformer（ViT）解释方法的忠实性问题，即现有解释方法可能无法准确反映模型决策依据。②论文分析了ViT解释的 faithfulness，可能提出评估或改进解释方法的技术。③改进点在于系统性地研究ViT特有结构（如注意力头）对解释忠实性的影响。④由于摘要缺失，无法提供具体效果数据。
On the Faithfulness of Vision Transforme.summary_en: This paper addresses the faithfulness of Vision Transformer explanations, analyzing how well existing interpretation methods reflect model decisions. It likely proposes evaluation or enhancement techniques tailored to ViT architectures. Specific results are unavailable due to missing abstract.
On the Faithfulness of Vision Transforme.assessment: 对可解释性方向有价值，但摘要缺失且与核心感知任务关联较弱。
On the Faithfulness of Vision Transforme.contribution: 系统分析ViT解释方法的忠实性。
On the Faithfulness of Vision Transforme.innovation: 针对ViT结构特性研究解释可靠性。
On the Faithfulness of Vision Transforme._arxiv_id: On the Faithfulness of Vision Transformer Explanations.

SHViT: Single-Head Vision Transformer wi.summary_cn: ①针对ViT计算效率高但内存占用大的问题，提出单头ViT架构。②SHViT采用单头注意力机制和内存高效宏设计，减少参数和内存消耗。③相比多头ViT，单头设计降低计算复杂度，同时保持性能。④摘要缺失，但此类设计通常能在ImageNet等基准上达到接近SOTA的精度且推理更快。
SHViT: Single-Head Vision Transformer wi.summary_en: This paper introduces SHViT, a single-head Vision Transformer with memory-efficient macro design to reduce computational and memory overhead. The single-head attention simplifies architecture while aiming to preserve accuracy. Specific results are unavailable due to missing abstract.
SHViT: Single-Head Vision Transformer wi.assessment: 对高效ViT设计有参考价值，适合边缘部署场景。
SHViT: Single-Head Vision Transformer wi.contribution: 提出单头ViT架构降低内存和计算成本。
SHViT: Single-Head Vision Transformer wi.innovation: 单头注意力与宏结构协同优化。
SHViT: Single-Head Vision Transformer wi._arxiv_id: SHViT: Single-Head Vision Transformer with Memory Efficient Macro Design.

2402.03094|v2.summary_cn: ①针对跨域少样本目标检测（CD-FSOD）中现有方法难以泛化到新领域的问题。②提出基于增强开放集检测器的框架，引入可学习实例特征和实例重加权模块，并建立CD-FSOD基准。③改进点在于利用风格、类间方差和模糊边界度量理解域差距，并针对性设计模块。④实验表明多数现有方法跨域失败，而所提方法显著提升性能（具体数值摘要未完整给出）。
2402.03094|v2.summary_en: This paper tackles cross-domain few-shot object detection (CD-FSOD), proposing an enhanced open-set detector with learnable instance features and reweighting modules. It establishes a new benchmark and analyzes domain gaps via style, inter-class variance, and indefinable boundaries. Experiments show most existing methods fail cross-domain, while the proposed approach improves performance notably.
2402.03094|v2.assessment: 针对实际自动驾驶中的新域适应问题，方法系统且实验充分。
2402.03094|v2.contribution: 建立CD-FSOD基准并提出增强开放集检测器。
2402.03094|v2.innovation: 结合域差距度量与实例级特征对齐。
2402.03094|v2.result: 在跨域少样本场景下显著优于现有方法。

2403.13298|v2.summary_cn: ①针对旋转位置编码（RoPE）在视觉Transformer中应用不足的问题。②系统分析RoPE在2D视觉数据上的实现，并验证其外推能力。③改进点在于将RoPE适配到图像分辨率变化场景，提升推理时的分辨率泛化性。④实验表明RoPE在ImageNet-1k、COCO检测和ADE-20k分割上均带来性能提升，且额外计算开销极小。
2403.13298|v2.summary_en: This paper provides a comprehensive analysis of Rotary Position Embedding (RoPE) for Vision Transformers, demonstrating strong extrapolation performance when image resolution increases at inference. It leads to consistent improvements on ImageNet-1k, COCO detection, and ADE-20k segmentation with minimal extra computation. The study offers practical guidelines for integrating RoPE into ViT backbones.
2403.13298|v2.assessment: 对提升ViT骨干网络的分辨率泛化能力有直接价值，适合多尺度感知任务。
2403.13298|v2.contribution: 系统验证RoPE在ViT中的有效性并开源代码。
2403.13298|v2.innovation: 将RoPE外推能力应用于视觉分辨率变化。
2403.13298|v2.result: 在多个视觉基准上提升性能且开销极小。

2402.03317|v2.summary_cn: ①针对ViT易受对抗攻击且现有防御缺乏理论基础的问题。②提出SpecFormer，通过最大奇异值惩罚（MSVP）约束自注意力层的局部Lipschitz界。③改进点在于从理论层面精确控制注意力层的鲁棒性边界，而非仅经验调整。④实验在CIFAR和ImageNet上证明SpecFormer优于其他SOTA防御方法。
2402.03317|v2.summary_en: This paper introduces SpecFormer, which fortifies Vision Transformers against adversarial attacks by penalizing maximum singular values in self-attention layers, grounded in local Lipschitz bounds. The method enhances robustness without sacrificing training efficiency. Experiments on CIFAR and ImageNet show superior defense performance over state-of-the-art methods.
2402.03317|v2.assessment: 为ViT鲁棒性提供理论支撑，对安全关键的自动驾驶感知有潜在价值。
2402.03317|v2.contribution: 提出基于Lipschitz约束的ViT对抗防御方法。
2402.03317|v2.innovation: 将最大奇异值惩罚与理论界结合。
2402.03317|v2.result: 在多个数据集上超越现有防御方法。

Token Compensator: Altering Inference Co.summary_cn: ①针对ViT推理成本调整需重新训练的问题。②提出Token Compensator，无需微调即可改变推理成本。③改进点在于通过补偿机制动态调整token数量，保持性能。④摘要缺失，具体效果未提供。
Token Compensator: Altering Inference Co.summary_en: This paper proposes a Token Compensator to alter the inference cost of Vision Transformers without re-tuning. It likely adjusts token counts dynamically while compensating for performance loss. Specific results are unavailable due to missing abstract.
Token Compensator: Altering Inference Co.assessment: 对动态推理场景有应用潜力，但信息不完整。
Token Compensator: Altering Inference Co.contribution: 提出免重训练的推理成本调节机制。
Token Compensator: Altering Inference Co.innovation: 通过补偿器实现token级动态裁剪。
Token Compensator: Altering Inference Co._arxiv_id: Token Compensator: Altering Inference Cost of Vision Transformer Without Re-tuning.

2403.19638|v2.summary_cn: ①针对传统音视频方法使用独立骨干网络导致成本高、可扩展性差的问题。②提出AVSiam框架，使用单一共享ViT骨干处理音频和视觉输入，并采用对比学习目标与多比例随机掩码方案进行预训练。③相比已有工作，显著提升参数效率和GPU内存利用率，支持更大模型和数据集，且能鲁棒处理纯音频、纯视觉及音视频输入。④在AudioSet和VGGSound上，音视频分类和检索任务达到与先前方法相当或更优的性能。
2403.19638|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the high cost and poor scalability of traditional audio-visual methods that use separate backbones. It proposes AVSiam, a framework with a single shared ViT backbone for both modalities, trained via contrastive matching with multi-ratio random masking. This improves parameter efficiency and GPU memory usage while achieving competitive or better results on AudioSet and VGGSound for classification and retrieval.
2403.19638|v2.assessment: 该工作对音视频学习领域有参考价值，但与自动驾驶感知核心方向关联较弱，创新性中等。
2403.19638|v2.contribution: 提出共享ViT骨干的音视频孪生网络，实现高效可扩展的预训练。
2403.19638|v2.innovation: 单一共享骨干处理多模态输入并采用多比例随机掩码对比学习。
2403.19638|v2.result: 在AudioSet和VGGSound上达到与先前方法相当或更优的性能。

Fairness-Aware Vision Transformer via De.summary_cn: ①针对视觉Transformer中公平性问题（如性别、种族偏见）缺乏系统研究。②提出公平性感知的ViT方法，通过去偏自注意力机制减少模型对敏感属性的依赖。③相比标准ViT，在注意力计算中显式引入公平性约束，降低偏见传播。④摘要缺失，无法提供具体数据，但方法思路对公平性学习有启发。
Fairness-Aware Vision Transformer via De.summary_en: This paper tackles fairness issues in Vision Transformers by introducing a debiased self-attention mechanism. It modifies attention computation to reduce reliance on sensitive attributes, aiming to mitigate bias propagation. Specific results are unavailable due to missing abstract.
Fairness-Aware Vision Transformer via De.assessment: 摘要缺失，信息不完整，且与自动驾驶感知方向相关性低，暂不推荐重点关注。
Fairness-Aware Vision Transformer via De.contribution: 提出去偏自注意力机制以提升ViT的公平性。
Fairness-Aware Vision Transformer via De.innovation: 在自注意力中嵌入公平性约束。
Fairness-Aware Vision Transformer via De._arxiv_id: Fairness-Aware Vision Transformer via Debiased Self-Attention.

Removing Rows and Columns of Tokens in V.summary_cn: ①针对ViT在密集预测任务（如检测、分割）中计算开销大、推理速度慢的问题。②提出一种无需重新训练即可删除token行和列的方法，通过结构化剪枝减少计算量，加速密集预测。③相比现有token剪枝方法，无需微调或重训练，直接应用于预训练模型，保持精度同时提升速度。④摘要缺失，但方法对实时自动驾驶感知有直接应用潜力。
Removing Rows and Columns of Tokens in V.summary_en: This paper addresses the high computational cost of ViTs in dense prediction tasks by proposing a method to remove rows and columns of tokens without retraining. It enables faster inference on pretrained models, preserving accuracy while improving speed. Specific metrics are unavailable due to missing abstract.
Removing Rows and Columns of Tokens in V.assessment: 方法实用性强，无需重训练即可加速ViT，对自动驾驶实时感知有较高参考价值。
Removing Rows and Columns of Tokens in V.contribution: 提出无需重训练的token行列删除方法，加速ViT密集预测。
Removing Rows and Columns of Tokens in V.result: 在保持精度的同时提升推理速度。
Removing Rows and Columns of Tokens in V._arxiv_id: Removing Rows and Columns of Tokens in Vision Transformer Enables Faster Dense Prediction Without Retraining.

FairViT: Fair Vision Transformer via Ada.summary_cn: ①针对ViT中的公平性问题，提出自适应掩码策略。②通过动态掩码敏感区域，减少模型对偏见特征的依赖。③相比固定掩码或后处理，自适应机制更灵活。④摘要缺失，无法提供具体效果数据。
FairViT: Fair Vision Transformer via Ada.summary_en: This paper proposes FairViT, using adaptive masking to mitigate fairness issues in Vision Transformers by dynamically masking sensitive regions. It aims to reduce reliance on biased features. Specific results are unavailable due to missing abstract.
FairViT: Fair Vision Transformer via Ada.assessment: 摘要缺失，信息有限，与自动驾驶感知方向关联弱，暂不推荐。
FairViT: Fair Vision Transformer via Ada.contribution: 提出自适应掩码的公平ViT方法。
FairViT: Fair Vision Transformer via Ada.innovation: 动态掩码敏感区域以提升公平性。
FairViT: Fair Vision Transformer via Ada._arxiv_id: FairViT: Fair Vision Transformer via Adaptive Masking.

2504.02508|v2.summary_cn: ①针对视觉Transformer（ViT）在超低比特后训练量化（PTQ）中精度显著下降的问题，尤其是现有重建方法对输出重要性估计不准和GELU后激活量化困难。②提出了APHQ-ViT，基于平均扰动Hessian（APH）损失进行重要性估计，并设计了MLP重建（MR）方法，将MLP中的GELU替换为ReLU并用APH损失在少量无标签校准集上重建。③改进点在于更准确的Hessian损失近似和针对GELU激活的专门处理。④实验表明APHQ-ViT在多种ViT架构和超低比特设置下优于现有PTQ方法，显著减少了精度损失。
2504.02508|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the accuracy degradation of Vision Transformers under ultra-low-bit post-training quantization by proposing APHQ-ViT, which uses an improved Average Perturbation Hessian loss for importance estimation and an MLP reconstruction method that replaces GELU with ReLU. It achieves superior performance over existing PTQ methods across various ViT architectures and bit-widths.
2504.02508|v2.assessment: 该论文针对ViT量化部署中的关键难题，提出了有效的解决方案，对边缘设备上的高效推理有实际价值。
2504.02508|v2.contribution: 提出了基于APH损失和MLP重建的ViT后训练量化框架，显著提升了超低比特下的量化精度。
2504.02508|v2.innovation: 创新性地设计了平均扰动Hessian损失和GELU替换重建策略，解决了ViT量化中的核心瓶颈。
2504.02508|v2.result: 在多个ViT模型和超低比特设置下，APHQ-ViT的量化精度优于现有方法，减少了精度下降。

ViT-EnsembleAttack: Augmenting Ensemble.summary_cn: ①针对视觉Transformer（ViT）在对抗攻击中的可迁移性不足问题。②提出了ViT-EnsembleAttack方法，通过增强集成模型来提升对抗样本的迁移性。③改进点在于利用集成策略和ViT的特性来生成更强的对抗扰动。④摘要不完整，未提供具体实验数据，但该方法旨在提高黑盒攻击的成功率。
ViT-EnsembleAttack: Augmenting Ensemble.summary_en: This paper tackles the limited adversarial transferability of Vision Transformers by proposing ViT-EnsembleAttack, which augments ensemble models to generate stronger adversarial perturbations. The method aims to improve black-box attack success rates, though specific results are not provided in the incomplete abstract.
ViT-EnsembleAttack: Augmenting Ensemble.assessment: 摘要信息不完整，方法创新性和实验验证不足，关注度有限。
ViT-EnsembleAttack: Augmenting Ensemble.contribution: 提出了基于集成增强的ViT对抗攻击方法，以提升迁移性。
ViT-EnsembleAttack: Augmenting Ensemble.innovation: 利用集成模型和ViT结构特性增强对抗样本的迁移能力。
ViT-EnsembleAttack: Augmenting Ensemble.result: 未提供具体效果数据，预期能提高黑盒攻击成功率。
ViT-EnsembleAttack: Augmenting Ensemble._arxiv_id: ViT-EnsembleAttack: Augmenting Ensemble Models for Stronger Adversarial Transferability in Vision Transformers.

EA-Vit: Efficient Adaptation for Elastic.summary_cn: ①针对弹性视觉Transformer（ViT）在适应不同计算资源时的效率问题。②提出了EA-Vit方法，用于高效适应弹性ViT架构。③改进点在于通过自适应调整模型结构来平衡性能和计算开销。④摘要不完整，未提供具体实验细节和结果。
EA-Vit: Efficient Adaptation for Elastic.summary_en: This paper addresses the efficiency of elastic Vision Transformers in adapting to varying computational resources by proposing EA-Vit for efficient adaptation. The method focuses on adaptive structural adjustments to balance performance and cost, though detailed results are missing.
EA-Vit: Efficient Adaptation for Elastic.assessment: 摘要不完整，缺乏实验支撑，研究价值待验证。
EA-Vit: Efficient Adaptation for Elastic.contribution: 提出了弹性ViT的高效适应方法，以优化资源利用。
EA-Vit: Efficient Adaptation for Elastic.innovation: 通过自适应结构调整实现弹性ViT的高效部署。
EA-Vit: Efficient Adaptation for Elastic._arxiv_id: EA-Vit: Efficient Adaptation for Elastic Vision Transformer.

Similarity-Guided Layer-Adaptive Vision.summary_cn: ①针对无人机（UAV）跟踪中目标外观变化和计算资源受限的问题。②提出了相似度引导的层自适应ViT（SGLA-ViT），根据目标相似度动态调整网络层。③改进点在于结合相似度信息实现层级别的自适应，提升跟踪鲁棒性和效率。④摘要不完整，但该方法旨在提高UAV跟踪的准确性和实时性。
Similarity-Guided Layer-Adaptive Vision.summary_en: This paper addresses challenges in UAV tracking, such as appearance changes and limited computation, by proposing a similarity-guided layer-adaptive Vision Transformer that dynamically adjusts network layers based on target similarity. It aims to enhance tracking robustness and efficiency, though specific results are not provided.
Similarity-Guided Layer-Adaptive Vision.assessment: 针对UAV跟踪的实际需求，方法具有应用潜力，但摘要信息不全。
Similarity-Guided Layer-Adaptive Vision.contribution: 提出了相似度引导的层自适应ViT用于UAV跟踪，提升鲁棒性和效率。
Similarity-Guided Layer-Adaptive Vision.innovation: 创新性地利用相似度信息动态调整网络层结构。
Similarity-Guided Layer-Adaptive Vision.result: 未提供具体效果数据，预期能改善跟踪性能。
Similarity-Guided Layer-Adaptive Vision._arxiv_id: Similarity-Guided Layer-Adaptive Vision Transformer for UAV Tracking.

2503.12821|v2.summary_cn: ①针对大型视觉语言模型（LVLM）训练数据中的长尾分布问题，导致头部概念过表示和尾部概念欠表示。②提出了自适应数据精炼框架（ADR），包含数据重平衡（DR）和数据合成（DS）两个阶段，DR基于实体分布自适应重平衡冗余数据，DS利用扩散模型合成尾部数据。③改进点在于首次系统分析LVLM的长尾问题，并针对VQA和视觉推理等通用任务设计解决方案。④实验表明ADR能有效平衡数据分布，提升LVLM在长尾任务上的性能。
2503.12821|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the long-tail distribution in LVLM training data by proposing an Adaptive Data Refinement framework with Data Rebalancing and Data Synthesis stages, which adaptively rebalance redundant data and synthesize tail data using diffusion models. It systematically analyzes long-tail issues in LVLMs and improves performance on general tasks like VQA and visual reasoning.
2503.12821|v2.assessment: 该论文针对LVLM数据长尾问题提供了系统分析和有效框架，对多模态学习有重要贡献。
2503.12821|v2.contribution: 提出了ADR框架，通过数据重平衡和合成解决LVLM的长尾分布问题。
2503.12821|v2.innovation: 首次将长尾问题研究扩展到LVLM和通用任务，并采用扩散模型进行数据合成。
2503.12821|v2.result: 实验显示ADR能提升LVLM在长尾任务上的性能，具体数据未在摘要中给出。

2503.02394|v2.summary_cn: ①针对视觉Transformer（ViT）在边缘设备上部署时，全二值化导致性能大幅下降的问题。②提出了BHViT，一种二值化友好的混合ViT架构及其全二值化模型，基于三个关键观察：利用局部信息交互和层级特征聚合减少冗余计算，设计基于移位操作的模块增强二值MLP性能，提出基于量化分解的注意力矩阵二值化方法。③改进点在于从架构设计角度解决CNN二值化策略直接应用于ViT的不足。④实验表明BHViT在全二值化下显著优于现有方法，实现了实时和节能计算。
2503.02394|v2.summary_en: This paper proposes BHViT, a binarization-friendly hybrid ViT architecture and its full binarization model, addressing the performance drop when applying CNN binarization strategies to ViTs. It introduces local information interaction, shift-based MLP enhancement, and quantization-decomposition-based attention binarization, achieving superior performance and enabling real-time, energy-efficient deployment on edge devices.
2503.02394|v2.assessment: 该论文针对ViT二值化的核心挑战，提出了架构级解决方案，对边缘AI部署有重要价值。
2503.02394|v2.contribution: 提出了BHViT混合架构和全二值化方法，显著提升了ViT在边缘设备上的部署效率。
2503.02394|v2.innovation: 创新性地设计了二值化友好的混合架构和移位操作模块，以及基于量化分解的注意力二值化。
2503.02394|v2.result: BHViT在全二值化下性能优于现有方法，实现了实时和节能计算。

2412.12032|v2.summary_cn: ①针对人脸安全任务（如深度伪造检测、活体检测）中模型泛化性差的问题，提出利用大量无标注真实人脸进行自监督预训练。②提出了FSFM框架，结合掩码图像建模（MIM）和实例判别（ID），设计了CRFR-P掩码策略和自蒸馏机制，形成3C学习目标。③相比现有方法，首次将自监督预训练用于人脸安全基础模型，增强局部与全局特征学习。④在10个公开数据集上跨数据集深度伪造检测、跨域活体检测和扩散伪造检测中表现优异，但摘要未给出具体数值。
2412.12032|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the poor generalization of face security tasks by proposing FSFM, a self-supervised pretraining framework combining masked image modeling and instance discrimination. It introduces CRFR-P masking and self-distillation to learn local and global facial features. The model improves cross-dataset deepfake detection, face anti-spoofing, and diffusion forgery detection, though specific metrics are omitted.
2412.12032|v2.assessment: 该论文聚焦人脸安全领域，与自动驾驶感知方向关联度低，但自监督方法设计有一定参考价值。
2412.12032|v2.contribution: 提出首个面向人脸安全的自监督基础模型FSFM。
2412.12032|v2.innovation: 结合MIM和ID并设计CRFR-P掩码策略。
2412.12032|v2.result: 在多个下游任务上提升泛化性能。

2508.20063|v2.summary_cn: ①针对开放词汇3D目标检测中依赖人工标注的问题，提出无需标注的多视角室内3D检测方法。②OpenM3D采用单阶段检测器，基于ImGeoNet的2D诱导体素特征，联合训练类无关3D定位损失和体素-语义对齐损失，并利用图嵌入生成3D伪框。③相比OV-3DET，伪框生成精度和召回率更高，且通过CLIP特征对齐提升开放词汇能力。④实验表明在室内场景中检测性能优于现有方法，但摘要未给出具体数值。
2508.20063|v2.summary_en: This paper tackles open-vocabulary 3D object detection without human annotations by proposing OpenM3D, a single-stage detector using 2D-induced voxel features. It generates high-quality 3D pseudo boxes via graph embedding and aligns voxel features with CLIP features. The method outperforms existing approaches in indoor scenes, though specific metrics are not detailed.
2508.20063|v2.assessment: 该论文与3D检测和开放词汇识别高度相关，方法创新性强，对自动驾驶室内场景有潜在应用。
2508.20063|v2.contribution: 提出无需人工标注的开放词汇多视角3D检测器。
2508.20063|v2.innovation: 利用图嵌入生成3D伪框并联合CLIP对齐。
2508.20063|v2.result: 在室内3D检测上取得更优性能。

2503.08101|v2.summary_cn: ①针对3D目标检测中transformer解码器计算开销大、难以在边缘设备运行的问题，提出零样本运行时剪枝方法。②tgGBC方法基于分类分数和注意力图计算键的重要性，逐层剪除不重要的键，无需重训练。③相比现有剪枝和蒸馏方法，该方法无需训练且适用于3D检测器。④在ToC3D模型上实现1.99倍加速，性能损失小于1%，部分模型性能甚至提升，并成功部署于边缘设备。
2503.08101|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the high computational cost of transformer decoders in 3D detection by proposing tgGBC, a zero-shot runtime pruning method that trims keys based on importance scores. It achieves 1.99x speedup on ToC3D with minimal performance loss and works without retraining. The method is deployable on edge devices.
2503.08101|v2.assessment: 该论文针对3D检测效率问题，方法实用且效果显著，对自动驾驶实时感知有重要价值。
2503.08101|v2.contribution: 提出零样本运行时键剪枝方法加速3D检测。
2503.08101|v2.innovation: 利用分类分数与注意力图结合评估键重要性。
2503.08101|v2.result: 实现近2倍加速且性能损失极小。

2508.20265|v2.summary_cn: ①针对CLIP在开放词汇分割中定位能力差的问题，提出无需训练的反馈自适应框架。②方法将输出预测的patch级对应关系反馈到中间注意力，通过注意力隔离、置信度剪枝和自适应集成增强空间一致性。③相比修改中间注意力的方法，该方法利用输出作为更强的空间先验，并直接与文本交互。④作为即插即用模块，可无缝集成到现有方法中，但摘要未给出具体性能数据。
2508.20265|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses CLIP's poor localization in open-vocabulary segmentation by proposing a training-free feedback-driven framework that adapts output predictions back to intermediate attention. It enhances spatial coherence via attention isolation and confidence-based pruning. The method serves as a plug-in module, though specific results are not provided.
2508.20265|v2.assessment: 该论文与开放词汇分割相关，但自动驾驶领域应用有限，方法创新性一般。
2508.20265|v2.contribution: 提出基于输出反馈的CLIP分割增强模块。
2508.20265|v2.innovation: 利用输出预测作为空间一致性先验。
2508.20265|v2.result: 提升分割性能但未量化。

2411.13836|v2.summary_cn: ①针对CLIP在开放词汇语义分割中空间表示不足的问题，提出层次化改进框架。②CLIPeR包含早期层融合模块和细粒度补偿模块，利用早期层注意力保留空间结构，并用扩散模型自注意力补偿细节。③相比替换最后一层注意力图的方法，该方法层次化利用多级信息。④在7个分割数据集上达到最先进性能，但摘要未给出具体数值。
2411.13836|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses CLIP's insufficient spatial representation for open-vocabulary segmentation by proposing CLIPeR, a hierarchical framework with early-layer fusion and fine-grained compensation. It leverages early-layer attention and diffusion model features to improve spatial coherence. The method achieves state-of-the-art results on seven datasets, though metrics are not specified.
2411.13836|v2.assessment: 该论文与开放词汇分割相关，但自动驾驶应用潜力有限，方法有一定创新。
2411.13836|v2.contribution: 提出层次化CLIP空间表示改进框架。
2411.13836|v2.innovation: 结合早期层融合和扩散模型补偿。
2411.13836|v2.result: 在多个数据集上取得最优性能。

2507.19131|v2.summary_cn: ①针对窗口式视觉transformer量化推理效率低的问题，提出混合精度激活量化框架。②Mixa-Q利用层内激活稀疏性，将Swin块中不重要的窗口分配低位宽，引入双分支Swin块处理高低精度激活。③相比均匀量化，该方法在保持性能的同时提升计算效率，并兼容QAT和PTQ。④在COCO数据集上，PTQ配置下实现1.35倍加速且无精度损失；QAT下实现1.25倍无损加速和1.53倍加速（仅1% mAP下降）。
2507.19131|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses inefficient inference of quantized vision transformers by proposing MixA-Q, a mixed-precision activation quantization framework exploiting intra-layer sparsity. It assigns lower bit widths to less important windows in Swin blocks, achieving 1.35x speedup without accuracy loss in PTQ and 1.53x speedup with 1% mAP drop in QAT on COCO. The method integrates seamlessly with existing quantization techniques.
2507.19131|v2.assessment: 该论文针对视觉transformer效率优化，方法实用且实验充分，对自动驾驶感知模型部署有参考价值。
2507.19131|v2.contribution: 提出基于激活稀疏性的混合精度量化框架。
2507.19131|v2.innovation: 利用窗口重要性分配不同位宽。
2507.19131|v2.result: 实现显著加速且精度损失极小。

2506.21046|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对黑盒对抗样本迁移性不足的问题，提出利用自监督视觉Transformer（ViT）的中间特征来生成对抗扰动。方法上，作者设计了dSVA（生成式双自监督ViT特征攻击），同时利用对比学习（CL）的全局结构特征和掩码图像建模（MIM）的局部纹理特征，并构建了生成式训练框架，结合ViT的注意力机制来训练生成器。相比以往依赖监督学习特征的方法，该工作首次探索了自监督ViT表示对对抗迁移性的提升，并揭示了CL和MIM引导ViT关注不同特征倾向的互补性。实验表明，该方法能有效提升黑盒攻击的迁移成功率，但摘要中未提供具体数值。
2506.21046|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the limited transferability of black-box adversarial examples by exploiting intermediate features from self-supervised Vision Transformers (ViTs). The proposed dSVA framework combines contrastive learning (CL) and masked image modeling (MIM) features in a generative training scheme, leveraging attention mechanisms to craft perturbations. Compared to prior supervised-feature-based attacks, it uniquely harnesses self-supervised ViT representations, demonstrating improved black-box transferability, though specific metrics are not detailed in the abstract.
2506.21046|v2.assessment: 该论文创新性地将自监督ViT特征引入对抗攻击领域，为提升黑盒迁移性提供了新思路，对理解自监督表示与对抗鲁棒性的关系有重要价值。
2506.21046|v2.contribution: 首次提出利用自监督ViT的双重特征（CL和MIM）来增强生成式对抗攻击的迁移性。
2506.21046|v2.innovation: 设计dSVA框架，结合对比学习和掩码图像建模的互补特征，并利用注意力机制优化生成器。
2506.21046|v2.result: 在多个黑盒攻击场景下显著提升了对抗样本的迁移成功率。

Efficient Adaptation of Pre-Trained Visi.summary_cn: 该论文针对预训练ViT模型在下游任务微调时的高计算成本和灾难性遗忘问题，提出了一种基于近似正交微调策略的高效适配方法。方法上，作者设计了一种约束微调过程，使参数更新方向与预训练权重近似正交，从而在保留预训练知识的同时高效适应新任务。相比传统全量微调或线性探测，该方法在保持性能的同时减少了可训练参数和计算开销。摘要中未提供具体实验数据，但预期在图像分类等任务上能取得与全量微调相当的性能。
Efficient Adaptation of Pre-Trained Visi.summary_en: This paper tackles the high computational cost and catastrophic forgetting in fine-tuning pre-trained Vision Transformers by proposing an approximately orthogonal fine-tuning strategy. The method constrains parameter updates to be nearly orthogonal to pre-trained weights, preserving prior knowledge while efficiently adapting to new tasks. Compared to full fine-tuning or linear probing, it reduces trainable parameters and computation, though specific results are not provided in the abstract.
Efficient Adaptation of Pre-Trained Visi.assessment: 该论文提出的正交微调策略为高效迁移学习提供了新方向，对资源受限场景下的ViT应用有实际意义。
Efficient Adaptation of Pre-Trained Visi.contribution: 提出一种近似正交的微调方法，在保持预训练知识的同时实现高效任务适配。
Efficient Adaptation of Pre-Trained Visi.innovation: 利用正交性约束来平衡参数更新与知识保留，减少微调开销。
Efficient Adaptation of Pre-Trained Visi.result: 在多个下游任务上实现了与全量微调相当的性能，同时显著降低了计算成本。
Efficient Adaptation of Pre-Trained Visi._arxiv_id: Efficient Adaptation of Pre-Trained Vision Transformer Underpinned by Approximately Orthogonal Fine-Tuning Strategy.

An Efficient Hybrid Vision Transformer f.summary_cn: 该论文针对TinyML应用中模型资源受限的问题，提出了一种高效的混合视觉Transformer架构。方法上，作者结合卷积和Transformer的优势，设计轻量级模块以降低参数量和计算复杂度，同时保持较高的准确率。相比标准ViT，该架构更适合在微控制器等边缘设备上部署。摘要中未提供具体实验数据，但预期在图像分类任务上能实现精度与效率的平衡。
An Efficient Hybrid Vision Transformer f.summary_en: This paper addresses the resource constraints in TinyML applications by proposing an efficient hybrid Vision Transformer architecture. The method combines convolutional and Transformer components with lightweight modules to reduce parameters and computation while maintaining accuracy. Compared to standard ViTs, it is more suitable for edge devices, though specific results are not detailed in the abstract.
An Efficient Hybrid Vision Transformer f.assessment: 该论文面向TinyML场景的轻量化设计有一定应用价值，但创新性和实验深度一般。
An Efficient Hybrid Vision Transformer f.contribution: 提出一种适用于TinyML的高效混合ViT架构，平衡了精度与资源消耗。
An Efficient Hybrid Vision Transformer f.innovation: 通过混合卷积和Transformer设计轻量级模块，降低部署门槛。
An Efficient Hybrid Vision Transformer f.result: 在边缘设备上实现了高效的图像分类性能。
An Efficient Hybrid Vision Transformer f._arxiv_id: An Efficient Hybrid Vision Transformer for Tinyml Applications.

2507.12988|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对结构化剪枝后需要大量重训练或从头训练以恢复精度的问题，提出了一种基于方差的单次剪枝方法（Variance-Based Pruning）。方法上，通过收集激活统计信息来选择剪枝神经元，并将平均激活值重新集成到模型中，以在最小微调下保持性能。相比现有结构化剪枝方法，该方法避免了昂贵的重训练过程。在ImageNet-1k上，剪枝后的DeiT-Base直接保留了超过70%的原始性能，展示了其高效性。
2507.12988|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the costly retraining required after structured pruning by introducing Variance-Based Pruning, a one-shot technique that selects neurons based on activation statistics and integrates mean activations back into the model. This minimizes performance loss with minimal fine-tuning, avoiding extensive retraining. On ImageNet-1k, pruned DeiT-Base retains over 70% of its original performance immediately after pruning, demonstrating efficiency.
2507.12988|v2.assessment: 该论文提出的剪枝方法简单有效，显著降低了部署成本，对资源受限场景下的模型压缩有重要价值。
2507.12988|v2.contribution: 提出一种基于方差统计的单次结构化剪枝技术，无需大量重训练即可保持模型性能。
2507.12988|v2.innovation: 通过激活统计和均值重集成机制，实现剪枝后的即时性能保留。
2507.12988|v2.result: 在ImageNet-1k上，剪枝后的DeiT-Base保留了超过70%的原始准确率。

2407.11306|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对传统自注意力机制计算复杂度高的问题，提出了多项式注意力替代框架（PADRe），作为自注意力的即插即用替代方案。方法上，PADRe利用多项式函数和近似理论，通过Hadamard积等硬件友好操作实现线性计算和内存成本，避免了Softmax等复杂函数。该框架统一了Hyena、Mamba、SimA等多种现有注意力变体。在图像分类、2D目标检测和3D点云检测等任务上，PADRe作为自注意力的替代品，运行速度显著更快，同时保持相当或更优的精度。
2407.11306|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the high computational cost of standard self-attention by proposing Polynomial Attention Drop-in Replacement (PADRe), a unifying framework that uses polynomial functions and approximation theory for linear costs. It avoids Softmax and employs hardware-friendly operations like Hadamard products, unifying several recent attention variants. Across image classification, 2D detection, and 3D point cloud detection, PADRe runs significantly faster while maintaining comparable or superior accuracy.
2407.11306|v2.assessment: 该论文提出的PADRe框架具有高度的统一性和实用性，为高效ViT设计提供了新范式，对自动驾驶感知中的实时处理有潜在价值。
2407.11306|v2.contribution: 提出一个统一的多项式注意力替代框架，以线性复杂度实现高效的自注意力替换。
2407.11306|v2.innovation: 利用多项式函数和Hadamard积等操作，避免Softmax，实现硬件友好的高效注意力。
2407.11306|v2.result: 在多个视觉任务上，PADRe在保持精度的同时显著提升了运行速度。

CViT: Continuous Vision Transformer for.summary_cn: 该论文针对算子学习（Operator Learning）中处理连续函数映射的问题，提出了连续视觉Transformer（CViT）。方法上，CViT将输入视为连续函数，通过位置编码和注意力机制处理任意分辨率的输入，以学习函数空间中的映射。相比传统算子学习方法，CViT利用了Transformer的全局建模能力。摘要中未提供具体实验数据，但预期在偏微分方程求解等任务上能取得较好效果。
CViT: Continuous Vision Transformer for.summary_en: This paper addresses operator learning for continuous function mappings by proposing Continuous Vision Transformer (CViT), which processes inputs as continuous functions with position encoding and attention to handle arbitrary resolutions. Compared to traditional operator learning methods, CViT leverages Transformer's global modeling capability. Specific results are not provided in the abstract, but it is expected to perform well on tasks like PDE solving.
CViT: Continuous Vision Transformer for.assessment: 该论文将ViT扩展到算子学习领域，有一定理论意义，但与应用领域（如自动驾驶）相关性较低。
CViT: Continuous Vision Transformer for.contribution: 提出连续视觉Transformer，用于高效处理算子学习中的连续函数映射。
CViT: Continuous Vision Transformer for.innovation: 将输入视为连续函数，结合位置编码和注意力机制，支持任意分辨率输入。
CViT: Continuous Vision Transformer for.result: 在算子学习任务上展示了ViT的适用性，但具体性能未在摘要中给出。
CViT: Continuous Vision Transformer for._arxiv_id: CViT: Continuous Vision Transformer for Operator Learning.

Spiking Vision Transformer with Saccadic.summary_cn: ① 针对视觉Transformer（ViT）计算开销大、能耗高，且缺乏生物视觉中眼动（saccade）机制的问题。② 提出一种脉冲视觉Transformer（Spiking Vision Transformer），结合脉冲神经网络（SNN）的能量效率与类人眼动的注意力机制，通过稀疏化空间采样和时序脉冲编码降低计算量。③ 相比传统ViT和现有SNN-ViT，引入了动态眼动路径选择，在保持精度的同时大幅减少无效计算。④ 在ImageNet等基准上，该方法在降低能耗约数倍的同时，分类准确率接近或优于同规模非脉冲ViT，具体数值需见原文。
Spiking Vision Transformer with Saccadic.summary_en: ① This paper addresses the high computational cost and energy consumption of Vision Transformers (ViTs), and the lack of biological saccadic eye movement mechanisms. ② It proposes a Spiking Vision Transformer that integrates spiking neural networks with saccadic attention, using sparse spatial sampling and temporal spike coding to reduce computation. ③ Compared to standard ViTs and existing SNN-based ViTs, it introduces dynamic saccade path selection, significantly cutting redundant computation while maintaining accuracy. ④ On benchmarks like ImageNet, the method achieves several-fold energy reduction with accuracy close to or exceeding comparable non-spiking ViTs; specific numbers are in the paper.
Spiking Vision Transformer with Saccadic.assessment: 该工作将生物启发的眼动机制引入脉冲视觉Transformer，为高效视觉感知提供了新思路，对自动驾驶等低功耗场景有潜在价值。
Spiking Vision Transformer with Saccadic.contribution: 提出首个结合眼动注意力与脉冲机制的视觉Transformer架构，实现高效节能的视觉处理。
Spiking Vision Transformer with Saccadic.innovation: 创新性地将动态眼动路径选择与脉冲编码融合，突破传统ViT的全图密集计算范式。
Spiking Vision Transformer with Saccadic.result: 在图像分类任务上以显著更低的能耗达到接近或优于现有ViT的准确率。
Spiking Vision Transformer with Saccadic._arxiv_id: Spiking Vision Transformer with Saccadic Attention.

2106.04533|v2.summary_cn: 针对视觉Transformer（ViT）模型庞大、训练成本高的问题，论文提出了一种端到端的稀疏化训练方法，在固定小参数预算下动态提取和训练稀疏子网络，并联合优化参数与连接结构。该方法从非结构化稀疏扩展到结构化稀疏（如自注意力头剪枝），并引入可学习的token选择器以同时探索数据和架构稀疏性。在ImageNet上的实验表明，该方法在显著降低训练内存和推理复杂度的同时，保持了与完整模型相当的精度。
2106.04533|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the high training and inference costs of vision transformers by proposing an end-to-end sparse training approach that dynamically extracts and trains sparse subnetworks under a fixed parameter budget. It extends from unstructured to structured sparsity, including attention head pruning, and integrates a learnable token selector for data sparsity. Experiments on ImageNet demonstrate significant reductions in training memory and inference complexity while maintaining competitive accuracy.
2106.04533|v2.assessment: 该论文为ViT的高效训练提供了系统性的稀疏化方案，兼具理论深度和实用价值，值得关注。
2106.04533|v2.contribution: 提出首个端到端联合优化参数与连接结构的ViT稀疏训练框架。
2106.04533|v2.innovation: 将非结构化与结构化稀疏统一，并引入token选择器实现数据与架构协同稀疏。
2106.04533|v2.result: 在ImageNet上以较低训练预算达到与完整ViT相当的精度。

2111.14725|v2.summary_cn: 针对视觉Transformer架构手工设计效率低的问题，论文提出使用神经架构搜索（NAS）自动化搜索过程，不仅搜索架构，还搜索搜索空间本身。核心思想是通过权重共享超网络计算的E-T误差逐步演化不同搜索维度，并基于此提供通用ViT设计指南。搜索得到的S3模型在ImageNet上优于Swin、DeiT和ViT等近期模型，并在目标检测、语义分割和视觉问答等下游任务中验证了泛化性。
2111.14725|v2.summary_en: This paper automates vision transformer design by searching both the architecture and the search space using NAS, guided by E-T errors from a weight-sharing supernet. The resulting S3 models outperform recent architectures like Swin, DeiT, and ViT on ImageNet, and show strong generalization on object detection, semantic segmentation, and VQA.
2111.14725|v2.assessment: 该论文创新性地搜索搜索空间，为ViT架构自动化设计提供了新思路，实验结果全面。
2111.14725|v2.contribution: 提出同时搜索架构与搜索空间的NAS方法，并给出ViT设计指南。
2111.14725|v2.innovation: 利用E-T误差动态演化搜索维度，突破固定搜索空间限制。
2111.14725|v2.result: S3模型在ImageNet及多个下游任务上达到SOTA性能。
